You probably think that working for an online travel agency that manages hundreds of millions of bookings per year or working for an airline that operates hundreds of thousands of flights per year must bring their fair chair of challenge. Monitor performances and manage database parameters, to provide best-of-class experience.
Investigate operational incidents, debug problems and provide solutions for recovery, in 24x7 operational conditions.
Contribute with colleagues to the on-call roster.
Write and maintain database documentation, platform specifications and procedural descriptions.
Work closely with database development team, for continuous improvement of the MariaDB automation & ecosystem based on operational return-of-experience.

3+ years managing MySQL or MariaDB database technologies, in a critical, highly available enterprise environment.
Experience in working with Linux platform.

Como Site Document Controller desempeñarás un papel importante en actuar como el punto central de control y seguimiento del proyecto. A través de la planificación, monitoreo y análisis del avance en campo, permite anticipar riesgos, controlar cronogramas y asegurar que las actividades de construcción avancen de manera coordinada, contribuyendo directamente al cumplimiento de los objetivos de tiempo, costo y calidad del proyecto
Este es un rol para alguien que quiere combinar calidad con propósito, aprender en un negocio internacional dinámico y construir experiencia en una de las industrias más relevantes del mundo.

Dar seguimiento al avance diario de las actividades de construcción para asegurar el cumplimiento del cronograma del proyecto.
Apoyar la elaboración y actualización de la planificación general del proyecto y sus líneas base.

Preparar reportes de avance, indicadores KPI, curvas S y análisis de desempeño para la toma de decisiones.

Experiencia práctica en un rol donde el desafío es estimulante, dinámico, significativo y basado en el aprendizaje práctico

Experiencia práctica en planificación y control de proyectos dentro de un entorno internacional, dinámico y colaborativo, con exposición a las mejores prácticas de construcción y gestión de proyectos.

Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en planificación y programación de proyectos dentro de organizaciones EPC.

Manejo de MS Project y Microsoft Office; experiencia en Primavera P6 será valorada.
Experiencia trabajando en sitio de construcción y coordinando actividades de campo.
Inglés intermedio y experiencia en proyectos de energía renovable serán considerados una ventaja.
Habilidades clave: organización, proactividad, enfoque a resultados, manejo de riesgos, toma de decisiones y fuerte sentido de responsabilidad (“ownership”)

En Scatec, combinamos propósito con desempeño. Valoramos la responsabilidad, la claridad y la colaboración, y alentamos a las personas a desafiar las formas de trabajo existentes, aportar ideas y seguir desarrollándose. Puedes esperar un entorno donde las personas trabajan juntas a través de disciplinas y geografías, donde el buen desempeño importa y donde se confía en ti para asumir responsabilidades sin jerarquías innecesarias.
Si te motiva ser el próximo Site Document Planner, este podría ser el siguiente paso sólido en tu carrera

En Scatec, formarás parte de una empresa con un propósito claro y ambicioso, trabajando en soluciones de energía renovable que generan una diferencia duradera. Asumirás responsabilidades desde temprano, aprenderás de colegas experimentados y desarrollarás tus capacidades en un negocio que ofrece exposición global, fuertes oportunidades de desarrollo y trabajo significativo en la transición energética. jobs.title: Senior HR Generalist
jobs.description:
Schedule:
Full-Time, Ontario / Eastern Time Business Hours

Compensation:
C$32,000–C$44,000 annually, plus performance-based bonuses

About Langford Staffing

Langford Staffing is a growing recruitment and workforce-services company supporting businesses with hiring, onboarding, employee administration, and workforce management.

We are strengthening our internal HR function to provide employees and managers with consistent support across onboarding, training, performance, leave administration, employee relations, and offboarding.

About The Role

Langford Staffing is hiring a Senior HR Generalist to manage day-to-day HR operations while leading company-wide onboarding and employee training.

This person must be outgoing, confident, and comfortable speaking with employees and managers throughout the day. You will lead live onboarding sessions, explain policies and expectations, encourage participation, assess employee understanding, and provide retraining when procedures are not being followed.

A major part of the role will involve building and improving structured training modules. You will be expected to turn policies, procedures, and company standards into clear presentations, facilitator guides, quizzes, scenarios, checklists, readiness assessments, and supporting materials.

You must also be comfortable using AI tools to help research, organize, draft, improve, and update training content while applying your own judgment, fact-checking the material, protecting confidential information, and ensuring everything accurately reflects company requirements.

The role also includes employee relations, performance documentation, probation tracking, attendance, leaves, employee records, and offboarding.

This is not an HR Coordinator position. We are looking for an experienced generalist who can independently manage routine HR matters, build effective training programs, support managers, and recognize when an issue requires escalation.

How To Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver new-hire orientation and foundational company training
Build training modules from company policies, procedures, systems, and workplace standards
Create presentations, facilitator guides, quizzes, scenarios, checklists, reference materials, and readiness assessments
Use AI tools to support training development, research, content organization, assessment creation, and material updates
Review and validate all AI-assisted content before it is used
Train employees on workplace expectations, policies, communication standards, systems, and procedures
Keep training sessions engaging, interactive, and easy to understand
Assess whether new employees are ready to move into role-specific training
Update training materials when policies, systems, or business processes change
Provide retraining when employees are not following policies or established procedures
Determine whether an issue is caused by insufficient training, unclear expectations, poor performance, or misconduct
Document coaching, retraining, warnings, required improvements, and follow-up
Manage onboarding, employee changes, probation tracking, and offboarding
Maintain complete and confidential employee records
Administer vacation, sick leave, attendance, and other approved leaves
Support managers with employee relations, performance concerns, coaching, and documentation
Answer employee questions about policies, procedures, attendance, and workplace expectations
Maintain HR policies, templates, handbooks, and standard documentation
Prepare reports on onboarding, training, attendance, leaves, probation, turnover, and employee relations
Coordinate with recruitment, payroll, operations, and department managers
Escalate serious, sensitive, legal, medical, or high-risk matters appropriately

Education And Experience Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Industrial Psychology, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Labour Relations, or a related field
Minimum 5 years of progressive HR experience
Candidates with 6–8+ years of broad HR experience are strongly preferred
At least 2 years of direct experience delivering onboarding, policy training, process training, or corrective retraining
Direct experience building structured training modules from the beginning
Experience creating presentations, facilitator guides, assessments, quizzes, scenarios, checklists, and training documentation
Practical experience using AI tools to support training development, research, drafting, assessment creation, or content improvement
Ability to review AI-generated material for accuracy, tone, confidentiality, and alignment with company policies
Experience in a broad HR Generalist, HR Advisor, HR Business Partner, or comparable role
Strong experience with onboarding, offboarding, employee records, attendance, leaves, and probation tracking
Experience supporting employee relations, coaching, warnings, and performance concerns
Strong written and spoken English
Confident, outgoing, and engaging communication style
Strong live facilitation, presentation, and group-training skills
Comfortable asking direct questions, encouraging participation, and checking understanding
Able to balance a warm and approachable manner with clear standards and accountability
Strong organization, judgment, discretion, and documentation skills
Ability to work independently while recognizing when escalation is required
Ability to work full-time during Ontario / Eastern Time business hours
Reliable computer equipment, high-speed internet, headset, webcam, and a professional remote workspace

Preferred Experience

Previous experience supporting North American companies is strongly preferred.

Staffing or recruitment
Professional services
Technology or SaaS
Business-process outsourcing
Remote or distributed workforces
Learning and development
Adult-learning principles
Performance management
Policy and compliance training
HRIS or learning-management systems
AI-assisted course or training-content development
Building HR and training processes in a growing company

The Person We Are Looking For

You are outgoing, approachable, and comfortable leading a room, even in a virtual environment.

You know how to turn detailed policies and procedures into practical training that employees can understand, remember, and apply.

You do not simply read from a presentation. You ask questions, use realistic scenarios, encourage participation, confirm understanding, and adjust your approach when someone is struggling.

You are comfortable using AI to work faster and improve training materials, but you do not rely on it blindly. You review the content, correct mistakes, protect confidential information, and ensure the final material is accurate and appropriate.

You are also comfortable having direct conversations when expectations are not being met.

You can distinguish between an employee who needs additional training and an employee who understands the expectations but is choosing not to follow them.

You are organized, discreet, dependable, and able to support both employees and managers while maintaining clear standards.

What Success Looks Like

New employees receive consistent and engaging onboarding
Training modules are clear, accurate, current, and professionally organized
Employees understand company policies, systems, and workplace expectations
New hires are properly assessed before role-specific training
AI is used responsibly to improve training quality, speed, and consistency
Retraining is documented and followed by measurable improvement
Managers receive practical and timely HR support
Employee records, leaves, attendance, and probation dates remainaccurate
Performance and employee-relations matters are handled consistently
Offboarding is completed securely and on time
Recurring issues lead to stronger training and clearer processes

Compensation and Bonuses

The Annual Base Compensation Range For This Position Is

jobs.description:
Architect the NetSuite Engine Behind Nationwide Manufacturing

Build the digital blueprint behind what gets fabricated, stocked, and installed. As a Senior NetSuite Administrator
, you'll command the ERP ecosystem powering U.S. interior building manufacturing, connecting production, inventory, distribution, and field service. Turn deep NetSuite expertise into global impact and take your career further without leaving Colombia.

Your Career Snapshot

Employment Type: Indefinite Term Contract

Exciting Perks Await!

Weekends off
Work-from-home arrangement

The Qualifications We Seek

Required Qualifications

More than 5 years of experience administering NetSuite,
including at least 2 years supporting a manufacturing or wholesale distribution account
involving work orders, lots, bins, and inventory commitments
Experience with multi-subsidiary NetSuite OneWorld environments
, including an understanding of the account-wide impact of system settings
Strong proficiency in SuiteFlow, saved searches, custom records, custom fields, and custom forms

Working knowledge of SuiteQL

Hands-on experience with a field service management solution integrated with NetSuite, with NextService
strongly preferred
Experience managing sandbox and production changes alongside a developer team using SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF)

Ability to read script logs and distinguish configuration issues from code defects

Preferred Qualifications

NetSuite Administrator certification, with SuiteFoundation certification at minimum
Experience administering OAuth 2.0 machine-to-machine integrations and REST Web Services access
Working knowledge of SuiteScript, including the ability to review deployment records and understand the behavior of user-event scripts
Experience with Advanced NetSuite functionality

Your Daily Tasks

Account Ownership & Governance

Administer production and sandbox as separate, strictly governed environments
Own the sandbox refresh cycle and maintain sandbox-first change discipline, ensuring no changes reach production without a tested and approved deployment path
Manage change processes for SDF deployments alongside developers
Review deployment scope and identify account-wide side effects, including role changes, preferred-form changes, and workflow releases, before they affect other subsidiaries
Maintain the multi-subsidiary structure, including item and record sharing across subsidiaries, subsidiary-specific forms and preferences, and intercompany hygiene
Test each NetSuite release preview twice annually against customizations and partner bundles
Document regressions and coordinate required fixes

Roles, Permissions & Access

Design and maintain custom roles according to least-privilege principles, including scoped integration roles for machine-to-machine API access
Conduct periodic user-access reviews using the User Access health dashboard
Own user onboarding and offboarding processes
Manage integration records, OAuth 2.0 client-credential configurations, and certificate lifecycles for API integrations
Assess permission ceilings and associated risks, including account-wide CSV import permissions that require governance decisions

Configuration & Automation

Build and maintain custom records, fields, custom segments, forms, per-form field-label overrides, and sublists
Own SuiteFlow workflows, including approval flows, field-sourcing backstops, state-gated transaction buttons, and display-type rules that control fields or values by subsidiary
Build saved searches, SuiteAnalytics workbooks, and SuiteQL-backed reports for operations, sales, and finance
Manage more than 90 CSV import definitions for items, price books, customers, and transactions
Prepare and validate import files and resolve name-matching issues involving hierarchy separators and entity display names
Administer the item master, including matrix and lot-numbered inventory items, item groups with member pricing, special price lists, builder price books, and system-generated SKU governance

FSM / NextService Administration

Administer the NextService field-service bundle, including technician and crew records, field-service regions, task types, and asset and case configurations
Own scheduler and mobile configurations, including dispatch board setup, mobile forms and filters, and project assignability rules
Diagnose resource-allowance settings and other configuration issues that may prevent assignments
Coordinate with the developer team on the in-house scheduling board and mobile Suitelets that extend NextService
Maintain task-type mappings between project tasks and field-service management records

Operations Support

Support daily manufacturing and warehouse workflows, including work orders, production runs, lot and bin management, bin putaway worksheets for first-bin assignments, inventory commitments, and fulfillment exceptions
Diagnose stuck transactions using Health Hub diagnostic dashboards for sales-order lifecycles, project tasks, tax calculations, and customer states
Review script execution logs and route confirmed defects to developers with clear reproduction steps
Manage partner-built customizations from Myers-Holum, PARA, and NextService
Identify the ownership and operational impact of each partner-built customization
Monitor partner user-event scripts for conflicts and coordinate vendor fixes
Train and support end users across sales, order entry, production, field crews, and accounting

About the Client

Our client is an established U.S. interior building solutions provider with over 25 years of industry experience.
They specialize in countertop fabrication, cabinetry manufacturing, design, supply, and installation, serving high-volume single-family and multifamily builders nationwide. Through vertically integrated operations, multiple specialized divisions, and advanced fabrication facilities, they combine craftsmanship, manufacturing technology, supply-chain capabilities, and turnkey services. jobs.description:
Accenture
es una compañía global líder en servicios profesionales, con una amplia oferta en estrategia y consultoría, tecnología, operaciones y capacidades digitales. Acompañamos a nuestros clientes en su evolución para alcanzar su máximo rendimiento mediante soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto.

Dentro de nuestro equipo de #Tecnología
, trabajamos de la mano con organizaciones de distintas industrias para enfrentar los retos de la transformación digital. Impulsamos el uso de tecnologías modernas para crear soluciones más eficientes, escalables y disruptivas.

Buscamos personas proactivas, flexibles, con orientación al trabajo en equipo, interés constante por el aprendizaje y una fuerte motivación por crear soluciones innovadoras. 💜

En Accenture
, promovemos un entorno inclusivo y diverso. Todas las decisiones de contratación se toman sin discriminación por motivos de raza, religión, color, sexo, edad, discapacidad, nacionalidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, o cualquier otra condición protegida por la legislación local.

Descripción del rol

Buscamos un analista de middleware semisénior especializado en servidores web para integrarse al equipo de Resolution Groups – Middleware del Proyecto Aurora. El profesional será responsable de la administración y operación del parque de servidores web IIS en nube pública, que representa el mayor volumen de la torre con aproximadamente 656 instancias (36 % productivas). El rol cubre la operación diaria, la atención de incidentes, la aplicación de parches y la ejecución de cambios sobre la plataforma de servidores web del cliente.

Responsabilidades principales

Administrar y operar instancias de IIS (Internet Information Services) en nube pública (AWS, Azure y OCI).

Resolver incidentes de web servers conforme a los acuerdos de nivel de servicio contractuales.

Gestionar sitios web, bindings, application pools y configuraciones de IIS en entornos productivos y no productivos.

Ejecutar despliegues de aplicaciones web en las ventanas de mantenimiento acordadas.

Aplicar parches correctivos y de seguridad de IIS siguiendo el ciclo de parcheo acordado entre las partes.

Analizar el riesgo de aplicar patchsets en entornos de desarrollo, aprobación y producción.

Monitorear proactivamente la disponibilidad y el rendimiento de los servidores web: tiempo de respuesta, errores HTTP, utilización de recursos y estado de los application pools.

Verificar y analizar mensajes de error en logs de IIS (Event Viewer, IIS logs) y escalar cuando corresponda.

Instalar y renovar certificados SSL/TLS en servidores web IIS a solicitud del equipo de ciberseguridad.

Aplicar configuraciones de hardening en nube pública conforme a los estándares de cliente (CIS Benchmarks para IIS).

Instalar agentes de seguridad y remediar vulnerabilidades dirigidas por el equipo de ciberseguridad.

Documentar procedimientos operativos, configuraciones y runbooks de la plataforma de servidores web.

Dar soporte técnico al perfil júnior del equipo en tareas de monitoreo y operación diaria.

Requisitos técnicos

3 o más años de experiencia en administración de IIS en entornos productivos.

Dominio de IIS 8.5, 10 y posteriores: gestión de sitios, application pools, bindings, módulos, autenticación y autorización.

Experiencia con IIS desplegado en instancias Windows Server en nube pública: AWS EC2, Azure VM u OCI Compute.

Conocimiento de gestión de certificados SSL/TLS en IIS: instalación, renovación y configuración de HTTPS.

Manejo de herramientas de diagnóstico de IIS: IIS logs, Failed Request Tracing, Event Viewer y Performance Monitor.

Conocimiento de PowerShell para automatización de tareas administrativas en IIS.

Familiaridad con ARR (Application Request Routing) y URL Rewrite para configuraciones de balanceo y redirección.

Experiencia con herramientas ITSM, preferentemente ServiceNow.

Competencias y perfil

Capacidad de trabajo en equipo con el perfil sénior de app servers y el perfil júnior del equipo.

Disciplina operativa y atención al detalle en la ejecución de cambios sobre entornos productivos.

Proactividad para detectar degradaciones de servicio antes de que se conviertan en incidentes.

Disponibilidad para guardia on-call rotativa ante incidentes críticos.

Condiciones

Modalidad híbrida - Bogotá

Cobertura 24×7 para P1/P2 y cambios de emergencia; 12×5 (lunes a viernes, de 7:00 a 19:00 h, hora Colombia) para P3/P4 y demandas.

Los festivos de Colombia no aplican como días hábiles para la atención de demanda no crítica.

Asegurar que los procesos de la compañía estén definidos, documentados, implementados y medidos conforme a los requisitos del Sistema Integrado de Gestión (ISO 9001, ISO 13485) y de la normativa aplicable a dispositivos médicos (INVIMA), con su operación soportada en el sistema ERP.
Responsabilidades

Gestión por procesos:
levantar, caracterizar y mantener actualizados los procesos; elaborar procedimientos, instructivos, formatos y diagramas de flujo en BPMN 2.0; validar en sitio con los responsables; mantener el mapa de procesos y las funciones de cada cargo.
Sistema integrado de gestión:
implementar y mantener los requisitos de ISO 9001 e ISO 13485; apoyar a la dirección técnica en las condiciones de almacenamiento y acondicionamiento de dispositivos médicos; mantener la matriz de requisitos legales; preparar a las áreas para auditorías externas y visitas de entes de control.
Control documental:
administrar la estructura documental (codificación, versiones y vigencias), realizar la revisión metodológica y gestionar aprobación, publicación y divulgación; controlar registros.
Digitalización de procesos:
traducir los procesos aprobados en requerimientos funcionales para el ERP, ejecutar pruebas con usuarios, acompañar la puesta en marcha y velar por la calidad de los datos maestros.
Medición y mejora continua:
definir y medir indicadores de gestión; ejecutar el programa de auditorías internas y autoinspecciones; gestionar no conformidades y acciones correctivas; consolidar la información para la revisión por la dirección.
Riesgos y formación:
mantener la matriz de riesgos y oportunidades, apoyar la gestión del cambio, capacitar al personal y promover la cultura de calidad.

Requisitos

Profesional en ingeniería industrial, de procesos, de producción, biomédica o afines, con matrícula profesional vigente.
Especialización terminada en sistemas integrados de gestión, gerencia de la calidad o gestión de procesos.
Formación como auditor interno en ISO 9001:2015.
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en implementación o mantenimiento de sistemas de gestión de calidad.
Experiencia comprobable en levantamiento y documentación de procesos con validación en terreno, participación en auditorías internas y externas, y trabajo directo con áreas operativas (almacén, compras o logística).
Conocimientos en ISO 9001, enfoque por procesos, pensamiento basado en riesgos, PHVA, SIPOC, RACI, BPMN 2.0, indicadores de gestión y análisis de causa raíz.
Manejo de modeladores de procesos (Camunda Modeler, Bizagi o similares), Excel avanzado y ERP a nivel de usuario funcional.
Competencias: redacción técnica clara, rigor y atención al detalle, capacidad de análisis y síntesis, comunicación efectiva con todos los niveles.

Se valora

Experiencia en dispositivos médicos, sector farmacéutico, salud o logística de producto regulado.
Conocimiento de ISO 13485, certificado de capacidad de almacenamiento y acondicionamiento del INVIMA y tecnovigilancia.
Conocimiento de ISO 45001 y de la versión 2026 de ISO 9001.
Participación en la implementación de un ERP, idealmente Odoo, e inglés para lectura técnica.

Condiciones

Contrato a término indefinido.
Salario a convenir según experiencia, más prestaciones de ley.

Día de la familia, día libre de cumpleaños y convenios con almacenes y ópticas.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator with 1–3 years of Track & Trace experience
to monitor shipments and maintain accurate, real-time visibility throughout the transportation process. This role requires knowledge of U.S. domestic ground freight, including FTL, LTL, and intermodal transportation, as well as hands-on experience with TMS platforms.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and comfortable communicating with carriers, drivers, dispatchers, and internal teams to ensure shipments move according to plan and any issues are identified and escalated promptly.

Key Responsibilities

Monitor and track shipments throughout the transportation lifecycle using phone, email, and TMS platforms.
Maintain accurate load statuses, pickup and delivery milestones, ETAs, arrival/departure times, and location updates.
Coordinate pickup appointments and confirm shipment details with carriers and drivers.
Manage and follow up on pre-alerts and ensure required shipment information is available and accurate.
Request and document ETA updates, shipment progress, and location information.
Communicate with carriers, drivers, dispatchers, planners, and internal teams to support smooth shipment execution.
Maintain detailed and accurate shipment records, notes, and updates within internal systems.
Identify, communicate, and escalate delays, discrepancies, missed milestones, or other operational issues.
Retrieve and validate shipment documentation when inconsistencies or missing information are identified.
Forward Proofs of Delivery (PODs) and other required documentation to the appropriate departments.
Ensure all assigned loads are actively monitored through successful delivery.
Support accurate and timely updates throughout the full shipment lifecycle.

Requirements

1–3 years of experience in Track & Trace, Logistics, Transportation, Dispatch, or a related operations role.
Full-time availability, including night shifts and weekends.
Knowledge of U.S. domestic ground freight, including FTL, LTL, and intermodal transportation.
Understanding of key shipment lifecycle milestones from pickup through final delivery.
Experience coordinating pickup appointments and managing pre-alerts.
Hands-on experience using Transportation Management Systems (TMS).
Experience with e2open TMF and/or Descartes Aljex is strongly preferred.
Experience communicating with carriers, drivers, dispatchers, and other transportation partners.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate shipment information.
Strong organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to identify and escalate operational issues in a timely manner.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel.
English level: B2+ written and verbal.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple shipments simultaneously.

jobs.title: Retail Gerente de Tienda - Bucaramanga, CO
jobs.description:
Propósito y Relevancia General Para La Organización

Lograr el desempeño de la tienda y los KPIs optimizando los recursos operativos para ofrecer a los clientes una experiencia memorable buscando su lealtad. Desarrollar y mantener motivado al equipo y utilizar todas las herramientas disponibles para lograr el desempeño comercial.

Responsabilidades Clave

Lidera, asegura y es responsable de la gestión de ventas, personas y operaciones en las tiendas categorizadas como tipo B y C para cumplir con el objetivo de la tienda y lograr los objetivos comerciales entregando una experiencia de consumidor memorable asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares de servicio de adidas.
Domina los KPI de la tienda, como CR (Conversion Rate / Tasa de Conversión), ATV (Average Transaction Value / Valor Promedio por Transacción), ASP (Average Selling Price / Precio de Venta Promedio), UPT (Unit Per Transaction /Unidad Por Transacción), Tráfico, Márgen estándar, NPS (Net Promoter Score) y garantiza que el equipo los conozca, cómo contribuyen a través del análisis de datos relevantes y toman decisiones comerciales para mejorarlos.
Hace un uso adecuado de los recursos disponibles, optimiza la programación del personal, controla los descuentos, minimiza y controla las pérdidas de inventario, y administra y controla de manera eficiente todos los gastos generales operativos bajo su responsabilidad, para impactar positivamente la rentabilidad de la tienda.
Impulsa el rendimiento de la tienda a través de una gestión óptima del espacio, Visual Merchandising, promoción de productos más vendidos, gestión de movimientos de los black holes, y el desempeño de cada categoría en el piso de ventas para lograr los objetivos y los resultados esperados del negocio.
Impulsa el cumplimiento de todas las políticas, procesos y procedimientos de la empresa y se asegura de que el equipo los comprenda y los siga para garantizar los estándares de adidas y reducir los riesgos, manteniendo un entorno laboral y de compras seguro y productivo.
Colabora con el equipo de la tienda para identificar mejoras en la tienda y la operación para mejorar el desempeño comercial, identifica las mejores prácticas y mantiene un conocimiento actualizado de nuestros competidores para mejorar el desempeño comercial.
Supervisa y garantiza que las transacciones de la caja se procesen de forma rápida y precisa para asegurar los procesos correctos.
Lidera la ejecución y seguimiento de iniciativas digitales que deben ser implementadas, de forma operativa y orientadas al consumidor. Garantiza una ejecución impecable en todo el proceso digital de un extremo a otro a nivel de tienda.
Lidera, motiva, inspira, desarrolla a los miembros del equipo y gestiona todos los procedimientos de las personas para garantizar el compromiso, la productividad y una cultura de alto rendimiento de los empleados al establecer expectativas claras, dar retroalimentación adecuada y rápida y liderar con el ejemplo como defensora de la marca, de manera constante exhibiendo los 6 valores de la marca (Courage, Ownership, Innovation, Team Play, Integrity y Respect) para reforzar la cultura adidas.
Se asegura que nuestro modelo de servicio y ritmo operativo de la tienda sea realmente vivido por todos los miembros del equipo, incluyendo el cumplimiento de todos nuestros estándares de operaciones de retail y el proceso postventa en una perspectiva omnicanal.
Garantiza que la adquisición de membresía de Creators Club sea impulsada por los miembros del personal a través de nuestro modelo de servicio en cada interacción con los consumidores.
Completa todos los programas de capacitación aplicables y aplica de manera efectiva el aprendizaje en el trabajo y garantiza que todos los miembros del equipo de la tienda estén capacitados en el conocimiento básico y de temporada de la marca y el producto.
Capacita al equipo para que esté completamente actualizado y entienda las herramientas digitales para implementarlas correctamente en la tienda promoviendo la experiencia de compra y venta omnicanal (Endless Aisle, Ship from Store, Click and Collect, WhatsApp Sales) y responde por el servicio post venta.
Trabaja siempre con una mentalidad de equipo primero, respetando plenamente a todos los colegas y participa activamente, promueve y contribuye a las iniciativas de diversidad e inclusión para hacer de su lugar de trabajo un entorno inclusivo y acogedor para todos.

Multi Store Manager
(Si aplica)

Lidera el desempeño y rentabilidad de las tiendas bajo su responsabilidad, incluyendo la búsqueda de sinergias en la gestión del desempeño y distribución de recursos entre su grupo de tiendas.
Desarrolla y capacita a un equipo sólido de administración por tienda (Assistant Store Manager y Team Leader o tercero a bordo) para garantizar la ejecución completa y consistente de los estándares y procedimientos operativos globales y regionales en todas sus tiendas.
Optimiza la planificación y programación del personal de manera eficiente entre sus tiendas.

Relaciones Clave

Consumidores
Equipo de soporte de oficina: Retail Operations, Sales Academy, Buying & Trading, Visual Merchandising, Retail marketing, HR, SCM, Real Estate, Global Business Services, Finance, Facilities and Services y IT.
Servicio al consumidor de Ecommerce
Proveedores: Socios de logística digital y otros.
Administración local (centros comerciales)

Conocimientos, Destrezas y Habilidades

Domina todos los procesos y herramientas de operación de la tienda y sabe cómo funciona la tienda y cómo lograr los KPI.
Capacidad para planificar, identificar oportunidades, definir objetivos y monitorear los proyectos que se puedan generar en la tienda.
Comprende los estándares de Visual Merchandising para impulsar la conversión a través de acciones estratégicas.
Conecta, involucra e inspira activamente a los consumidores.
Comunica un deseo de aprendizaje continuo y da la bienvenida a todas las oportunidades disponibles para aumentar el rendimiento propio y de la tienda al comprender el entorno minorista, los productos y el conocimiento de la marca y el comportamiento del consumidor.
Comunicación verbal y escrita fluida y eficaz. Capacidad para transmitir información a otros. Gestiona conversaciones difíciles de forma constructiva y utiliza las habilidades de comunicación para permitir una gran experiencia al cliente.
Capacidad para demostrar agilidad y capacidad de respuesta al liderar e implementar procesos y estrategias, incluidas ofertas omnicanal y soluciones digitales.
Capacidad para manejar diferentes situaciones de la tienda y gestionarlas para encontrar una solución.
Ser capaz de atraer, retener e involucrar a las personas para que se desempeñen al máximo mediante el uso de herramientas de capacitación, reconocimiento y desarrollo que promuevan un entorno diverso e inclusivo dentro del equipo.

Educación y Experiencia Requeridas / Calificaciones Mínimas

Debe poder demostrar una experiencia de 2 años como gerente de tienda, liderando equipos e impulsando las operaciones y los resultados comerciales.
Sólida experiencia en la gestión de datos, métricas y KPIs de operaciones minoristas.

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, Learning & Development, Learning Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Sr. Analyst, Learning & Development, Learning Infrastructure

At Mastercard, our Learning & Development (L&D) organization plays a vital role in empowering our people to grow, lead, and thrive. From onboarding to skill development and leadership development, we support every stage of the employee journey with impactful learning experiences.

We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Learning Infrastructure to serve as a hands-on, enablement resource that keeps L&D running. Where the Manager, Learning Infrastructure partners with POI and P&C Technology on strategy, this role makes it real day to day — administering our enterprise learning platforms, building the guidance that helps practitioners use them well, and acting as the first line of support when something breaks mid-delivery.

This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys making other people more capable. You will spend as much time helping colleagues become self-sufficient as you will in the admin console — and you should find both equally satisfying.

Role

Platform Administration

Partner with vendors and internal teams to execute tasks related to day-to-day maintenance and administration of Mastercard's L&D ecosystem, including audience configuration, permissions, and system settings
Support the Manager of L&D Infrastructure and internal teams in testing, validating, and rolling out new platform capabilities, configurations, and integrations

Tool Enablement & Documentation

Build and maintain lightweight, genuinely usable enablement assets — step-by-step guides, FAQs, decision trees, quick-reference materials, and short how-to videos — that reduce friction and answer questions before they are asked
Deliver structured onboarding and refresher sessions for new tools and new capabilities
Keep the enablement library current as platforms evolve

Escalation & Troubleshooting Support

Serve as first-line escalation for L&D team on program/initiative configuration and data issues arising during delivery and evaluation
Diagnose root causes and resolve issues directly where possible; escalate cleanly to the Manager of L&D Infrastructure and partners in HR technology
Run and maintain a clear intake and triage process so requests, access needs, and edge cases are handled predictably and nothing sits unowned
Identify recurring issues and suggest permanent fixes — a configuration change, a documented workaround, or an enablement asset — rather than resolving the same ticket repeatedly
Flag platform constraints early to L&D team so initiatives are designed around these constrains, not discovered at deployment

Reporting Enablement

Enable the wider L&D team and non-L&D stakeholders to navigate and interpret available reporting independently, including training, documentation, and hands-on walkthroughs
Highlight frequent requests that fall outside the self-serve layer, so People Analytics and HR technology teams can evaluate and prioritize for longer term improvement.

All About You

3+ years of experience in L&D, learning operations, or people technology, with direct hands-on ownership of learning platform administration
Demonstrated experience in the day-to-day management of an enterprise-grade LMS — Workday Learning, Cornerstone, Docebo, or comparable
Proven track record of enabling and empowering users: you have built guides, run training, or supported a user community, and you can point to people who became more self-sufficient because of your work
Strong troubleshooting instincts — you diagnose methodically, resolve the root cause rather than the symptom, and document what you learned
Able to translate technical constraints and capabilities into plain language that non-technical practitioners can act on
Experience in a large, matrixed organization where technology ownership is shared across functions
Familiarity with HR/people data environments and governance requirements (PII, data access policies) A practitioner's background in learning delivery — enough to understand what teams actually need from their tools, not just what the tools technically offer

Skills

Platform Administration: Configures and maintains enterprise learning environments accurately, consistently, and within established governance
Enablement & Documentation: Creates resources and sessions that people actually use, scaling expertise across the team rather than concentrating it in a single point of failure
Troubleshooting & Resolution: Diagnoses issues methodically under time pressure, resolves what can be resolved, and escalates with clarity and context when it cannot
Technology Fluency: Maintains deep working knowledge of the L&D tooling stack and applies it to guide how colleagues configure, launch, and maintain programs
Communication & Simplification: Translates platform capabilities, data definitions, and technical constraints into language practitioners can understand and act on
Service Orientation: Treats internal colleagues as customers — responsive, reliable, and focused on removing blockers before they escalate
Data & Reporting: Builds and maintains standardized reporting outputs and helps others interpret them independently
Continuous Improvement: Spots recurring friction and converts it into a permanent fix, a documented standard, or an enablement asset

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: ADO Quality & Governance Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The ADO Quality & Governance Analyst – Senior Associate
supports program delivery operations by administering and maintaining Azure DevOps while also owning core data quality, traceability, reporting, and self-service enablement responsibilities. The role ensures that ADO projects, boards, work item structures, permissions, and templates are configured consistently, while validating that delivery artifacts are complete, accurately linked, production-ready, and usable for governance, release readiness, quality assurance, and operational reporting.

This merged position combines platform administration with data quality execution and automation. The role will help reduce manual effort by automating quality checks, reporting outputs, training materials, and runbook creation to support more scalable self-service across delivery teams.

Responsibilities

ADO Administration & Platform Support

Administer and configure Azure DevOps projects, boards, repositories, work item structures, dashboards, and standard templates.
Manage user access, permissions, and security groups in alignment with governance standards.
Configure and maintain work item types, fields, workflows, states, rules, and templates to support consistent delivery execution.
Support environment setup, project onboarding, and standard configuration enforcement across delivery teams.
Respond to ADO usage questions, operational issues, and support requests from PMO, delivery, product, quality, and release stakeholders.

Data Quality, Traceability & Governance

Maintain end-to-end requirements traceability across delivery artifacts within Azure DevOps.
Build, maintain, and improve traceability views or matrices that align business requirements through epics, features, stories, test cases, defects, releases, and deployment readiness.
Enforce artifact linkage standards and identify gaps, misalignments, missing fields, incomplete artifacts, or inconsistent data usage.
Perform recurring data quality checks to validate completeness, accuracy, consistency, and auditability of delivery data.
Support release readiness by validating traceability coverage and quality evidence prior to deployment.
Partner with project/program managers, QA, product, release, and delivery leads to reinforce quality expectations and improve adoption of standards.

Automation, Reporting & Quality Controls

Automate recurring quality reports, dashboards, exception views, and data health outputs to reduce manual tracking and improve transparency.
Create and maintain reusable reporting outputs that show artifact completeness, linkage status, data quality exceptions, release readiness indicators, and trends in what is being produced.
Develop automated or semi-automated quality checks that identify missing work item fields, broken links, incomplete test coverage, open defects, aging items, and other delivery risks.
Recommend improvements to ADO configuration, reporting structure, and data standards based on recurring quality findings.
Contribute to continuous improvement of traceability, reporting, quality management, and delivery governance practices.

Training, Runbooks & Self-Service Enablement

Build training items, job aids, and self-service guidance for delivery teams using ADO.
Document standard work through runbooks, how-to guides, checklists, and reusable templates that support consistent execution.
Automate or accelerate creation of recurring runbooks, process instructions, and support materials where possible.
Support quality certification or quality-readiness activities by documenting evidence, standards, completion criteria, and repeatable validation steps.
Help teams understand the quality expectations for artifacts produced in ADO and how those outputs support reporting, release readiness, governance, and auditability.

Skills And Experience

Required Skills

Strong experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) administration from a delivery governance perspective, including project configuration, board setup, work item management, and template maintenance.
Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, release management, and hybrid delivery models.
Experience with requirements traceability, artifact linkage, and delivery data validation.
Ability to develop and maintain data quality reports, dashboards, exception tracking, and operational metrics.
Ability to translate delivery standards into practical ADO configurations, reports, checklists, and user guidance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and the ability to identify data quality issues and process gaps.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with PMO, delivery, QA, product, and release teams.
English proficiency at B2+ level, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively in both written and verbal settings.

Preferred Skills / Differentiators

Experience creating automated reports, dashboards, and data quality checks using Azure DevOps queries, dashboards, Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, or similar tools.
Experience supporting PMO, delivery governance, release readiness, QA, or quality management activities.
Experience developing runbooks, process documentation, training guides, operating procedures, and self-service support materials.
Familiarity with quality certification, audit readiness, control evidence, and structured quality review processes.
Ability to work across multiple delivery teams to improve the quality, consistency, and usability of work products generated in ADO.

Education, Professional Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
3–5 years of experience supporting technology delivery, PMO operations, ALM platforms, delivery governance, release readiness, quality management, or IT operations.
Experience with Azure DevOps or similar Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools strongly preferred.
Experience supporting delivery teams through configuration, reporting, data validation, training, documentation, or operational support.

Success Measures

ADO projects, boards, and work item structures are configured consistently and aligned with delivery standards.
Delivery artifacts are complete, traceable, properly linked, and ready for governance, reporting, release readiness, and audit purposes.
Quality exceptions are clearly identified through recurring reports, dashboards, or automated checks.
Training materials, runbooks, and self-service resources reduce repetitive support requests and improve user adoption.
The organization has improved visibility into the quality, consistency, and completeness of deliverables across programs and delivery teams.

Summary

This Role will be part of Project Automation Technology (PAT) area. The BIM/CAD Systems Implementation Specialist is responsible for the deployment, configuration, customization, integration, and technical support of Hatch’s integrated project engineering design tool suite. These tools ensure project data quality and consistency throughout the engagement lifecycle, which in turn follow the approved procedures and processes outlined in the Engagement Lifecycle Process.

The BIM/CAD Systems Implementation Specialist also helps enforce the requirements for Digital Project Delivery (DPD) and provides specialist support to create value for stakeholders, while applying a continuous improvement culture to all DPD initiatives within the engagement.

Planning and Setup

Assist with identification and customization of design tools as it relates to any engagement specific deviations.
Assess, pilot, and implement mass data handling and automation opportunities associated with design tools as well as associated interfacing.
Configure and maintain the design tools to meet engineering and design standards (e.g. Asset tagging, document numbering) including geo-coordinate and geographical information system (GIS) requirements, Information Container Breakdown Structure (ICBS) and other classification systems to align with the federation strategy.
Prepare and deliver onboarding, knowledge, and skills training materials for design tool processes and procedures, as it relates to deviations to the standard Hatch build.
Set up, configure, and manage design tool templates, managed workspaces (including seed files), and object libraries.

Execution and Control

Coordinate technical support for Design tools.
Coordinate design file conversion and language translation processes based on discipline and stakeholder requirements.
Manage design tool access and permissions through security model.

Close-out and Improvement

Assist with (progressive) archiving and handover of design files and data.
Assist with close-out of project information in Hatch Design Tools.
Qualifications and Experience

Essential

A recognized degree in Engineering or Computer Science from an accredited College or University.
5-10 years of experience in Information Technology, ideally in an Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Management (EPCM) environment.
Excellent knowledge of automation and data modeling, systems and data integration, validation, and verification.
Advanced knowledge of either Bentley MicroStation or Autodesk AutoCAD
Experience in one or more of the following data-centric design tools: Bentley OpenPlant suite, Hexagon Smart Suite (3D, Instruments, Electrical, P&ID), Autodesk Plant suite (Plant 3D)
Advanced knowledge of Windows OS & networking.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, specifically Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Visio.
Working knowledge of SQL Server programming and administration (SQL & MYSQL), with a sound understanding of Databases and Data Structures.
Programming Experience (one of): .NET 4.0 and above, VB/VBA, C#/C++, PowerShell.
Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills.
Excellent time management skills, and the ability to prioritize tasks with minimal supervision.
High level of critical and logical thinking, analysis, and/or reasoning to identify underlying principles, reasons, or facts.
Experience with reportability systems, SQL, Excel Power Query, PowerBI, Microsoft’s Fabrics
High understanding of BIM, 3D Models, 2D, P&ID, Isometric

Preferred

Software development experience
Knowledge of BIM principles, with emphasis on ISO 19650 and ISO 15926
Experience working directly on projects in a multi-disciplinary engineering environment.
Expert user in MicroStation and AutoCAD or SP3D
Experience working with ProjectWise and SharePoint
High Capacity to understand and resolve problems
High disposition to Support end users in CAD tools.
Experience for training to end users.

.

We are looking for a Warehouse Analyst
to support the export process by ensuring that physical cargo received at the warehouse accurately matches the information provided by vendors and clients. This role is responsible for reviewing and validating Material Receipts in C2C, resolving discrepancies, coordinating with suppliers and internal teams, and ensuring shipments are properly documented and released for the next stage of the export process.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage assigned Material Receipts from the shared team queue, prioritizing tasks based on standard oldest-first procedures and client-specific priorities.

Manage Overage, Shortages & Damages (OS&D)

Communicate directly with suppliers and vendors regarding issues affecting Material Receipts.

Monitor and update Material Receipt statuses throughout the process, including Not Complete, Needs to be Checked, OS&D, and Complete
.

Maintain accurate daily records of assigned Material Receipts in the shared team spreadsheet, including start and submission dates.

1 year of experience
in export operations, warehouse receiving, or inventory/material control within a freight forwarding, 3PL or supply chain environment.
English level: B2+
(written and verbal).

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel.

jobs.title: Legal Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About Veho

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone.

We are building a modern, end-to-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers.

Powered by next-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post-purchase experience. We make delivery the ‘extension of the brand’ and leverage it to create deeper loyalty and trust between brands and their customers, driving customer retention and lifetime value. Our rapidly growing client list includes leading consumer brands like HelloFresh, Zara, Macy’s, Sephora, and more.

To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit-based culture. We seek team players who want to compete, win, make an impact and build a legacy, and we reward performance and impact players with generous equity and incredible career growth opportunities.

About The Role

You'll be the operational backbone of Veho's global legal function—owning our SpotDraft platform configuration, workflow automation, and data integrity while partnering with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and IT to eliminate friction from contract execution. You'll translate business bottlenecks into technical solutions: designing metadata schemas that enable accurate reporting, building conditional routing logic that cuts contract cycle time, and integrating our CLM stack with Salesforce to eliminate manual handoffs. Your work directly accelerates deal velocity and ensures legal doesn't become a bottleneck as we scale across markets.

A Great Candidate

You have 3+ years in Legal Ops, Sales Ops, or Revenue Ops at a multinational or high-volume environment—you've actually debugged CLM platforms and know where contract processes break down, not just read documentation.
You've administered SpotDraft (or Ironclad, LinkSquares) at scale—backend configuration, custom fields, approval workflows, conditional logic—and can speak fluently about schema design and data governance decisions you've made.
You're fluent in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) and comfortable being the operational bridge between Bogotá-based legal and distributed international teams; you understand what gets lost in translation and prevent it.
You've built dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or Looker Studio (or advanced Sheets/Excel) that actually moved the needle—you know which KPIs matter (contract cycle time, approval bottlenecks, spend variance) and can make them visible and actionable.
You've configured Salesforce or HubSpot integrations or understand GTM tech stack architecture deeply enough to identify where manual data entry is causing friction and then fix it.
You've used no-code/low-code platforms or generative AI tools to automate repetitive work—you see Excel-based processes and instinctively think "this shouldn't require human hands."
You have experience with e-billing platforms, vendor compliance platforms, or third-party risk management—you've actually tracked spend against policy, caught overbilling, or ensured compliance checks happen before contracts execute.
You're organized and detail-oriented in a way that shows in your work—you own data audits without prompting, flag inconsistencies, and document decisions so others can follow your logic and scale your solutions.

What You'll Do

Own SpotDraft as the core platform administrator—configure custom metadata fields, schema tags, and conditional routing logic to match our business metrics and ensure 95%+ data accuracy across contract records.
Design and build approval workflows and dynamic routing rules that reduce contract turnaround time—eliminate manual triage by automating intake-to-first-review pathways and reducing legal team admin overhead by quantifiable hours per week.
Champion and deploy AI-powered tools (using generative AI platforms and no-code automation) to streamline contract intake, automate repetitive legal tasks, and measure adoption and time savings across the legal team.
Optimize integrations between SpotDraft, DocuSign, and Salesforce to eliminate manual data entry and handoffs—ensure contract data syncs accurately and establish monitoring to catch misalignment.
Administer our third-party risk and vendor compliance platform—execute background checks and compliance screening before contract execution, track completion against SLAs, and flag risk items for escalation.
Prepare and route critical business documents for e-signature via SpotDraft and DocuSign—own the final-mile execution process and monitor signature bottlenecks in real time.
Design and maintain visual performance dashboards tracking contract cycle time, approval bottlenecks, legal team utilization, and signature status—translate raw data into visibility that enables the legal team to self-diagnose delays.
Conduct regular system audits to enforce data hygiene—audit metadata consistency, validate dropdown entries, and ensure compliance reporting is built on reliable data foundations.
Administer our law firm e-billing platform—track external legal spend against budget, validate invoices against billing guidelines, recover overbilling discrepancies, and enforce corporate billing policy.

Veho is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. No matter the location, or the role, every Veho teammate shares one galvanizing mission: driving commerce forward with a customer-centric delivery experience that's built for the modern era. We live by our leadership principles. We're looking for team members who are: obsessed over the customer, first-principles thinkers, builders at heart, intrinsically driven to win, and owners biased toward action.

Join us in building the future of ecommerce logistics and in doing the work of our lifetime!

All California applicants, please reference our California Applicant Privacy Notice located here.

jobs.description:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

About The Role

We are looking for a Benefits Specialist to join our HR team and lead the design, administration, and communication of employee benefits programs across the LATAM region. This role, based in Colombia, will serve as a key partner to HR teams throughout the region, ensuring that benefits offerings are compliant with local regulations, competitive in local markets, and tailored to the diverse needs of our employees across Latin America.

The Benefits Specialist will manage a wide range of benefits — from statutory social security programs and healthcare to wellness initiatives and leave entitlements — while navigating the distinct cultural, legal, and labor frameworks of each LATAM country.

What You’ll Do:

Benefits Strategy & Administration
Lead day-to-day operations for benefits programs across the LATAM region, including healthcare, pension/retirement plans, life insurance, and wellness programs
Partner with regional HR teams to tailor benefits to local employee needs, benchmarking against LATAM-specific market data
Manage country-specific statutory benefits including social security contributions, severance funds (e.g., Cesantías in Colombia, FGTS in Brazil), profit-sharing obligations (PTU in Mexico), and 13th/14th month salary requirements.

Vendor & Provider Management
Manage relationships with regional insurance brokers and wellness vendors across LATAM markets
Ensure service delivery meets agreed SLAs and handle escalations with local vendor contacts.
Negotiate plan designs and pricing with vendors, factoring in LATAM inflation rates and currency volatility.

Compliance & Regulatory Management
Stay current on regulatory changes across key LATAM markets including Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, and Peru in partnership with our global and local brokers.
Ensure all benefits programs comply with local labor codes, tax laws, and social security mandates — including Colombian Decreto 1072, Mexico's Ley Federal del Trabajo, Brazil's CLT, and Argentina's Ley de Contrato de Trabajo.
Manage country-specific statutory requirements such as prima de servicios (Colombia), aguinaldo (Mexico/Argentina), 13º salário (Brazil), asignación familiar (Chile/Peru), and obra social coverage (Argentina).
Liaise with local legal counsel and payroll teams to ensure benefits are correctly treated for tax and social contribution purposes in each jurisdiction.

Pension & Retirement Programs

Proactive Improvement & Security: Continuously identify vulnerabilities, evaluate new tools and processes, and contribute to business-critical IT initiatives that strengthen efficiency, reliability, and data security.
Enable Smarter IT Practices: Contribute to the documentation of processes, support self-service knowledge bases, and assist with automating routine IT tasks to increase team capacity.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Support & Installation: Install, configure, support, and troubleshoot desktop and laptop workstations (macOS & Windows), software, printers, mobile devices, and peripherals for local and remote employees.
System Maintenance & Upgrades: Implement operating system patches, software/application upgrades, and actively troubleshoot system performance issues before they impact operations.
Ticket & Incident Management: Monitor and respond to help desk tickets with urgency, delivering Tier 1 & Tier 2 support through ITSM tools, escalating complex issues to regional senior teams with clear documentation of steps taken.
Root Cause Analysis: Go beyond reactive fixes — perform root-cause analysis on recurring incidents to identify and implement permanent, systemic solutions.
Asset & Inventory Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of local IT hardware, software licenses, and equipment inventory. Oversee provisioning for new hires and equipment recovery during offboarding.
User Access & Account Management: Manage user accounts, access permissions, and identity provisioning/deprovisioning across enterprise systems (Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace).
User Training & Enablement: Educate and coach employees on best practices for hardware, software, cybersecurity hygiene, and productivity tools.
Security & Data Protection: Apply and uphold IT security policies, endpoint security protocols, and enterprise backup/recovery procedures. Maintain strict confidentiality of all sensitive company information.
System Documentation & SOPs: Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, configuration logs, and self-service support resources.
Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate with external vendors, ISPs, and internal departments to meet service agreements and ensure seamless technology operations.

Requirements & Qualifications:

Technical Skills & Experience:

3–4+ years of hands-on experience in IT Desktop Support, Technical Helpdesk, Systems Administration, or a similar IT support role.
English Level: B1+ / B2 (Intermediate to Upper-Intermediate) — sufficient to communicate clearly and professionally with regional and global teams via email, chat, and calls.
OS Expertise: Strong working knowledge of macOS and Windows 10/11, including installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
Enterprise Software: Proficient in supporting Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive), Google Workspace, and standard productivity and collaboration tools.
Identity & Access Management: Practical knowledge of user account management via Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), or equivalent IAM platforms.
Networking: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN configuration, Wi-Fi troubleshooting, and local network access management.
Endpoint & Security Tools: Familiarity with endpoint management platforms (e.g., Jamf, Microsoft Intune), endpoint security tools, antivirus solutions, and enterprise backup/recovery procedures.
ITSM & Remote Tools: Hands-on experience with IT ticketing platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk) and remote desktop support tools.

Nice-to-Have / Pluses:

Basic familiarity with creative software suites (e.g., Adobe Creative Cloud).
Previous experience supporting teams in an advertising agency, media production, or creative studio environment.
Basic understanding of shared storage network drives and cloud file-sharing tools.

Soft Skills & Competencies:

Confidentiality & Integrity: Demonstrates absolute discretion in handling sensitive company and user data at all times.
Customer Service Excellence: High empathy and patience, with a consistently approachable and respectful attitude — particularly when supporting non-technical staff.
Communication Skills: Clear, concise verbal and written communicator in both Spanish and English, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, actionable guidance.
Analytical Problem-Solving: Strong critical thinking and logical troubleshooting skills, focused on identifying root causes rather than surface-level fixes.
Resilience Under Pressure: Ability to stay calm, effective, and focused when managing high-priority or simultaneous incidents in a fast-paced, creative environment.
Prioritization & Escalation Judgment: Skilled at managing competing priorities and knowing when and how to escalate issues appropriately and efficiently.
Collaboration & Independence: Proven ability to work autonomously on local tasks while actively contributing as a trusted member of a distributed, cross-functional regional team.
Adaptability: Open to evolving workflows, new technologies, and changing business needs — a growth mindset is essential.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related field.
Industry certifications are a strong plus, including: CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, ITIL 4 Foundation, Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator, Jamf Certified Associate/Admin, or Google IT Support Professional Certificate.
Experience assisting with IT projects such as office hardware refreshes, system migrations, or new technology rollouts is a plus.

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

You will play an active role in all the stages of the development lifecycle and support your team throughout the process. You will also help ensure that developed products and deployments meet requirements and are within total quality management standards. You will collaborate with multiple, global teams. When you join our software engineering group, you become part of a team that believes in knowledge sharing and collaboration and that is committed to using reliable and well-thought-out engineering practices and technology to overcome any challenges. We are looking for someone who will use from a diverse set of technical backgrounds and opinions by encouraging a team-oriented environment and the use of open and direct communications, and respect. You will also seek knowledge of new developments in the software engineering, computer engineering, and test automation fields and will identify and pursue career training opportunities. Report to Engineering Manager

Your Responsibilities

You will design and implement Grafana dashboards for operational insights.
You will use Prometheus (or equivalent) to monitor the health of deployments.
You will develop automated runbooks for common operational tasks and resolving support escalation issues.
You will be an operations contact communicating with developers and customers alike.
You will document and review incidents and future resolutions, including team knowledge.
You will design and implement build, deployment, and configuration management systems.
You will test the designs you have implemented.
You ill monitor metrics and develop ways to improve.
You will provide technical guidance and educate team members and coworkers on development and operations.
You will build configuration standards.
You will maintain daily management and administration of projects.
You will design multiple processes; update existing processes.
You will improve infrastructure development and application development.
You will follow all best practices as established by the company.
You will build relationships and work with peers to ensure assigned tasks are prioritized.
You will look for knowledge of new developments in the software engineering, computer engineering, and software testing fields.
You will think outside the box and research and explore new avenues using the latest technologies and standards.

The Essentials - You Will Have

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

At least 2 years of experience in a software product development environment
Customer-facing operations on Cloud and Mobile platforms.
Proficiency in scripting languages like Go, JavaScript, and Python.
Experience with cloud services like AWS or Microsoft Azure.
Experience with software infrastructure management including Kubernetes and Terraform.
Experience deploying CloudOps/SRE practices.
Knowledge of software and deployment test methodologies and automated test tools.
Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, testing, and operations.
Software development on both Windows and Linux.
Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs.

What We Offer

Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.

jobs.title: Medical Insurance Biller and Claims Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Location:
On- Site, Barranquilla, Colombia (Remote positions not available)

Company Description
Venture Global Solutions (VGS S.A.S) is a leading business process outsourcing (BPO) company based in Barranquilla, Colombia, serving clients worldwide. The organization delivers high-quality services across customer service, technical support, data entry, and back-office operations. By leveraging modern technologies and proven best practices, VGS provides cost-effective, tailored solutions that support diverse business needs. The company’s focus on quality, efficiency, and reliability has earned it a reputation as a trusted partner for organizations of all sizes. Venture Global Solutions helps clients streamline operations, enhance customer satisfaction, and support global growth.

Role Description
The Claims Insurance Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Barranquilla, Colombia for an orthopedic and wellness surgery center located in the United States. This role is responsible for reviewing, processing, and validating insurance claims to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with policy terms and regulatory guidelines. The specialist will investigate claim details, gather and analyze supporting documentation, and coordinate with insurance carriers, brokers, and internal teams to resolve discrepancies and expedite claim decisions. Daily tasks include communicating with customers and stakeholders, updating claim records in internal systems, preparing reports on claim status and trends, and escalating complex cases when necessary. The role also involves collaborating with finance and operations to support accurate billing, payment reconciliation, and continuous process improvements in claims handling.

Key Responsibilities:

Claim Management: Proactively track and resolve out of network insurance claims. Work on 75-80 claims daily
Billing Data Entry: Post billing and paid claims using health insurance and billing software
Direct Payer Contact: Conduct outbound calls to insurance companies to dispute and investigate claim statuses.
Denial & Escalation: Identify denial patterns, submit formal appeals, and escalate unresolved claims to maximize reimbursement.
Data Documentation: Maintain precise records by capturing claim reference numbers, call notes, and payer responses.
Medical Records Assembly: Gather, organize, and submit comprehensive medical record packages for appeals and audits.

Qualifications

Must have experience in Health Insurance, including claims processes OR
billing and relevant regulations.
6 months to 2 years experience in Out-of-Network (OON) insurance claims follow-up, healthcare billing or similar.
Foundational understanding in the difference between In-network and out-of-network insurance claims and finance concepts related to claims payments, billing, reconciliations, and reporting.
Excellent Communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly in writing and verbally.
Proven Customer Service skills, including empathy, patience, and professionalism when handling sensitive or high-pressure situations.
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills for managing multiple claims and deadlines simultaneously.
Proficiency with office software and claims or CRM systems; ability to quickly learn new tools and platforms.
Prior experience in insurance claims, health insurance, property and casualty, or a similar environment is highly beneficial.
Ability to work on-site full-time in Barranquilla, Colombia and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced team setting.

To apply:
Email your resume to Jobs@ventureglobalsolution.com

Definir la estrategia de carga inicial, normalización y mantenimiento de datos de configuración.

Establecer modelos de datos, clases, atributos, relaciones y estándares de configuración.

Garantizar la integridad, precisión, completitud y actualización permanente de la CMDB.

Definir y administrar el ciclo de vida de los Elementos de Configuración (CI).

Integración con Procesos ITIL

Asegurar la integración de la CMDB con los procesos de Gestión de Cambios, Incidentes, Problemas, Continuidad y Gestión de Activos.

Validar que los cambios realizados en la infraestructura y aplicaciones se reflejen oportunamente en la CMDB.

Participar en el análisis de impacto de cambios e incidentes mediante el uso de la información de configuración.

Automatización e Inventario

Definir e implementar mecanismos automáticos y manuales para el descubrimiento y actualización de activos.

Coordinar la integración de herramientas de Discovery, monitoreo, nube y gestión de activos.

Supervisar la correcta identificación y reconciliación de información proveniente de múltiples fuentes.

Definir políticas, procedimientos y controles relacionados con la Gestión de Configuración.

Establecer métricas e indicadores de calidad de la CMDB.

Realizar revisiones periódicas para identificar inconsistencias, duplicidades o información obsoleta.

Liderar planes de remediación para mejorar la calidad de los datos de configuración.

Soportar auditorías internas, externas, regulatorias y controles SOX relacionados con la CMDB.

Generar evidencias y reportes de cumplimiento.

Implementar controles que aseguren la trazabilidad de las modificaciones realizadas sobre los CIs.

Participar en iniciativas de mejora continua relacionadas con cumplimiento normativo y gobierno de TI.
