jobs.title: RevOps Lead
jobs.description:
See something that should exist? Build it.

See a better way? Do it.

At Terrific
, every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI.

And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms.

What makes someone a Terrific RevOps Lead?

This role is for someone who wants to own the commercial operating layer, not just maintain it.

A strong Terrific RevOps Lead brings structure where there is ambiguity, discipline where there is leakage, and visibility where there are blind spots. They know how to build clean systems across HubSpot, forecasting, commissions, and reporting — and they understand that the point of doing that well is to help the company sell, scale, and make better decisions.

They are energized by high ownership, strong standards, and the opportunity to support a revenue motion at the intersection of social commerce, e-commerce, and media
.

About The Role

Terrific
is hiring a Revenue Operations Lead
to build the operating backbone of our revenue organization.

Right now, no one fully owns pipeline hygiene, HubSpot, reporting, or forecasting. This role is designed to architect it.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a hands-on build role for someone who can bring structure, discipline, and visibility to the revenue engine. You will help leadership understand pipeline health, forecast more accurately, track performance more clearly, and eliminate invisible leakage across the commercial team.

You should be excited by the opportunity to take a messy but high-leverage environment and turn it into a reliable operating system.

What You’ll Own

HubSpot administration and structure

jobs.title: Maintenance Planner
jobs.description:
APM Terminals

Buenaventura | Resiliencia en acción. Transformación en movimiento.

APM Terminals Buenaventura es más que un lugar de trabajo, es una historia de transformación de la que es posible formar parte. Aquí, la innovación se une a la determinación, y cada mejora genera un impacto real para los clientes y las comunidades. Si se busca propósito, retos y la oportunidad de marcar la diferencia, este es el lugar ideal.

¿Por qué te encantará trabajar aquí?

Formar parte de una terminal que está dando forma al futuro del comercio en Colombia.
Contribuir a mejoras significativas y procesos de modernización.
Trabajar junto a personas apasionadas por generar impacto.
Mentalidad de mejora continua: donde la curiosidad es valorada, el análisis de causa raíz es fundamental y la mejora constante forma parte esencial de cómo generamos resultados.

En APM Terminals somos líderes en la industria portuaria y formamos parte de una red global de operadores portuarios de primer nivel. Como parte del Grupo A.P. Moller-Maersk, conectamos economías y comunidades en todo el mundo, impulsando el comercio global y el crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro éxito está impulsado por una sólida cultura de mejora continua, colaboración e innovación. Únete a un equipo que está redefiniendo los estándares de la industria y ayudando a construir el futuro del comercio global.

APM Terminals busca incorporar un/a Planeador/a de Mantenimiento
que será responsable de asegurar la disponibilidad de recursos para la ejecución de los planes de mantenimiento, garantizando el cumplimiento de los cronogramas y ventanas de intervención con el mínimo impacto en la operación y en la infraestructura civil y eléctrica de la terminal.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

En APM Terminals promovemos una cultura dinámica de aprendizaje y desarrollo que permite a las personas potenciar sus capacidades y avanzar profesionalmente. Nuestro compromiso con la mejora continua y la excelencia operativa crea un entorno donde el crecimiento de cada colaborador es una prioridad.

Además, ofrecemos:

Oportunidad de formar parte de una compañía líder en la industria portuaria a nivel global.
Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo, inclusivo y enfocado en el desarrollo profesional.
Exposición a operaciones estratégicas y de alto impacto.
Beneficios competitivos y oportunidades de crecimiento interno.

Responsabilidades principales

Aplicar y supervisar los estándares globales de planificación y gestión del trabajo.
Garantizar el uso efectivo del sistema GMAO para la gestión de órdenes de trabajo, planificación y programación de actividades.
Construir programas de mantenimiento ejecutables optimizando el uso de recursos y minimizando impactos operativos.
Gestionar el seguimiento integral de las órdenes de trabajo desde su emisión hasta su cierre.
Monitorear y mejorar los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) del proceso de mantenimiento.
Colaborar estrechamente con las áreas de almacén e inventarios para asegurar la integración de las mejores prácticas de gestión de la cadena de suministro.
Participar activamente en las comunidades de planificación de mantenimiento de la red global de APM Terminals.
Mantener una comunicación efectiva con clientes internos y equipos globales de mantenimiento.
Promover el cumplimiento de los valores y principios corporativos de APM Terminals.

Requisitos:

Formación técnica o tecnológica en áreas industriales, eléctricas, electrónicas, mecánicas o afines.
Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en entornos de mantenimiento de activos o gestión de instalaciones.
Disponibilidad para residir en Buenaventura, Valle del Cauca.
Manejo avanzado de Microsoft Excel y herramientas ofimáticas.
Experiencia en planificación del mantenimiento basada en información proveniente de sistemas GMAO.
Conocimiento de métricas, procesos y principios de mantenimiento de activos.
Capacidad para planificar, programar y coordinar actividades de mantenimiento de forma estructurada.
Habilidad para trabajar con disciplina, realizar seguimiento a acciones y asegurar la documentación requerida.
Alta orientación a la calidad y atención al detalle.
Fuertes habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
Conocimiento de inglés escrito y hablado será considerado un valor agregado.

Mentalidad Lean:
buscamos una persona con una sólida orientación hacia la mejora continua, naturalmente curiosa, comprometida con la resolución de problemas desde la causa raíz y motivada por encontrar formas de hacer las cosas mejor cada día.

Si estás buscando un nuevo reto profesional y quieres contribuir al futuro del comercio global desde una de las terminales más importantes de Colombia, te invitamos a postularte y formar parte de APM Terminals.

jobs.title: Network Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
WSP

WSP is a global leader in engineering and professional services. We pride ourselves on delivering innovative solutions to our clients and maintaining a robust IT operation to support our employees worldwide. WSPs vast global network is today comprised of over 1,000 offices, 29 data centres, 1,300 data circuits, and used by over 65,000 users.

POSITION SUMMARY

To ensure the efficient operation of WSPs internal network services in the AMER Hub, we are seeking a talented and experienced Network Operations Specialist. This role will be part of the IT Operations team and report to the IT Infrastructure Operations Manager in the designated Hub. The overall team is dedicated to support IT infrastructure operations which includes network, compute, cloud, and workplace systems and services. You will manage and maintain all aspects of network operations with a primary focus on the services within the designated Hub.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Related to network services and infrastructure:

Managing, monitoring, and maintenance of day-to-day activities to align with expected service levels.
Performing routine and health maintenance.
Managing upgrades & performance related activities.
Identifying and correcting faults with services and infrastructure.
Planning and execution of minor infrastructure moves, adds, changes, and disposals (IMACDs).
Execution of business continuity tests.
Oversight and support of all related service supplier and/or manufacturer activities.
Proactive identification and resolution of issues before they affect service performance.
Identifying any improvements that can improve service levels.
Engaging in the problem management process.
Technical peer review and approvals for all related changes.
Support audit and compliance activities.
Management and maintenance of related platforms.
Ability to provide on-call support and extended working hours when called on and willingness to accept periodic rotation.

ACADEMIC AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

The ideal candidate would meet all, or most of the below criteria:

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
At least 4-6 years relevant and practical experience in a network operations role.
Vendor certifications not a requirement, proven practical experience preferred.
Experience working in large/global enterprise IT with multiple distributed branch/campus sites.
Experience of working within ITIL aligned Service Management organisation.
Practical experience in managing, operating, and troubleshooting large, complex, multi-vendor networks that include WAN, Wired & Wireless LAN, Perimeter Security, Security Services Edge (SSE), Application Delivery Controllers/ Load Balancing, Cloud Networking, and Remote Access VPN.
Experience in managing networks that encompass the following technologies is advantageous:
Software-Defined-WAN (preferably Aruba/Silver Peak)
Cloud Networking (preferably Microsoft Azure)
Cloud-based Internet Security (preferably Zscaler Internet Access)
Unified Communications (preferably Microsoft Teams)
Remote Access Solutions (preferably Zscaler Private Access & Cisco AnyConnect)
Multi-vendor LAN switching (preferably Cisco)
Multi-vendor wireless LAN (preferably Cisco and Aruba)
Next Generation Perimeter firewall technologies (preferably Palo Alto)
Application Delivery Controllers & Load Balancing (preferably F5 Networks)
Identity and Access Control Policy platform (preferably Cisco Identify Services Engine)
Experience in Network Automation and DevOps practices is highly desirable.

SKILLS/ COMPETENCIES/ OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Excellent written and spoken Spanish and English is required.
Competency in French considered a plus.
Ability to work with minimal direction and little supervision.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with excellent documentation abilities.
Excellent analytical and diagnostic problem-solving skills with the ability of providing solutions to identified problems.
Demonstrated experience in understanding and demonstrating compliance with information security requirements.
Knowledge and experience in performing information security practices in the management and delivery of infrastructure and operations.

jobs.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Job Description

Your Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Platform Engineer to join our Infrastructure Customer Engineering and Support team. This is a special Engineering task force dedicated to design, deploy and troubleshoot OpenStack/ OpenShift environments. They are deeply involved in technologies like Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS), private clouds based on Kubernetes and OpenStack, and collaborate closely with developers and product engineers to bridge the gap between infrastructure and software.

Design, deploy, configure, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on platforms like Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack.
Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.
Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer incidents.
Utilize expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions.
Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.
Stay current with industry’s best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Your Profile:

Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment. A solid grasp of computer networking fundamentals, such as understanding of VLANs and IP routing, is a must.
Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization. Knowledge in areas like Podman, Kubernetes, Helm, and/or OpenStack, KVM/QEMU is a significant advantage.
Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management. Proficiency in scripting with Bash and Python, or the willingness to learn and adapt, as well as familiarity with Ansible is required.
Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.
Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.
Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases such as MySQL and MariaDB, as well as experience with ETCD.

Certifications:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210).
Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
Red Hat OpenStack (EX310).
RedHat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration (EX280).
RedHat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management (EX380).

It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

Top performers move into lead roles, get matched with higher-tier clients, or transition into internal positions at Assistant Launch. We have EAs who've been with us 4+ years and grown their careers here.

Clear paths to advancement.

Mantener una comunicación efectiva con clientes internos y equipos globales de mantenimiento de activos.
Fortalecer relaciones de colaboración con áreas internas y socios externos.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos una persona organizada, orientada a resultados y apasionada por la excelencia operativa, que disfrute trabajar en entornos dinámicos donde la planificación y la mejora continua son clave para el éxito.

En Mailamericas buscamos un Analista Sr. DBA
con un perfil de ingeniería marcadamente hands-on para asumir la propiedad absoluta (data ownership) de nuestra infraestructura multicloud en AWS y Azure. El objetivo principal del rol es garantizar la alta disponibilidad de los sistemas, ejecutar la optimización de los motores relacionales, aplicar procesos de anonimización/ofuscación de datos y adecuar la infraestructura técnica a estándares internacionales de seguridad como ISO 27001.

¿Qué desafíos te esperan?

Data Ownership Total:
Asumir la propiedad absoluta y responsabilidad directa sobre la disponibilidad (HA), integridad, rendimiento y escalabilidad de la totalidad de las bases de datos (productivas y no productivas) en nuestra infraestructura multicloud en AWS y Azure.
Garantía de Continuidad y Operatividad:
Mantener la alta disponibilidad de los sistemas y ejecutar restauraciones Point-In-Time (PITR) bajo presión, realizando pruebas periódicas de failover con medición constante de RTO y RPO.
Administración Multicloud Hands-on:
Gestión avanzada y directa de motores relacionales como AWS Aurora PostgreSQL y SQL Server en Azure (Managed Instance, Azure SQL DB).
Estrategias de Migración Zero-Downtime (es blue green) :
Diseñar e implementar migraciones utilizando AWS Aurora Blue/Green Deployments, replicación lógica nativa, AWS DMS (Change Data Capture) y protocolos post-migración (ANALYZE, verificación de paridad y rollback).
Seguridad de Datos, Data Masking y Cumplimiento:
Implementar técnicas de Static y Dynamic Data Masking para la protección de PII en ambientes no productivos, adecuando la infraestructura técnica a estándares internacionales como ISO 27001, SOC 2 o PCI-DSS.
Performance Tuning e Internals:
Optimizar la infraestructura DB mediante query tuning, estructuración de índices, análisis de planes de ejecución, mecanismos de aislamiento e internals de motores relacionales.
Automatización e Infraestructura:
Desarrollar scripts para automatizar procesos operativos, mantenimiento y sanitización, apoyándote en herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC) como Terraform.
Observabilidad y Monitoreo:
Integrar y administrar herramientas de monitoreo como AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Performance Insights y Grafana.
Soporte Crítico y Rotación:
Participar en esquemas de rotación de guardias (On-Call) y atender incidentes críticos fuera del horario laboral cuando el negocio lo requiera.

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

Experiencia Previa Comprobable:
Mínimo de 3 a 5 años administrando bases de datos relacionales y operando directamente entornos productivos en la nube (AWS/Azure).
Perfil Técnico Hands-on:
Marcado perfil de ingeniería con dominio avanzado en AWS Aurora PostgreSQL y SQL Server en Azure.
Dominio de Scripting:
Uso fluido de Python, Bash o PowerShell para la automatización operativa y sanitización.
Conocimientos en IaC y Cumplimiento (Deseables):
Manejo de Terraform para aprovisionamiento de recursos y experiencia en adecuación técnica para normas ISO 27001, SOC 2 o PCI-DSS.
Certificaciones Oficiales (Deseables):
Valorable contar con AWS Certified Database - Specialty o Microsoft Azure DP-300.

Graduado o profesional en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Computación o carreras afines (o experiencia equivalente comprobable).

Impact analysis and remediation of custom code
Post-upgrade validation and issue resolution

Custom APIs, reports, and integrations

Account and entitlement aggregation
Access request and approval workflows
Automated provisioning and deprovisioning
Role and birthright access modeling
Implement and support identity lifecycle management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) processes
Configure and manage access certifications, SoD controls, and compliance reporting
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to connectors, workflows, provisioning, and upgrades
Collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and security stakeholders during onboarding and upgrades
Support environment management across dev/test/prod and participate in release management activities
Create and maintain technical documentation (Standard operating procedures, Knowledge base articles), upgrade runbooks, and application onboarding standards

Remote in all other cities within: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru.

Requirements

Mandatory Requirements (Must-Have)

Core IGA & Platform Expertise

Application Onboarding: Demonstrated experience onboarding applications into Saviynt.

Messer es la compañía privada de gases industriales más grande del mundo y una de las principales compañías de gases industriales y médicos en América del Norte y del Sur. Messer ofrece más de 120 años de experiencia en gases industriales, médicos, especiales y electrónicos. La empresa entrega gases, servicios y tecnologías de manera segura a través de una extensa red de producción y distribución.

Descripción del Puesto

Liderar la gestión de abastecimiento y contratación de las categorías asignadas, mediante la planificación y ejecución de estrategias de sourcing, negociación y gestión de proveedores, asegurando la disponibilidad oportuna y eficiente de bienes y servicios para la operación.

Impulsar la generación de valor para el negocio a través de la identificación de nuevas alternativas de abastecimiento, proveedores y soluciones que optimicen costos, mejoren el servicio y fortalezcan la competitividad de la Compañía.

Garantizar condiciones comerciales y contractuales óptimas, gestionando el costo total de adquisición, los riesgos de la cadena de suministro y el cumplimiento de los objetivos corporativos de rentabilidad y eficiencia.

Responsabilidades

Ejecutar la estrategia de abastecimiento de las categorías asignadas, asegurando la disponibilidad oportuna de bienes y servicios, el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas y la optimización del costo total de adquisición, alineado con los objetivos de la Compañía.
Diseñar e implementar estrategias de sourcing y contratación orientadas a la identificación y captura de oportunidades de ahorro dentro de las categorías, mediante el análisis y monitoreo del gasto, comparativos de costos y evaluación del mercado, con el fin de optimizar la eficiencia, reducir costos y generar valor sin comprometer la calidad de los bienes y servicios adquiridos.
Analizar tendencias del mercado y condiciones de la industria, ajustando las estrategias de abastecimiento para anticipar impactos en disponibilidad, costos y competitividad de los insumos.
Identificar e incorporar nuevas alternativas de abastecimiento, modelos de contratación y proveedores innovadores que fortalezcan la competitividad de las categorías.
Identificar, evaluar y mitigar riesgos en la cadena de suministro, incluyendo riesgos de abastecimiento, volatilidad de precios, interrupciones logísticas y factores externos, asegurando la continuidad operativa del negocio.
Definir, junto con las áreas usuarias, la homologación y estandarización de especificaciones técnicas de bienes y servicios, garantizando procesos de compra eficientes, comparabilidad de ofertas y reducción de riesgos asociados a adquisiciones inadecuadas, obsoletas o no alineadas a la necesidad del negocio.
Identificar, seleccionar, desarrollar y evaluar proveedores desde una perspectiva comercial, técnica y de desempeño, promoviendo relaciones de largo plazo que los conviertan en aliados estratégicos del negocio. Gestionar su calificación y mejora continua, asegurando altos estándares de calidad, servicio, cumplimiento, confiabilidad y competitividad en las condiciones de suministro, contribuyendo a la generación de valor en los bienes y servicios adquiridos.
Liderar licitaciones y procesos de negociación con proveedores, asegurando condiciones óptimas en precios, calidad, volúmenes, niveles de servicio, tiempos de entrega y condiciones comerciales, en beneficio de la eficiencia operativa y financiera del negocio.
Evaluar, analizar y seleccionar las mejores alternativas de abastecimiento mediante la gestión de cotizaciones, asegurando decisiones de compra basadas en criterios de costo total, calidad, servicio y riesgo.
Hacer seguimiento al desempeño de proveedores y contratos, identificando desviaciones, riesgos o incumplimientos, y gestionando oportunamente planes de acción con las áreas internas y los proveedores.
Gestionar y coordinar el proceso de trámite, revisión, aprobación y firma de los contratos, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas garantizando la oportunidad, trazabilidad y correcta formalización de los acuerdos comerciales.
Hacer seguimiento a la ejecución de los contratos de la categoría, verificando el cumplimiento de las condiciones pactadas y gestionando oportunamente alertas de vencimiento, renovación o desviaciones, en coordinación con las áreas internas.
Atender y dar solución a los reclamos o discrepancias que se puedan presentar con los proveedores buscando el cumplimiento contractual de las condiciones comerciales pactadas.
Cumplir, medir, analizar y reportar los indicadores de gestión (KPIs) del área, incluyendo ahorros, términos de pago, nivel de servicio, desempeño de proveedores y cumplimiento de objetivos, generando información para la toma de decisiones.
Identificar e implementar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos de abastecimiento, incluyendo digitalización, automatización y optimización de la cadena de suministro.
Desarrollar reportes, análisis y presentaciones ejecutivas sobre el desempeño de las categorías, tendencias de mercado, iniciativas de abastecimiento y generación de valor, apoyando la toma de decisiones estratégicas de la organización.
Dar a conocer a los proveedores y contratistas las normas de seguridad, salud, medio ambiente, calidad e inocuidad del producto para garantizar su cumplimiento.
Garantizar el cumplimiento de las políticas de SAGRILAFT en el proceso de selección y contratación de proveedores, realizando evaluaciones de riesgo de lavado de activos y financiación del terrorismo, asegurando la debida diligencia y el registro adecuado de la información para mitigar riesgos legales y reputacionales para la Compañía.
Gestionar y dar seguimiento integral al proceso de compra, desde la recepción y validación de la solicitud de compra hasta la entrega satisfactoria del bien o servicio al área usuaria, asegurando el cumplimiento de las condiciones pactadas, los tiempos establecidos y los niveles de servicio requeridos
Participación de auditorias

Requisitos

Título universitario en Ingeniería Mecánica, Electromecánica, Eléctrica, Civil o Industrial.
Disponibilidad de trabajar de lunes a sábado en horario de oficina
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en operación y mantenimiento de activos de alta complejidad, como centros comerciales, edificios corporativos, hospitales u hoteles.

Al unirte a CBRE, pasas a formar parte del líder global en servicios e inversión inmobiliaria comercial, que ayuda a las empresas y a las personas a prosperar. En CBRE, estamos comprometidos con fomentar una cultura en la que todas las personas sientan que pertenecen. Valoramos la diversidad de perspectivas y experiencias, y damos la bienvenida a todas las postulaciones.

jobs.title: Ops Team Lead
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Descripción de puesto

As a DevOps Team Lead, you will lead a team of DevOps engineers responsible for the CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and cloud infrastructure that power our software delivery. You will balance hands-on technical contribution with team leadership — coaching engineers, coordinating delivery, and partnering with development and operations teams to keep our platforms reliable, secure, and improving.

You will report to the Engineering Manager

Main Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Delivery:

Lead, coach, and develop a team of DevOps engineers, setting clear goals, removing roadblocks, and encouraging a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
Coordinate the team's backlog and delivery commitments, ensuring you prioritize work, keep it on track, and align it with program goals.
Support hiring, onboarding, and competency development to build a, high-performing team.

CI/CD & GitOps Operations

Lead the reliability and evolution of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows (e.g., FluxCD), ensuring stable, automated, and reproducible deployments.
Guide the use of GitOps best practices across teams and support migrations away from legacy tooling.
Resolve complex configuration and deployment issues, especially during critical cutover and release events.

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

Oversee provisioning and management of cloud infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform on Azure/AWS), enforcing consistency and security standards.
Champion automation to reduce manual effort and improve delivery speed and quality.

Observability & Incident Management

Ensure observability (logging, metrics, alerting) across the platform and lead the team's incident response and post-incident review practices.
Partner with development and product teams to embed reliability and operational readiness into the delivery lifecycle.

Security & Compliance

Uphold enterprise security and data governance policies across the DevOps toolchain and infrastructure.
Support audits and compliance requirements for the systems the team operates.

The Essentials
— You Will Have

Bachelor's Degree
Advance English

The Preferred — You Might Also Have

Typically requires 5+ years of DevOps/platform engineering experience, including prior team lead or technical leadership responsibility.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins) and GitOps frameworks (e.g., FluxCD, Argo CD).
Proficiency with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and a major cloud platform — Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Proficiency in scripting/automation (e.g., Python, Bash, and PowerShell).
Experience with observability/monitoring tooling and incident management practices.
Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies.

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes…

Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
We match your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity with a charitable donation through its volunteer and donation matching program.
Employee Assistance Program.
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy expects employees to work at a Rockwell location at least on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

We believe that employee diversity is an important element of our common future. We provide opportunities for talent growth with the entire organization. We support equality by celebrating the individuality of every person, regardless of their origin and identity. We appreciate the unique cultural pattern and variety of experiences in each of us. We invite all who want to join and change the world of Our organization.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Associate
jobs.description:
Location:
Barranquilla, Colombia
Engagement Type:
Independent Contractor

About Releasit

Releasit builds apps that help Shopify merchants streamline their operations and grow their businesses. Releasit is part of Shop Circle, Circeus’s agentic commerce software division.

We care deeply about making our products easy to use and making sure merchants get fast, thoughtful support whenever they need help.

We’re looking for a Customer Experience Associate
who is curious, customer-focused, and excited to solve problems in a fast-moving ecommerce environment.

About the Role

As a Customer Experience Associate, you’ll be one of the first people our merchants interact with when they need help.

You’ll support customers through tickets and live chat, troubleshoot common product issues, explain solutions clearly, and make sure merchants feel supported from the beginning of a conversation through resolution.

You’ll work within established processes, collaborate closely with the wider team, and help us identify recurring questions or pain points that can improve our products, documentation, and overall customer experience.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, learning how software works, and building strong problem-solving skills in a SaaS and ecommerce environment.

What You’ll Do

Support our merchants

Be a trusted first point of contact for merchants who need help using Releasit.
You’ll guide conversations with clarity and professionalism, understand the issue the merchant is facing, and work toward the best possible solution.
You’ll set clear expectations, communicate next steps, and maintain a helpful, respectful, and solution-oriented tone throughout every interaction.

Troubleshoot and solve problems

Investigate common product and configuration issues by following established troubleshooting processes and available documentation.
You’ll carefully review merchant setups, reproduce issues when needed, and gather the right information to understand what is happening.
When an issue requires deeper technical expertise, you’ll escalate it with clear context and the information needed for the next person to continue the investigation efficiently.

Make complex things easy to understand

Explain product functionality and troubleshooting steps in simple, practical language.
You’ll provide step-by-step guidance, share useful resources, and help merchants understand how to solve similar issues independently in the future.
When the product cannot support a particular request exactly as expected, you’ll help identify practical alternatives or workarounds whenever possible.

Build strong product knowledge

Develop a strong understanding of Releasit apps, their features, settings, and how different configurations can affect merchant outcomes.
You’ll stay current with product updates and new features so you can provide accurate, relevant guidance to customers.
You don’t need to be a developer, but being comfortable with basic web concepts such as HTML, CSS, browser tools, or technical troubleshooting is a plus.

Help us improve

Customer conversations are one of our best sources of product insight.
You’ll flag recurring issues, confusing workflows, missing documentation, and common merchant questions so the team can improve our support resources and product experience.
You’ll also contribute observations and learnings that help the wider team provide faster and more consistent support.

Collaborate with the team

Work closely with other Customer Experience team members and partner with Product, Technical Support, and other teams when needed.
During busy periods, you’ll help teammates unblock cases, share useful context, and contribute to a smooth and collaborative support environment.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who:
Communicates clearly, professionally, and empathetically.
Enjoys helping customers and solving problems.
Is patient, curious, and comfortable asking the right questions.
Can follow structured processes while using good judgment.
Pays close attention to detail.
Is comfortable learning new software and technical concepts.
Takes ownership of customer conversations and follows through.
Can explain complex information in a simple and understandable way.
Works well with others and is comfortable asking for help when needed.
Is proactive about identifying recurring problems and opportunities to improve.

Experience with Shopify, ecommerce, SaaS, customer support, customer success, or technical troubleshooting
is a plus, but not essential.

Why Join Releasit?

This role is a great opportunity to build experience across customer experience, ecommerce, SaaS, and technical troubleshooting.

You’ll work directly with merchants, develop deep product knowledge, collaborate with different teams, and contribute ideas that help improve both our products and the way we support customers.

If you enjoy solving problems, communicating with people, and learning something new every day, we’d love to hear from you.

Working with Us

This is an ongoing independent contractor engagement
.
You’ll work closely with the Releasit team as part of our Customer Experience function while operating as an independent professional.
We’re looking for someone interested in building a strong, long-term collaboration with the team.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

Job Description

As an Agentic AI Operations Engineer
, you will support and operate the Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions that power our enterprise AI platform. Working under the guidance of senior architects and engineers, you will help deploy AI pipelines and agentic applications in production, ensuring they run reliably, securely. This is a hands-on operational role focused on keeping our AI systems healthy and improving.

You will report to the Engineering Manager.

Main Responsibilities

Agentic AI Application & Pipeline Operations:

Deploy, configure, and maintain AI Agents that use Tools and Skills, including supporting MCP clients and servers within established frameworks.
Operate and support Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. These pipelines include data ingestion, document processing, and promoting generation (e.g., Azure OpenAI or Gemini embeddings). Additionally, help maintain integrations with vector and NoSQL databases.
Maintain the Azure Infrastructure that supports the AI Agents (Postgres, Redis, Grafana / Monitoring, Kubernetes Services, Application Gateway)
Configure / Maintain a Service Mesh to support the AI Architecture

Monitor & Performance Support

Monitor model serving layers and data processing pipelines, identifying and escalating performance issues to maintain low latency and efficient resource use across the cloud environment.
Implement and tune observability (logging, metrics, alerting) and respond to incidents to keep AI services available and reliable.
Implement Grafana Dashboards for the existing infrastructure and usage

Security & Compliance Operations

Apply and uphold established security and data governance policies in daily operations, including PII filtering and guarded conversation frameworks.
Support audits and compliance checks for AI products in production.

Infrastructure Automation & CI/CD

Use Terraform to provision and manage Azure infrastructure-as-code within existing standards.
Maintain Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to help automated, reproducible deployments.

The Essentials — You Will Have

Bachelor's Degree.
English proficiency for collaboration with global teams

The Preferred — You Might Also Have

Typically requires 3+ years of relevant work experience.
Be able to work in diverse technical teams and adaptability to changes
Proficient at Kubernetes Clusters Management
Python experience
Hands-on experience deploying, operating, or supporting Generative AI solutions, RAG pipelines, or multi-agent frameworks (any cloud vendor).
2+ years of experience with a major cloud platform — Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience with MLOps and orchestration tooling such as Docker and Airflow.
Exposure to vector search platforms like Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL, Redis, Azure AI Search, or pgvector/Mongo Atlas.
Experience with observability/monitoring tooling and incident response.
Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies.

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes …

Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
Employee Assistance Program.
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

jobs.title: Database Administrator
jobs.description:
Database Administrator (DBA), you will play a critical role in architecting, building, maintaining, optimizing, and securing clients databases across both Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle Database platforms. This is a hands-on position that goes well beyond monitoring: you will design and implement new database environments, lead migrations and upgrades, troubleshoot complex performance and availability problems through to root cause, and define the architecture, standards and automation that keep multi-client, heterogeneous estates reliable.

Responsibilities

Validate database design and architecture solutions for new and existing client environments on both SQL Server and Oracle, including sizing, high availability and disaster recovery topology, storage layout and security model.
Build, install, configure and harden new database instances and environments to a documented standard, and hand them into operation with runbooks and monitoring already in place.
Administer databases regarding efficiency, security, and systems integrity.
Monitor system's health and performance.
Ensure high levels of performance and availability.
Ensure that all database backup schedules are implemented and monitored for issues.
Test database recovery procedures periodically and validate that recovery time and recovery point objectives are actually met.
Lead and execute database migrations, upgrades and patching cycles on both platforms, with tested rollback plans and post-change performance validation.
Optimize query performance through T-SQL and PL/SQL improvements, indexes, statistics, partitioning, execution plan management and other techniques.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex production incidents to root cause across both platforms, lead technical bridges during major incidents, and produce root cause analyses with preventive actions.
Perform capacity and growth planning, and raise storage, licensing and infrastructure needs proactively before they become incidents.
Define and maintain database standards, reference architectures, technical documentation and operational runbooks for the supported estate.
Design and implement automation for repetitive database operations in order to reduce manual effort and human error.
Optimize use of operational resources.
Provide 24x7 support for critical production systems.
Overseeing the compliance of company operating processes.
Maintain technical expertise in both Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle technologies.
Maintain awareness of current and future technologies and best practices relevant to operations.
Act in a mentoring capacity to other team members, including technical guidance and knowledge transfer on both platforms.
Make recommendations on performance improvement and automation opportunities to improve operations

Requirements

6+ years' experience as a senior DBA in large-scale production environments supporting several clients, with hands-on, in-depth experience in both Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle Database. Dual-platform capability is a requirement of this role, not a preference.
Proven experience building database environments from the ground up: sizing and architecture definition, installation and configuration, instance and storage layout, schema and object design, standards definition, and documented handover into operations.
Demonstrated experience troubleshooting and resolving complex production incidents to root cause on both platforms: performance degradation, blocking and locking, execution plan regressions, data corruption, cluster and replication failures, and capacity exhaustion.
Experienced in high availability and disaster recovery architectures on both platforms: SQL Server Always-On availability groups, failover clustering and log shipping; Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Data Guard, and RMAN backup and recovery strategies.
Experience leading database migrations, version upgrades, consolidations and platform modernization, with tested rollback plans and no-regression validation.
Desirable 2 years' experience of Azure SQL Database, AWS RDS (SQL Server and Oracle), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and/or MS Dataverse.
Experienced in Clustering Services, High Availability and Always-On configurations.
Proven experience with cloud-based services and shared operations in heterogeneous environments.
Participate in 24x7 on call support rotation.

Education:
Computer Science, Engineering, IT bachelor's degree or equivalent working experience.
Azure Data Engineer Associate.
Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Oracle Database Administrator, or equivalent demonstrable Oracle expertise.

Technical Skills

Expert-level SQL Server administration and performance engineering: T-SQL, Query Store, execution plan analysis, Dynamic Management Views, wait statistics, indexing and statistics strategy, partitioning, hints, resource governance, and Azure Monitor SQL Insights for cloud-hosted instances.
Expert-level Oracle administration and performance engineering: PL/SQL, AWR and ASH analysis, optimizer behavior and execution plan management, SQL plan baselines, statistics management, partitioning, ASM and tablespace design, RMAN, Data Guard and RAC.
Database architecture: capacity and growth planning, instance and storage layout, high availability and disaster recovery topology design, consolidation strategy, data lifecycle and archiving, and the definition of build standards and reference architectures that can be reused across clients.
Excellent knowledge of database backup and recovery on both platforms, including restore testing, point-in-time recovery, block and page level recovery, and validated recovery time and recovery point objectives.
Structured troubleshooting and root cause analysis: the ability to isolate a problem with evidence rather than assumption across the database, operating system, storage and network layers, and to document both the root cause and the preventive control.
Database security and compliance: least-privilege access models, auditing, encryption at rest and in transit, key management, and data masking for non-production environments.
Automation and scripting for database operations (for example PowerShell, Python, Shell or Ansible), covering health checks, patching, provisioning and non-production refresh.
Familiarity with database design, documentation and coding, clustering, replication.
Knowledge of client-server applications.
Knowledge in ITIL.

Desired Technical Proficiencies:
Azure Database Administrator Associate.
Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) Database Administrator.
AWS Certified Database - Specialty.
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect or equivalent cloud database certification.

Language Skills

English Level B2+

The System & Cloud Engineer Jr.
is a hands-on member of the Data Center & Cloud team for the Mosaic Infrastructure Managed Services engagement, supporting a managed estate of servers, virtualization, storage, and cloud workloads across roughly 60 sites in the United States, Canada, Brazil, Peru, and Paraguay. Resolve escalated server and infrastructure incidents from the Service Desk and NOC, including Windows Server and Linux OS-level issues.
Perform routine server administration: account and access requests, disk and resource management, service restarts, certificate renewals, and scheduled task upkeep.

Working knowledge of Windows Server administration; Linux exposure a plus.

Solid troubleshooting fundamentals and a methodical approach to incident resolution.
Good documentation habits and disciplined ticket hygiene.
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English B2+.

Virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V) at an operator level.

jobs.title: NOC Analyst Sr. (Patching)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The NOC Analyst Sr. (Patching)
is a senior member of Auxis' shared 24x7 Network Operations Center supporting the Mosaic Infrastructure Managed Services engagement, with a dedicated focus on patch management across the client's server and infrastructure estate spanning roughly 60 sites in the United States, Canada, Brazil, Peru, and Paraguay. This role plans, schedules, executes, and verifies patching cycles in coordination with the Systems, Network, and Security teams, ensuring vulnerabilities are remediated within agreed timelines and patching activity is executed safely through the account's change management process. The role also provides senior-level monitoring and event management coverage within the NOC.

Responsibilities

Own the execution of the recurring patch management calendar for the managed server estate (Windows and Linux), including planning, scheduling, deployment, verification, and reporting.
Coordinate patching windows through the Change Management process, preparing change records, rollback plans, and post-implementation verification evidence.
Track patch compliance against agreed timelines and vulnerability remediation SLAs, producing compliance reporting for the NOC Lead and Security stakeholders.
Coordinate with the Systems Engineer Lead and Tower D engineers on patch sequencing for critical or sensitive workloads, including pre/post health checks.
Partner with the Security/vulnerability management function to prioritize remediation of identified vulnerabilities across the estate.
Troubleshoot failed patch deployments, driving them to resolution or escalating to the appropriate resolver team.
Provide senior-level NOC monitoring and event management coverage during assigned shifts, including alert triage, first-response diagnostics, and escalation.
Mentor NOC Analysts on patching procedures, monitoring tools, and the client environment.
Maintain and improve patching runbooks, SOPs, and automation scripts.
Support maintenance-window coordination with site contacts and third-party vendors where required.

Skills And Experience

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
3+ years of experience in NOC operations, systems administration, or infrastructure operations, including hands-on patch management responsibility.
Hands-on experience with enterprise patching tools (e.g., SCCM/MECM, WSUS, Ivanti, BigFix, or Linux patching tooling).
Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration fundamentals.
Experience operating within ITIL change management for scheduled maintenance activities.
Understanding of vulnerability management concepts and remediation prioritization.
Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation of executed work.
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English B2+.
Availability to work scheduled after-hours and weekend patching windows on a rotating basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with vulnerability scanning platforms (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or similar).
Scripting skills for patch automation and reporting (PowerShell, Bash, Python).
ITIL Foundation certification.
Experience in a managed services environment supporting enterprise clients.
Bilingual English/Spanish or English/Portuguese a plus.

Technical Skills & Tools

Patching platforms: SCCM/MECM, WSUS, and/or Linux patch management tooling.
Monitoring and event management tools (SolarWinds or similar).
ITSM/ticketing and change management platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent).
Scripting for automation and reporting (PowerShell, Bash) a plus.
Vulnerability management platforms (Tenable, Qualys, or similar) a plus.

Job Summary

The End-Point Engineer Sr.
is a senior hands-on engineer on the End-User Computing team for the Mosaic Infrastructure Managed Services engagement, supporting roughly 11,000+ managed endpoints across the United States, Canada, Brazil, Peru, and Paraguay. Working under the direction of the End-Point Lead/Architect, this role executes and improves the day-to-day engineering of the SCCM (Configuration Manager/MECM) and Microsoft Intune platforms - application packaging, OS deployment, patching, compliance policies - and plays a hands-on role in the account's migration from traditional SCCM-based management to modern, cloud-first Intune management.

Package, test, and deploy applications across the managed endpoint estate, maintaining packaging standards and documentation.
Execute endpoint patch management cycles, monitoring deployment success rates and remediating failures.
Support the migration of endpoints from SCCM-based management to Intune modern management, executing migration waves under the roadmap set by the End-Point Lead/Architect.

Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for endpoint automation.

Experience in a managed services environment supporting enterprise clients.

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Job Description

Joining Capgemini Engineering means becoming part of a global community of passionate engineers and technology experts who are shaping the future of connectivity. In this role, you will work at the heart of cutting-edge telecommunications infrastructure, contributing to the performance and reliability of next-generation mobile networks. You will collaborate with world-class professionals on challenging, meaningful projects that make a real impact — all within a culture that values curiosity, innovation, and continuous growth.

Your Role

In this role you will play a key role in:

Performing 24x7x365 incident monitoring of mobile access and transmission networks, ensuring continuous service availability and rapid response to any disruptions across RAN environments.
Managing and resolving transmission network failures, including the creation of backup routes and provisioning of circuits within DWDM and SDH environments using platforms from Nokia, Huawei, and Ericsson.
Operating and maintaining Radio Access Network (RAN) elements across 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G technologies for both Ericsson and Nokia, including eNodeB, gNodeB, and virtualized elements such as ASBSC (CBAN, NCIR, NADCM).
Supporting the deployment and configuration of Cloud RAN and 5G Standalone environments, working with virtualized network components and DELL technology switches within the ASBSC ecosystem.
Coordinating and providing technical support to field technicians carrying out installation and configuration of RPC equipment, ensuring quality and alignment with network standards and client requirements.

Your Profile

Minimum 3 years of experience in telecommunications or IT, with hands-on knowledge of monitoring DWDM and SDH transmission environments and working with network management platforms from major vendors including Nokia, Huawei, and Ericsson.
Solid understanding of RAN technologies across multiple generations (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), including familiarity with Nokia and Huawei photonic mesh, Nokia trace elements (EMIL, MEGAMON, MEGAPLEXER, UTF), and Ericsson components such as TCU and R6K.
Experience working with network management tools and platforms including OMS, Tarantella, Geiser, NRIF, FEMTOS, and Personalized Management Centers in a Telefónica environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex network issues, make data-driven decisions under pressure, and implement effective resolutions in a fast-paced operational environment.
Awareness of 5G Standalone and Cloud RAN architectures, with a proactive mindset towards staying up to date with emerging telecommunications technologies and network evolution trends.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

To be the leading producer of glass bottles and jars worldwide you need passion, commitment and innovation baked into the very fabric of a business and its people. For more than 120 years, our glass makers have honed their craft—channeling their creativity into more than 1,800 patents held today. When you join O-I you become part of that story.

We are proud to provide high quality glass packaging for beer, wine, spirits, food, non-alcoholic beverages, cosmetics and pharmaceuticals. We are dedicated to make what matters to shape a healthier, more sustainable and more exciting world. We transform the industry to make glass more relevant and more accessible to more people.

With nearly 19,000 employees and an unparalleled footprint spanning almost 64 plants in 18 countries, O-I is a truly global maker of glass packaging.

You will work with the business customers, users, technical architects, and application designers to define the functional business process requirements for the SAP system within a designated functional area.

In this position you will provide full life-cycle support, as well as creating system documentation, including operating procedures, functional and technical design specifications, and technical support documentation.

Serves as primary IT contact and lead role for customer-facing projects

Trouble shoots, debugs, tests the existing solutions to ensure business continuity
Collaborate with other IT teams for integration, development and cross functional requirements
Effectively utilize new and existing technology to design solutions that are fit for purpose in supporting the needs of the commercial and order to cash organization.

Note: Please submit your resume in English.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
Advanced English language skills.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT, supporting business enabled processes in commercial and order to cash processes in SAP.
Experience with end to end full life cycle SAP implementation.
In-depth expertise with SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) module.

Royal York Property Management is hiring experienced Property Managers to manage the owner and tenant experience across active residential property-management files.

Act as the main point of contact for property owners and tenants throughout the management relationship.
Manage multiple active clients, properties and files with strong organization and follow-through.
Provide proactive updates so owners understand what is happening, what is pending and what comes next.
Handle time-sensitive property and tenancy matters with urgency, professionalism and clear communication.
Coordinate next steps between owners, tenants, internal departments, vendors and other service providers.
Collect, review and track required property, owner and tenant documentation.
Maintain complete CRM records, including notes, tasks, follow-ups, updates and file movement.
Identify stalled files, missed follow-ups, client concerns and service problems before they escalate.
Escalate serious issues promptly and use sound judgment to protect client satisfaction.
Support a structured, process-driven property-management experience from onboarding through ongoing management.

Requirements

Three to five or more years of property management, account management, client success, client services, relationship management or comparable client-ownership experience.
Proven ability to manage multiple clients, properties, accounts or active files simultaneously.
Strong communication skills and confidence handling owner, tenant or client concerns.
Strong process discipline and comfort working within a structured CRM and task-management system.
Strong follow-up habits, task management and documentation accuracy.
Ability to remain calm under pressure and prioritize quickly in a high-volume environment.
Professional judgment when handling complaints, escalations, deadlines and sensitive client matters.
Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience working with North American clients.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About Share

Share is a venture backed company building the marketplace for bandwidth: the infrastructure layer that connects internet capacity suppliers to every individual and business that runs on it.

Today, bandwidth is the most in-demand asset in the world, but its buy/sell process is highly fragmented and inefficiently priced. Share brings the supply and demand together by building distributed routing nodes and connecting carriers, ISPs, data centers, and enterprise buyers through a neutral exchange, turning bandwidth into a liquid, tradeable resource.

We're building the category-defining marketplace for how bandwidth gets bought, sold, and delivered globally.

The Role

Share's physical network runs on real infrastructure: servers, virtualization, firewalls, and the operating systems underneath everything the company runs, cloud-native or not. We're looking for a senior Systems Engineer to own that foundation, the traditional infrastructure layer that everything else still depends on, hardened and run the way a carrier-grade network demands.

This is the seat for someone who's spent years running production Linux, virtualized infrastructure, and the security perimeter around it at real scale (most likely inside a telco, ISP, or carrier-grade network operator) and who's now bringing that discipline into a more modern, cloud-first stack.

Our Ideal Candidate

7+ years of professional systems engineering experience, ideally including time inside a telco, ISP, or carrier-grade network operator.
Deep, production Linux administration: you've built, hardened, and kept Linux systems running at real scale, not just deployed them from a template.
Real virtualization depth: VMware, KVM, Hyper-V or similar, you're just as comfortable at the VM layer as you are one layer up.
Genuine security ownership: perimeter security, firewalls, network segmentation, VPNs, intrusion detection. You've designed and defended a real security boundary, not just followed a checklist.
Solid networking fundamentals: routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, load balancing, enough to hold your own with our network team, even if carrier-scale BGP isn't your specialty.
Working knowledge of at least one hyperscaler (AWS, GCP, or Azure), you don't need to be cloud-native yet, but you're comfortable operating there.
Kubernetes exposure.
AI-native in your workflow: you've built with these tools, not just used them, and can show the leverage you've gained.
You ship, and you drive. Handed an infrastructure or security problem, you scope it, build it, own it through production, and use what you've learned to push the department forward.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a mission-driven, investor-backed company. A high-ownership environment with a steep but well-supported learning curve, and a team that writes things down.

Conectando Personas Mejorando Vidas

Conviértete en un DHL y consigue lo esencial de tu vida diaria, a través de los mejores beneficios, buscamos tu seguridad, tu salud y la de tu familia.

A eso nos referimos cuando hablamos de inclusión.

Diversidad es nuestra fuerza.

Administrar, ejecutar y controlar las operaciones logísticas, de acuerdo con los parámetros establecidos por el cliente y la Compañía, buscando optimizar los recursos, generar valor agregado y lograr rentabilidad esperada.

Tier 1 End-User Support: Provide first-line technical support for all hardware (laptops, desktops, monitors, peripherals, mobile devices), software (Microsoft 365 applications, proprietary programs), and network connectivity issues.

Business Continuity Support: Assist in ensuring the continuity of end-user services and basic network connectivity, escalating to senior IT personnel as needed.
Network & Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of critical network infrastructure, including the firewall, switch stack, access points and CCTV cameras.
Assist with basic troubleshooting of network connectivity issues: Assist with basic troubleshooting of network connectivity issues (LAN/WLAN), identifying potential hardware faults or service interruptions, escalate through appropriate escalation channels. Support basic telephony systems and connectivity.
Software Installation & Maintenance: Install, configure, and troubleshoot operating systems (Windows, macOS), productivity software (Microsoft 365 suite), and specialized applications.
Documentation & Knowledge Management: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for IT procedures, common issues, and infrastructure configurations. Contribute to the team's knowledge base for continuous improvement.
After-Hours & Weekend Support: Provide scheduled or on-call support for critical issues outside of regular business hours as required.

Requirements:

jobs.title: Data Domain Administrator
jobs.description:
Data Domain Administrator

The Data Domain Administrator is responsible for the administration, monitoring, maintenance, performance optimization, security, and support of Dell EMC PowerProtect Data Domain and DDVE environments. The role ensures reliable backup storage, replication, cyber resilience, disaster recovery readiness, and integration with AS 400/IBM i-Series.

Key Responsibilities

Administration and Operations

Install, configure, and manage Data Domain appliances, including physical Data Domain and DDVE instances.
Perform regular system health checks, proactive monitoring, and operational validation.
Manage storage units, MTrees, CIFS/NFS shares, DD Boost configurations, and access controls.
Monitor backup storage utilization, available capacity, growth trends, and system alerts.
Plan and perform software upgrades, patches, and firmware updates as per organizational change processes.

Backup Storage Management

Configure Data Domain as backup storage target for enterprise backup applications.
Monitor backup storage performance and support troubleshooting of failed or slow backup jobs.
Manage retention policies, storage optimization, deduplication, compression, and cleanup activities.
Ensure backup images remain available, recoverable, and aligned with business retention requirements.

Replication and Disaster Recovery

Configure and manage Data Domain replication between production, DR, and vault environments.
Monitor replication health, lag, throughput, and capacity usage.
Support DR drills, recovery validation, and restoration exercises.
Validate backup storage readiness against defined RPO and RTO requirements.

Security and Cyber Resilience

Implement Retention Lock, immutability, RBAC, and secure administrative access.
Support Dell Cyber Recovery, isolated vault, air-gap, and cleanroom recovery use cases.
Investigate backup storage anomalies, security alerts, and suspicious operational behavior.
Participate in ransomware recovery planning, cyber resilience testing, and compliance reporting.

Monitoring and Performance Optimization

Monitor CPU, memory, disk utilization, throughput, stream counts, and backup/recovery performance.
Analyze deduplication and compression ratios to identify optimization opportunities.
Tune DD Boost, networking, and backup application integration settings as required.
Prepare capacity forecasts, performance reports, and operational dashboards.

Troubleshooting and Vendor Coordination

Resolve Data Domain hardware, software, replication, connectivity, and DD Boost issues.
Perform initial diagnosis, log collection, RCA support, and incident documentation.
Coordinate with Dell Support and backup application vendors for critical incidents and escalations.
Track issue closure and contribute to problem management and permanent fix implementation.

Documentation and Compliance

Maintain SOPs, operational runbooks, configuration documents, and architecture diagrams.
Support audit requirements related to backup retention, immutability, access, and recoverability.
Prepare operational reports covering capacity, health, backup storage utilization, and risks.
Ensure compliance with change, incident, security, and governance processes.

Required Technical Skills

Data Domain Core

Data Domain OS, DDVE, MTrees, storage units, cleaning, alerts, filesystem, capacity monitoring
Backup Integration

DD Boost, NFS, CIFS, PowerProtect Data Manager, NetWorker, Avamar, Commvault, Rubrik, Cohesity, Veeam
Replication and DR

MTree replication, collection replication, replication monitoring, DR validation, failover/failback support
Security

Retention Lock, immutability, RBAC, LDAP/AD integration, secure access, cyber recovery vault support
Infrastructure

Linux, VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewall coordination, SNMP
Operations

Incident, change, problem management, RCA, SLA reporting, capacity forecasting, SOP/runbook creation
Experience and Qualifications

3 to 5 years of experience for a mid-level Data Domain Administrator role.
5 to 8 years of experience for a senior administrator or SME role.
Hands-on experience managing enterprise backup storage environments in 24x7 or business-critical operations.
Ability to work with backup, storage, OS, network, security, and application teams during incidents and recovery events.

Preferred Certifications

Dell EMC Proven Professional certification.
Dell PowerProtect Data Manager or Data Domain specialist certification.
VMware VCP certification.
ITIL Foundation certification.

Knowledge of IBM i-Series and AS400

jobs.title: Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Remote | Gastroenterology | Part-Time, 40 hours/week | Rate: $6.5/hour

About The Role

This Gastroenterology practice is looking for a highly organized, patient-focused Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist
to support its clinics in two locations in Texas.

This role is heavily focused on appointment scheduling and patient communication
, with a high daily call volume of approximately 70 to 90 calls per day
. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment, managing multiple communication channels, and maintaining accurate patient documentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Appointment Scheduling

Handle approximately 70 to 90 inbound and outbound calls daily related to appointments for the Lewisville and Denton locations.
Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments while ensuring accurate and timely communication with patients.
Maintain and update provider schedules in RingCentral and eClinicalWorks (eCW) based on availability and scheduling requirements.

2. Fax Management

Send and receive faxes involving patient records, referrals, insurance documents, and other clinical or administrative information.
Review incoming fax communications and route documents to the appropriate provider, department, or patient record.
Accurately log, upload, and organize faxed documentation within the clinic's systems.

3. Language Interpretation Support

Provide occasional language interpretation assistance between patients and clinic staff when needed.
Help ensure medical and administrative information is communicated clearly and accurately across language barriers.
Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and accuracy when assisting with patient-provider communication.

4. Outbound Calling

Conduct outbound calls for appointment reminders, follow-ups, patient updates, and care coordination.
Contact insurance companies, referring providers, pharmacies, or other healthcare offices when necessary.
Document call outcomes, follow-up requirements, and relevant information accurately in the patient's record.

5. Patient Text Messaging

Send appointment confirmations, reminders, updates, and other approved patient communications through text messaging.
Monitor and collect patient responses and escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate clinic team member when needed.
Document relevant text conversations and patient responses in RingCentral and eCW to maintain continuity of care.

6. Billing and Payment Reminder Support

Contact patients regarding outstanding balances, billing reminders, or upcoming payment obligations as instructed by the clinic.
Provide basic payment-related information and direct patients to the appropriate billing resource when additional assistance is required.

Qualifications

Previous experience in medical administration, medical virtual assistance, patient scheduling, front desk support, or a similar healthcare role is strongly preferred.
Comfortable handling a high-volume call environment, including approximately 70 to 90 calls per day.
Experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) and RingCentral is highly preferred.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills with a professional and patient-friendly approach.
Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and ability to manage multiple tasks throughout the workday.
Experience supporting a gastroenterology or specialty medical practice is an advantage.
Ability to communicate in an additional language and provide interpretation support is an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is confident speaking with patients throughout the day, comfortable managing a high volume of appointments and communications, and able to stay organized while supporting two clinic locations. You should be dependable, detail-oriented, professional, and capable of providing a positive patient experience while maintaining accurate documentation.

Hello, potential PriceSmart candidate. We’re on a mission to hire the very best, and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity.
