We are seeking a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Vendor Promotion Clerk
to support the scheduling, tracking, reporting, and administrative coordination of vendor promotional activities across PriceSmart locations in Latin America and the Caribbean. In this role, you will work closely with the Vendor Promotions Manager, Buyers, and Assistant Buyers to ensure promotional activities are properly scheduled, supported, monitored, and reported.
This is a hands-on role that requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, the ability to manage multiple priorities, and confidence working with data, budgets, reports, and cross-functional teams.

What's unique about this job (What you’ll do)

Vendor promotions coordination & tracking

Support the Vendor Promotions Manager with the development of monthly promotional budgets by department and country.
Prepare, send, and receive vendor commitments for promotional activities.
Review in-country quantities and available locations to support promotional performance.
Prepare and maintain Manufacturer Savings and Digital Marketing schedules.
Audit promotional readiness and follow up on scheduled activities with Buyers and Assistant Buyers.
Ensure promotional activities are properly scheduled and supported across participating locations.

Data management & reporting

Enter Manufacturer Savings pricing into JD Edwards.
Review, evaluate, and process Digital Marketing demonstration performance reports.
Gather and review proof-of-performance reports from promotional activities.
Maintain accurate promotional records and supporting documentation.
Prepare monthly vendor billing reports for the Accounting team.

Budget & administrative support

Monitor monthly promotional budgets by participating department and location.
Follow up on promotional activities to help ensure budget targets are met or exceeded.
Support the Vendor Promotions Manager with administrative and operational activities.
Perform other position-related administrative tasks as assigned.

Collaboration & communication

Maintain regular communication with Buyers and Assistant Buyers to ensure the performance of scheduled promotional activities.
Work closely with the Vendor Promotions Manager and other stakeholders to address follow-ups and maintain accurate information.
Collaborate effectively across teams and countries in a fast-paced business environment.

Bring your passion and expertise (Who you are)

2–3 years of work experience in an administrative assistant or similar capacity.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook
.
Experience with JD Edwards
is a plus.
Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
Ability to work closely with others in a team environment while also working independently.
Ability to deliver consistent results and support assigned budget objectives.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Bilingual English/Spanish required.

Some important intangibles

You feel connected to our mission and values: Integrity, Respect, Accountability, Passion,

Community and Continuous Improvement.

You are a self-starter who doesn’t need direct supervision to motivate you for success.
You are highly organized and enjoy keeping track of details, deadlines, and multiple activities at the same time.
You are comfortable working with numbers, reports, budgets, and administrative processes.
You enjoy collaborating with different teams and communicating with stakeholders to ensure things get done.
You take ownership of your work and are committed to delivering accurate and consistent results.
You remain calm and organized when managing competing priorities or unforeseen constraints.

Our Commitment

We not only embrace and celebrate the diversity of our membership base and communities, but also strive to achieve the same in our employees. At PriceSmart, we are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status or any other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Get to know us

PriceSmart was founded with a purpose: to inspire and impact the lives and businesses of our Members, our employees and our communities through the ethical delivery of the best quality goods and services at the lowest possible prices.
Throughout the years, we have constantly asked ourselves how we can do more and have a greater impact. We want to prove that we are a company that can grow, be profitable and do good in the world, and we have learned that it takes a great organizational culture to achieve that goal.
At PriceSmart, you can look forward to company events, anniversaries celebrating our employees with more than 20, or 30 years of tenure, volunteering and learning opportunities, and just great company filled with curious, kind folks. Dreaming up and sharing ideas aren’t responsibilities reserved for certain teams or leaders; the challenge of building our own culture is on all of our shoulders. That sense of community and belonging keeps us excited to walk through the door everyday, wherever that door may be, in any of our 13 countries.

Gestionar y monitorear el ciclo de vida de los pedidos, desde la programación de despachos hasta la entrega final, asegurando actualizaciones precisas en nuestros sistemas.
Coordinar directamente con proveedores de transporte para la asignación de cargas y garantizar que los tiempos de entrega se cumplan a cabalidad.
Controlar los movimientos de inventario (entradas y salidas) en nuestro ERP/WMS, participando en tomas físicas y reportando ágilmente cualquier discrepancia.
Analizar datos operativos clave (tiempos de entrega, costos, niveles de servicio) para construir reportes e identificar oportunidades reales de mejora.
Resolver consultas logísticas de las áreas comerciales y de servicio al cliente, garantizando la trazabilidad de la documentación y escalando incidencias de manera estratégica.

Formación técnica, tecnológica o profesional en Logística, Negocios Internacionales, Administración, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

Orientación a los datos: Sabes que detrás de cada tabla dinámica hay información vital sobre cómo podemos ser más rápidos y eficientes.

Curiosidad y aprendizaje continuo: Eres una esponja de conocimiento, siempre buscando entender el "por qué" de las cosas dentro del e-commerce.

Ser parte de una startup de e-commerce en pleno crecimiento.

jobs.title: Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist
jobs.description:
Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About The Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist
to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.
Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.
Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.
Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.
Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.
Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.
Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.
Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.
Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.
Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.
Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.
Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.
Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

Fully fluent in English and Spanish.
Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.
Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.
Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.
Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.
Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.
Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.
Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience working with personal injury practices.
Experience communicating with attorneys or law firms.
Experience fulfilling medical records or billing documentation requests.
Familiarity with legal, clinic, or attorney portals.

Tools & Systems

Internal Clinic Symptom Database for documenting standardized patient follow-up responses and recovery symptoms.
External Law Firm/Clinic Portals for uploading completed evaluations, medical records, bills, and other requested documentation.
GoLean Productivity Tool and GoLean Private Network for productivity monitoring and secure access to practice systems and patient information.

What Success Looks Like

The existing patient follow-up backlog is steadily cleared, with patients contacted approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit and their recovery information documented accurately.
Attorney and law firm requests for evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation are completed accurately and on time, with the practice expecting effectively zero preventable errors.
Follow-ups, portal uploads, records requests, and outstanding tasks are consistently tracked through completion, with clear End-of-Day reporting and reliable backup coverage for scheduling and intake when needed.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
About Pentice

Pentice is the operating system behind Cloud9 Windy City: 63 units across 13 Class-A residential buildings in Chicago, turning long-term luxury apartments into hotel-grade short stays and unlocking top-line revenue for the buildings' owners. We are building toward the autonomous operating system for luxury high-rises, and expanding city by city across the U.S.

How we work

A small, AI-native team that builds 4:1 leverage. You work alongside Claude every day; AI is a co-pilot, not a buzzword. The team is distributed — some in Chicago, most in Latin America. We move fast, decide fast, and cut politics. We don't hire to fill seats. We hire to pull levers that move numbers. Outcomes beat effort beats intentions.

How we pay

Every role we post carries its compensation in figures, in the currency you would be paid in. Base is one part. The rest is a quarterly bonus tied to the one number your seat owns. If you move the number you are paid for it, and if the number does not move the bonus does not pay. You get both halves before you apply.

We run on C.L.O.U.D.9, our culture operating system

C
Customer Obsession. If they're not raving, we missed it.
L
Leadership Through Ownership. No passengers, only drivers.
O
Operational Excellence. How we do one thing is how we do everything.
U
Urgency With Intelligence. Act now, iterate later.
D
Do the Right Thing. Character over convenience.
9
The 9x Mindset. 10% better is safe; 9x better is unforgettable.

Three of those decide who lasts here, so read them as warnings rather than slogans.

Leadership Through Ownership.
You will be handed a number and very little scaffolding. Nobody will sequence your week for you. If you need a manager to tell you what matters this Tuesday, you will be unhappy here inside a month.

Urgency With Intelligence.
We ship, measure, then fix. A good decision today beats a perfect one in three weeks. If you need complete information before you move, this pace will feel reckless to you.

Do the Right Thing.
You will get chances to report a number that flatters you. We check. Someone who softens a bad result once does not get a second chance to.

Executive Assistant to the CEO

The Role

We are looking for an Executive Assistant to the CEO to hold everything Cloud9 and Marcus owe that is not yet automated — and to hand each piece to a system, on a date.

Most of this seat is the CEO's administrative life: that everything is paid, the car is insured, the registrations are current, the flights are booked, the appointments happen, and none of it ever needs a follow-up. The rest is the company's dated obligations that no automation has reached yet — licenses, leases, insurance, renewals, and the occasional payment that still goes out by hand.

One thing about how we work that you should know going in. Every manual task in this seat goes on a list called Automate
, with a target date. Until that date you do it by hand, to a standard, without dropping it. When the date comes, you help hand it to a tool, an agent or a process.

That list never empties, and it is not meant to. We are growing, so new obligations arrive faster than old ones get automated — a new property, a new license, a new country, a new supplier. What changes over time is which things are on your desk, not how full it is. The routine bill-checking you do by hand in month one may be a script by month eight, and the space that frees up gets filled by something that needs a person.

So this is a long-term seat and the work is genuinely yours. What we ask is that you do not hoard it: write down how you do things, hand over what can be handed over, and let the boring repetitive parts go so you can take on the parts that actually need judgment.

Run this well and there is a clear path into operations for whoever wants it — the person who knows where every obligation lives is the obvious person to run them at a larger scale.

What You Will Do

The CEO's administrative life — the largest part of the seat

Everything is paid, on time, without being asked: household and utility accounts, subscriptions, personal services and suppliers.
Vehicles, registrations and insurance current — nothing expires quietly.
Travel end to end for business and personal trips: flights, hotels, ground transport, itineraries. Booked and confirmed, not researched and handed over.
Appointments, contractors, family logistics, school arrangements.
Purchases and returns across online and local suppliers, reconciled against what was ordered.
Ad-hoc requests that need to be reliably closed rather than discussed.

The company's dated obligations that are not yet automated

One calendar of every date-driven obligation: license renewals, lease dates and notice windows, insurance policies, permits and filings, across Colombia and the U.S. entity.
Confirm and schedule each one at least 60 days before its deadline. A blank date is not "fine" — it is an open item.
The payments that still go out by hand: chase them, file the proof the same day, and escalate anything that does not clear.
Keep the external bookkeeper and both accounting firms supplied with what they need, on schedule, without being chased.

The Automate list

Maintain one list of every manual task in this seat, each with a target date to be automated and a note on who is building it.
Write each recurring task down clearly enough that someone — or something — else could run it. This is a deliverable, not documentation hygiene.
Work with the Chief of Staff and the CEO on the handoffs, then stay the human who catches what the automation gets wrong.
Add to the list as fast as things come off it. New properties, new licenses, new suppliers — the point of the list is that nothing manual stays invisible.
Report honestly on what is not moving. A task that has sat on the list for six months without a date is a problem to raise, not to absorb.

Tools and Systems You Will Use

Banking and government portals in Colombia and the U.S., ClickUp, Google Workspace, Guesty, QuickBooks Online, custom spreadsheets, and the internal AI agents that monitor recurring obligations. You will use AI daily and you will be expected to say how you checked its output.

Your Scorecard

Nothing lapses: zero missed renewals, filings, insurance dates or payments in a quarter, across both entities and the CEO's personal obligations.
100% of renewals confirmed and scheduled 60+ days before deadline.
Every miss, slip or near-miss reported by you before anyone else finds it.
The Automate list moves: items handed off on or before their target dates.
The CEO stops being asked about administrative things.

What We're Looking For

2+ years running the administrative or personal-support side of a business owner, founder or executive — with real ownership, not as one of a team of assistants.
A record of holding a large number of small dated obligations without lapses, and a system you built yourself to do it.
Comfort with portals and institutions: banks, utilities, government desks, county licensing offices, insurers. You have been told no by a website and found the way through.
Professional Spanish and English, written and spoken, used daily.
Exceptional discretion. This seat sees the CEO's household, his family's arrangements and the company's private matters. A confidentiality agreement is required.
The habit of saying "not done yet" the day something is not done.
Willingness to write down how you work and hand pieces of it over. You should be able to point at something you simplified, documented or stopped doing by hand.

This Role Is For You If

You are the person who remembers the thing nobody else remembered — and you have a system rather than a good memory.
You would rather write down how you do something and hand it over than be the only one who can do it.
You like a job where the specific tasks evolve, even though the ownership stays yours.
You are comfortable being close to someone's private life and entirely uninterested in talking about it.

This Role Is Not For You If

You want an identical set of duties every month for the next five years.
The personal-support half sounds like it is beneath the title. It is the largest part of this seat.
You measure your value by how much only you can do.
Government portals, insurers and utilities stress you out.
You avoid raising problems and hope they resolve themselves.

Nice to Have

Experience supporting an executive across two countries.
Familiarity with U.S. municipal licensing, property insurance or vehicle registration.
Guesty, Stripe, ClickUp, QuickBooks, Amazon Business.
Having built an automation yourself — a Zap, a script, an agent, a form that replaced an email thread. At any level.

What we offer

Competitive compensation for the Colombian market, based on seniority and track record.
Contrato a término indefinido, with full statutory benefits: EPS health, pension, ARL, cesantías and interest, prima de servicios, and paid vacation.
Hybrid in Bogotá: three days a week in the office (Monday, Wednesday, Thursday), two from home. Flexible hours.
Direct daily exposure to the CEO and the Chief of Staff, with real ownership from day one.
A small, senior team that documents and automates rather than repeating itself — so the boring parts of your job get lighter over time and the interesting parts get bigger.

Why Pentice

If you want to own a number, move fast, and build with AI instead of around it, this is the place. Small team, real leverage, high standards, and the people who build the systems get to run them as we scale city by city. If you want a comfortable seat where effort counts more than outcomes, we are not it.

Equal opportunity

jobs.title: Executive Assistant – Bilingual (English/Spanish)
jobs.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

We are looking for a highly proactive, resourceful, and tech-savvy Bilingual Executive Assistant
to provide high-level support to senior leadership.

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support. We are looking for someone who operates with speed, urgency, ownership, and exceptional attention to detail
— someone who anticipates needs, solves problems before they escalate, and continuously looks for smarter and more efficient ways of working.

The ideal candidate is highly comfortable with technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools
and has strong PowerPoint and executive presentation skills
. This person should be able to transform ideas, data, notes, and business updates into polished, executive-ready presentations and communications.

The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, demanding, and constantly changing environment
, managing multiple priorities while maintaining excellent judgment, discretion, and quality.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Business Support

Provide high-level administrative and operational support to senior leadership.
Manage complex calendars and schedules across multiple time zones, proactively resolving conflicts and optimizing executive time.
Coordinate complex domestic and international travel arrangements, including itineraries and expense reporting.
Anticipate executive needs and proactively identify potential conflicts, risks, or required actions.
Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, capture key decisions, and ensure timely follow-up on commitments.
Act as a trusted point of contact across internal teams and external stakeholders.
Handle confidential and sensitive information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism.
Support project coordination, leadership meetings, business reviews, town halls, and other key events.
Provide support for office operations and facilities-related activities as needed.

Executive Presentations & PowerPoint

Create, edit, and enhance high-quality executive PowerPoint presentations for leadership meetings, business reviews, town halls, and other key forums.
Transform complex information, business data, and leadership ideas into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations.
Work independently from rough notes, emails, spreadsheets, data, or verbal direction to develop executive-ready materials.
Ensure presentations are polished, accurate, consistent, and aligned with business objectives.
Demonstrate strong visual judgment, business storytelling, and exceptional attention to detail.

Automation, AI & Process Improvement

Actively identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative and operational tasks.
Leverage AI and productivity tools to improve efficiency, organization, communication, meeting preparation, and information management.
Develop smarter workflows for recurring activities, follow-ups, reporting, document management, and executive support processes.
Continuously challenge manual processes and recommend simpler, faster, and more scalable ways of working.
Quickly learn, test, and adopt new digital tools and technologies.
Serve as a proactive advocate for technology and automation within the executive support environment.

Communication & Coordination

Draft and edit professional communications, emails, presentations, and executive materials in both English and Spanish.
Coordinate effectively across different functions, countries, cultures, and time zones.
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
Communicate confidently and professionally with senior leaders and key stakeholders.
Follow through consistently on open actions, deadlines, and executive commitments.
Ensure priorities move forward and that important actions are closed on time.

Required Qualifications

5–7 years of administrative and executive support experience, preferably supporting senior or executive-level leadership in a complex, fast-paced organization.
Bachelor’s degree preferred, ideally in Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Full professional fluency in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
Expert proficiency in Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
Advanced calendar management and scheduling skills, including coordinating complex schedules across multiple time zones.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, with demonstrated ability to create polished, visually compelling, executive-level presentations.
Strong experience coordinating complex domestic and international travel arrangements, itineraries, and expense reporting.
Experience with enterprise systems such as Workday, Concur, PRMS, or similar platforms.
Strong interest and practical experience with AI, automation tools, and digital productivity solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and sound judgment.
Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, anticipate needs, take initiative, and prioritize multiple competing tasks with limited supervision.
Strong project coordination and event planning capabilities.
Professional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships across organizational levels, functions, countries, and cultures.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced and highly dynamic environment.
Flexibility with work hours when business needs, executive schedules, travel, or events require additional support.

Preferred Qualifications

Portuguese language proficiency is considered a strong plus, particularly for supporting stakeholders and business activities across Latin America.
Experience supporting senior or executive-level leaders in a multinational organization.
Experience working across multiple countries, functions, cultures, and time zones.
Experience supporting office operations and/or facilities-related activities.
Demonstrated ability to leverage technology, AI, and automation to improve executive and team productivity.

What Success Looks Like

A successful person in this role will quickly become a trusted extension of the executive
.

They will anticipate what is needed before being asked, keep priorities moving, produce excellent executive materials, reduce administrative complexity, and use automation and AI to give time back to the leader and the broader team
.

They will be known as someone who makes things happen, solves problems, brings structure to complexity, and consistently stays one step ahead
.

The goal is not simply to manage an executive’s agenda — it is to make the executive and the organization around them more effective.

About Provectus

About Provectus and the Role

Provectus is a Premier AWS partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide and are obsessed with reimagining how they operate and compete. We’re remote-first, with a culture built on curiosity, ownership, and learning.

About The Role

Our Alliances Org is where our most important relationships in AI — AWS and Anthropic today, with more partners on the way — turn into pipeline, funding, and revenue. Someone has to make that engine run cleanly. That’s this role.

As our Alliance Operations Analyst, you’ll own the day-to-day operations of the Alliances Org: the partner portals where opportunities and funding live, the reporting that proves our impact, and the processes that keep sales, marketing, and alliances in sync. You’ll be the person who knows exactly where every opportunity, fund request, listing, and metric stands — and who makes sure nothing slips.

What you’ll own:

Partner operations & portals

Own and maintain our presence in AWS Partner Central, and in Anthropic’s Euler portal — Opportunities, Fund Requests, Marketplace listings, and solution listings — keeping everything accurate, current, and submitted on time
Extend the same operating discipline to additional partners and programs as the Alliances portfolio expands
Keep partner records, deal registrations, listings, and funding statuses clean and audit-ready across systems

Performance reporting & insights

Collect, organize, and report the metrics that show what Alliances delivers: AWS-influenced revenue, opportunities created, funding secured, and other measures of the org’s impact
Turn messy inputs from multiple teams into clear, trustworthy dashboards and partner-ready reports
Track trends and flag what’s working (and what’s stalling) so leadership can act on it

Process & project coordination

Document and streamline internal workflows and handoffs across sales, marketing, and alliances
Track action items, SLAs, and deadlines across partner initiatives; chase down what’s needed and close the loop
Help operationalize new plays (co-marketing pilots, AWS- and Anthropic-funded initiatives) from idea to execution, and flag early when something goes off track

Communication & enablement

Draft internal briefs, recaps, and updates; run meeting follow-ups so decisions don’t evaporate
Translate internal intelligence into partner-ready formats
Be the connective tissue between sales, marketing, and alliances.

What we’re looking for:

Hands-on ownership of a partner, vendor, or client-facing portal or system of record — you’ve been the person responsible for keeping submissions accurate, complete, and on time, and for chasing the inputs you needed from other teams to do it.
Strong organization and relentless follow-through — you don’t let things fall through the cracks
Excellent written and verbal communication in English (you’ll work directly with AWS and Anthropic partner teams)

jobs.title: Onboarding Coordinator - Blue Gems (Remote - LATAM)
jobs.description:
Onboarding Coordinator

Blue Gems

About The Brand

Blue Gems manages vacation homes around Orlando, Florida — the theme-park corridor and the resort communities that ring it. Our guests are almost always families on a trip they saved for, arriving late, tired, with children. Getting the first ten minutes of their stay right is most of the job.

The role

You are the person who makes sure the thing that was agreed actually happens. Scheduling, vendor coordination, onboarding a new property, chasing a repair that has been rescheduled twice, keeping the data in our systems true. It is a role for someone who is happier with a closed loop than a busy inbox, and who will chase a vendor a third time without being asked.

Unreasonable hospitality

We hold ourselves to what Will Guidara calls unreasonable hospitality: doing the thing nobody asked for, that nobody would have missed, and that they will tell someone about. A guest mentions in a message that it is their daughter's birthday, and there is something waiting on the counter when they walk in. An owner asks a question on a Sunday and gets a real answer, from a person, before Monday. We do not measure this in a survey. We measure it in whether the person on the other end felt looked after by someone who was paying attention. Everyone here is expected to notice things, and everyone here is trusted to act on what they notice without asking permission first.

Where you sit

You sit in Operations and report into the operations lead for this market. This role is remote and open to people anywhere in the Americas. You work every day with the guest experience team, the field operations team and the coordinators who schedule them — this is not a role where you are handed a queue and left alone. Because Stayd runs shared systems across every brand, a process you improve here tends to end up running in six other markets, which is the closest thing we have to a promotion path.

What you'll own

Scheduling and coordinating vendors, cleaners and inspections against real calendars
Onboarding new properties end to end — listings, access, supplies, documentation
Keeping records in Guesty, Breezeway, SuiteOp and our own systems accurate
Chasing commitments to completion, and escalating early when something will slip
Writing to owners and vendors clearly enough that nobody has to ask what you meant
Spotting the recurring failure and proposing the fix

How you'll live our core values

Five values run this company, and we hire and promote against them.

See Something Do Something
— if you spot it, it is yours. Nobody here is allowed to walk past a problem because it belongs to another team.

Do What You Say
— a commitment with a date on it is a promise. If it slips, you say so before it is late, not after.

Own the Miss
— we get things wrong. What matters is that you name it first, fix it, and make sure it cannot happen the same way twice. Nobody is punished for a miss they owned.

Say the Hard Thing
— kindly, directly and early. Silence in a meeting followed by a private complaint is the one behaviour we will not carry.

Make It Better
— leave the process, the property or the shift in better shape than you found it. Small improvements, constantly, beat big ones occasionally.

What you bring

Enough daily overlap with US working hours to close loops the same day
Written English clear enough for owner and vendor correspondence
Experience with scheduling, coordination, operations or admin where you owned the follow-through
Comfort with everyday tools — Google Workspace, Slack, a PMS, a spreadsheet
Reliable internet and a quiet place to work

How to apply

Apply here — it takes about four minutes on a phone. You will answer a handful of questions written to find out what you can actually do, upload a résumé, and record a short voice note so we can hear how you sound with a guest. There is no cover letter and there is no portal account to create.

Every single applicant hears back from us, including a no. If we are not moving forward we will tell you, and we will tell you why. If you need an accommodation to complete this application, email careers@stayd.co — asking never counts against you.

What to expect

This is a long-term team role on a strong, established global team, with structured onboarding and ongoing support.

jobs.title: AWS Network Engineer - Palo Alto firewalls
jobs.description:
We are One Sutherland
— a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 38 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description

The purpose of this position is to provide technical assistance to the NICE Cloud Networking Team, coordinating and participating in the design, deployment, operation and maintenance of NICE’s customer cloud hosted network and security infrastructure, while also resolving customer issues that require direct access to the network and security infrastructure, and acting in an appropriate professional working style

The Specialist Cloud Network Engineer
has the following duties:

Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain cooperative working relationships within a global, diverse, multicultural environment.
Ability to work with data center or On premise environment, standing for extended periods of time while performing maintenance duties.
Position may be required to work at a computer terminal and desk for long periods of time on projects.
Network and security administration tasks using industry-standard network equipment and software.
Experience operating and maintaining network devices and security products like Palo Alto, Cisco, F5, and other industry-leading network hardware and software.
Experience deploying and supporting IP networks and associated network technologies.
Establishing, configuring & troubleshooting VPN tunnel related works.
Deep understanding on IPSEC protocol, the TCP/IP stack, how a layer 7 FW processes packets. SSL protocol
Ability to write Terraform scripts and good knowledge in GIT is a plus.
Design and testing of network and security infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPN, WAN and other support systems.
Familiarity with Internet and WAN communications technologies, protocols, and best practices.
Minimum 3 Year of Experience with AWS Cloud & managing AWS network stacks is a mandatory.
Minimum 3 Year of Experience with Palo Alto is mandatory.
AWS and Palo Alto Certification is mandatory.
Configuring & troubleshooting URL related works.

Qualifications

Advanced English proficiency (B2 or Higher)
A minimum of 3 Years of experience in managing Network & Security Infrastructure and administration of associated software and tools.
Demonstrated ability to work with different security appliances like Palo Alto, Cisco firewalls for ACL, NAT, VPN and other technical assistance.
Demonstrated ability to resolve complex technical issues. Encouraging free and open exchange of technical ideas and suggestions and working with regional and global management to implement approved projects.
Demonstrated ability to install and deploy network routers, firewalls, switches, and other support systems as needed to support corporate and hosted capacity, performance, security, or product functionality requirements.
Experience implementing and supporting a production multi-tenant architecture
Demonstrated ability to prepare, review, test, and deploy network configuration and security software to perform administrative tasks as assigned.
Ability to act as part of NICE Infrastructure Cloud Operations, continuously sharing information and assisting on tasks with other team members.
Ability to provide excellent and ongoing support to other NICE business teams as needed to solve customer and product issues in a timely manner.
Demonstrated ability to deal directly with internal and external customers in a friendly, supportive manner to troubleshoot and solve complex technical issues regarding NICE hosted performance, security, availability, and reliability
Ability to work with or understanding of URL deployments and troubleshooting
Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or other technical discipline or equivalent experience.
PaloAlto Certification.
AWS Certifications.

Additional Information

This is a Hybrid model position in Bogotá Sutherland's Facilities at Torre Krystal (Cra 7 #156-10, Usaquén)

¿Nos conocías?

En 2025, myCloudDoor y Henson Group se han unido para formar ALIANDO, una compañía global nacida de la fusión de dos compañías referentes en soluciones Cloud. Esta integración estratégica nos posiciona como un Partner Líder en innovación Cloud, Inteligencia Artificial y servicios gestionados, con un enfoque claro en acompañar a las organizaciones en su evolución digital: Cloud Infrastructure & Modernization | FinOps | Data & AI | Cybersecurity | SAP on Azure | Business Applications: Power Platform, Dynamics 365, low-code/no-code solutions | Managed Services & Licensing. Si buscas crecer en un entorno internacional, innovador y en constante evolución, ALIANDO es tu lugar.

Administrar y mantener entornos Microsoft Azure, realizando tareas de configuración, monitorización y mantenimiento.

Mantener una actitud proactiva y autónoma, siendo capaz de llevar a cabo las tareas asignadas de principio a fin con el acompañamiento necesario.

Al menos 2 años de experiencia en administración de sistemas y/o entornos Cloud.
Experiencia en Microsoft Azure, con conocimientos de administración y gestión de servicios Cloud.

Experiencia en administración de sistemas Windows y Linux.
Conocimientos o experiencia inicial con Terraform; no es necesario un nivel avanzado, pero sí haber tenido contacto con la herramienta.
Conocimientos de Hyper-V serán valorables.

jobs.title: Data Center Technician - Colombia - Cali - On-site
jobs.description:
Reboot Monkey is a global leader in IT solutions, specializing in data center management that simplifies your IT operations. We provide hosting space, future-proof upgrades, and 24/7 support through our smart or remote hands, ensuring seamless, secure, and sustainable service. Our fully remote, round-the-clock management frees businesses from supervision hassles, setting new benchmarks in data center solutions. We’re seeking skilled Freelance Data Center Technicians to join our growing team. If you have expertise in data center operations and want flexible work, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Overview:

As a Freelance Data Center Technician,
you will play a key role in delivering on-demand support to our global data centers. Your responsibilities will include hardware installation, troubleshooting complex issues, and managing network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. We’re looking for someone with deep expertise in data center equipment and software who can work independently while collaborating with remote teams. In this role, you’ll be essential to maintaining smooth, secure, and efficient data center operations, contributing to our high standards of service excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Install, configure, and maintain servers, networking equipment, and other hardware to ensure optimal performance and maximum uptime, facilitating seamless operations within the data center.
Monitor data center operations both remotely and on-site, quickly diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and connectivity issues to minimize downtime and maintain service reliability.
Configure, manage, and troubleshoot networking devices, including Cisco and Juniper routers, switches, and firewalls, to ensure secure and efficient network operations that align with organizational standards.
Manage and troubleshoot both Linux and Windows-based systems, performing essential updates, patches, and security enhancements to keep systems secure and up-to-date.
Document all installations, repairs, maintenance tasks, and system performance, providing comprehensive reports to the remote management team to ensure transparency and accountability in operations.
Implement and maintain security protocols to protect the integrity of the data center infrastructure, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices for data security.
Collaborate with remote IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to enhance data center operations, actively participating in the planning and execution of projects that drive efficiency and innovation.

What We Offer:

Flexibility: Work around your existing freelance or permanent job. You choose the tickets you want to pick up, with no minimum hour commitment.
Professional Environment: Join a professional work environment where you can reconnect with the practical side of IT.
Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive rewards for your compensation and efforts.
Growth Opportunities: Work with compelling clients and seize opportunities to grow in your field.
Data center or IT infrastructure experience

Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

Build the business. Build the marketing team.

HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.

You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.

You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.

What You Will Own

Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand
Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention
Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands
Establish commercial discipline: Connect campaign performance to paying customers, repeat enrollment and contribution profit. Allocate marketing investment using reliable reporting and testing
Stay close to execution: Inspect advertising accounts, diagnose funnel problems and help launch improvements yourself while building a team that can execute consistently

Support and autonomy

The parent provides bookkeeping assistance, HR support, IT and website support, and a local manager covering customer service and day-to-day sales. You will propose budgets and team plans, then make operating decisions within agreed authority. After onboarding, the founder expects a monthly business review, supported by clear weekly reporting and escalation of exceptional issues.

Your first 90 days

Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You may have built an ecommerce business, led growth for a consumer brand, run a digital agency with meaningful operating responsibility, or managed a business where digital acquisition was central to its success.

Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention
Commercial responsibility beyond a marketing budget: pricing, margins, staffing, forecasts or business profitability
Experience hiring and managing marketers, creatives, agencies or other specialists
Ability to translate ecommerce methods into a service business with real delivery capacity and customer commitments
Comfort doing practical work while developing people and systems
Strong professional English and effective remote leadership

Experience in youth sports, education, fitness, memberships or multi-location services is useful. Evidence of building a profitable business and an effective team matters most.

How To Apply

Submit your CV through this application form. Describe a business or brand you grew, including spend, results and your personal contribution; a team you built or managed; and a commercial decision that failed and what you changed afterward.

Complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners using that email, indicate this in the form.

Culture Index survey

Somos una empresa de inteligencia artificial para restaurantes. Hacemos menús digitales con código QR, fotos que dan hambre y un asistente que atiende a los clientes y les toma el pedido, mientras el dueño cocina.

Experimentos pequeños y medibles. Uno que funcione vale más que diez ideas.

Que escribas código. No hace falta ser ingeniero de carrera, hace falta que puedas construir lo que propones.

Que ya hayas construido algo con modelos de lenguaje, aunque fuera para ti.
Que pienses en negocio. La pregunta nunca es "se puede", es "cuánto mueve la aguja".

Es una empresa temprana con un producto vivo y clientes que pagan. Vas a tocar el sistema entero, no un pedacito, y vas a ver el efecto de lo que haces en cuestión de días.

jobs.title: Entertainment Operations Manager (MÚSICA & MF)
jobs.description:
SOBRE LA COMPAÑÍA DURO. (Casa Matriz):
Estudio creativo con sede en Bogotá y operación multinacional en transición hacia compañía de entretenimiento integral, enfocado en contenido digital/audiovisual, publicidad y desarrollo de creadores. Es la compañía matriz que respalda y financia a DURO.MÚSICA y DURO.MF, contando entre sus clientes con multinacionales de la música y marcas de primer nivel (Adidas, Coca-Cola, Colgate, Bavaria / AB InBev, Warner Music Latina, entre otras).
DURO.MÚSICA:
HUB creativo enfocado en el desarrollo de música de actualidad operado bajo 4 áreas: Record Label , Publishing Powerhouse (con un acuerdo global de subedición con Sony Music Publishing), Management y Creative Studio / New Business . Con un roster propio de 20+ creadores internacionales (Colombia, Chile, México y EE. UU.), desarrolla proyectos fonográficos, alianzas con marcas y curaduría de A&R.
DURO.MF:
Plataforma multicanal de contenido de entretenimiento original, que consta de producciones audiovisuales propias en formato corto y largo, horizontal y vertical, que en menos de un año ha creado una comunidad de creyentes alrededor de la música, el fútbol, los debates, el miedo y el humor.

SOBRE EL ROL El/La Entertainment Operations Manager (EOM)
construirá, ejecutará y mantendrá sistemas operativos eficientes para respaldar las necesidades del negocio en DURO.MÚSICA
(Sello & Editora) y DURO.MF
(Media & Contenido Original). Trabajando directamente de la mano con la Dirección General, administrará los flujos de trabajo diarios entre lanzamientos musicales, administración de publishing, proveedores de marketing y producción de medios.

RESPONSABILIDADES Operaciones del Negocio & Trazabilidad Financiera

Establecer y mantener estándares operativos de precisión, productividad y cumplimiento legal en todos los lanzamientos musicales y shows de contenido.
Gestionar las funciones diarias del negocio, manteniendo tableros de control en tiempo real (Notion/Excel) para costos de proyecto, presupuestos y fuentes de ingresos.
Monitorear el ciclo de vida de los contratos, seguimiento de opciones, ventanas de exclusividad y vencimientos de licencias para garantizar el cumplimiento normativo y legal.
Auditar estados de cuenta mensuales y trimestrales de distribuidoras digitales y Sociedades de Gestión Colectiva (ASCAP, BMI, SACM, SAYCO, etc.).
Calcular y procesar liquidaciones netas de regalías para titulares de máster y splits de autoría para compositores, coordinando los pagos con contabilidad.

Marketing, Proveedores & Gestión de Proyectos

Administrar presupuestos de lanzamiento y supervisar proveedores de marketing externos (PR, agencias de TikTok, pauta digital y equipos creativos), auditando el ROI de campañas y métricas de rendimiento.
Negociar términos, hacer seguimiento de entregables y cerrar contratos con estudios de grabación, ingenieros, diseñadores, distribuidores y equipos de realización audiovisual.

Operaciones Diarias de Lanzamientos & Medios

A&R Admin & Distribución:
Recopilar split sheets, licencias de derechos y metadatos (ISRCs, UPCs, créditos); gestionar la carga en distribuidoras (The Orchard, Believe, Altafonte, Symphonic) garantizando un estricto Control de Calidad (QC).
Pitching & Auditoría de Lanzamiento:
Ejecutar postulaciones editoriales (Spotify for Artists, Amazon Music) y auditar créditos post-lanzamiento, enlaces y gráficas de rendimiento.
Media & Content ID (DURO.MF):
Monitorear Content ID en YouTube, bibliotecas de audio de TikTok/Meta, analítica de canales (AdSense/sponsors) y gestionar la logística de producción de programas y sesiones en vivo.

REQUISITOS / CUALIFICACIONES Experiencia:
Mínimo 3+ años en Operaciones de Sello, Administración de Publishing, Distribución o Gestión de Proyectos en la industria de la música y el entretenimiento.
Dominio Bilingüe:
Inglés fluido (C1 / Bilingüe) y Español, con sólidas habilidades de comunicación escrita y verbal para negociaciones internacionales.
Requisitos de Viaje:
VISA Americana vigente (B1/B2) o pasaporte con exención de visado a EE. UU.
Habilidades Técnicas:
Dominio avanzado de Notion, Excel (dashboarding financiero), Microsoft Office, back-offices de distribuidoras y herramientas de analítica (Spotify for Artists, Chartmetric, YouTube Analytics).
Ubicación:
Residencia en Bogotá, Colombia
(Modalidad de trabajo híbrida).
Enfoque en Ejecución:
Excepcionales habilidades de organización, alta atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar múltiples tareas en un entorno dinámico e iterativo.

QUÉ OFRECEMOS Contrato laboral a término indefinido directo con la compañía.
Salario competitivo acorde a perfil y experiencia + Prestaciones de ley y beneficios extralegales.
Formar parte del equipo de liderazgo de una de las estructuras de entretenimiento e innovación musical más ambiciosas de la región.
Entorno de alto crecimiento, autonomía y visibilidad ejecutiva en proyectos de alcance internacional.

CÓMO POSTULARSE Postúlate a través de LinkedIn adjuntando tu CV actualizado
, aspiración salarial
y disponibilidad de inicio (Contratación Inmediata - Noviembre 2026)
.
__________
ABOUT THE COMPANY DURO. (Parent Company):
A Bogotá-based creative studio transitioning into a full-service entertainment company with multinational operations. Focused on digital/audiovisual content, advertising, and creator career development. DURO. serves as the parent holding company backing DURO.MÚSICA and DURO.MF, with a client roster that includes global music giants (Warner Music Latina, Interscope Records, Sony Music, M3 Music) and top-tier corporate brands (Adidas, Coca-Cola, Colgate, Bavaria / AB InBev).
DURO.MÚSICA:
A creative music HUB operating across 4 core verticals: Record Label , Publishing Powerhouse (holding a global sub-publishing deal with Sony Music Publishing), Artist Management , and Creative Studio / New Business . Representing an active roster of 12+ international creators across Colombia, Chile, Mexico, and the US, it delivers contemporary music releases, brand partnerships, and A&R curation.
DURO.MF:
A multichannel platform for original entertainment content, featuring proprietary short- and long-form audiovisual productions across vertical and horizontal formats. In less than a year, it has built a highly engaged community around music, football, culture, debates, horror, and comedy.

ABOUT THE ROLE The Entertainment Operations Manager (EOM)
will build, execute, and maintain efficient operational systems to support business needs across DURO.MÚSICA
(Record Label & Publisher) and DURO.MF
(Media & Original Content). Working directly with Executive Leadership, this candidate will manage daily workflows connecting music releasing, publishing administration, marketing vendors, and media production.

RESPONSIBILITIES Business Operations & Financial Traceability

Establish and maintain operational standards for accuracy, productivity, and legal compliance across all releases and media shows.
Manage daily business functions, maintaining real-time dashboarding (Notion/Excel) for project costs, budgets, and revenue streams.
Oversee contract lifecycles, tracking options, exclusivity windows, and licensing expiration dates to ensure regulatory and legal compliance.
Audit monthly and quarterly financial statements from digital distributors and Collection Societies (ASCAP, BMI, SACM, SAYCO, etc.).
Calculate and process net royalty payouts for master rights holders and publishing splits for songwriters, coordinating disbursements with accounting.

Marketing, Vendors & Project Management

Manage release budgets and supervise external marketing providers (PR, TikTok agencies, digital ads, and creative teams), auditing campaign ROI and performance metrics.
Negotiate terms, track deliverables, and close contracts with recording studios, engineers, designers, distributors, and video production teams.

Day-to-Day Releasing & Media Operations

A&R Admin & Releasing:
Collect split sheets, clearance rights, and metadata (ISRCs, UPCs, credits); manage supply chain uploads to DSP distributors (The Orchard, Believe, Altafonte, Symphonic) ensuring strict Quality Control (QC).
Pitching & Launch Audit:
Execute editorial playlist submissions (Spotify for Artists, Amazon Music) and audit post-launch credits, link mappings, and performance charts.
Media & Content ID (DURO.MF):
Track YouTube Content ID, TikTok/Meta audio libraries, channel analytics (AdSense/sponsors), and manage production logistics for original streaming shows and live sessions.

QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of experience
in Label Operations, Publishing Administration, Distribution, or Project Management within the music and entertainment industry.
Bilingual Proficiency:
Fluent English (C1/Bilingual) and Spanish, with strong written and verbal communication skills for international negotiations.
Travel Requirements:
Active US Visa (B1/B2) or passport eligible for US entry.
Technical Skills:
High proficiency in Notion, Excel (financial dashboarding), Microsoft Office, DSP back-offices, and analytics tools (Spotify for Artists, Chartmetric, YouTube Analytics).
Location:
Based in or willing to relocate to Bogotá, Colombia
(Hybrid work model).
Execution Focus:
Exceptional organizational skills, high attention to detail, and comfort multitasking in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

WHAT WE OFFER Direct, indefinite full-time employment contract.
Competitive salary aligned with experience + legal benefits and perks.
Leadership role within one of the region's most ambitious entertainment and music innovation ecosystems.
High-growth, autonomous environment with executive visibility across international projects.

HOW TO APPLY Apply via LinkedIn with your updated CV
, salary expectations
, and earliest available start date (Immediate - November 2026)
.

You'll be embedded with one founder as the person who runs the business day to day, so they can work on it instead of in it. Most of our founders are building more than one thing at once. They protect their time hard and measure success in leverage, not hours. They won't hand you a process. They'll hand you a problem, often a messy one, and trust you to come back with the answer, the plan, and then the thing running.
You'll work directly with the founder and, depending on the business, their team, contractors, agencies and vendors. You're placed with one founder, but you're never operating alone: the Atlas team trains you, reviews what you build, and is on hand when you're building something new.

What a typical week looks like

No two weeks are the same. One week a launch is going live. The next there's a customer escalation to own, a hire to make, or a system that has quietly stopped working. Most days you'll be in the founder's inbox and calendar, moving priorities forward, unblocking people, and spotting the recurring task that shouldn't be manual anymore.

What success looks like

Day 1:
something is already off the founder's plate
Week 1:
real hours are back on their calendar
Day 30:
the account has paid for itself in hard dollars saved
Day 90:
the founder is out of the day-to-day, and the operation runs whether or not they're in the room

Where this role leads

This is a high-ownership seat with a clear path to a raise as you prove your impact. You'll leave every quarter able to do more than you could before: designing AI workflows, running the numbers, and making the calls a 7- to 8-figure operator makes. Your scope grows as fast as you can show you can run more.

Get inside the founder's calendar, inbox, tools and context fast enough to decide without asking
Own outcomes from goal to done, and report progress without being chased
Find manual or broken processes and fix them for good with systems and SOPs

Track the numbers that show the operation is working

Used AI to get real work done, and want to build with it (we train you)

What you get:
USD pay with a clear path to a raise, 10 paid leave days and unlimited sick leave, ongoing training and mentoring, and a global, majority-women community across ~20 countries that keeps in touch long after any one role.
Who we are

Atlas Assistants is a career home for operators, not just a placement agency. We match you with the founder of a fast-growing, 7- to 8-figure business (DTC brands, coaching and education, professional services, media). Then we keep investing in you: training, mentoring, and a community that stays in touch even after you've moved on. Job Description

DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a LATAM Trade & Transportation Lead , located in Brazil or Colombia etc.

The Manager, LATAM Trade & Transportation Lead is a key member of the global supply chain function, responsible for both the operational transportation network and the trade compliance framework across Latin America.

The role ensures the reliable, cost-efficient, and fully compliant movement of products — from manufacturing sites and regional hubs into local distribution centers, hospitals, and distributors — while safeguarding adherence to customs and international trade regulations across all operating countries.

This is a single regional leadership position that brings together two closely related disciplines: how products physically move (transportation networks, carriers, logistics providers) and how they cross borders compliantly (customs, import/export, trade documentation). The role partners closely with regional and global stakeholders to enable uninterrupted product flow, mitigate risk, and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Trade Compliance & Customs

Provide regional trade leadership for LATAM, ensuring compliance with applicable customs, import/export, and trade regulations across all operating countries.
Serve as the primary LATAM point of contact for global trade operations, supporting global supply chain execution and strategic initiatives.
Oversee and standardize trade processes, controls, and documentation to ensure consistent execution and audit readiness across the region.
Monitor trade performance metrics, identify risks or gaps, and lead corrective and preventive actions.
Engage with external partners — customs brokers, freight forwarders, and government authorities — to ensure effective and compliant trade execution.

Transportation Operations

Drive value across LATAM through optimized regional transportation flows for both inbound freight (from manufacturing sites to regional hubs, and from hubs to local affiliates and distributor warehouses) and outbound flows to hospitals and distributors.
Manage relationships with third-party and fourth-party logistics providers (including regional Control Tower partners) through performance metrics, strategic direction, and continuous improvement programs.
Lead performance measurement of transport reliability through critical metrics aligned with regional Plan, Make, and Deliver operations teams; provide input into executive performance reviews.
Deliver on annual cost improvement and productivity targets through operational improvements while protecting service, quality, reliability, and compliance.
Translate regional inventory strategy and business requirements into innovative transportation solutions; support transportation set-up for manufacturing network changes and new product launches.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner with regional and global supply chain, quality, finance, and legal teams to enable compliant product movement and rapid issue resolution.
Represent transportation and trade in end-to-end supply chain forums, projects, and sales and operations planning discussions; drive process alignment and trade-off decisions.
Actively collaborate with the regional Deliver lead, distribution operations, and demand & supply planning teams to optimize capacity planning, reliability, and adherence to service commitments.
Support product launches, network changes, and supply chain transformations by assessing and managing both transportation and trade impacts.

Key Objectives / Metrics

Transportation cost and continuous improvement savings delivery.
Transportation reliability — manufacturing/hub to distribution center, and distribution center to customer.
Logistics provider (Control Tower) performance against agreed service levels.
Trade compliance audit readiness; zero critical findings in customs audits.
On-time customs clearance and reduction in border-related disruptions.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree required (Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, International Trade, or related field).
Master's degree or MBA preferred.

Required Experience And Skills

6–8 years of progressive experience in supply chain, transportation, trade compliance, logistics, or related operational roles, aligned with a manager-level position.
Strong working knowledge of international trade, customs regulations, and import/export operations within Latin America.
Solid expertise across core transportation, planning, and carrier / logistics-provider management, including familiarity with control-tower operating models.
Excellent analytical skills and an affinity for numbers: ability to support budgeting, financial reconciliation, and identify cost-saving opportunities in transportation.
Good understanding of the order-to-cash process and end-to-end supply chain mindset.
Experience partnering with global stakeholders and operating within a matrixed, multinational organization.
Proven ability to manage complex operational issues, assess risk, and drive compliant outcomes.
Effective communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across cultures and geographies.

Preferred Experience And Skills

Experience in medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or other highly regulated industries.
Familiarity with global trade systems, transportation management systems, enterprise resource planning platforms, and trade automation tools.
Demonstrated experience leading regional or global process standardization initiatives.
Prior exposure to customs audits, investigations, or regulatory inspections.
Understanding of good distribution practice and a quality-first approach.
Lean or continuous improvement certification is a plus.
Demonstrated awareness of artificial intelligence concepts and responsible / ethical use, with experience generating effective prompts to boost productivity.

Other

Language: English required; Portuguese and/or Spanish strongly preferred to support stakeholders across LATAM.
Travel: Up to 25–30% regional and international travel.
Certifications: Trade compliance or customs certifications preferred but not required.

Fomentamos el respeto, por lo que nuestros procesos de adquisición, selección de talento y desarrollo se realizan de manera equitativa y son basados en parámetros de competencias, desempeño y potencial. ¡Queremos que llegues a nuestro equipo tal y como eres!

Reporta a: Jefatura de Producción

GF: 6

Área: Producción

Vacantes: 1

Ubicación: Mosquera

Fecha de Cierre: viernes 09 de octubre de 2026

Resumen de posición

Implementar e impulsar la mejora continua en el equipo de producción a través de las iniciativas de mejora de la compañía, garantizando el cumplimiento de la implementación de NCE, TPM, LEAN, y demás iniciativas. Liderar la consolidación de la cultura de la seguridad, calidad y medio ambiente en el equipo de la producción. Construir la estrategia de cumplimiento (compliance) y liderar los principales proyectos que impacten y aseguren los principales KPI de la fábrica (AI, MSA y Costos de producción - fijos y variaciones de uso).

Un día en la vida de...

Controlar el costo de producción mediante la construcción de la estrategia traducida en curva drive de los indicadores de producción anuales de acuerdo con los resultados cascadeados de las prioridades del OMP: AI, MSA, Desviaciones de uso de materiales y gasto fijo de producción, así como asegurar los estándares relacionados con recetas de fabricación.
Liderar las actividades de implementación de NCE, TPM/LEAN en las áreas de producción de acuerdo con el roll out establecido.
Liderar proyectos de mejora, como DMAIC, SMED, o Just Do it, que permitan lograr los objetivos de AI, APP, Variaciones de uso de materiales, Gastos fijos del área y cualquier dimensión que impacte al TDC.
Entrenar al personal de la fábrica en el manejo y aplicación de herramientas de mejora continua y metodologías de análisis y resolución de problemas (LTA, GSTD, IPA, SMED, DMAIC - WB), para asegurar su utilización, por parte del personal de fábrica, cuando sea aplicable.
Liderar la estrategia de Compliance del área de Producción, asegurando el cumplimiento de estándares corporativos, requisitos legales y controles operacionales. Garantizar el cierre oportuno de hallazgos, la gestión de riesgos, la actualización de estándares y la sostenibilidad de los Health Checks y auditorías aplicables al proceso productivo.
Acompañar y asegurar la implementación del plan de desarrollo y de capacitación del equipo operativo de producción con el fin de cerrar los gaps de competencias identificados, tanto técnicas PPMS como de TPM, para garantizar la operación segura de los equipos (incluyendo equipos, procedimientos de seguridad e higiene). Evaluar y entrenar a los operadores de los puestos claves de la planta.
Cumplir con los lineamientos definidos en los Sistemas de Gestión aplicables a la fábrica, proponiendo acciones y/o medidas que posibiliten la mejora continua, asegurando acciones y facilitando proyectos para el manejo eficiente de la energía, reducción en el consumo de agua, el manejo adecuado de los desechos y residuos, gestionando su minimización y asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de seguridad industrial, salud ocupacional, medio ambiente y calidad.
Gestionar a través de la herramienta Capacity Summary Tool (CST) el análisis de la capacidad instalada de la fábrica, para garantizar el óptimo uso de los activos, de tal manera que se impacte positivamente la utilización de los recursos disponibles para la operacion.
Apoyar a TAG en los procesos de formulación de la planta en caso de cambios de programa o eventos que requieran cambiar las fórmulas emitidas por TAG.

Lo que te hará exitoso

Profesional en Ingeniería de Alimentos, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería Ambiental o carreras afines.
Mínimo 4 años de experiencia en ambientes industriales, manufactureros o de producción.
Experiencia liderando proyectos de mejora continua, optimización de procesos, gestión de operaciones, gestión de retrabajo y desperdicio.
Haber desempeñado cargos como Coordinador(a), Especialista de Procesos o roles similares con responsabilidades de liderazgo.
Certificación Green Belt o Yellow Belt (deseable).
Manejo avanzado de Microsoft Office y Power BI.
Conocimiento avanzado de SAP en módulos de producción.
Nivel intermedio de inglés.

Compensación

4'200.000 a 4'400.000 + Beneficios de Compañia

jobs.title: Programmatic Executive, GOC
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC)
, you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Executive who will:

Interact effectively with regional teams and be a strong communicator.  
Support digital media campaign launches and setup according to established processes.  
Monitor and report on digital media campaign checks across channels/platforms.  
Ensure data accuracy for campaign reporting tools and WPP Media campaign management software.  
Produce daily campaign reports, including daily pacing, data inputting and providing commentary to regional teams. 

Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:

Bachelor’s degree.
Advanced English level (B2–C2).
Strong analytical and numerical skills.
Excellent communication, both written and verbal.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

For Colombia

This position is in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed within Colombian territory. Only candidates residing in Colombia with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work contracts do not allow employment or relocation abroad.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. 

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

jobs.description:
Company Description
Trans International Trucking & Distribution Inc. is a transportation and logistics company focused on prompt, dependable service and exceptional customer care. The organization emphasizes long-term business relationships built on integrity, accountability, and responsiveness. It offers Full Truckload (FTL), drayage and distribution, and brokerage services tailored to each customer’s specific needs and timelines. Through a proactive approach, the company strives for operational proficiency and continued success in the trucking and distribution industry. A dedicated customer support team is available on weekdays to assist with service and support needs.
Role Description
The Port Dispatcher role is a full-time, remote position responsible for coordinating daily truck movements to and from ports and terminals. This role includes scheduling pickups and deliveries, assigning loads to drivers, monitoring shipment status, and ensuring compliance with port and carrier requirements. Promover un ambiente de trabajo inclusivo, colaborativo y orientado al alto desempeño, fomentando el compromiso, la comunicación abierta, el trabajo en equipo y la mejora continua.

Experience working across multicultural and matrixed global organizations.
