Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission
and what we offer
.

People and businesses all over the world use Wise to avoid big bank fees and week-long international wires when they send, spend, and receive money abroad. We have over 15 million customers who move $15 billion every month with us. We help them save more than $6 million in bank fees every day.

Our banking relationships determine the quality of our product and a large part of its economics. And our relationships with regulators, governments and payment systems are crucial too. So, we’re on the hunt for an executor with a brilliant mind and strong communication skills to expand our product offering in Colombia.

This is a unique and exciting opportunity to play a pioneering role to grow Wise in one of our key markets, allowing millions more potential customers to save money by using our services. You will have full responsibility for overseeing our local operations, defining our market expansion strategy and executing on it, and being the face of Wise in Colombia.

What will you be doing?

Working with the Product teams (Product Managers, Analysts and Engineers), you will help define the opportunities for our products in Colombia and will help build better products and experiences for our customers. You will collaborate across teams and inspire others so that we deliver the best solution. Your contribution will mainly be from the payments infrastructure, regulatory and operational banking partnerships point of view.

Your Mission

To own and expand Wise’s regulatory presence in the country.

Identify the most appropriate way to grow Wise in Colombia. You will manage the entire licensing process for Wise’s entry into Colombia and will: understand the regulations, prepare, coordinate and submit the application, and get the regulatory buy-in as well as support the fulfillment of any other local requirements for the license applications.
Identify opportunities to offer the best product in the market taking advantage of our existing framework and future authorizations.
Understand existing and new regulations and figure out the best ways our product can comply with them. You will translate regulatory requirements into product implementations together with our Compliance teams. You will be one of the product team’s go-to people for regulatory knowledge. We see regulation as an opportunity!

Contribute to defining the opportunities and direction for our products in Colombia. Collaborate across teams and inspire others so that we deliver the best solution.

Work closely with product teams (Product Managers and Product Engineers) to develop our vision and build better products and experiences for our customers. Your contribution will mainly be from the payments infrastructure, regulatory and operational banking partnerships point of view.
Work with our global teams (Product, Finance, Treasury, etc.) to ensure our customers and products are at the center of our mission.
Be the person of reference in our new Colombia office, from both internal and external perspectives.

To Build New Relationships With Relevant Financial Institutions

Open new relationships with relevant financial institutions (i.e. banks, payment processors, cards issuers, processors, etc.). You will manage the process end-to-end: find the right potential partners, pitch Wise as a client, negotiate the commercial agreements and contracts, complete account opening forms, explain our compliance processes, pass due diligence, and do anything else needed to be ready for development.

Take ownership of improving existing relationships with transactional banking partners and other financial institutions. You will:

Lead commercial and relationship discussions with partners and monitor our economics to ensure we offer the most sustainable and competitive service in the market.
Create new opportunities within existing relationships with financial institutions in Colombia to ensure we continuously improve our product (i.e. increase speed, reduce costs, add more visibility to our transactions, etc.).

Qualifications

This role would suit someone who is:

Able to independently negotiate the most ideal terms with a clear product vision and understanding in mind and you can figure out the ideal operational and commercial process with every new partner.
Excellent at managing financial regulatory relationships, constantly creating opportunities to improve them.
Able to get stuff done. Not afraid to get hands dirty to deliver what is needed - we’re a fast growing company and you will need an entrepreneurial mindset to thrive.
Deep understanding of how financial, payments and FX regulators work and the different decision makers that need to be taken into account to make things happen.
Understand financial, payments and FX regulation in a changing regulatory environment and have an interest in AML/KYC and risk controls.
Familiar with different financial licensing frameworks and requirements in Colombia, including payments institutions, FX brokers, and securities brokers.
Familiar with how corporate banks and financial institutions work and their decision makers. You’re excellent at managing those relationships and are constantly creating opportunities to improve them.
You are fluent in Spanish and English.
You are resident in Colombia and able to serve as the local representative in the country.
Happy to work independently and flexibly within a fast-moving environment.
Passionate about transforming the financial industry for good.

It Would Be Ideal, But Not Essential If You

Have strong relationships and experience with regulators in Colombia, especially the Superintendencia Financiera and Banco de la Republica.
Understand financial regulation in the broader Latam region, or have experience working with financial regulators.
Have experience in obtaining licenses in Colombia, with a desirable experience in SEDPE license.
Understands payments infrastructure in the region and is well-versed in the nuances of the FX market in Latam.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, hands-on Product Analyst to join our Business Information Systems (BIS) team. Working closely with the Product Manager, this individual will be responsible for defining, documenting, testing, and delivering enterprise capabilities supporting our Product Business Systems (PBS), the internal systems that support our Product organization, focusing on two main areas: business systems’ products and pricing, and software provisioning, usage, and overage.

This role will support both Kaseya’s current operating environment and its future-state transformation. PBS is a newly formed team and growing fast! PBS capabilities are supported across platforms including Salesforce, NetSuite, integrations, and our Kaseya products, including Kaseya One.

As Kaseya advances its transformation, this role will help support the transition to a more scalable future-state architecture anchored by Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle ERP, and related boundary applications.

The ideal candidate will understand how the Lead-to-Cash process works at an Enterprise SaaS company and will be comfortable turning business needs into detailed Jira stories, acceptance criteria, and test cases. Hands-on exposure to configuring Products and Pricing, bundle configurations, and provisioning software licenses through different integration tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, etc.) and capturing usage and overage in different systems (Salesforce and NetSuite) is strongly preferred.

This person must be comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with competing priorities, while helping Kaseya simplify legacy processes, strengthen controls, and deliver well-tested, well-documented PBS capabilities for the future.

Product & Pricing Capabilities in Scope:

Product Configuration: Product configuration using the Revenue Cloud configurator, Product attribute selection and validation.
Product Catalog Management: Product creation and onboarding, SKU management, Product hierarchy management, Product master data governance, Oracle synchronization.
Product Governance: Product intake process, data dictionary management, Integration dependency documentation, revenue recognition and billing metadata
Pricing Management Capabilities: Pricing Waterfall, Discount Management, Renewal Pricing, Dynamic Pricing, Pricing Governance, Promotions
Bundle Management Capabilities: Bundle Modeling, Configuration, Ownership Validation, Cart Management, Cross-sell/Upsell, Bundle Pricing

Fulfillment & Provisioning Capabilities in Scope:

Provisioning Method Management: Automated provisioning, Manual provisioning, Hybrid provisioning, Fulfillment route determination, Platform selection (K1, DPP, Manual Operations)
Provisioning Exception Management: Provisioning Error Handling, Manual Provisioning, Provisioning Operations
Tenant & Instance Provisioning: New tenant provisioning, Tenant onboarding, Customer-to-tenant mapping, Multi-tenant support, Instance Management, Instance creation, Instance updates, Instance identity management, Zone and sub-domain assignment
Entitlement Management: License Provisioning, Entitlement Lifecycle Management
Usage & Rating: Support for subscription, usage-based, hardware, and one-time products; usage consumption and rating; overage management; and related billing and revenue treatment.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Requirements & Analysis
Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements for Product and Pricing, Fulfillment & Provisioning capabilities in support of the roadmap set by the Product Manager
Develop deep working knowledge of PBS processes and data across current and future-state systems, including Salesforce, Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, MuleSoft / Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kaseya One, and key boundary applications.
Partner with Finance, Billing Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and IT stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify business rules, and validate that delivered solutions meet the stated need.
Produce and maintain business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, process flows, data mappings, and decision logs that serve as the source of truth for PBS workstreams.
Perform gap analysis between current-state (legacy) and future-state processes, documenting impacts, dependencies, and migration-readiness considerations for the Product Manager and Architecture teams.
Support the Product Manager in maturing the PBS operating model by documenting as-is and to-be processes, clarifying ownership and handoffs, and identifying manual steps that can be eliminated or automated.
Apply business acumen and knowledge of managed service providers (MSPs), subscription-based business models, usage-based billing, customer lifecycle processes, and Corporate / BIS systems.

Lead-to-Cash Lifecycle Execution
Own detailed requirements definition and traceability across the Lead-to-Cash (L2C) lifecycle, with a focus on product and pricing setup, order fulfillment and provisioning, entitlements, and usage and overage capture, including downstream impacts on billing, revenue recognition, and reporting.
Translate complex business processes into clear system requirements, Jira epics and user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and testable outcomes.
Validate that product, pricing, order, entitlement, provisioning, and usage data flows are consistent, traceable, and aligned across integrated systems, performing data analysis and reconciliation where needed.
Partner with technical teams to document and test integrations between Salesforce, NetSuite, Kaseya One and the rest of the products.

Jira & Agile Delivery
Maintain the Jira backlog day-to-day: write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria; keep epics, stories, sub-tasks, labels, components, and fix versions accurate and up to date.
Prepare and facilitate backlog refinement, participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, solution reviews, demos, and retrospectives for assigned PBS workstreams; ensure stories are groomed and ready before sprint start.
Track story status, defects, and blockers in Jira; produce sprint and release reporting (burndown, velocity, defect counts) for the Product Manager and stakeholders.
Partner with Scrum Masters, Engineering Leads, QA, Business Process Leads, and Release / PMO teams to clarify requirements, resolve open questions quickly, and keep work flowing through the sprint.
Support delivery across both business-as-usual (BAU) and NextGen (future-state transformation) workstreams, keeping Jira work clearly tagged and separated between legacy support, transformation delivery, and migration-readiness activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with technical leads, engineers, QA, enterprise architecture, fulfillment operations, finance operations and customer support teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams, translating operational pain points and business needs into detailed system requirements and answering functional questions during build.
Document impacts to upstream and downstream teams and confirm they are understood and signed off before changes are introduced into production.
Triage and support issue resolution across complex, integrated workflows, reproducing issues, gathering evidence, and logging clear defect tickets where ownership spans multiple teams, platforms, or business functions.

Governance, Risk & Compliance
Ensure requirements and test coverage address applicable compliance standards, including internal controls, data privacy, and security requirements.
Partner with governance, architecture, security, integration, and release management teams to maintain alignment with enterprise policies.
Ensure every change is backed by clear documentation, approved requirements, defined business rules, traceable decisions, test evidence, and operational readiness artifacts (release notes, training materials, runbooks).

UAT & Quality Assurance
Define test strategy and write detailed test cases and scripts (functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end) that trace directly back to requirements and acceptance criteria.
Plan, coordinate, and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business users across Finance, Billing, Revenue Operations, and Fulfillment; prepare test data, track UAT progress, and obtain formal business sign-off.
Log, triage, and prioritize defects in Jira; partner with QA and Engineering on root-cause analysis, retesting, and closure, and report defect trends and quality metrics to the Product Manager.
Validate post-release behavior in production (hypercare), monitor data quality and defect trends, and feed findings back into the backlog to continuously improve PBS capabilities.

Required Qualifications:

5+ years of experience as a Product Analyst, Business Analyst, or Business Systems Analyst supporting CRM, ERP, billing, or revenue operations systems in an enterprise SaaS environment.
Solid understanding of Lead-to-Cash, Quote-to-Cash, or subscription lifecycle processes.
Hands-on experience writing and managing Jira epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and defects; proficiency with Jira and Confluence (JQL, boards, dashboards) strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience writing test cases, executing functional and regression testing, and planning and running UAT cycles with business users through to sign-off.
Working knowledge of Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud / RCA, NetSuite, integration platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi), or comparable enterprise systems; exposure to software license provisioning, entitlements, and usage-based pricing is a plus.
Understanding of integrated system flows across sales, order management, billing, receivables, collections, revenue recognition, and reporting.
Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams on enterprise-scale system implementations; comfortable facilitating refinement and participating in all sprint ceremonies.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to run requirements workshops, document decisions clearly, and work effectively with both business users and engineers.
Solid understanding of business process mapping, technical integrations, data dependencies, and system controls; basic SQL or data analysis skills for validating data across systems preferred.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and navigate a mix of legacy and future-state platforms.

CARRERAS PARA SONREÍR

En PepsiCo, descubrirás un lugar donde nuestra misión es crear sonrisas alrededor del mundo. Con más de 500 marcas queridas, incluyen Gatorade, Lay's y Quaker y nuestro trabajo llega a millones de personas cada día.

En el corazón de nuestra compañía hay un equipo de pensadores y creadores que colaboran para innovar y convertir las ideas en acciones. Impulsados por la innovación y centrados en crear momentos de alegría a través de los alimentos y bebidas, nuestras decisiones se guían por y para el consumidor, creando oportunidades para que nuestros asociados realicen un trabajo significativo y tengan un impacto duradero en las comunidades a las que servimos.

Sea cual sea tu función, formarás parte de una comunidad global que valora tus ideas y te empodera para que tengas impacto en tu carrera y en el mundo que te rodea.

Responsibilities

La oportunidad

Liderar la estrategia comercial en el canal de Cadenas Regionales, Independientes, Minimercados, Conveniencia y Away From Home; gestionando de forma directa las relaciones con clientes clave y liderando la ejecución . El rol exige visión de Key Account Management, disciplina de P&L a nivel cliente, analítica avanzada de sell-out y category management, y una mentalidad digital que acelere la formalización, cobertura y productividad del canal, en línea con el plan estratégico de la compañía.

La persona responsable diseñará estrategias diferenciadas para cadenas con negociación centralizada y para independientes y minimercados con ejecución territorial. También negociará promociones y planes anuales de crecimiento, asegurará el desempeño de ventas, distribución y ejecución, y liderará surtido, planogramas y participación en anaquel.

Tu impacto

Responsabilidad financiera: Gestionará ingresos, márgenes, descuentos, inversión comercial y gastos operativos del canal, con análisis de presupuesto y proyecciones. Asimismo, deberá optimizar el retorno de promociones y administrar el crédito y la cobranza dentro de los parámetros corporativos.

Decisiones basadas en datos: El puesto requiere liderar el uso de herramientas de inteligencia de negocios, analizar información de sell-out y desarrollar tableros de desempeño por producto, cliente, geografía y temporalidad. Los análisis deberán convertirse en acciones comerciales con responsables y fechas de cierre.

Transformación y evolución del canal: Se impulsará aplicaciones de fuerza de ventas y gestión digital de rutas, además de proyectos de automatización y precios inteligentes. El rol colaborará con tecnología, digital y cadena de suministro para mejorar la experiencia del cliente y del punto de venta.

Liderazgo y colaboración: La posición dirigirá Preventistas, Mercaderistas y Supervisores, establecerá metas, dará retroalimentación y desarrollará planes de sucesión y talento. También coordinará el plan de negocio con Trade Marketing, cadena de suministro, Cartera, Recursos Humanos, y representará a la región ante clientes y asociaciones comerciales.

El desempeño se medirá mediante ventas, sell-in, sell-out, margen, distribución, ejecución de planogramas, retorno de la inversión, cobertura, expansión de puntos, adopción digital, precisión del pronóstico, desempeño del equipo y satisfacción de clientes.

Qualifications

¿A quién buscamos?

Formación Académica

Licenciatura concluida en Administración de Empresas, Mercadotecnia, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía o afín. (Indispensable)
Certificación en transformación digital, metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Design Thinking) o afines. (Deseable)

Experiencia Profesional

Mínimo 6-8 años de experiencia en ventas en empresas de consumo masivo (FMCG), preferentemente del sector de bebidas o alimentos.
Al menos 4 años en posiciones de liderazgo comercial con manejo de cuentas clave (Key Account Management) en Cadenas Regionales/locales, Conveniencia y AFH.
Experiencia comprobable en negociación con cadenas, category management y planogramación.
Experiencia en gestión de P&L, presupuesto y análisis financiero a nivel cliente, regional o divisional.
Manejo previo de los canales mencionados en contextos urbanos y foráneos.
Experiencia en proyectos de formalización de canal o transformación digital comercial es un plus significativo.

Si esta es una oportunidad que te interesa, te alentamos a postularte aún si no cumples con el 100% de los requisitos.

Qué puedes esperar de nosotros:

Oportunidades para aprender y desarrollarte todos los días a través de una amplia oferta de programas.
Plataformas internas digitales que promueven el self-learning.
Programas de desarrollo de acuerdo con habilidades de Liderazgo.
Entrenamientos especializados de acuerdo con el rol.
Experiencias de aprendizaje con proveedores internos y externos.
Nos encanta celebrar el éxito, por lo que contamos con programas de reconocimiento por antigüedad, comportamientos, liderazgo, momentos de vida, entre otros.
Programas de bienestar financiero que te ayudarán a alcanzar tus metas en todas las etapas de la vida.
Un programa de flexibilidad que te permitirá balancear tu vida personal y laboral, adaptando tu jornada laboral a tu estilo de vida.
Y porque tu familia también es importante para nosotros, ellos también pueden gozar de beneficios como nuestra Línea de Bienestar, miles de Convenios y Descuentos, programas de Becas para tus hijos, Planes de Ayuda para diferentes momentos de vida, entre otros.

En PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos con impulsar un equipo de trabajo diverso al crear un espacio colaborativo, equitativo e incluyente, en donde todos y todas independientemente de cómo nos vemos, de dónde somos o a quién amamos- tengamos una voz.

jobs.title: Regional Manager
jobs.description:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Who You'll Work With

You will join our office in Bogota
to work in teams and directly interact with our partners, providers, and venues.

In this role, you will help Fever grow its pipeline of original events in the region. To do so, you will manage and grow a team of Project Managers, Producers, and other types of profiles, while working together with all departments of Fever, from Marketing to Operations.

The team you’re about to join (and lead) consists of people that are motivated, young, and fun. On top of having multicultural backgrounds, people in the team are all top profiles: McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Rocket Internet, Uber, Amazon, Google, KKR, Cirque du Soleil, PSG, Roland Garros.

What You'll Do

As Regional Manager for Colombia
, you will create and lead a team to develop, launch and manage events, from A to Z. You will be responsible for the region’s P&L, team development, development of local connections in the industry and represent Fever across all cities you will be managing. Together with the other departments, you will define the strategy to grow the business in your region and define the scalability of events to all our other markets, working hand in hand with other General Managers and the company’s leadership.

Employees are expected to be in the office Monday to Thursday with possibility to work from home on Fridays.

In this role, you'll:

Build and manage the Fever Originals team for Colombia (Project Managers, Producers, Location Scouters, etc) that will be generating growth for the country within the scope.
Ensure individual team members are effective in achieving their quality and revenue goals on a quarterly basis, by auditing their work and performance on a regular basis
Define the strategy of the region for its growth by ensuring maximum sales performance, customer excellence, and operational quality of our events, to meet quarterly and annual regional goals in all KPIs
Manage the local portfolio of experiences based on data analyses, ensuring Fever’s penetration in the local market
Develop and maintain a very high level of relationship with senior stakeholders from major entertainment and real estate companies
Manage big local partners and ensure our local network keeps expanding
Negotiate and close business deals with partners
Define and support the scalability of our experiences in other cities (opportunity for travel)
Report performance on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis
Provide coaching, mentoring, and feedback to local team members
Execute detailed analysis of business opportunities and processes
Represent Fever at local events and conversations

Qualifications

Project management / startup or consulting background (10y+ experience)
MBA from top-tier school preferred
Fluent English & Spanish
Strong analytical and organizational skills with large team management experience
Solution-focused, identifying problems and defining solutions with an entrepreneurial spirit
Experience managing complex projects
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with strong skills in creating and developing relationships with C-level executives
Ability to influence/persuade all levels of staff
Able to coordinate and audit all different internal and external teams to guide them to success in all achievements
Extensive networking skills and ability to make partnerships happen
Advanced commercial acumen - ability to understand counterparty, find leverage and negotiate high value deals with favourable terms for Fever
Curious and keen to push boundaries and try new concepts while being in contact with the top management - very high visibility and exposure both internally and externally
Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work-streams
This is not a position for an event production background

What You'll Get

All job positions at Fever in Colombia include the following perks:

Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
Work in the heart of the city, with possible travel across our markets
Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

Our hiring process

A 30 min video call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers, to better understand your career plan, assess cultural fit and answer any questions you may have
A 60 min online test with three topics: logic, analytics, and written understanding
A 30 minute conversation with your Hiring Manager to understand in more detail the position/team etc.
A 45 min video call with your future manager + another FO manager, including questions about your profile and a business case presentation (to be prepared in advance)

On average our process lasts 20 working days and offers usually follow within a week.

You will be the bridge between executive leadership and the operational teams. The Strategy Manager is the right hand of the Sr. Commercial Directors of the differnet countries where we operate. In this role, you'll be...

Strategic Planning: Leading strategic reviews of business segments, products, and key initiatives.
Analysis & Research: Conducting rigorous market research, competitor analysis, and financial modeling.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Driving implementation of strategic projects by coordinating across various departments.
Leadership & Mentorship: Overseeing junior strategy staff, cultivating a collaborative environment, and acting as a strategic advisor to leadership.

Leadership & Execution: Strong project management, leadership, and, in some cases, experience driving organizational transformation.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Position Summary

The "Business Process Analyst" is part of Optimization, Enablement & Governance. We work with our stakeholders (customers, distributor partners, country teams and Business Process Owners) to build operational process transaction and guide process optimization and enhancement followed by Continuous Improvement and potential Automation. You will reduce transactional efforts by efficient process execution which helps to expedite issue resolution and enhance ease of doing business with Rockwell Automation.

You will report to the Team Leader GEBS Business Operations.

Your Responsibilities

Accomplish operational processes transaction as defined by the GEBS Ops.
The Business Process Analyst works as part of a larger shared services team to execute a variety of defined operation tasks ranging from data entry, updates data quality, monitors email inbox, provides standardized responses, and documents process improvement opportunities as they execute the standardized operational tasks.
Resolving customer queries or complaints, issues received within the SLA and ensuring to provide an initial response, prioritizing the request based on the urgency. Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
Development to ensure that high quality standards are maintained.
Optimizing operational processes for maximum efficiency while maintaining quality standards.
Help with the implementation of new processes. Create a variety of documents, including Standard Operating Procedure, FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions) and training materials.
Analyze data and use it to create different reports, which are then submitted to managers and used to develop business plans.
Reduce customer efforts and enhance productivity by process improvements.
Improve the process by using multiple CI (Continuous Improvement) and Lean Methodologies and Allow the ecosystem for potential automation.
Improves process of all stakeholders.
Enhance competency level in a planned manner.

The Essentials - You Will Have

Bachelor’s or Associate degree, completed or currently in progress
Advanced to Fluent English

The Preferred – You Might Also Have

Bachelor’s or Associate degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, International Trade, Engineering, or another relevant field of study
1 year of experience as Business Process Analyst
Expertise with SAP – CRM (Customer Relationship Management), ERP, ECC
Knowledge of MS Office suite & other productivity applications
Problem-Solving Skills, Critical Thinking Skills, Business Analysis Skills
Analytical and conceptual expertise
Ability to work on own initiative within guardrails
Desired - CI & Lean Awareness
Collaboration skills and working in a matrix environment required

Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
Employee Assistance Program.
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Role Summary

The Billing, Credit & Collections Manager is responsible for end-to-end ownership of global billing operations and credit & collections activities. This role leads teams to perform both functions and plays a critical role in driving financial discipline, cash flow optimization, and risk mitigation. Beyond execution, this leader is expected to drive continuous improvement, apply strong critical thinking and structured problem solving, and lead the adoption of modern tools, analytics, automation, and new ways of working to improve speed, quality, and decision-making as the business continues to evolve.

This professional will lead teams of 10+ employees
, working closely with Sales, Finance, Tax, and Legal stakeholders, and will play a key role in driving process improvements and system transformations at a regional level.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end Billing, Credit & Collections operations for Latin American countries, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with internal policies and local regulations.

Ensure billing and invoicing processes comply with LATAM tax legislation (including indirect taxes, fiscal documentation, and statutory requirements) as well as tax regulations across other LATAM markets.

Manage and develop cross-functional teams with more than 10 direct and indirect reports, fostering high performance, engagement, and continuous development

Lead teams responsible for invoice generation, dispute management, credit risk assessment, collections strategy, and customer communications.

Apply strong critical-thinking skills to assess complex issues, balance risk and commercial outcomes, and recommend solutions aligned with enterprise goals.

Drive adoption of new processes, systems, automation, and reporting capabilities, ensuring consistent execution and strong change adoption.

Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and control through simplified workflows, standardization, and smarter use of technology.

Partner closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Deal Management, and other stakeholders to enable sound deal structures and disciplined revenue realization.

Proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and control as the business and customer base continue to evolve.

Ensure adherence to SOX requirements, internal controls, and audit standards, while continuously strengthening process maturity.

Monitor performance metrics related to billing accuracy, aging, cash collections, dispute resolution, and risk exposure, and take corrective action as needed.

Lead change management efforts within the team by clearly communicating rationale, expectations, and benefits of new ways of working.

Develop and coach team members to think strategically, exercise sound judgment, and operate effectively in a changing business environment.

Leadership & Change Enablement

Serve as a change agent by promoting a mindset of continuous improvement, critical evaluation, and adaptability.

Serve as a regional change agent, promoting continuous improvement

Support enterprise initiatives that impact billing, credit, collections, and cash flow, ensuring the team is prepared for change.

Translate company strategy and evolving business priorities into clear operational actions and expectations.

Foster collaboration across regions and functions to ensure alignment and consistency in execution.

Qualifications & Experience

Fluent English – Mandatory

Solid experience in Billing, Credit, Collections, or Financial Operations, preferably within a regional or LATAM scope.

Solid prior experience leading large teams (10+direct and/or indirect reports) in complex, high volume operational environments.

Strong knowledge of Brazilian taxation and hands-on experience with fiscal and regulatory requirements across Latin American countries.

Demonstrated experience in billing, credit, collections, or related financial operations roles.

Proven ability to lead teams performing multiple functions within a shared operational model.

Experience working in structured corporate environments with a strong focus on compliance, controls, and audit readiness.

Demonstrated success leading process transformation, automation, or system implementation initiatives.

Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to balance risk, compliance, and commercial objectives.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels of the organization

jobs.description:
Title: Team Leader (Sales)

Location: GSC BOG

The Team Leader – Sales will lead the GSC Bogotá Sales service line teams (such as Sales Support, Digital Sales and After Sales) that enable DHL Global Forwarding's commercial organization to win and grow business. The team supports global and regional Business Partners, including DGF US, through services such as sales performance reporting, lead research and qualification, customer onboarding, bid and contract support, and sales management support.

This role sits at the intersection of people leadership and commercial performance. The Team Leader is accountable for service delivery against the agreed SLAs, for strong and trusted relationships with Business Partners and, above all, for building a motivated, high-performing team that grows the next generation of leaders.

We are looking for a leader who develops people as intentionally as they deliver results: someone who grows new leaders within the team, keeps engagement high in a fast-paced environment, leads with data, and brings a commercial mindset to every conversation with the business.

Key Responsibilities
:

People Leadership & Leadership Development

Lead, develop and inspire a growing team of Sales professionals across multiple service teams, promoting a culture of accountability, collaboration, respect and high performance.
Build a strong leadership bench within the team: identify high-potential team members, give them real ownership of services, projects and team routines, and develop their leadership skills through coaching, stretch assignments and individual development plans.
Keep the team motivated and engaged through consistent recognition (e.g., Hi5s, Star of the Month nominations), transparent communication and a positive, inclusive team climate; follow up on engagement results (EOS) and act on them.
Run weekly Performance Dialogs and one-on-one coaching sessions with clear, data-based feedback, and follow up on performance and development commitments.
Identify training needs and coordinate upskilling in commercial processes (lead management, customer onboarding, bid support and sales reporting), freight forwarding products, tools, communication and stakeholder management.
Participate in hiring and onboarding of new team members, including technical assessments, ensuring new hires reach production readiness quickly.

Service Delivery & Performance Management

Own the day-to-day delivery of the agreed Sales services in adherence to SLAs and SOPs, monitoring volume, turnaround time (TAT), accuracy, FTE utilization, errors, complaints and Business Partner satisfaction (NPA and case rating).
Manage workload distribution, capacity planning and prioritization across teams, anticipating volume changes and proactively flagging risks, bottlenecks and required capacity actions.
Lead root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive action plans (CAPA) for errors and complaints, focusing on fixing processes rather than blaming individuals.Manage escalations and complex scenarios with a solution-oriented and professional approach.

Business Partner Management & Commercial Enablement

Act as the single operational point of contact for regional and country Sales organizations (Sales Heads, KAMs, Digital Sales Executives and other Business Partners), ensuring clear, timely and professional communication.
Lead monthly Service Performance Reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), presenting results, insights and action plans at executive level.}
Understand the commercial goals behind each service (lead conversion, bid success, customer onboarding) and translate them into clear team priorities.
Identify opportunities to expand the service portfolio to new services, countries or Business Partners, and support the business case, transition and onboarding of the new scope.

Continuous Improvement & Digitalization

Drive the standardization, automation and scalability of processes and reporting (dashboards, trackers, workflow automation) in partnership with OPEX and digital teams.
Document processes (SOPs and process maps) and lead the implementation of process changes and transitions, including UAT, go-live and handover to steady state.

What We Are Looking For
:

Leader of leaders: sees developing new leaders as a core part of the job, shares ownership and trusts the team to lead.
Energizing and close to the team: keeps people motivated and connected, adapting the leadership style to a diverse, hybrid team and making work meaningful.
Data-driven: makes decisions and gives feedback based on facts and KPIs, not opinions.
Commercially minded: understands how GSC Sales helps DHL win and keep customers, and looks for new ways to add value to the business.
Ownership under pressure: stays calm, takes accountability and turns challenges or underperformance into clear action plans.
Learning mindset: treats errors as learning opportunities and promotes continuous improvement within the team.
Curious about technology: embraces automation and digital tools to make the team more productive and the service more scalable.

Skills / Requirements
:

jobs.title: Jefe de RGM

SOMOS LIDERAZGO CON CONCIENCIA

En Natura, tenemos el potencial de impulsar transformaciones significativas. Esto es posible a través de los productos innovadores de Natura y Avon; las experiencias memorables de los servicios de belleza de Bluma y nuestra plataforma de educación financiera, Emana Pay. Marcas y servicios relevantes para quienes los utilizan y reconocidos por nuestro compromiso con la conducción de negocios regenerativos.

Ocupación

Permanente

¿Qué harás aquí?

Serás el socio estratégico (Business Partner) de los equipos comerciales, de marketing y canales para liderar la estrategia de Revenue Growth Management (RGM). Tu objetivo principal será maximizar los ingresos y la rentabilidad omnicanal mediante la gestión del P&L de inversión comercial y el diseño de una arquitectura óptima de portafolio, formatos, promociones y precios adaptada a cada canal y ocasión de consumo, asegurando valor para la compañía y el consumidor final.

¿Qué conocimientos y experiencias necesitarás traer para compartir con nuestra red?

Tus Principales Responsabilidades Serán

Optimización y Control del Gross-to-Net Omnicanal: Analizar y controlar la estructura de precios desde la tarifa base hasta el precio neto (pocket price) en Venta Directa (con alta prioridad), Retail, E-commerce y Marketplaces, definiendo direccionamientos de descuentos e incentivos para evitar la erosión de valor.
Gobernanza de Inversión y Eficiencia Promocional (ROI): Auditar la salud financiera de las inversiones comerciales en canales, entregando pautas a Planeación para definir acciones comerciales con mayor retorno y emitiendo alertas sobre tácticas que diluyan el margen.
Armonía Omnicanal ("Set the Price" vs. "Get the Price"): Liderar la integración estratégica entre canales para mitigar la canibalización y el conflicto de canal, garantizando que la arquitectura de precios se ejecute armónicamente sin afectar la competitividad ni destruir valor en la fuerza de Venta Directa ni en Tiendas Propias.
Estructuración y formación: Liderar la creación de procesos de RGM desde cero, así como la formación y desarrollo de equipos en metodologías de RGM.

¿Qué conocimientos y vivencias vas a necesitar para compartir con nuestra red?

Mínimo 6 años de experiencia en roles de RGM (indispensable), Pricing, Finanzas Comerciales (Commercial Finance), Pricing Estratégico o Trade Marketing Estratégico.
Experiencia comprobada en gestión de P&L, administración de presupuestos comerciales, estructuración de procesos de RGM y creación o formación de equipos.
Solidos conocimientos financieros y entendimiento de la cadena de valor omnicanal.
Conocimiento metodológico en elasticidad de precios y efectividad promocional.
Manejo de herramientas de visualización y análisis de datos (Tableau, Power BI, SQL o lenguajes de programación/Python).

¿Cuáles son los diferenciales?

Liderazgo de influencia y capacidad de objetar o direccionar decisiones con sustento analítico de datos.
Excelente capacidad de Storytelling y comunicación ejecutiva.
Pensamiento estratégico, agilidad y habilidades avanzadas en resolución de problemas complejos.
Resiliencia y manejo de la frustración para construir estructuras y procesos en contextos dinámicos y desde cero.
Experiencia previa en la industria de consumo masivo, idealmente en empresas del modelo de Venta Directa (ej. Belcorp, Yanbal, Herbalife, etc.).
Experiencia liderando proyectos de armonía y precios omnicanal a gran escala.

¿Qué encontrarás aquí?

Somos más que un lugar de trabajo: construimos y vivimos diariamente el Ecosistema Bien Estar Bien, basado en la relación armoniosa entre cada individuo, las relaciones a su alrededor y el entorno en el que está inmerso. Además de ofrecer beneficios enfocados en el bienestar social, físico, financiero, mental y emocional, promovemos un ambiente de prosperidad, pertenencia y propósito, fortaleciendo una red sólida de apoyo, expansión de la conciencia y respeto por la diversidad, equidad e inclusión.

Somos un movimiento que transforma la forma de vivir y hacer negocios en 14 países de América Latina, siempre guiados por la conciencia.

¿Conoces a alguien en Natura?

Si es así, solicita el correo corporativo de esa persona y, al postularte a una vacante, utilízalo para solicitar una recomendación. ¡Es una excelente oportunidad para fortalecer tu red de contactos y avanzar en tu proceso de selección con nosotros!

Natura celebra y abraza la diversidad en todas sus formas y pluralidades.

Invitamos a #Mujeres, #PersonasNegras, #PersonasConDiscapacidad, personas de la comunidad #LGBTQIA+, #MujeresEmbarazadas y personas con #50años+ a postularse para esta vacante.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Analyst Operations & Process Transformation

Job Overview

The Revenue Operations and Enablement department provides centralized billing for products and services billed to our customers using the MasterCard Consolidated Billing System (MCBS). Our mission is to provide core billing services, drive billing assurance, provide value added services, and enable growth as MasterCard advances commerce globally.

Partner with business owners and release manager/lead to understand new business opportunities and define the business and functional requirements. Deliver high quality business and functional requirements to the development teams for the purpose of completing the design, coding, testing, and implementation phases of the project life cycle and support our tools operationally.

Role

Identify trends, recurring issues, and operational risks; recommend and support implementation of process and product improvements.

Provide subject matter expertise on billing application functionality, invoicing processes, and downstream impacts.

Create and maintain job aids, operating procedures, user guides, and training materials related to the billing environment, applications and invoicing processes.

Support change enablement through training sessions and knowledge transfer focused on the billing environment and systems.

Lead intake and vetting of enhancement requests, partnering with stakeholders to clarify business objectives, success measures, and priority.

Validate delivered solutions against requirements to ensure business outcomes are achieved.

Coordinate and participate in reviews, revisions, changes, enhancements, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication related to billing application and invoicing changes.

Required Experience & Skills

Advanced experience supporting billing products, systems, or platforms in an operational, business analyst, or product support role.

Demonstrated ability to lead requirements gathering and documentation for complex billing, invoicing, or financial system enhancements.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate ambiguous billing and financial business needs into clear, actionable requirements.

Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities in a fast‑paced environment.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain billing and invoicing impacts to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and focus on data accuracy and financial outcomes.

Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel, including analysis of billing data and invoice outputs.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: AI Strategist - Remote, Medellín
jobs.description:
About WON

WON redesigns how a business works: what its customers experience on the outside, and how its operation runs on the inside. We do that for retail and consumer brands, travel, hospitality, financial services, and private equity portfolios. We are not a consultancy that separates the thinking from the doing, and we are not a platform company with something to sell you. Those two halves are our two disciplines: Experience Intelligence and Operational Intelligence.

The firm is built around senior practitioners. The people you meet are the people doing the work, and the people who find the opportunity stay to design it, build it, and optimize it. AI gives exceptional people extraordinary leverage. It increases capacity; it does not replace judgment.

This role sits in Operational Intelligence, the discipline that gets inside the workflows running a business and rebuilds how they work. We sell a program, not a point solution. We come into a business across a defined set of areas, often led by customer experience, marketing operations, and forecasting and inventory, benchmark how the business performs in each, and use the gap against that benchmark to show where the opportunity actually is. Then we execute across those areas over the life of the engagement. Your accounts today are retail and consumer brands with potential to expand.

This role reports to the AI Practices Lead
. You are the primary point of contact on your accounts and run them independently, with the Practices Lead joining when a conversation is notable or a decision calls for it.

What You’ll Own

Running the program rather than a point solution. Clients buy a long-term engagement across our areas, not the one tool they got excited about, and expansion comes from delivering, reassessing what the business needs, and moving into the next area
Discovery led by those areas rather than by whatever the client raises first: benchmark how the business performs in each, and stay embedded through recurring touchpoints and their internal channels so you see the opportunity before they package it for you
The business case behind everything you scope: what it should move, by how much, what it costs us to deliver, and how we will know
Specifications precise enough for a specialist engineer or analyst to deliver against, direction of that delivery across concurrent projects, and adoption once it lands, because a system nobody uses is indistinguishable from a system nobody built

How Success Is Measured

Clients buy the program rather than the one tool they got excited about, and treat you as an operational and AI partner instead of a vendor contact
Work expands past the project that opened the account, because you found the next thing before the client thought to ask
Contractors execute from your direction without a second discovery pass or a rewrite of the spec
What you scope moves a number the business already tracks, and stays in use after launch
Several accounts run at once without quality, client trust, or margin slipping, and the AI Practices Lead is no longer the default path for discovery and scoping

What You’ll Bring

Startup experience, built or operated, and real comfort creating the playbook while delivering the work including owning a United States client relationship entirely remotely
Client-facing experience with the maturity to lead an executive conversation, tell a client something they are paying not to hear, and pull the conversation back to the business problem when they jump straight to the tactical
Deeply AI-native rather than a casual user, with AI-enabled tools, products, or workflows you have actually built. The bar is materially above vibe coding, and we will ask you to demo and walk us through an Applied AI case study project
Enough technical and analytical fluency to reason through agent systems, data connections, backend architectures, APIs, and implementation tradeoffs, even though you will not be the primary engineer. SQL/Python experience is valuable
You can read a P&L,explain how a Shopify or e-commerce business actually makes money, and build financial models

Bonus points:
time inside a consumer or e-commerce brand on the operator side; published writing or talks on applied AI

How We Work

We don’t start by asking where AI can be deployed. We start with where value is being left in the business, and we build systems that make the business healthier rather than tools that make one team’s day slightly nicer
Insight has to become a shipped system. We work inside our clients’ businesses, not adjacent to them, and strategy that stops at the recommendation is half a job
You may own the whole arc: the relationship, the discovery, the business case, the direction of delivery, and the number at the end, with specialists on tap so your scope is not capped by what you can personally build
An early hire into the practice, so you shape the offering rather than inherit one, and saying no is part of that. A client asking for the wrong thing is a conversation, not an order
Probably not the right environment if you want a fixed scope, a predictable week, or distance from the outcome

If you want to write the recommendation and hand it off, this probably isn’t for you. If you want to work directly with clients, find the thing that is actually broken in their business, direct the people who fix it, and be held accountable for whether anything changed, we’d love to meet you.

The Global Pricing & Interchange (P&IC) team plays a critical role in shaping Mastercard’s economic strategy and supporting profitable growth across markets. The team partners closely with regional teams and global business units to design, align, and execute pricing and interchange strategies under a consistent global framework.

The team leads high-impact initiatives that require enterprise-wide coordination, strategic thinking, and cross-functional collaboration. With visibility into some of Mastercard’s most important commercial priorities, the team influences key business decisions by driving revenue optimization, simplifying commercial constructs, enhancing customer and employee experiences, and ensuring adherence to pricing and interchange principles.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of strategy, analytics, product, and commercial execution while helping shape Mastercard’s future economic model globally.

Role

The Manager, Global Pricing & Interchange Strategy plays a key part in developing and executing pricing and interchange strategies, advancing transformation initiatives, building data-driven tools and frameworks, and providing analytical insight to support strategic business decisions. The position also serves as a key partner to regional, product, services, finance, and commercial teams across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Support the execution of Mastercard’s global pricing and interchange strategy and transformation initiatives.
Drive initiatives from ideation through business case development, stakeholder alignment, regional syndication, and implementation.
Develop creative, fact-based solutions to complex business challenges and lead cross-functional teams toward successful execution.
Conduct strategic and financial analyses to evaluate new opportunities, benchmark performance, and inform pricing and interchange decisions.
Leverage and enhance analytical models to evaluate economic strategy, competitive positioning, and value creation across the four-party payments ecosystem.
Partner with regional and global stakeholders to ensure alignment of business objectives and successful project delivery.
Communicate progress, insights, recommendations, and risks effectively to leadership and key stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous evolution of tools, methodologies, and capabilities that support Mastercard’s pricing and interchange decision-making.

All About You

Demonstrated experience applying financial, strategic, and business management principles to solve complex business problems.
Strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities, including business case development, P&L forecasting, ROI analysis, cost-benefit assessments, and scenario modeling.
Strategic thinker with a strong bias for action, attention to detail, and focus on execution.
Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize large and complex data sets into actionable business insights.
Strong interpersonal and leadership skills with the ability to influence and build alignment across stakeholders without direct authority.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas in a concise and compelling manner.
Ability to effectively collaborate across functions, geographies, and organizational levels.
Advanced technical proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, data mining and analytics tools, including Power BI, Tableau, Python, and related technologies.
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while maintaining high-quality execution.

About Addi

We are a leading financial platform, building the future of payments, shopping, and banking—a world where consumers and merchants can transact effortlessly and grow together. Today, we serve over 3.6 million customers and partner with more than 55,000 merchants, making Addi Colombia’s fastest-growing marketplace.

With a state-of-the-art, technology-first approach, we provide banking solutions (deposits, payments, unsecured credit) and commerce services (e-commerce, marketing), bridging the financial gap for millions and redefining how people experience financial freedom. As the country’s leading Buy Now, Pay Later provider, we have secured regulatory approval to operate as a bank, unlocking even greater opportunities for our customers. In the past year, we have also achieved profitability, reinforcing the strength of our business model and our ability to scale sustainably.

Our mission has earned the trust of world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Architect Capital, GIC, Goldman Sachs, Greycroft, Monashees, Notable Capital, Quona Capital, Union Square Ventures, Victory Park Capital, and more, who back our vision for the future. With their support, we are not just growing—we are transforming Latin America’s financial ecosystem and shaping the next generation to shop, pay, and bank in Colombia.

But what truly sets us apart is how we build. We are a conscious company, driven by deep experience in scaling technology, services and products, and we live by our values
every day.

About The Role

This is where you come in. Below, you’ll find what this role is all about—the impact you’ll drive, the challenges you’ll tackle, and what it takes to thrive at Addi. If you’re ready to be part of something big, keep reading.

What’s The Mission You’ll Drive

Build and scale the integrated financial engine that drives Addi’s banking operations. You will provide the definitive, forward-looking view of capital, liquidity, and earnings to enable high-stakes decisions as we transform Latin America’s financial ecosystem into a more accessible and transparent landscape.

What You Will Do

Build Addi's growth engine on both sides of GMV. Grow Active Sellers 150%+ and the Published base 2x, while shifting the mix deeper into strategic categories and away from top-25 dependency — growth that compounds, not just adds up.
Win on value and trust. Get pricing and quality on high-impact listings to beat MeLi and Falabella head-on, and cut merchant-driven order issues 30% across 80K+ monthly orders — make the experience the reason customers repurchase.
Turn supply into a commercial asset. Own the commercial calendar against demand peaks, convert programs like Fulfilled by Addi into direct revenue, and give the base self-service tooling so it scales without scaling headcount.
Close the selection gap upstream of demand. Move brand coverage and category productivity from where they are today to where a best-in-class marketplace needs to be — the constraint isn't demand, it's what's on the shelf.

What We’re Looking For

Runs Selection as a System (distinctive for this role)
Has operated a marketplace selection function through an explicit cause-to-effect model (breadth, then price and stock and fit, then quality), managing the causal levels rather than reporting the outputs.
Builds and runs a decision-grade governance cadence (a daily input pulse, a weekly review, a monthly decision instance on inputs not outputs), holding the line that no build ships without a named commercial owner and a committed action.
Prices acquisition by merchant maturity value and mix (not publication counts) and manages concentration as a health metric.

Category and Brand Strategy
Built a data-driven category prioritization and brand-tiering method (crossing market size, search and demand signal, internal performance, and momentum) and executed hunt-and-farm plans against it.
Reads a category by productivity (GMV per seller, listings per seller) and activates existing catalogue instead of over-publishing.

Proven Senior Leadership and ownership in Marketplace/E-commerce Operations
Minimum of 8+ years of progressive professional experience, with at least 3-5 years in a senior leadership role owning the full supply side of a major E-commerce, B2B Marketplace, or high-growth Fintech platform

The Manager will help monitor program performance, analyze participant and transaction activity, evaluate adherence to Mastercard standards and rules, and support the development of recommendations that strengthen program governance and network integrity. The role will also contribute to standards implementation, issue resolution, operational oversight, and strategic program initiatives across the region.

Success in this position requires a highly analytical mindset, sound business judgment, strong communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex and matrixed environment while balancing multiple stakeholder perspectives and priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, GTM Territory Planning
jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

The Senior Analyst, GTM Territory Planning sits within the Territory Planning & Operations Management function and reports to the Sr. Manager (or Director), GTM Territory Planning. This role is responsible for supporting the design, execution, and ongoing maintenance of territory models across Account Management, New Customer Acquisition, and Specialist organizations.

This individual owns the analytical foundation of territory planning by building and maintaining capacity models, territory allocation frameworks, and coverage analyses that inform how GTM resources are deployed across the organization. The Senior Analyst translates headcount data, productivity benchmarks, and business priorities into structured planning outputs that enable leadership to make informed decisions regarding territory design, coverage strategy, and workforce allocation.

This is an individual contributor role that partners closely with GTM Strategy, Finance, Sales Leadership, GTM Operations, Compensation, and BIS/Systems teams to ensure territory models remain accurate, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Design & Allocation

Support the design, implementation, and maintenance of territory models across Account Management, New Customer Acquisition, and Specialist organizations.
Build and maintain territory allocation frameworks that balance market opportunity, workload distribution, customer coverage, and business objectives.
Analyze territory performance and coverage data to identify imbalances, gaps, and optimization opportunities.
Develop territory design recommendations and supporting analyses for leadership review and decision-making.
Maintain territory data integrity across Salesforce and related planning systems, ensuring models accurately reflect approved designs and assignments.

Capacity Planning & Coverage Modeling

Build and maintain capacity planning models to determine optimal headcount requirements across GTM sales organizations.
Develop Day-in-the-Life models and support ratio analyses to establish workload expectations and identify resource coverage gaps.
Monitor hiring plans against Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets, proactively identifying variances and updating planning assumptions.
Evaluate productivity benchmarks and workload distribution metrics to assess territory effectiveness and resource utilization.
Support Finance and HR planning cycles by providing headcount and coverage modeling insights and recommendations.

Account & Territory Operations

Maintain Account Manager books of business and ensure territory assignments remain balanced, accurate, and aligned to organizational goals.
Support annual and in-year territory planning cycles, including data preparation, model maintenance, change tracking, and execution support.
Process and document territory and account assignment changes through established governance processes, including Salesforce case management workflows.
Conduct impact assessments for account segment changes, evaluating implications on territory coverage, capacity, and resource allocation.
Maintain accurate records of territory assignments, account movements, and planning decisions as the operational source of truth.

Segmentation & Lead Distribution Support

Support customer segmentation reviews by preparing data analyses, reporting outputs, and recommendations for leadership teams.
Maintain the accuracy and consistent application of customer segmentation criteria across GTM systems and processes.
Provide analytical support for lead routing and distribution strategies by evaluating capacity, territory alignment, and utilization metrics.
Identify and resolve segmentation or lead distribution inconsistencies in partnership with BIS/Systems teams.

Reporting & Planning Insights

Define and document reporting requirements for territory planning dashboards and recurring planning reports in partnership with Reporting and BIS/Systems teams.
Prepare territory health summaries, capacity utilization reporting, hiring progress updates, and other planning insights for leadership review.
Track and report on territory coverage metrics, AOP hiring progress, and book-of-business balance on a recurring cadence.
Translate planning data into concise, actionable recommendations that support territory, hiring, and coverage decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with GTM Strategy, Finance, and Sales Leadership teams to ensure territory and capacity models reflect evolving business priorities.
Collaborate with BIS/Systems teams to maintain territory data accuracy across Salesforce and connected planning tools.
Work closely with GTM Operations and Compensation teams to evaluate downstream impacts of territory and account assignment changes.
Support governance processes by maintaining clear documentation of territory decisions, account movements, and approved exceptions.

Required Qualifications

3–5 years of experience in GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Territory Planning, or a closely related analytical role within a B2B SaaS environment.
Experience building, maintaining, or supporting territory models, capacity planning frameworks, and coverage analyses in a structured sales organization.
Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce, including knowledge of account management, territory structures, and CRM data governance processes.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex modeling, data analysis, and Power Query.
Strong analytical skills with experience working with large datasets, building structured business models, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT to improve productivity, efficiency, and business problem solving.
Strong attention to detail with a commitment to maintaining data accuracy and model integrity across multiple planning initiatives.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high standards of execution in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills with the ability to prepare structured analyses and planning recommendations for leadership review.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting territory planning, workforce planning, quota planning, or resource allocation initiatives within a high-growth SaaS organization.
Familiarity with Annual Operating Plan (AOP) processes, sales headcount planning, and productivity benchmarking methodologies.
Experience conducting coverage analysis, book-of-business balancing, customer segmentation, and territory optimization initiatives.
Knowledge of GTM organizational structures, sales motions, and territory management best practices.
Experience partnering with Finance, Sales Leadership, GTM Operations, Compensation, Reporting, Business Intelligence, or Systems teams to operationalize planning requirements.
Familiarity with Power BI, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and reporting platforms.
Demonstrated ability to identify operational inefficiencies and drive process improvements through data-driven insights.

You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.
Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.
Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.
Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.
Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.
Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.
Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.
Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.
Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.
Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.
Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.
Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).
Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.
Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.

Work remotely
