jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Latin America, Remote
jobs.description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.

You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.
Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.
Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.
Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.
Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.
Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.
Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.
Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.
Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.
Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.
Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.
Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.
Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.
Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).
Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.
Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.
Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.
Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).
Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.
Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.
Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
Generous paid-time-off policy
Flexible working hours
Work remotely
Continuing education, training, conferences
Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
You're the brains behind our work.

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility—career growth is not a question of if, but when.

What is Services?

Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting-edge technology, and client-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world.

In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio.

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

The Services Analyst Program is a rotational program designed to help you build a broad skill set and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to multiple areas within the Services business. The program involves an intensive training and orientation to give you a strong foundation in both the business and Citi's culture. You will rotate across two different roles within Services based on your interests and the needs of the business, gaining meaningful experience through hands-on projects and exposure to senior leaders.

Your time here will look something like this:

Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors.
Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth, identifying opportunities where data-driven insights and AI capabilities can add value. This may involve contributing to business cases for new AI-driven product features or improvements to existing services.
Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk, potentially exploring how AI/ML tools can automate tasks or improve decision-making. Evaluate the effectiveness of AI-powered automation in improving operational workflows and reducing manual effort.
Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings, leveraging various analytical techniques, including interpreting insights derived from advanced analytical models. You will be exposed to how AI models are used to segment clients, predict behaviors, and personalize service delivery.
Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership, effectively communicating complex data analysis and potentially insights from AI-driven tools. Clearly articulate the implications and benefits of AI-generated insights for business strategies.
Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development.

We want to hear from you if…

You are graduating with a bachelor's degree by March 2027, or you are a recent graduate within the last two years.
You are fluent in English and Spanish.
You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Exposure to analytical platforms or an eagerness to learn about AI-specific tools (e.g., natural language processing applications, machine learning dashboards) will be beneficial.
You have an interest in financial services and a drive to learn how technology, including AI, is transforming the industry. Demonstrated curiosity about how AI is being leveraged for efficiency, client experience, and risk management is key.

Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit…

We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to start their careers at a global organization, tend to think strategically, have an innovative approach to business, and value diversity as much as we do. We know that anyone—not just those with business degrees—can have a knack for business, so we’re open to all disciplines. We’ll also be looking for:

Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
Excellent communication skills.
A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail, including a proactive interest in understanding AI methodologies and their application in real-world business scenarios.
Solid organizational skills and ability to work autonomously – self-starter.
A high level of personal integrity, commitment to excellence, and a strong desire to learn.
Resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
A sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently.

Your future at Citi

During the program, you will have access to mentorship, career development sessions, and networking opportunities with senior leaders and professionals across Citi. This experience is designed to provide you with a strong foundation to launch a long-term career within the firm, preparing you for a future where technology and AI play an increasingly central role. You will develop skills that are not only relevant today but are also essential for navigating the evolving landscape of AI-driven financial services.

Join us and take the first step toward shaping the future of Citi!

El Coordinador de Planeación Financiera

jobs.title: AI Content Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About WON

WON redesigns how a business works: what its customers experience on the outside, and how its operation runs on the inside. We do that for retail and consumer brands, travel, hospitality, financial services, and private equity portfolios. We are not a consultancy that separates the thinking from the doing, and we are not a platform company with something to sell you. Those two halves are our two disciplines: Experience Intelligence and Operational Intelligence.

This is not a social media job. We are not hiring someone to post content. We are hiring the person who will design, operate, and continuously improve the AI-powered media engine behind WON, turning every founder conversation, workshop, keynote, podcast, interview, and strategy session into a continuous stream of exceptional content across every major platform. The role sits inside Operational Intelligence and points that discipline at our own operation.

AI gives exceptional people extraordinary leverage. It increases capacity, it does not replace judgment. That is the bet this role is built on: the systems absorb the repetition, and your taste decides what is actually worth publishing.

This role reports to the CEO and works directly with the technical team on the internal tooling behind the pipeline.

What You’ll Own

The complete content production lifecycle: capture, intake, AI-assisted production, review, publishing, and the searchable library where everything lands
Editorial judgment: which moments are worth cutting, which assets ship, and where the quality bar sits
Coordination of editors and creative resources, including review of every asset before it publishes
The measurement layer: production velocity, turnaround time, quality, and what the content actually does for audience and pipeline
Work with the technical team to design the internal tooling behind the pipeline: ingestion from Zoom, Google Meet, Riverside, Loom, etc, scoring of high-value moments, generation of titles, hooks, captions and platform-specific variations, routing through editing and approval, and scheduling across platforms
Build the quality checks that run before publication, so moving fast never means shipping something that doesn’t align with the company's point of view or quality standards.
Keep a prioritized list of what to automate next, with the manual cost of each item quantified, and bring it to the technical team as specific proposals rather than general frustration

How Success Is Measured

By day 30, every meaningful conversation enters a structured production pipeline
By day 60, production is predictable, measurable, and repeatable: volume and turnaround time are known numbers rather than estimates
By day 90, WON consistently publishes more than 500 high-quality pieces of content a month
By month 12, a large share of the work you did by hand in your first month runs through AI-assisted workflows you helped design
Over time the capability compounds rather than resets: faster, more autonomous, and cheaper to run each quarter, and durable enough to outlast any one person operating it

What You’ll Bring

Experience running a content or media operation end to end, in-house or agency, where you owned the pipeline and not a single stage of it
Systems thinking evidenced by what you have built: a process you designed, documented, and then measurably improved
Real fluency with AI tools in daily work rather than curiosity about them. You can describe a workflow you rebuilt around AI and what it saved
Editorial judgment you can defend: you can articulate why a moment, a hook, or a cut is good, not just that it feels good
Comfort operating with high ambiguity and little supervision, creating structure where none exists
Fluent written and spoken English, with the precision to work closely with both creative and technical colleagues

Bonus points:
hands on with OpusClip, Descript, Vizard, Submagic, CapCut or Canva; have used ClickUp, Slack and Google Workspace as an operating environment, not just a place to keep notes; publishing and scheduling at volume through Buffer, Metricool or similar; have specified or shipped an internal automation alongside an engineering team.

How We Work

We use AI to remove operational friction, not to create more of it. A system that costs more than it saves gets killed, not defended
Experience with every tool is not required. The ability to master a new one quickly is
We care far more about how you think than what your resume says. Finalists may be asked to complete a paid project using real WON recordings
Compensation is $4,000 to $5,500 USD per month plus performance incentives tied to production volume, quality, automation milestones, and audience growth
This is a founding role. The production capability you build becomes one of the firm’s durable operating assets, and you will have built it
If six months from now you are still doing the manual work you did in your first week, we will both know it went wrong. The role is designed to automate itself forward

Most companies use AI to work a little faster. If you are excited by the idea of building the capability that produces the work, rather than simply producing the work, we would love to meet you.

jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior BI Analyst
who will:

Manage the partner data update process, from file reception and validation through quality assurance, pipeline execution, and final dashboard verification, ensuring accurate and complete data for campaign reporting and decision-making.
Receive, review, and consolidate Partner Data files provided through Excel, Google Sheets, email, or Google Drive.
Validate key data fields, including placement codes and placement names, against master and reference tables.
Consolidate validated information into the historical first-party data repository, ensuring that previous records remain accurate and unchanged.
Execute established Alteryx QA workflows, investigate identified flags, and resolve data inconsistencies before files continue through the reporting pipeline.
Prepare approved files and upload them to the appropriate server using FileZilla or FTP tools.
Execute and monitor Azure Data Factory pipelines that load validated information into SQL tables for reporting consumption.
Create and adapt SQL queries to validate partner information, retrieve reference data, and reduce errors before completing the full QA process.
Review Tableau dashboards to confirm that newly loaded information is displaying accurately and report any inconsistencies for resolution.
Use Adverity to retrieve missing campaign data and configure new campaign data connections when necessary.
Conduct recurring data quality checks by comparing information from Facebook Ads and Reddit Ads against internal tables.
Adjust QA frequency according to client needs, including weekly, quarterly, semiannual, or annual validation cycles.
Monitor existing Alteryx workflows and update internal calculation formulas when required.
Collaborate with partner teams and internal stakeholders to investigate file discrepancies and resolve reporting issues.

Skills And Experience

Professional experience in Business Intelligence, data operations, marketing analytics, data quality assurance, or reporting.
Strong proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets, including experience reviewing and consolidating large datasets.
Hands-on experience executing and troubleshooting Alteryx workflows.
Experience using SQL to query, validate, and reconcile data across historical and reference tables.
Experience executing or monitoring data pipelines in Azure Data Factory.
Experience reviewing and validating reporting dashboards in Tableau.
Familiarity with Adverity or comparable marketing data integration platforms.
Experience working with FileZilla, FTP tools, or similar file-transfer solutions.
Familiarity with campaign data from digital advertising platforms, particularly Facebook Ads and Reddit Ads.
Strong understanding of data validation, reconciliation, and quality-assurance processes.
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage recurring reporting and QA deadlines.
Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with partners, client teams, and internal stakeholders.
Professional English proficiency for collaborating with international stakeholders is highly valued.

Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

El Oficial de Monitoreo, Evaluación, rendición de cuentas y Aprendizaje (MEAL), coordinará una amplia gama de actividades de recolección de datos a nivel de campo (por ejm. encuestas, grupos focales, etc.), dirigidas a evaluar la experiencia de los beneficiarios y el progreso/ desempeño de las intervenciones de cada programa. El objetivo principal de este puesto es diseñar herramientas, recopilar y analizar la información para garantizar la calidad, comprender el impacto y mejorar la entrega de los programas, de acuerdo con las herramientas y procesos de seguimiento establecidos. Las responsabilidades claves incluyen: trabajar con el equipo de programas y los socios locales, diseñar estrategias de acompañamiento y seguimiento a los equipos de IRC y socios para la recolección y análisis de información clave, analizar la información recogida como insumo a la ejecución y realizar informes, y apoyar en las labores de comunicación e incidencia de la organización.

Responsabilidades Principales

Participar en el desarrollo de la estrategia de monitoreo y seguimiento de los proyectos para medir la evolución de indicadores claves del programa, asegurar la calidad, indagar por la experiencia de los beneficiarios, evaluar el impacto del programa y facilitar el aprendizaje organizacional.

Diseñar e implementar herramientas para el procesamiento de datos levantados.

Asistir a reuniones de equipo y coordinación para facilitar la colaboración entre los sectores de IRC para garantizar una estrategia integral de monitoreo, evaluación y aprendizaje en todos los programas de IRC.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Experian es una empresa global de datos y tecnología que impulsa oportunidades para personas y negocios en todo el mundo. Ayudamos a redefinir prácticas de préstamos, descubrir y prevenir el fraude, simplificar la atención médica, crear soluciones de marketing y obtener perspectivas más profundas del mercado automotriz, todo utilizando nuestra combinación única de datos, análisis y software. También asistimos a millones de personas a alcanzar sus metas financieras y ayudarles a ahorrar tiempo y dinero.

Operamos en una variedad de mercados, desde servicios financieros hasta atención médica, automotriz, agroindustria, seguros y muchos otros segmentos industriales.

Invertimos en personas y nuevas tecnologías avanzadas para desbloquear el poder de los datos. Como empresa del índice FTSE 100, cotizada en la Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN), contamos con un equipo de 22,500 personas en 32 países. Nuestra sede corporativa está en Dublín, Irlanda. Obtenga más información en experianplc.com.

Job Description

El área de consultoría de negocio es la encargada de guiar al cliente hacia la mejora continua de sus procesos en cada una de las etapas del ciclo de crédito (planeación, originación, mantenimiento, cobranza, producto y datos). Apoyado en las soluciones brindadas por Experian, se desarrollan estrategias, diagnósticos y análisis que permitan a nuestros clientes maximizar sus utilidades.

El consultor de negocio es un experto en las diferentes etapas del ciclo de crédito, transformación digital y gobierno de datos. Su visión y experiencia de negocio le permite generar insights que enriquecen los procesos de los clientes y proponer soluciones que transformen y mejoren sus procesos.

El Rol Del Consultor

Identificar las oportunidades de alto valor en los clientes a nivel de optimización y mejora de sus indicadores de: colocación, riesgo, cartera vencida, deserción. Asimismo, proponer modelos analíticos, políticas y estudios que permitan optimizar la operación del cliente
Tener la visión global del mercado y poder identificar desviaciones específicas que el cliente pueda corregir en sus indicadores y oportunidades que se puedan capturar de acuerdo con los cambios en las tendencias

Responsabilidades del cargo

Apoyar el proceso de venta de consultoría con base en su experiencia y visión de negocio para ayudar al cliente a entender el valor que Experian proporciona a través de sus solucione
Prestar servicios de consultoría a nuestros clientes de forma que pueda darse solución de necesidades específicas en diferentes áreas de la compañía
Compartir experiencia y conocimiento a través de las mejores prácticas existentes locales y globales para acompañar a los clientes en sus objetivos de negocio
Desarrollar soluciones a la medida de las necesidades del cliente con base en prácticas de mercado y soluciones con las que cuenta la compañía
Gestiona el desarrollo e implementación de consultorías para clientes, incluyendo diseño técnico, arquitectura, análisis e integración de soluciones.
Desarrollar la propuesta de valor a los clientes incluyendo claramente los retos estratégicos del cliente, como los productos/soluciones que podrían aportar al desarrollo de la estrategia y como estos impactarían a los resultados
Desarrollar consultorías de transformación digital buscando integrar las soluciones de Experian en el Customer Journey de nuestros clientes

Qualifications

Educación:
Ingeniero industrial, Economista Matemático, estadístico, administrador de empresas/negocios o áreas afines.

Posgrado en Administración, Finanzas, Inteligencia de Negocios, Product Management o Analytics, Gobierno de datos (Ideal)

Experiencia:
Más de 5 años de experiencia, por lo menos un año en cargos relacionados en empresas del sector financiero, telecomunicaciones, o seguros en cargos relacionados con riesgo de crédito, manejo de productos, inteligencia de negocio o consultoría

Conocimientos técnicos requeridos:
Experiencia en consultoría en sector financiero y captación de clientes. Conocimientos técnicos y de negocio en desarrollo de modelos y riesgo de crédito, deseable gobierno de datos

Competencias:
CRM (Salesforce) (Nice to have) Excel intermedio avanzado Oracle Power Point Python, SQL o R (Nice to have)

Additional Information

Nuestra singularidad es que celebramos eso que nos hace diferentes. La cultura y el personal de Experian son elementos diferenciadores clave. Nos tomamos muy en serio nuestra agenda de personas y nos centramos en lo que realmente importa: DEI, conciliación de la vida laboral y personal, desarrollo, autenticidad, compromiso, colaboración, bienestar, recompensa y reconocimiento, voluntariado... y la lista continúa. El sólido enfoque de Experian, en el que las personas son lo primero, ha sido premiado: Great Place To Work™ en 24 países, FORTUNE Best Companies to work y Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globalmente 4,4 estrellas), por nombrar algunos. Eche un vistazo a Experian Life en las redes sociales o a nuestro sitio de empleo para entender por qué.

Experian se enorgullece de ser una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y acción positiva. La innovación es una parte fundamental del ADN y las prácticas de Experian, y la diversidad de nuestra fuerza laboral impulsa nuestro éxito. Todo el mundo puede tener éxito en Experian y aportar todo de sí independientemente de su género, etnia, religión, color, sexualidad, capacidad física o edad. Si tiene alguna discapacidad o necesidad especial que requiera adaptaciones, por favor háganoslo saber lo antes posible.

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Description

Sales Coordinator

What if your next role changed lives, including your own?

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that learning a language abroad is one of the most transformative experiences a person can have. And we need passionate, driven people to help make that happen. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Sales Coordinator
to join our team in Medellin, Colombia
. This is your chance to grow your career in a global company, work alongside an energetic and ambitious team, and help young people take the leap toward a life-changing experience abroad.

You'll be at the heart of our sales operation: managing your own pipeline, building real relationships with prospective students, and guiding them through one of the most exciting decisions of their lives. No scripts, no cold calling - just meaningful conversations, real impact, and a team that's genuinely rooting for you from day one

Student Recruitment

Your main responsibilities are:

Own your sales pipeline from end to end - from the first contact to the signed enrollment.
Conduct consultations and virtual office meetings, guiding prospective students through their options with confidence and empathy.
Host and participate in Information Meetings to present our programs to potential students.
Make welcome home calls to nurture relationships after initial contact.
Develop customized nurturing strategies via email and social media to keep prospects engaged throughout the funnel.

Beyond Sales - A Little Bit of Everything

As part of a dynamic team, you'll occasionally get involved in representing EF at fairs and events, supporting marketing campaigns and content creation, building ambassadors and referral networks, helping localize global materials for the local market, and supporting operational tasks such as airport duty, rebooking, payment follow-ups, document collection, and visa processes.

Requirements

Education: Currently enrolled in or recently graduated with a bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Tourism, or related fields.
Work Experience: Any professional experience, internship, or summer job is valued. Up to 1 Year of full-time experience is ideal.
Language Level: Upper-intermediate English proficiency. Additional languages are a plus.
International Experience: Having lived, studied, or worked abroad is a nice-to-have.
Sales Drive: Strong motivation to hit targets and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
People Skills: Passion for building genuine relationships and delivering outstanding service.
Adaptability: Comfortable in dynamic environments, under pressure, and occasionally on weekends.
Team Player: Collaborative, open-minded, and culturally aware.
Tech-Savvy: Familiar with CRM tools to manage leads, follow-ups, and KPIs.

Why you will love working with us

More than just a job, we offer a career
- and the benefits grow with you.

From Day One, All EF Team Members Enjoy

Benefits by law
Corporate benefits discounts
Staff referral bonus (500 USD)
EF Hello App
Access to the Mental Health App "Foundation"

As a Sales Executive, You Also Unlock

Global Mobile Office
National KO recognition
EF Summer Helper Nomination: 1 week as a group helper abroad
Famtrip Nomination: travel to the USA

As you grow through our career ladder, even more doors open. Depending on your level, you may also unlock:

Intercontinental Famtrip nominations
Free language courses and international training nominations
Hub Office visits with training and networking opportunities
Leadership development programs and international kickoffs

Benefits vary by career level and are subject to local labor laws and business eligibility criteria.

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that the world is better when people try to understand one another. Since 1965, we've helped millions of students discover new places, embrace diverse cultures, and gain fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to our mission of opening the world through education, harnessing the power of language learning to deepen the connection between people across the globe.

We offer immersive short-term and long-term language courses and programs across different languages in the countries where they’re spoken. Through blending classroom-based lessons with interactive exercises and real-world practice, our courses bring you to the heart of the language. Together, our global staff help students from around the world develop the language skills they need to achieve their dreams.

EF is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults. All positions are subject to a criminal background and/or reference checks, as applicable.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. who will:

Serve as a core partner to local Business Intelligence teams, leading reporting deliverables and ensuring the quality and continuity of analytical workstreams.
Own the development, maintenance, and enhancement of dashboards and data visualizations, ensuring their accuracy, functionality, and timely delivery.

Research platform capabilities and industry trends, identifying opportunities to improve data quality, operational efficiency, and the feasibility of new reporting requests.
Facilitate data and reporting architecture discussions to ensure reporting products are optimally deployed, reliable, and accessible.
When required, design, build, and deploy ETL and data management processes with appropriate error handling, exception management, and rollback procedures.

Skills And Experience

5+ years of professional experience in Analytics or Business Intelligence, working with large and complex datasets, or equivalent relevant experience.

Experience working with digital media data, including Google Campaign Manager/CM360, major digital and social platforms, and web analytics tools such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, charts, and complex data manipulation.
Experience with SQL, Python, or R is a plus; knowledge of tag management or application coding is also desirable.
Understanding of common media metrics and buying models, including CPV, VCR, and GRP, and how they connect to business outcomes.
Ability to independently manage day-to-day workstreams within large analytical projects with limited guidance.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly when collaborating across offshore and onshore teams.
Availability for a minimum three-hour morning overlap with New York, working within EST or CST time zones; up to six hours of overlap is preferred.

for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

The Opportunity

We are recruiting for an established Canadian residential real estate services company that manages relationships between property owners, residents, internal teams, and external service partners.

We are looking for a Customer Service Manager to directly manage a team of client-facing employees. You will be accountable for their workload, responsiveness, service quality, documentation, performance, and client-retention results.

This is a formal people-management position with direct reports—not a senior customer-service or individual-contributor role. Direct property-management experience is preferred but not mandatory. Strong managers from other recurring-service industries will be considered.

Key Responsibilities

Directly manage, coach, and evaluate client-facing employees.
Assign workloads and ensure employees understand their priorities and deadlines.
Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, coaching, and performance reviews.
Investigate missed commitments, repeated complaints, poor-quality work, and incomplete documentation.
Create performance-improvement plans and recommend reassignment or replacement when improvement does not occur.
Ensure customer onboarding, scheduled check-ins, and follow-ups are completed.
Identify dissatisfied or at-risk clients and lead service-recovery efforts.
Monitor contract renewals and client-retention activities.
Oversee escalated concerns, overdue payments, and compliance-sensitive matters.
Coordinate service requests across internal departments and external partners.
Hold employees and service partners accountable for their commitments.
Ensure employees follow company systems, documentation standards, and escalation procedures.
Evaluate whether performance problems are caused by workload, process, training, or individual performance.
Produce reports identifying client risks, overdue work, team performance, and required action.
Improve workflows, service standards, reporting, and departmental accountability.

Required Experience

Four or more years in customer experience, customer success, service delivery, account management, operations, property management, or another recurring-service environment.
At least two years of formal people-management experience with direct reports in a client-facing or operational department. Informal team leadership alone is not sufficient.
Experience coaching employees, evaluating performance, and addressing underperformance.
Experience handling escalations, service failures, renewals, and client-retention risks.
Experience assigning work, monitoring deadlines, and holding employees accountable.
Experience coordinating across departments, vendors, or external partners.
Experience using KPIs, dashboards, CRM, ticketing, or workflow-management systems.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong organization, judgment, prioritization, and follow-through.
Ability to be assertive and direct while remaining calm and professional.
Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, and a professional environment for calls.

Candidates may come from customer success, managed services, BPO, SaaS, telecommunications, insurance, financial services, property management, hospitality, facilities, field services, healthcare, logistics, or another high-volume service industry.

Property-management or North American client experience is an asset. Industry-specific training will be provided.

What Success Looks Like

Performance Will Be Measured Through

Team productivity and service quality
Employee responsiveness and accountability
Client retention and contract renewals
Customer onboarding and follow-up completion
Service resolution and escalation management
Documentation quality and system compliance
Reduction of overdue and unresolved work
Accuracy and usefulness of management reporting

Who Will Succeed

The right person is comfortable managing people, not simply completing their work for them.

You must be able to challenge unclear explanations, address missed commitments, set measurable expectations, conduct difficult performance conversations, and apply consequences when improvement does not occur.

You should also know when to support an employee, when additional training is needed, and when continued underperformance requires reassignment or replacement.

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst (Operations)
jobs.description:
About Addi

We are a leading financial platform, building the future of payments, shopping, and banking—a world where consumers and merchants can transact effortlessly and grow together. Today, we serve over 3.6 million customers and partner with more than 55,000 merchants, making Addi Colombia’s fastest-growing marketplace.

With a state-of-the-art, technology-first approach, we provide banking solutions (deposits, payments, unsecured credit) and commerce services (e-commerce, marketing), bridging the financial gap for millions and redefining how people experience financial freedom. As the country’s leading Buy Now, Pay Later provider, we have secured regulatory approval to operate as a bank, unlocking even greater opportunities for our customers. In the past year, we have also achieved profitability, reinforcing the strength of our business model and our ability to scale sustainably.

Our mission has earned the trust of world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Architect Capital, GIC, Goldman Sachs, Greycroft, Monashees, Notable Capital, Quona Capital, Union Square Ventures, Victory Park Capital, and more, who back our vision for the future. With their support, we are not just growing—we are transforming Latin America’s financial ecosystem and shaping the next generation to shop, pay, and bank in Colombia.

But what truly sets us apart is how we build. We are a conscious company, driven by deep experience in scaling technology, services and products, and we live by our values
every day.

About The Role

This is where you come in. Below, you’ll find what this role is all about—the impact you’ll drive, the challenges you’ll tackle, and what it takes to thrive at Addi. If you’re ready to be part of something big, keep reading.

What’s The Mission You’ll Drive

Lead Addi’s Capital Markets Analytics & Reporting function by taking end-to-end ownership of covenant monitoring, debt and cash forecasting, and pre-launch funding viability assessments for new products and credit facilities. Elevate operational precision by scaling a high-performing two-person analyst team and embedding AI-driven automation into reporting workflows, acting as an independent, risk-mitigating counterpart to CMO Servicing as Addi expands its funding infrastructure.

What You Will Do

Achieve 100% timely, accurate sign-offs on servicing reports and covenant compliance across all active debt facilities (GS, VPC, BBVA, Citi, JPM, GS FF) by establishing independent automated verification protocols, resulting in zero unflagged breaches or lender audit observations within the first 6 months.
Reduce cash/liquidity forecast variance to within ±3% by redesigning and continuously refining CMO’s rolling cash flow and dynamic borrowing base models, resulting in optimized capital allocation and enhanced liquidity visibility over the next 12 months.
Ensure 100% capital efficiency and covenant readiness for product launches by establishing structured pre-launch funding viability assessments in partnership with New Money and Product teams, delivering impact assessments for all new products within the agreed-upon SLA.
Build a high-performing analytics team within 6 months by hiring, onboarding, and mentoring 2 Senior Business Analysts, resulting in clear career pathways and 80% operational autonomy across daily reporting workflows.
Streamline onboarding and operational readiness for new credit facilities by driving analytical alignment across Finance, Risk, Legal, and Lenders, ensuring 100% compliance readiness prior to facility activation.

What We’re Looking For

Proven track record of driving capital markets and structured finance analytics (MUST HAVE)

Demonstrates deep expertise in borrowing base mechanics, debt facility structuring, and complex covenant frameworks across warehouse and structured debt facilities in asset-heavy fintech or banking environments.
Analyzes complex, loan-level financial data to identify trends, mitigate covenant exposure, and drive strategic capital allocation decisions.
Navigates accounting practices and regulatory constraints in high-growth credit ecosystems with speed and high precision.

Demonstrates ability to execute advanced SQL and large-scale data analysis (MUST HAVE)

Writes and audits complex SQL queries against massive, loan-level datasets (Snowflake/Databricks) to validate data pipelines and guarantee absolute data integrity.
Combines hands-on querying expertise with advanced Excel/Sheets financial modeling to audit data pipelines without requiring full data science overhead.
Translates raw multi-table database extracts into clean, executive-ready financial models and analytical reports.

Possesses strong capabilities in AI-driven automation and risk oversight (MUST HAVE)

Identifies and executes high-impact opportunities where AI/LLM-based automation replaces manual overhead across covenant monitoring and forecasting workflows.
Directs senior analysts in building and deploying automated monitoring/reporting agents while enforcing strict human-in-the-loop review protocols.
Applies a zero-failure risk mindset to evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs before they reach external institutional lenders or senior leadership.

Track Record Of Leading And Developing Analytical Talent (PREFERRED)

Recruits, mentors, and retains top-tier business analysts (2+ direct reports), establishing clear operational ownership, quality standards, and career pathways.
Fosters a culture of extreme ownership, continuous technical learning, and operational autonomy across daily reporting workflows.

Experienced in high-stakes stakeholder management and executive communication (MUST HAVE)

Communicates complex financial concepts, risks, and facility performance clearly to executive leadership and international institutional lenders.
Demonstrates full professional English proficiency to lead technical, legal, and operational conversations across global credit markets.

Has solid expertise in maintaining a zero-failure risk mindset and detail-oriented ownership (MUST HAVE)

Treats every lender report, covenant check, and data feed with extreme rigor, recognizing that reporting errors carry real structural and legal exposure.
Maintains an independent control perspective over execution teams, ensuring uncompromising accuracy across all recurring compliance processes.

Why join us?

Work on a problem that truly matters – We are redefining how people shop, pay, and bank in Colombia, breaking down financial barriers and empowering millions. Your work will directly impact customers' lives by creating more accessible, seamless, and fair financial services.
Be part of something big from the ground up – This is your chance to help shape a company, influencing everything from our technology and strategy to our culture and values. You won’t just be an employee—you’ll be an owner
Unparalleled growth opportunity – The market we’re tackling is massive, and we’re growing faster than almost any fintech lender at our stage. If you’re looking for a high-impact role in a company that’s scaling fast, this is it.
Join a world-class team – Work alongside top-tier talent from around the world, in an environment where excellence, ownership, and collaboration are at the core of everything we do. We care deeply about what we build and how we build it—and we want you to be a part of it.
Competitive compensation & meaningful ownership – We believe in rewarding our talent. You’ll receive a generous salary, equity in the company, and benefits that go beyond the basics to support your growth.

How The Hiring Process Looks Like

We believe in a fast, transparent, and engaging hiring experience that allows both you and us to determine if there's a great fit. Here’s what our process looks like:

Step 1: People Interview (30 min) A conversation with a recruiter to get to know you, your experience, and what you're looking for. We’ll also share more about Addi, our culture, and the role.
Step 2: Initial Interview (45 min) A more in-depth conversation with our Capital market manager, where we explore your skills, experience, and problem-solving approach. We want to understand how you think and work.
Step 3: Live business case (60 min)
A hands-on session designed to assess your analytical thinking and how you work with AI in your day-to-day. We'll explore your SQL skills through a live exercise.
Step 4: Deep dive interview (45min)

You'll meet future colleagues and cross-functional team members to get a feel for how we work together. We’re looking for strong contributors and cultural fits, so bring your questions, too!

Step 6: Co-Founder Interview (30 min) If there’s a strong match, you’ll have a final conversation with our Founder to align on expectations, cultural fit and ensure mutual excitement. From there, we’ll move quickly to an offer and discuss next steps.

We value efficiency and respect for your time, so we aim to complete the process as quickly as possible. Our goal is to make this experience insightful and exciting for you, just as much as it is for us. Regardless of the outcome, we are committed to always providing feedback
, ensuring that you walk away with valuable insights from your experience with us.

jobs.title: Territory Manager - Cali
jobs.description:
Acerca de PayJoy

PayJoy, una Corporación de Beneficio Público, es una empresa de crédito con una misión clara: ayudar a clientes desatendidos en mercados emergentes a alcanzar la estabilidad y el éxito financiero. Nuestra tecnología patentada de crédito garantizado ofrece una vía de acceso para que nuevos clientes ingresen al sistema crediticio. A través del financiamiento en punto de venta y y las ofertas de tarjetas de PayJoy, los clientes obtienen acceso a una vida moderna y de calidad. El crédito de PayJoy también les permite aprovechar oportunidades como microempresarios y actuar como una forma de seguro. Al aprovechar tecnologías avanzadas como el aprendizaje automático, la ciencia de datos y la inteligencia artificial para la prevención del fraude, hemos prestado servicio a más de 18 millones de clientes hasta 2025, logrando una sólida rentabilidad que impulsa un crecimiento sostenible.

Acerca del rol

En PayJoy buscamos un Territory Manager
con fuerte orientación comercial, capacidad de liderazgo, pensamiento analítico y alto sentido de ownership, responsable de desarrollar y acelerar el crecimiento del negocio dentro de su territorio asignado.

Esta posición tendrá la responsabilidad integral por el desempeño de su territorio, diseñando y ejecutando la estrategia comercial para lograr un crecimiento sostenible, incremental y predecible
, asegurando al mismo tiempo la productividad de la red de tiendas y la calidad del negocio generado.

El Territory Manager liderará al equipo de Representantes de Ventas de su región, desarrollará relaciones estratégicas con socios comerciales, distribuidores y cuentas clave, identificará nuevas oportunidades de negocio y garantizará una ejecución comercial de excelencia en el punto de venta.

Asimismo, tendrá un rol clave como articulador entre el mercado y las diferentes áreas de PayJoy
, trabajando de manera transversal con equipos como Operaciones, Customer Experience (CX), Marketing, Riesgo y otras áreas de soporte
, con el objetivo de identificar oportunidades, resolver fricciones y construir soluciones que mejoren la experiencia de nuestros partners y aceleren el crecimiento del negocio.

Responsabilidades

1. Estrategia y crecimiento del territorio

Definir y ejecutar la estrategia comercial del territorio, alineada con los objetivos de PayJoy Colombia.

Establecer metas y planes de acción que permitan generar crecimiento sostenible, incremental y predecible.

Gestionar el territorio con una visión integral del negocio, equilibrando crecimiento, productividad, penetración, calidad y riesgo
.

Identificar nuevas oportunidades de mercado, zonas geográficas, aliados, cadenas y puntos de venta con potencial para PayJoy.

Diseñar estrategias diferenciadas de acuerdo con el potencial, desempeño y necesidades de los diferentes partners y segmentos.

Desarrollar planes para incrementar la participación de PayJoy dentro de los clientes existentes.

2. Gestión de performance y KPIs

Gestionar el desempeño del territorio a través de indicadores comerciales y operativos.

Realizar seguimiento permanente a métricas como originaciones, active stores, productividad por tienda, same-store growth, nuevos partners y calidad/riesgo de las originaciones
, entre otros KPIs relevantes para el negocio.

Identificar rápidamente desviaciones frente a los objetivos y desarrollar planes de acción concretos para corregirlas.

Utilizar información y datos para priorizar tiendas, clientes, zonas y oportunidades con mayor potencial.

Traducir los indicadores del territorio en acciones comerciales específicas para el equipo.

Asegurar que el crecimiento en ventas esté acompañado por una adecuada calidad de las originaciones y sostenibilidad del negocio.

3. Liderazgo y desarrollo del equipo comercial

Liderar, desarrollar, motivar y gestionar al equipo de Representantes de Ventas asignado al territorio.

Establecer objetivos claros, prioridades y expectativas de desempeño individuales y colectivas.

Realizar acompañamiento permanente en campo, proporcionando coaching y feedback para mejorar las capacidades comerciales del equipo.

Desarrollar una cultura de ownership, accountability, disciplina comercial y orientación a resultados
.

Garantizar una adecuada planificación y utilización del tiempo del equipo, priorizando clientes y tiendas de acuerdo con su potencial.

Identificar oportunidades de desarrollo del talento y construir planes de mejora cuando sean necesarios.

4. Desarrollo de partners y cuentas estratégicas

Construir y fortalecer relaciones de largo plazo con socios regionales, distribuidores, administradores y cuentas clave.

Comprender profundamente el negocio de cada partner e identificar oportunidades que permitan desarrollar conjuntamente su potencial.

Incrementar la penetración de PayJoy dentro de los clientes existentes mediante planes comerciales específicos.

Prospectar, desarrollar y cerrar nuevos partners estratégicos para ampliar la cobertura y presencia de PayJoy.

Liderar negociaciones comerciales relevantes dentro de su territorio.

Convertirse en un trusted business partner
para los principales clientes de la región.

5. Excelencia en ejecución en punto de venta

Garantizar una ejecución consistente y de alta calidad de la estrategia comercial en los puntos de venta.

Desarrollar relaciones sólidas con administradores, vendedores y demás personal de las tiendas.

Asegurar la correcta capacitación, inducción y actualización del personal sobre los productos, procesos y herramientas de PayJoy.

Identificar barreras que estén afectando las ventas o la experiencia en tienda y liderar acciones para solucionarlas.

Coordinar y hacer seguimiento a campañas, activaciones e iniciativas comerciales orientadas a incrementar ventas y productividad.

Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares comerciales y operativos definidos por PayJoy.

6. Colaboración transversal y gestión con áreas internas

El Territory Manager será el principal representante de las necesidades y oportunidades de su territorio al interior de PayJoy y deberá trabajar de manera cercana y colaborativa con las diferentes áreas de la compañía.

Entre sus responsabilidades estará:

Trabajar con Operaciones
para identificar y resolver fricciones en procesos, herramientas y ejecución que puedan afectar el desempeño de partners, tiendas o equipos comerciales.

Colaborar con Customer Experience (CX)
para identificar oportunidades de mejora en la experiencia de partners, vendedores y clientes, dando visibilidad a problemas recurrentes y acompañando la implementación de soluciones.

Coordinar con Marketing
las necesidades comerciales del territorio, priorizando campañas, materiales, activaciones e iniciativas que permitan acelerar las ventas.

Trabajar conjuntamente con Riesgo
para comprender el comportamiento y calidad de las originaciones del territorio y desarrollar acciones que permitan crecer de manera saludable y sostenible.

Proporcionar a las diferentes áreas internas insights provenientes del mercado
, incluyendo feedback de partners, vendedores y clientes, movimientos de la competencia y oportunidades identificadas en campo.

Escalar oportunamente problemas que requieran intervención de otras áreas, realizando seguimiento hasta su resolución.

Participar activamente en proyectos e iniciativas cross-functional que tengan impacto sobre el crecimiento, productividad o experiencia del canal.

El Territory Manager no será únicamente un receptor de soluciones de las áreas internas: se espera que tenga la capacidad de identificar problemas, estructurarlos con datos, proponer soluciones y movilizar a los stakeholders necesarios para llevarlas a ejecución
.

7. Conocimiento del mercado y competencia

Mantener un conocimiento profundo de las dinámicas comerciales de su territorio.

Identificar movimientos de competidores, nuevas ofertas de financiación, cambios en el mercado y tendencias relevantes del retail de telefonía móvil.

Recopilar sistemáticamente feedback de partners y puntos de venta.

Convertir información de mercado en recomendaciones y oportunidades accionables para PayJoy.

Compartir aprendizajes y mejores prácticas que puedan ser escalables a otros territorios.

Requisitos

Profesional universitario en Administración de Empresas, Mercadeo, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía, Finanzas o carreras afines.

Mínimo 5 años de experiencia relevante
en ventas, desarrollo de negocios, servicios financieros, financiación, fintech, tecnología, telecomunicaciones, telefonía móvil o sectores relacionados.

Experiencia comprobada liderando y desarrollando equipos comerciales.

Experiencia en manejo de territorios, distribuidores, canales de venta, retail o redes de puntos de venta.

Capacidad demostrada para abrir mercados, prospectar nuevos clientes y cerrar oportunidades comerciales de manera autónoma
.

Experiencia gestionando indicadores comerciales y tomando decisiones basadas en datos.

Capacidad para trabajar transversalmente con diferentes áreas de una organización.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación, influencia y construcción de relaciones.

Alta orientación a resultados, autonomía y capacidad para convertir estrategias en planes de acción concretos.

Disponibilidad para realizar trabajo frecuente en campo y desplazamientos dentro del territorio asignado.

Beneficios

Seguro de salud y vida para el empleado y familiares directos

Contrato a término indefinido 20 días de vacaciones

$2,000 USD beneficio anual para Co-working travel

$2,000 USD beneficio anual para desarrollo profesional

Financiamiento para teléfono, audífonos, equipo para oficina en casa y beneficios de bienestar. 

Principios de PayJoy

En PayJoy estamos orgullosos de ser un empleador que promueve la igualdad de oportunidades. Damos la bienvenida y alentamos la inclusión de personas de todos los orígenes. No discriminamos por raza, religión, color, origen nacional, género (incluido el embarazo, parto o condiciones médicas relacionadas), orientación sexual, identidad de género, expresión de género, edad, estatus como veterano protegido, condición de discapacidad o cualquier otra característica legalmente protegida.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Power a New World

The world is at the intersection of major paradigm shifts toward renewable energy, electrification, and new energy. ‘Power a New World’ is a call to the future amid these changes.

Consolidar la información de capacidades de producción y estado de inventarios a nivel nacional, para la construcción del balance de capacidades por servicio.
Realizar la medición y acompañamiento en el análisis para las desviaciones de los distintos focos de medición del proceso.

You will manage the entity's day-to-day operations, overseeing governance structures, internal controls, and operational processes, ensuring the entity is well-run and positioned for sustainable growth as the business scales. You will also own the local credit risk framework, ensuring lending activity is managed responsibly and in line with both regulatory expectations and ARQ's credit strategy and risk frameworks. You will work closely with global legal, risk, operations, product and compliance teams.

What you'll be doing

Act as the local signatory and board-level representative where required by the regulator or entity governance structure

What you'll need

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager
jobs.description:
About Addi

We are a leading financial platform, building the future of payments, shopping, and banking—a world where consumers and merchants can transact effortlessly and grow together. Today, we serve over 3.6 million customers and partner with more than 55,000 merchants, making Addi Colombia’s fastest-growing marketplace.

With a state-of-the-art, technology-first approach, we provide banking solutions (deposits, payments, unsecured credit) and commerce services (e-commerce, marketing), bridging the financial gap for millions and redefining how people experience financial freedom. As the country’s leading Buy Now, Pay Later provider, we have secured regulatory approval to operate as a bank, unlocking even greater opportunities for our customers. In the past year, we have also achieved profitability, reinforcing the strength of our business model and our ability to scale sustainably.

Our mission has earned the trust of world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Architect Capital, GIC, Goldman Sachs, Greycroft, Monashees, Notable Capital, Quona Capital, Union Square Ventures, Victory Park Capital, and more, who back our vision for the future. With their support, we are not just growing—we are transforming Latin America’s financial ecosystem and shaping the next generation to shop, pay, and bank in Colombia.

But what truly sets us apart is how we build. We are a conscious company, driven by deep experience in scaling technology, services and products, and we live by our values
every day.

About The Role

This is where you come in. Below, you’ll find what this role is all about—the impact you’ll drive, the challenges you’ll tackle, and what it takes to thrive at Addi. If you’re ready to be part of something big, keep reading.

What’s The Mission You’ll Drive

Own strategic financial business partnering for FP&A’s internal relationships — marketplace, sales (merchant pricing and negotiation), marketing (CAC and RoI), and new products — so every pricing, renegotiation, and launch decision has finance rigor behind it and decisioning is led, not followed, by Finance. Become the finance point of contact restoring coverage to Marketplace partnering, which today runs with minimal finance involvement.

What You Will Do

Restore active finance coverage to Marketplace business partnering for recurring reporting/decision-support cadence live within the first 90 days.
Own and formalize the merchant business-partnering workflow (pricing/renegotiations + new merchant deals), with a documented process and target turnaround SLA — replacing today's ad hoc handling by the team.
Take full ownership of new-products financial modeling/reporting, becoming the named finance lead on every product launch reviewed by Business/Product.
Take over marketing spend and RoI business partnering end-to-end within the first quarter.

What We’re Looking For

Excellent financial acumen and business-partnering toolkit
5+ years in strategic finance, FP&A, corporate strategy, or strategy consulting, with direct exposure to business partnering (not just reporting/analysis).
Experience across high-growth environments; exposure to both large companies and startups is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a finance/strategy partner: translating commercial decisions (pricing, renegotiations, launches) into P&L and unit-economics terms that drive action.

Deep command of unit economics and deal-level modeling

Strong financial modeling skills — able to build a merchant or product business case from scratch (unit economics, contribution margin, deal-level P&L).
Ability to translate commercial terms (pricing, discounts, merchant conditions) into financial impact quickly, without sacrificing rigor.
Experience in marketplace or e-commerce business partnering (two-sided network economics) is a plus.
Prior experience in fintech, lending, or banking is a plus — understanding credit/lending unit economics helps connect merchant and marketplace decisions back to Addi's core economics.

Impeccable analytical and quantitative mindset

Track record of high performance in analytically demanding environments (consulting, strategic finance, investment banking, fintech, or similarly rigorous contexts).
Comfortable operating with high autonomy and ambiguity — this role starts with live, informally-run workstreams and no dedicated support team.
High attention to detail paired with good judgment about what must be exact vs. what can be directionally correct early, given several of these workstreams have no formal process today.

Strong communication and cross-functional partnering

Communicates complex financial topics clearly and succinctly to non-finance stakeholders (commercial, marketing, product) and translates between finance rigor and commercial speed.
Builds trust and influence without formal authority — needed to restore finance's seat at the table with teams (e.g., Marketplace) used to operating without it.

Comfortable in a startup setting

Thrives in ambiguity and “organized chaos” without sacrificing rigor.
Takes on responsibility proactively, balancing speed with structured decision-making.
Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; SQL a strong plus. Fluent in Spanish and English.

Why join us?

Work on a problem that truly matters – We are redefining how people shop, pay, and bank in Colombia, breaking down financial barriers and empowering millions. Your work will directly impact customers' lives by creating more accessible, seamless, and fair financial services.
Be part of something big from the ground up – This is your chance to help shape a company, influencing everything from our technology and strategy to our culture and values. You won’t just be an employee—you’ll be an owner
Unparalleled growth opportunity – The market we’re tackling is massive, and we’re growing faster than almost any fintech lender at our stage. If you’re looking for a high-impact role in a company that’s scaling fast, this is it.
Join a world-class team – Work alongside top-tier talent from around the world, in an environment where excellence, ownership, and collaboration are at the core of everything we do. We care deeply about what we build and how we build it—and we want you to be a part of it.
Competitive compensation & meaningful ownership – We believe in rewarding our talent. You’ll receive a generous salary, equity in the company, and benefits that go beyond the basics to support your growth.

How The Hiring Process Looks Like

We believe in a fast, transparent, and engaging hiring experience that allows both you and us to determine if there's a great fit. Here’s what our process looks like:

Step 1: People Interview (30 min) A conversation with a recruiter to get to know you, your experience, and what you're looking for. We’ll also share more about Addi, our culture, and the role.
Step 2: Initial Interview (45-60 min) A more in-depth conversation with the hiring manager, where we explore your skills, experience, and problem-solving approach. We want to understand how you think and work.
Step 3: Deep Dive Interview (30 min) You'll meet future colleagues and cross-functional team members to get a feel for how we work together. We’re looking for strong contributors and cultural fits, so bring your questions, too!
Step 4: Case Study (3-5 Days) You may receive a real-world challenge or case study to complete. This is a chance to showcase your expertise and how you approach key problems relevant to the role.
Step 5: Co-Founder Interview If there’s a strong match, you’ll have a final conversation with our Founder to align on expectations, cultural fit and ensure mutual excitement. From there, we’ll move quickly to an offer and discuss next steps.

We value efficiency and respect for your time, so we aim to complete the process as quickly as possible. Our goal is to make this experience insightful and exciting for you, just as much as it is for us. Regardless of the outcome, we are committed to always providing feedback
, ensuring that you walk away with valuable insights from your experience with us.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Specialist, Revenue Optimization & Analytics

Overview

As an Specialist in the Revenue Optimization & Planning team, you will support the development of product strategies, pricing initiatives, revenue planning, and lifecycle management across Mastercard's products and services.

You will work in a truly global environment, partnering closely with Product, Finance, Regional teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to develop data-driven analyses and support the implementation of strategic initiatives. This role offers significant exposure across the organization and provides an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in payments, product strategy, pricing, and revenue economics.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven, innovative, and collaborative problem solver with a passion for delivering impactful insights that drive customer and revenue success.

In This Role, You Will

Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to support strategic decision-making and business planning.
Analyze market trends, customer needs, industry developments, and competitive dynamics to identify opportunities for growth.
Gather, structure, and analyze large datasets to generate actionable business insights using tools such as SQL, Python, R, or similar analytical platforms.
Perform financial impact assessments, scenario analyses, and revenue forecasting at the product, customer, market, and regional levels.
Assist in the design, evaluation, and optimization of pricing models for Mastercard products and services.
Prepare recommendations, presentations, and materials for leadership reviews and decision-making processes.
Participate in cross-functional projects involving Product, Finance, Account Management, Operations & Technology, Legal, and Regional teams.

All About You

Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering or a related field.
Experience with data analysis and financial modeling is preferred.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for using data to solve business challenges.
Curious and eager to learn about the payments industry, digital commerce, and product economics.
Comfortable translating complex analyses into clear business recommendations.
Able to effectively manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Self-motivated, collaborative, and results-oriented.
Ability to communicate in English is required.
