jobs.title: Senior Analyst, GTM Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

The Senior Analyst, GTM Territory Planning sits within the Territory Planning & Operations Management function and reports to the Sr. Manager (or Director), GTM Territory Planning. This role is responsible for supporting the design, execution, and ongoing maintenance of territory models across Account Management, New Customer Acquisition, and Specialist organizations.

This individual owns the analytical foundation of territory planning by building and maintaining capacity models, territory allocation frameworks, and coverage analyses that inform how GTM resources are deployed across the organization. The Senior Analyst translates headcount data, productivity benchmarks, and business priorities into structured planning outputs that enable leadership to make informed decisions regarding territory design, coverage strategy, and workforce allocation.

This is an individual contributor role that partners closely with GTM Strategy, Finance, Sales Leadership, GTM Operations, Compensation, and BIS/Systems teams to ensure territory models remain accurate, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Design & Allocation

Support the design, implementation, and maintenance of territory models across Account Management, New Customer Acquisition, and Specialist organizations.
Build and maintain territory allocation frameworks that balance market opportunity, workload distribution, customer coverage, and business objectives.
Analyze territory performance and coverage data to identify imbalances, gaps, and optimization opportunities.
Develop territory design recommendations and supporting analyses for leadership review and decision-making.
Maintain territory data integrity across Salesforce and related planning systems, ensuring models accurately reflect approved designs and assignments.

Capacity Planning & Coverage Modeling

Build and maintain capacity planning models to determine optimal headcount requirements across GTM sales organizations.
Develop Day-in-the-Life models and support ratio analyses to establish workload expectations and identify resource coverage gaps.
Monitor hiring plans against Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets, proactively identifying variances and updating planning assumptions.
Evaluate productivity benchmarks and workload distribution metrics to assess territory effectiveness and resource utilization.
Support Finance and HR planning cycles by providing headcount and coverage modeling insights and recommendations.

Account & Territory Operations

Maintain Account Manager books of business and ensure territory assignments remain balanced, accurate, and aligned to organizational goals.
Support annual and in-year territory planning cycles, including data preparation, model maintenance, change tracking, and execution support.
Process and document territory and account assignment changes through established governance processes, including Salesforce case management workflows.
Conduct impact assessments for account segment changes, evaluating implications on territory coverage, capacity, and resource allocation.
Maintain accurate records of territory assignments, account movements, and planning decisions as the operational source of truth.

Segmentation & Lead Distribution Support

Support customer segmentation reviews by preparing data analyses, reporting outputs, and recommendations for leadership teams.
Maintain the accuracy and consistent application of customer segmentation criteria across GTM systems and processes.
Provide analytical support for lead routing and distribution strategies by evaluating capacity, territory alignment, and utilization metrics.
Identify and resolve segmentation or lead distribution inconsistencies in partnership with BIS/Systems teams.

Reporting & Planning Insights

Define and document reporting requirements for territory planning dashboards and recurring planning reports in partnership with Reporting and BIS/Systems teams.
Prepare territory health summaries, capacity utilization reporting, hiring progress updates, and other planning insights for leadership review.
Track and report on territory coverage metrics, AOP hiring progress, and book-of-business balance on a recurring cadence.
Translate planning data into concise, actionable recommendations that support territory, hiring, and coverage decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with GTM Strategy, Finance, and Sales Leadership teams to ensure territory and capacity models reflect evolving business priorities.
Collaborate with BIS/Systems teams to maintain territory data accuracy across Salesforce and connected planning tools.
Work closely with GTM Operations and Compensation teams to evaluate downstream impacts of territory and account assignment changes.
Support governance processes by maintaining clear documentation of territory decisions, account movements, and approved exceptions.

Required Qualifications

3–5 years of experience in GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Territory Planning, or a closely related analytical role within a B2B SaaS environment.
Experience building, maintaining, or supporting territory models, capacity planning frameworks, and coverage analyses in a structured sales organization.
Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce, including knowledge of account management, territory structures, and CRM data governance processes.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex modeling, data analysis, and Power Query.
Strong analytical skills with experience working with large datasets, building structured business models, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT to improve productivity, efficiency, and business problem solving.
Strong attention to detail with a commitment to maintaining data accuracy and model integrity across multiple planning initiatives.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high standards of execution in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills with the ability to prepare structured analyses and planning recommendations for leadership review.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting territory planning, workforce planning, quota planning, or resource allocation initiatives within a high-growth SaaS organization.
Familiarity with Annual Operating Plan (AOP) processes, sales headcount planning, and productivity benchmarking methodologies.
Experience conducting coverage analysis, book-of-business balancing, customer segmentation, and territory optimization initiatives.
Knowledge of GTM organizational structures, sales motions, and territory management best practices.
Experience partnering with Finance, Sales Leadership, GTM Operations, Compensation, Reporting, Business Intelligence, or Systems teams to operationalize planning requirements.
Familiarity with Power BI, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and reporting platforms.
Demonstrated ability to identify operational inefficiencies and drive process improvements through data-driven insights.

Additional Information

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate

Portfolio Manager

C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually | Full-Time | Remote | Eastern Time Hours

The Opportunity

Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.

You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.

This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.

Direct property-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.

What You’ll Own

Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
Identify dissatisfied or at-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re-leasing activity.
Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups.
Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.

What You’ll Need

Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
Excellent organization, documentation, and follow-through.
Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property-management platform, or workflow-management system.
Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Availability to work full-time during Eastern Time business hours.
Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.

Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring-service industry will be considered.

What Success Looks Like

Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.

Who Will Succeed

The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.

You are client-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.

Compensation

The annual compensation range is C$30,000–C$36,000
, based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

Si cuentas con visión analítica, orientación a resultados y experiencia en procesos de aseguramiento en salud, esta es una excelente oportunidad para aportar al mejoramiento de la calidad asistencial y la sostenibilidad del sistema.

Objetivo Del Cargo

Garantizar la gestión integral farmacéutica de la EPS mediante el desarrollo de actividades de seguimiento, análisis, auditoría, acompañamiento técnico y articulación con la red prestadora, promoviendo el uso seguro, efectivo y eficiente de los medicamentos y demás tecnologías en salud. Verificar el cumplimiento de las líneas de tratamiento establecidas en guías clínicas, protocolos institucionales y criterios de aseguramiento definidos por la EPS.
Analizar desviaciones terapéuticas, escalonamientos, cambios de tratamiento y usos no alineados con la evidencia científica, generando intervenciones técnicas dirigidas a los equipos tratantes.
Realizar seguimiento al uso de medicamentos desabastecidos o descontinuados y proponer alternativas terapéuticas cuando sea pertinente.
Monitorear el cumplimiento de las programaciones de quimioterapia y la utilización de moléculas de alto costo para la población afiliada.

jobs.title: Growth Specialist
jobs.description:
¿Te animas a construir el futuro de Latinoamérica? 🚀

En Rappi construimos la SuperApp que cambia la vida de millones de personas cada día. Somos un equipo apasionado por la velocidad, la ejecución y los resultados reales.

Aquí hacemos que las cosas pasen. Si te mueve resolver problemas de escala real, aprender en tiempo récord y ver el impacto de tus ideas en cuestión de días, este es tu lugar.

Rappi Pro, Analista (Report Directo Head de Pro). Remoto, LatAm

El reto

Rappi Pro es uno de los principales impulsores del volumen de Rappi y el programa más directamente vinculado a nuestro beneficio bruto a largo plazo. Pequeños movimientos en nuestros Resultados Clave principales se traducen en un impacto material en P&G en toda la empresa. Ese es el tipo de negocio que estamos entregando a un analista con experiencia de 0 a 4 años.

Estamos contratando a personas en etapas tempranas de su carrera con intención. Queremos alguien sin cicatrices, sin el "así se hacía en mi antigua empresa" y con fluidez nativa en IA. Reportarás directamente al Head of Pro. Sin intermediarios, sin capa de traducción, sin política de grupos de analistas.

Este no es un rol de soporte. Serás responsable de una parte del negocio Pro y serás evaluado por resultados, no por entregables.

Lo que administrarás

Serás responsable personalmente de una o más partes del P&G de Pro: un Resultado Clave (por ejemplo, mejoras de plan), un corte por país o una línea estratégica de trabajo. Tu trabajo no es "apoyar el análisis". Tu trabajo es manejar tu parte como un mini-GM:

Conoces tus números al detalle. Si el COO pregunta a las 9 p.m., respondes en menos de 30 segundos.

Diagnosticas qué está funcionando y qué no. Presentas propuestas, no problemas.

Impulsas la ejecución transversal -CRM, Producto, Country GMs, Finanzas- para mover tu número. Ninguno de ellos nos reporta. Aun así, haces que suceda.

Escribes los memorandos, preparas las revisiones y eres responsable de las presentaciones cuando toca tu parte.

Construyes los flujos de trabajo de IA que te permiten operar con la productividad de un equipo de análisis de tres personas.

Ejecutar y optimizar procesos de Growth Specialist en Rappi, aplicando expertise técnico y generando insights que impulsen decisiones de negocio.

Tus desafíos

Cómo trabajarás: la IA es el sistema operativo, no una herramienta
Ya eres nativo de la IA. Si estás leyendo esto y no usas Claude, ChatGPT o Cursor varias horas cada día laboral, cierra la pestaña.
SQL es tu capa de auditoría, no tu oficio. Lo lees, lo validas, no lo escribes línea por línea.
Construyes análisis de cohortes, informes de experimentos, diagnósticos por país y memorandos ejecutivos con IA. Entregas en horas lo que un analista tradicional entrega en días.
Construyes agentes reutilizables para todo lo que se repite: revisiones comerciales semanales, detección de anomalías, escaneos de cohortes de cancelación, exploraciones profundas de países.
Detectas cuando la IA está equivocada: números alucinados, uniones fabricadas, lógica confiada pero errónea. Esta es la habilidad más importante en el puesto.
Si tienes un GitHub, un Notion o un cuaderno lleno de flujos de trabajo personales con IA, envíalo con tu solicitud.
Cómo se ve el éxito
30 días: Conoces el modelo de datos de Pro a la perfección. Tu pila de IA está construida. Has entregado tu primer informe que cambió una decisión.
90 días: Posees completamente una parte del P&L de Pro. Los GM de CRM, Producto y País te consideran el DRI para tu número, no solo soporte analítico.
6 meses: Has movido tu número. Has construido al menos un flujo de trabajo de IA que el resto del equipo de Pro ha adoptado. El Jefe de Pro confía en tu juicio sin necesidad de re-verificar.
12 meses: Estás operando al nivel de alguien con más de 5 años de experiencia.

Serás un gran fit

No aplicar si
Quieres estructura y una cola de tickets semanal. Este rol es ambiguo por diseño.
Ves la IA como una amenaza para tu oficio. Serás miserable aquí.
Quieres "aprender analítica" antes de asumir responsabilidad. Contratamos para que asumas responsabilidad desde el primer día.
Necesitas un gerente que revise tu trabajo línea por línea.

Lo que necesitas dominar

Requisitos indispensables
0-4 años de experiencia laboral. Se anima encarecidamente a los recién graduados.
Fluidez en IA que se note. Usas Claude, ChatGPT o Cursor varias horas al día. Puedes describir flujos de trabajo específicos que has creado. "He usado ChatGPT" de forma genérica no cuenta.
Rigor estadístico y analítico. Cálculos de potencia, significancia, causalidad vs correlación. Indispensable.
Instinto para los negocios. Lees una línea del P&L y nos dices qué significa, no qué dice.
Comunicación efectiva al nivel C. Resumes 40 horas de trabajo en un memo de 5 puntos que un COO lee en 90 segundos.
Inglés funcional. Zona horaria LatAm.

Lo que te hace diferente

Deseables
SQL: nivel intermedio es suficiente.
Python/R para casos particulares.
Español.
Proyectos paralelos, hackatones o experiencia en startups donde hayas tenido responsabilidad total.
Experiencia en suscripciones, marketplaces o economía de crecimiento.

Expertise técnico, pensamiento analítico y la capacidad de generar insights que impulsen decisiones de negocio.

En Rappi, la diversidad nos hace más fuertes

Creemos que los equipos diversos e inclusivos construyen los mejores productos, y buscamos activamente personas de todos los géneros, edades, orígenes, religiones y orientaciones sexuales. Si quieres construir el futuro de Latinoamérica, tu lugar es aquí.

¿Te unes al equipo? En Rappi, el límite lo pones tú. Si te apasiona aprender en movimiento y construir soluciones que escalan a millones, queremos conocerte.

jobs.title: Strategy & Planning Associate
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

What You’ll Do

You will bridge the gap between complex quantitative analytics and high-level business strategy for restaurant brands. This role is responsible for conducting thorough market analysis, transforming raw data into actionable insights and driving strategic decision-making for enterprise clients.

End-to-End Data Ownership: Demonstrated ability to mine, clean, analyze, and extract insights from complex, unstructured datasets using SQL and Python.
Data Visualization & Storytelling: Expertise in BI tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI) and advanced presentation tools to transform raw numbers into clean visual decks.
Structured Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills to deliver organized, clear speeches and present data-backed narratives to non-technical stakeholders.
Commercial & Financial Acumen: Strong grasp of business metrics, financial data, and enterprise drivers to support account retention and sales pipelines.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: High standard for quantitative accuracy where every number in a slide deck is double-checked and trustworthy.
Domain Awareness: Deep understanding of the US restaurant and food service market, including common operational challenges and market dynamics.

What We’re Looking For

5+ years of experience in data analytics and/or business intelligence.
Ideally familiar with the restaurant, food-tech, or hospitality industry and its core business drivers.
Technical proficiency in SQL, Python, and modern business intelligence tools (Looker, Power BI).
Track record of building visual presentations (e.g., PowerPoint, Google Slides) that translate numbers into clear business stories.
Strong communication skills with an ability to present data logically to internal teams and external stakeholders.
Outstanding communication skills.

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

What Else You Need To Know

This role is based in our Bogotá office. Atoms is a company driven by innovation and continuous change. We are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

Responsabilidades Clave

Apoya las operaciones comerciales de la tienda y las personas como un tercero a cargo cumpliendo el rol de gerente a cargo en caso de que el Gerente de Tienda y el Subgerente de Tienda estén ausentes para garantizar la gestión y supervisión de la tienda asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares de servicio de adidas.
Colabora con el logro de los KPI de la tienda como CR (Conversion Rate / Tasa de Conversión), ATV (Average Transaction Value / Valor Promedio de Transacción), ASP (Average Selling Price / Precio Promedio de Venta), UPT (Unit per Transaction / Unidad por Transacción), Tráfico, Margen Estándar, NPS (Net Promoter Score) y garantiza que el equipo los conozca, conozca cómo contribuyen y hace sugerencias de los ajustes necesarios para impulsar la productividad y la eficiencia a nivel de servicio y piso de ventas.

Apoya al gerente de la tienda en la capacitación del equipo en todas las soluciones y herramientas de ventas digitales y omnicanal y brinda un servicio posventa para garantizar una experiencia de compra perfecta.
Impulsa que la adquisición de la membresía de Creators Club sea ejecutada por los miembros de nuestro personal a través de nuestro modelo de servicio en cada interacción con los consumidores.

Trabaja siempre con una mentalidad de equipo primero, respetando plenamente a todos los colegas y contribuyendo activamente a hacer de su lugar de trabajo un entorno inclusivo y acogedor para todos.

jobs.title: Director de calidad y Regulatorio
jobs.description:
Sobre Allied.

Allied Corp produce cannabis medicinal de grado farmacéutico en Mesa de los Santos, Santander, y lo exporta a mercados médicos altamente regulados: Europa y Australia.

Combinamos experiencia canadiense de cultivo y estándares farmacéuticos con las condiciones agronómicas de Colombia: más de 12 cosechas al año, producción rodante mes a mes y más de 1.000 kg exportados a la fecha, liberados contra especificaciones alineadas con la Farmacopea Europea y con los límites de la TGO 93 de Australia. Contamos con certificación ICA BPA, certificación CUMCS-GACP y auditorías superadas con socios EU-GMP europeos y australianos.

Los compradores europeos y australianos exigen cada vez más controles de tipo GMP en poscosecha, procesamiento y empaque, además del GACP que rige el cultivo. Llevar nuestros sistemas a ese nivel es una prioridad estratégica de la compañía y el eje de este cargo.

Sobre el cargo.

Buscamos al Director(a) de Calidad y Asuntos Regulatorios que lidere integralmente la Calidad y el cumplimiento regulatorio de la operación en Colombia. El eje técnico del cargo es llevar la operación a estándares GMP, consolidando en paralelo el cumplimiento GACP que rige el cultivo y la poscosecha. Eso implica definir qué cubre cada estándar a lo largo de la cadena, cerrar las brechas según su nivel de riesgo y elevar el nivel de control de toda la operación.

Es un cargo directivo que se ejerce en la operación, no desde el escritorio: presencia permanente en campo, invernaderos, cultivo, procesamiento, laboratorio y almacenes. Buscamos a alguien que no solamente establezca la estrategia, sino que la ejecute, convirtiendo los requerimientos regulatorios y de calidad en soluciones prácticas, eliminando obstáculos, resolviendo los problemas en su origen y dando seguimiento hasta el cierre efectivo.

Tendrás autonomía para construir la función de Calidad, definir su estructura y formar el equipo, con acompañamiento directo del Gerente de Operaciones y del equipo ejecutivo internacional. La liberación de lote, las decisiones frente a resultados fuera de especificación y las investigaciones de eventos críticos son responsabilidad de este cargo, en trabajo conjunto con Producción: buscamos calidad con producción, no calidad contra producción, con criterio técnico firme y sentido práctico de la operación.

Responsabilidades:

Presencia en la operación y cultura de calidad

Mantener presencia activa y visible en el piso operativo y en las áreas agrícolas, identificando riesgos antes de que se conviertan en problemas de calidad, y trabajando de forma transversal con Operaciones, Cultivo, Procesamiento, Ingeniería, Supply Chain, Laboratorio y EHS.
Liderar la mejora continua desde el terreno: reducir desviaciones, rechazos, reprocesos y pérdidas, usar los datos de la operación para priorizar, y construir una cultura de calidad, excelencia operacional y desempeño Right-First-Time.
Conformar, dirigir y desarrollar el equipo de Calidad y Asuntos Regulatorios.

Calidad del producto y liberación de lote

Asegurar la calidad del producto a lo largo de toda la cadena: insumos y agua, control microbiológico, monitoreo ambiental, manejo integrado de plagas, cosecha, secado y curado, almacenamiento, contaminación cruzada y trazabilidad de lotes.
Dirigir el Control de Calidad y la relación con los laboratorios externos: especificaciones, planes de muestreo, toma y envío de muestras, muestras de retención, calificación de laboratorios, análisis e interpretación de resultados y aprobación de certificados de análisis.
Responder por la liberación de lote y por las decisiones frente a resultados fuera de especificación, y liderar personalmente las investigaciones de eventos críticos de calidad, en trabajo conjunto con Producción.

Sistema de gestión de calidad (QMS) y evolución hacia GMP

Hacer funcionar el QMS todos los días —desviaciones y no conformidades, CAPA, control de cambios, gestión de riesgos, calificación de proveedores, gestión documental, capacitación, auditorías internas, y quejas, devoluciones y retiro de producto—, manteniéndolo trazable y auditable, depurando los formatos y procesos que no agreguen valor, y desafiando los que no sean suficientemente robustos.
Llevar la operación a estándares GMP: análisis de brecha, plan de cierre priorizado por riesgo, y elevación de la documentación operativa —procedimientos, especificaciones, controles en proceso y registros de lote— al nivel de detalle y trazabilidad que exige el estándar.
Liderar la calificación de instalaciones, equipos y sistemas críticos —incluidos los sistemas de tratamiento y distribución de agua—, la validación de procesos de producción y limpieza, y la integridad de los datos conforme a los principios ALCOA+.

Cumplimiento regulatorio, auditorías y clientes internacionales

Sostener y fortalecer el cumplimiento GACP en cultivo, cosecha y poscosecha, así como la normativa colombiana aplicable (Ministerio de Justicia – plataforma MICC, ICA, Fondo Nacional de Estupefacientes e INVIMA), en un entorno regulatorio en constante actualización.
Atender auditorías de clientes farmacéuticos internacionales y de autoridades, y mantener la operación en estado permanente de inspection readiness.
Gestionar la relación técnica con socios, compradores y clientes certificados bajo EU-GMP: cuestionarios de calidad, acuerdos técnicos, requerimientos documentales y auditorías.

Requisitos

Profesional en Química Farmacéutica, Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería de Alimentos, Microbiología, Ingeniería Agroindustrial o carreras afines.
Mínimo 5 años en Calidad (control de calidad, aseguramiento de calidad y asuntos regulatorios) en industria regulada, con al menos 2 años liderando la función o el equipo.
Experiencia comprobable en GMP en la industria farmacéutica o en una industria equivalente altamente regulada.
Experiencia en entornos de producción, con disposición y gusto por el trabajo en piso.
Experiencia atendiendo auditorías e inspecciones regulatorias o de cliente.
Inglés funcional (B2 o superior): nuestros socios, compradores y auditores son europeos y australianos.
Disponibilidad para trabajar de manera presencial en Mesa de los Santos, Santander.

﻿
Este cargo no es para un perfil de calidad exclusivamente documental ni de certificación de sistemas de gestión sin trabajo directo en planta y campo: buscamos a alguien que decida sobre el producto, esté en la operación todos los días y acompañe a los equipos de Operaciones y Cultivo en su día a día.

Deseable

Experiencia en cannabis medicinal, fitoterapéuticos, cosméticos, alimentos o biotecnología.
Experiencia en GACP, EU-GMP o participación en procesos de certificación desde su etapa inicial.
Conocimiento en control de calidad de agua de riego y agua potable en operación agrícola e industrial.
Metodologías de mejora continua: Lean, Kaizen, RCA, FMEA.
Posgrado en Calidad, Sistemas de Gestión, Asuntos Regulatorios, Industria Farmacéutica o Gestión de Operaciones.

Qué significa el éxito

A los 3 meses: diagnóstico de la operación, análisis de brecha frente a GMP y plan de cierre priorizado por riesgo acordado con la Gerencia de Operaciones, más una propuesta de simplificación documental.
A los 6 meses: QMS simplificado y en uso, con desviaciones y CAPA cerradas en plazo, y Calidad visible en el piso todos los días.
A los 12 meses: CUMCS-GACP e ICA BPA renovadas sin no conformidades mayores, auditorías de clientes superadas, cero lotes rechazados o devueltos en destino, y la operación lista para una auditoría de diagnóstico GMP.
De forma sostenida: menos desviaciones, rechazos y reprocesos, y decisiones de calidad a tiempo y con criterio técnico.

Perfil que buscamos

Un líder práctico, con criterio técnico y comercial, cómodo tanto en espacios directivos como en la operación. Alguien que construya cultura de calidad desde el terreno, que trabaje bien con equipos técnicos y agrícolas, que tome decisiones con orientación a resultados y que entienda que cumplimiento y crecimiento del negocio avanzan juntos.

Condiciones

Cargo directivo, presencial en Mesa de los Santos, Santander (aproximadamente 45 minutos de Bucaramanga). Compensación competitiva acorde con la experiencia.

Postulación

Si te interesa liderar la Calidad de una operación de cannabis medicinal con presencia real en mercados internacionales y llevar sus estándares al siguiente nivel, postúlate a través de LinkedIn con tu hoja de vida actualizada.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Finance & Commercial Operations
jobs.description:
Antenna is the leading provider of data and analytics for subscription media services in the U.S. Antenna's standardized metrics, competitive benchmarks, syndicated insights, and market intelligence are trusted by some of the most recognized and respected brands across media and entertainment sectors. Using a proprietary AI-powered approach, Antenna connects subscription activities with real consumer viewership to provide services, studios, and creators with an unmatched, market-wide view of subscriber behaviors to better understand acquisition, retention, and engagement.

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Finance & Commercial Ops
to be the financial backbone of our commercial team. You'll bring an FP&A mindset to how we sell, price and renew. That means building the forecasts, models and metrics that tell leadership where revenue is headed, and making sure every deal is grounded in sound numbers. You'll get real satisfaction from turning a messy pipeline into a forecast leadership can trust, a pricing question into a clear model, and scattered data into a story the team can act on.

This is a hands-on role at a small, fast-moving startup. You'll own revenue forecasting, commercial metrics like ARR, bookings, renewals and churn, and deal economics. You'll also own the contract flow and reporting that connect them. You'll partner with the CEO on monthly financial reporting and planning, and build the AI-powered reporting layer that keeps the whole executive team and commercial org informed.

You will report to the CEO. Antenna is a remote-first company, and this role requires working hours that overlap substantially with US Eastern Time.

What You'll Do

Finance & Planning

Own revenue forecasting: project quarterly bookings and revenue from the pipeline, track forecast against actuals, and explain the variance
Build and maintain reporting on our core commercial metrics, including ARR, bookings, renewals, expansion and churn
Model deal economics to support pricing decisions, such as how discounts, multi-year terms and deal structures affect revenue over time
Partner with our CEO on monthly financial reporting, budget tracking, and inputs for leadership and board materials

Deal Flow & Contracts

Own the contract flow from proposal to signature: prepare SOWs, run standard MSAs, and coordinate with outside legal on non-standard terms
Act as a thought partner on deal structuring, flagging risks and opportunities in contract terms before they become problems
Own pipeline hygiene, stage definitions and forecast inputs, and run recurring pipeline reviews with leadership
Track commercial OKRs and surface risks and blockers early

Systems, Data & AI

Take our commercial systems from design to execution, seamlessly integrating all of the systems and managing it effectively with a cross-functional commercial team
Build a clean, connected data layer across CRM, call transcripts and contracts, including making our contract library readable by AI tools
Build and manage an AI-driven executive dashboard
Publish regular commercial reports that create visibility and accountability across the team

Who You Are

5-10 years of experience across FP&A, revenue operations, deal desk, business operations, or a similar commercial finance role
Startup or growth-stage experience; you're comfortable owning the whole picture rather than one narrow lane
Solid FP&A fundamentals: forecasting, financial modeling, variance analysis, and building reports executives trust
Commercial and contract fluency; comfortable reading an MSA or SOW, spotting what needs attention, and reasoning about pricing
Working knowledge of CRM and SaaS tools (HubSpot a plus); you can carry out integrations and improve workflows without needing to be a CRM consultant
Hands-on AI experience that goes beyond casual chatbot use: you've built workflows, automated reporting, or used LLMs on real business data
A strong cross-functional partner who can keep up with senior leaders, think on your feet, and use good judgment
Professional fluency in English, written and spoken. Advanced English proficiency (B2-C1) Please submit a resume in English language in the application

Antenna Benefits:

Work from anywhere during US business hours
Competitive compensation, including participation in Antenna equity program
Mentorship from experienced executives
Opportunity to grow and impact a rapidly growing start up
Travel to In-person team off-sites (visa-permitting)

About Antenna

Antenna is the leading provider of data and analytics for the U.S. Subscription Economy. Our standardized metrics, competitive benchmarks, syndicated insights, and market intelligence are used by some of the most trusted brands across media and entertainment sectors to better understand subscriber behavior and successfully navigate the rapidly changing consumer subscription landscape.

Founded in 2019 by Jonathan Carson, a successful serial entrepreneur with deep roots in data and analytics, and Rameez Tase, a seasoned executive in media and analytics, Antenna's mission is supported by top investors with global expertise in media and technology: Raine Ventures, BDMI, UTA Ventures, and many more. Antenna is powered by a dedicated group of individuals who are intellectually curious, passionate about service, and committed to supporting the needs of Antenna clients and each other every day. As a small remote-first team, Antenna team members have the opportunity to work alongside senior leaders and professionally grow with an early-stage team.

jobs.title: Jefe de eCommerce
jobs.description:
QUIÉNES SOMOS

Quiénes somos:

Samsonite es el líder mundial en bolsos, equipaje y accesorios de viaje, que combinan un estilo notable con la última tecnología de diseño y la máxima atención a la calidad y durabilidad. Durante más de 100 años, Samsonite ha aprovechado su rica herencia para crear productos inigualables que satisfacen las necesidades de estilo de vida de viaje de los viajeros conscientes de todo el mundo. Con una cartera de marcas que incluye Samsonite, Tumi, American Tourister, High Sierra, Gregory, Hartmann y Lipault Paris, nuestros productos se venden en más de 100 países de América del Norte, Asia, Europa y América Latina a través de nuestras tiendas propias, sitios web y una variedad de socios minoristas
DESCRIPCIÓN DE PUESTO

Misión

Liderar el desarrollo comercial del negocio digital en su país, abarcando Ecommerce D2C y e‑Wholesale (marketplaces 1P/3P como Mercado Libre, Amazon, Éxito, Falabella, etc), maximizando ventas con foco en rentabilidad (margen, costos) y contribución de EBITDA positiva. Administrar el presupuesto del canal y negociar con proveedores y retailers para el desarrollo del .com (en 1P y 3P). Corelacionar y co‑gestionar, junto al Gerente de Marketing del país, el presupuesto de inversión en medios (performance y retail media) para impulsar tráfico y el cumplimiento de metas. Coordinar diariamente/semanalmente con equipos regionales de Negocios Digitales (proyectos, operación, medios y planificación) para asegurar ejecución consistente e incrementalidad real.
Gestión Comercial & P&L Digital

Construir y ejecutar el plan comercial digital país (D2C + marketplaces) con forecast, pricing y promociones.
Administrar el P&L digital: revenue, margen, descuentos, costos logísticos/medios; velar por EBITDA positivo.
Definir objetivos por categoría y canal; impulsar cross‑category, AOV y frecuencia de compra.

Presupuesto, Negociaciones y Medios

Gestionar el presupuesto del canal digital y aprobar reasignaciones en caso de ser necesario.
Negociar con retailers/marketplaces del país (1P/3P) condiciones, fees y acciones.
Co‑planificar y coordinar con el Gerente de Marketing del país la inversión en medios (performance y retail media) para generar tráfico calificado.

Ecommerce D2C

Alinear calendario comercial con Marketing/Digital Growth; coordinar campañas, landings y contenidos.
Mejorar conversión (CVR), UPT, AOV y recurrencia junto a PO/UX, SEO y CRM/CDP (audiencias y journeys).
Asegurar medición (GA4, UTMs) y reporting (Power BI) para decisiones basadas en datos.

E‑Wholesale / Marketplaces (1P/3P)

Desarrollar el negocio en Marketplace (MELI, Falabella, retail locales, Rappi) con enfoque en visibilidad, buy‑box y rotación.
Gestionar catálogo, pricing, fulfillment/logística y rating; coordinar retail media/CO‑OP con partners y el equipo regional de Digital Growth.
Negociar condiciones y acciones comerciales con cuentas clave; monitorear comisiones, fees y rentabilidad.

Omnicanalidad, Operación & Automatización

Impulsar iniciativas omni (BOPIS/BORIS/BOSS) con Operaciones; velar por SLAs y promesas al cliente.
Identificar cuellos de botella y promover automatizaciones para escalar operación con eficiencia.

Gobernanza, Incrementalidad & Coordinación Regional

Demostrar incrementalidad del digital sin canibalizar Retail/Wholesale.
Coordinar diariamente/semanalmente con equipos regionales de Negocios Digitales: proyectos, operación, inversión en medios y planificación.

Requisitos

Ingeniería Comercial, Civil/Industrial, Administración o afines a negocios.
3–5 años liderando desarrollo comercial online o gestión de canales digitales.
Gestión de backlog y planificación comercial; analítica (GA4) comunicación efectiva, manejo de CMS (Ej: Shopify, Vtex, otros), Gestión de tableros BI.
GA4/GTM; Power BI/Looker; suites marketplace (MELI, Amazon), integradores (Multivende, Producteca, otros); Excel/Sheets avanzado.
Ingles - Basico Intermedio

ACERCA DEL EQUIPO

Por Qué Te Encantará Trabajar Aquí

Nuestros empleados importan.
Como empresa centrada en las personas, trabajamos duro para ofrecer recompensas y oportunidades de desarrollo a nuestros empleados, reconociendo su rendimiento y creando un entorno de trabajo propicio para ellos, dondequiera que se encuentren.
Cultura vibrante.
Estamos comprometidos con una cultura diversa y rica, que acoge a personas de todas las profesiones y condiciones sociales. Nuestro compromiso de larga data con la diversidad y la inclusión nos permite aportar cada día al trabajo nuestro auténtico yo y nuestras diferencias únicas.
Socialmente responsables.
Queremos minimizar el impacto de nuestros productos en el medio ambiente y ayudar a crear viajes positivos en todo el mundo. Para ello, creamos los mejores productos utilizando los materiales, métodos y modelos más sostenibles e innovadores.
Lo Que Valoramos

En Samsonite, hacemos más que crear las maletas que se mueven con nuestros clientes, inspiramos y celebramos los momentos que les mueven. Creemos que tenemos una responsabilidad con el mundo en cómo operamos, los productos que vendemos, las comunidades donde vivimos y trabajamos, y cómo tratamos a las personas que trabajan con nosotros. Somos tan diversos como los viajes mismos, y como los viajes, tu viaje con Samsonite presenta la oportunidad de formar parte de algo más grande y explorar tus pasiones. Por eso ofrecemos varios caminos para los profesionales y celebramos los conocimientos y habilidades que aportan a nuestro equipo. Estamos comprometidos con un lugar de trabajo respetuoso que permita a los miembros de nuestro equipo aportar diariamente lo mejor de sí mismos.
Samsonite es una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a promover y mantener un entorno de trabajo en el que todos los solicitantes, asociados, clientes y otras personas sean tratados con dignidad y respeto, libres de acoso, discriminación o represalias.

jobs.title: Export Operations Executive
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Export Operations Executive to join our team!!
At Trading Solutions, we are redefining the future of global logistics by merging cutting-edge technology, real-time visibility, and seamless coordination across continents. We empower businesses to move faster, smarter, and with absolute confidence in every shipment.
The Export Operations Executive will be the operational backbone of our logistics execution, managing end-to-end import and export processes from booking to cargo release across maritime, air, and ground shipments. This role ensures flawless documentation, proactive client communication, and real-time cargo visibility for 300+ active clients moving 52,000+ TEUs annually. You'll own daily operational excellence while building systems that scale with our international expansion.

What You'll Do

Execute and monitor daily export logistics operations, including bookings, cargo releases, documentation management, and customs coordination across maritime, air, and ground channels to ensure on-time delivery and compliance.
Manage end-to-end export processes, including coordinating empty equipment pick-up, submitting VGM (Verified Gross Mass), and ensuring timely port gate-in for outbound maritime shipments.
Manage cargo release processes with shipping lines, customs brokers, and warehouses, verifying documentation accuracy and coordinating with customs authorities to eliminate delays.
Conduct continuous track and trace monitoring across all carriers and airlines, maintaining precise data in internal systems to ensure operational visibility and enable proactive issue resolution.
Prepare and review House Bills of Lading (HBL) and Master Bills of Lading, coordinate Switch BL requests, and manage corrections with shipping lines to ensure documentary compliance for all outbound and inbound freight.
Transmit import filings (AMS/ISF) to U.S. Customs and manage origin export customs declarations (e.g., AES or local equivalents) within regulatory deadlines to prevent penalties or shipment holds.
Coordinate booking confirmations with carriers and depots, resolve operational issues promptly, and send required documentation (gate passes, export declarations, BLs) to clients with complete transparency.
Deliver timely notifications to clients on shipment departures, arrivals, delays, and itinerary changes, escalating critical issues and coordinating cross-functional resolution.
Maintain organized operational records, meet internal KPIs for accuracy and turnaround time, and contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance service quality.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in International Trade, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
2-4 years of progressive experience in freight forwarding operations, logistics coordination, handling both export shipments.
Hands-on experience with booking management, BL issuance, cargo tracking systems, and customs documentation (knowledge of AMS/ISF and export declarations required).
Proficiency with freight management platforms (CargoWise, Magaya, or similar TMS/ERP systems) and advanced Excel for operational reporting.
English proficiency at B2+ level (written and spoken) to communicate effectively with international carriers, clients, and customs authorities.
Strong attention to detail with proven ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously while maintaining documentary accuracy (Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin) and regulatory compliance.
Ownership mindset with proactive communication skills and ability to anticipate issues, escalate appropriately, and follow through to resolution.

Nice to Have

Experience working with U.S. customs regulations, ISF filing requirements, and coordination with U.S.-based customs brokers.
Familiarity with multiple trade lanes (Latin America, Asia, Europe, North America) and carrier-specific portal systems.
FIATA Diploma, IATA certification, or customs brokerage training.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Operations Specialist to drive operational growth, marketplace balance, and cross-functional execution for our Ride Hailing business in Colombia.
This is a heavily quantitative role. You are a data power-user who queries production databases with SQL, navigates complex Tableau environments, and uses AI models like Claude and Gemini to move faster. You also bring the communication clarity and authority to align cross-functional teams, defend local operational realities with evidence, and make sure decisions actually land on the ground.

What you will do

Data analytics and quantitative rigor
Query production databases directly with SQL. Run complex ad-hoc analyses (joins, aggregations, conditional logic) and investigate supply and demand anomalies independently, without waiting on a centralized analytics team.
Interpret existing BI dashboards to track core KPIs, unit economics, conversion funnels, and driver retention metrics in real time.
Use LLMs (Claude, Gemini) as daily force multipliers to analyze operational scenarios, structure analytical frameworks, and accelerate reporting.
Translate raw data into concrete operational adjustments and country-level trade-offs.

Cross-functional alignment and communication
Coordinate with Product, PR, Government Relations, Safety, and Regional HQ with clarity, rigor, and assertiveness.
Defend local operational realities in front of regional stakeholders using structured logic and hard evidence.
Own initiatives end to end. When cross-departmental projects stall, step in to align incentives and clear roadblocks.

Market sensitivity
Keep a pragmatic pulse on local market dynamics so operational strategy stays responsive to what is actually happening in Colombia.

What we are looking for

1+ years in Ride Hailing, Tech Operations, Business Intelligence, or high-growth marketplaces, with continuous exposure to data.
Intermediate to advanced SQL. You write and run your own queries against relational databases.
Proven quantitative fluency: business intelligence, data interpretation (Tableau), and quantitative decision-making.
Fluency using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to scale analytical throughput and personal efficiency.
Executive presence. You can articulate complex data points clearly, negotiate priorities with peer departments, and align regional stakeholders around local execution goals.
Pragmatism over noise. You focus on facts, impact, and root causes rather than surface metrics or speculation.
Professional working proficiency in English and Spanish.

Who We Are

GEP, with over 30 offices internationally, is the fastest growing procurement and supply chain solutions firm – consulting, software and managed services. GEP has succeeded by being smart and creative; solving complex problems and finding opportunities for the world’s largest organizations.

How You Grow At GEP

We recognize people who make a genuine difference, work hard and drive achievements. Results are noticed and rewarded. It’s how you will grow a career at GEP, and in a much shorter time frame than at other firms.

Celebrating Everyone

GEP succeeds through the ideas and creativity of our team members so we embrace people of all experiences, nationalities, abilities, cultures, races, gender identities, sexual orientations and ages. What makes you unique and different is celebrated and will help GEP stand out even more. And we are a women-founded and -owned company so our foundation is making GEP a great place to work for women, a place where women can learn, advance and give back.

Are You One of Us

What you will do:

As a Sourcing Lead, you will partner with our client and internal teams and manage the planning and execution of strategic sourcing initiatives using a multi-step sourcing process. In this role, your duties will include but will not be limited to:

Develop category specific requirements and scopes of work consistent with business requirements and client sourcing strategy.

Education: Minimum Bachelor's degree (or in progress) in Science, Business or Engineering or similar stream or a combination of relevant experience.
Experience: 5+ years previous work experience managing Strategic Sourcing is a MUST, procure to pay process, RFX auctions process and procurement process experience.

jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a highly organized and execution-oriented operator to become a strategic operational partner to the three founders of RunMonsterRun and Telos Media
helping coordinate and scale the business as the RunMonsterRun brand continues to grow.

This person will transform ideas into execution by coordinating projects, aligning senior stakeholders, tracking priorities, and ensuring critical initiatives move forward. They will work across the founders' different priorities, working styles, and areas of ownership, creating alignment and driving follow-through across functions.

A key part of the role will also be taking ownership of RunMonsterRun's production timelines, ensuring projects stay on track, dependencies are managed, bottlenecks are identified early, and the relevant stakeholders remain aligned throughout the production process.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional project and production management skills with strong business judgment, excellent communication, and the ability to independently navigate ambiguity while coordinating multiple senior stakeholders and concurrent priorities.

This is a role for someone who naturally creates structure, anticipates problems before they arise, follows through relentlessly, and enjoys building operational foundations in a fast-moving, evolving creative environment.

What You'll Do

Serve as a strategic operational partner to the founders, coordinating across their different priorities, working styles, and areas of ownership.
Manage and coordinate multiple senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment, clear ownership, and consistent follow-through across initiatives.
Own and manage RunMonsterRun production timelines, including milestones, dependencies, priorities, risks, and deliverables.
Drive accountability and follow-through across creative, production, operations, leadership, and external partners.
Identify and remove operational bottlenecks before they impact delivery.
Create visibility across project status, production milestones, risks, dependencies, and upcoming priorities.
Protect the founders' time by coordinating meetings, managing priorities, organizing information, and reducing operational overhead.
Facilitate communication and alignment between creative, production, operations, leadership, and external partners.
Build and improve documentation, workflows, operating procedures, and project management systems.
Research, evaluate, and help execute new growth opportunities for RunMonsterRun, including partnerships, products, distribution channels, monetization initiatives, and other strategic business opportunities.
Step into ambiguous situations, identify what needs to happen, and independently drive initiatives forward.

About You

5+ years of experience in Business Operations, Project Management, Producer, Chief of Staff, Production Management, Operations Leadership, or similar roles.
Proven experience coordinating complex cross-functional initiatives and managing multiple senior stakeholders or executives.
Experience managing production timelines and workflows, ideally within media, entertainment, creative, or another fast-paced production environment.
Exceptional organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams without losing track of details.
Strong project management skills and a demonstrated ability to drive initiatives from idea through execution.
Strong business judgment with the ability to identify opportunities, assess priorities, and turn ideas into action.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Spanish fluency is strongly preferred.
Comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments with evolving priorities and ambiguity.
Highly proactive, resourceful, entrepreneurial, and self-directed.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence rather than formal authority.
Strong ability to manage up, keep senior stakeholders aligned, and drive accountability and follow-through.
Strong documentation and operational process improvement skills.
Experience using project management platforms such as Notion, ClickUp, or similar tools.

What Makes This Role Exciting

Work directly alongside with the founders of RunMonsterRun helping coordinate the leadership team behind one of Telos Media's newest entertainment IPs.
Play a key role in shaping the growth of RunMonsterRun from an emerging brand into a scalable entertainment business.
Become the operational integrator responsible for turning ambitious ideas into consistent execution across leadership, production, and business operations.
Take ownership of production coordination and help build the systems and processes that enable creative teams to execute effectively.
Build the operational foundations that will support the brand's long-term growth.
Gain exposure to creative leadership, Hollywood-level production, strategic partnerships, product development, and business operations in a rapidly growing media company.

jobs.title: AI Business Operations Analyst - Bogotá (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading spend management platform in Latin America.
More than 40,000 businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We're ~400 people, backed by Kaszek, monashees, Coatue, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for an AI Business Operations Analyst to join Clara Ops and drive a new chapter of how we run the company. This is not a traditional ops role. You will be the person who spots where humans are doing work that machines could do better — and then builds the systems that make it happen. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, automation, and execution, working across teams to eliminate friction, accelerate decisions, and raise the operational ceiling of Clara.

You will report to the Global Head of Operations and partner closely with Product, Sales, Finance, and Engineering. You will own the full loop: identify the opportunity, design the solution, deploy it with AI and automation tooling, and measure the outcome.

Map high-friction operational workflows across Clara and prioritize them for AI-augmentation and automation — building a roadmap that compounds in impact over time.
Design, deploy, and iterate on AI-powered workflows using tools like Claude Code/Codex, n8n, and other LLM APIs to do things that weren't possible before and replace manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes.
Collaborate with commercial and operational leaders to identify where agent-based or rule-based automation can improve speed, accuracy, or capacity — without adding headcount.
Build and maintain operational dashboards in Metabase to surface the KPIs that matter and flag anomalies before they become problems.
Partner with Product and Product Marketing on process changes tied to new feature launches, ensuring operational readiness before every release.
Serve as the internal expert on AI tooling for operations — evaluating new tools, sharing what works, and building the internal playbook on how Clara uses AI.
Identify data gaps and work with Engineering to create the instrumentation or pipelines needed to power better operational decisions.
Document processes clearly so that what you build can be maintained, improved, and handed off — not just understood by you.
You're excited about leading a team of AIs - not becoming a people manager - and have an unlimited token budget.

Who you are

""

Must haves:

Experience working at top consulting firm (Bain/BCG/McKinsey) or similar professional services or/and high-velocity startup.
Proven AI automation track record. Demonstrated examples and experience automating and augmenting operations with AI. This is not aspirational — we want to see what you've already shipped.
3–7 years of experience in operations, strategy, or a related field — ideally in a LatAm fintech, payments, or high-growth B2B SaaS company.
Hands-on experience building automated workflows with tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar — no-code and low-code fluency is a must.
Familiarity or proven ability to work with company systems of records such as CRMs (e.g. HubSpot, Attio, Salesforce), Support triage (e.g. Zendesk), data warehouses (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake), and BI tools
Comfortable working directly with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) to build operational tools and agents, even if you're not a software engineer.
Strong analytical skills — comfortable querying data in SQL or working with BI tools like Metabase to build the operational visibility Clara needs.
Structured thinker with a bias for action: you break down complex problems, make decisions with incomplete data, and move fast without breaking things.
Excellent communicator — you translate technical solutions into business terms for non-technical stakeholders, and business needs into precise specs for engineers.
Fluent in English

Nice to haves:

Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it.
Independent analytical skills using Metabase, SQL, or Python to drive data-informed decision-making.
A good sense of humor.

Why Clara

A high talent-density team
driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.
Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.
An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.
English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

Clarity
— Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.
Simplicity
— If it can be simpler, it should be.
Ownership
— We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.
Pride
— We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.
ABC (Always Be Changing)
— We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.
Inclusivity
— Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

Hybrid at Clara

Claridians split their time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles, but we expect you to spend time there naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

No egos, no hand-holding — just a team of experienced professionals moving fast, adapting easily, and delivering impact. Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven. Our work is rooted in solving real problems that help ecommerce brands grow. No empty promises — we bring in results. And yes, we have fun. The Account Expert
role at Omnisend is a crucial part of our customer and partner success. We highly believe in the importance of customer-centricity and are looking for individuals with a great positive attitude and ability to work well with merchants and partners alike. This position is perfect for client-oriented and goal-driven individuals who are passionate about ecommerce and marketing, have a problem-solving mindset and strong technical and interpersonal skills. This role requires the ability to work across organizational stakeholders and a research-based mindset.

What you’ll do @Omnisend:

Be passionate about customer success and establish themselves as a trusted advisor for Omnisend’s top tier customers
Proactively develop strategies with our merchants to help increase revenue through digital marketing strategies for their managed accounts
Onboard new clients, so they are set up for success. This may include assistance with migrating contacts, guiding them through a warmup process and helping them set up their first campaigns and automations across channels
Be proactive with strategic advice and guidance on a weekly, bi-monthly or monthly cadence and respond to client questions in a timely manner
Provide best practices to ensure clients are achieving their business goals
Regularly review customer dashboards, address any open issues and ensure consistent messaging and appropriate escalation
Keep merchants up to date on product releases and new features
Contribute feedback to Product/Engineering on platform improvements to enhance customer engagement
Conduct QBRs, establish quarterly goals for customers and help achieve them
Document troubleshooting and problem resolution steps

We expect that you’ll bring:

1-2 years of customer success-related experience
An understanding of what the main digital marketing metrics are and what is driving their trends (opens, clicks, conversions)
A proven track record of creative problem-solving for customers
Fluency in English language
Fluency in Spanish language
Experience and comfort discussing business and sales topics with clients during renewal or cancellation conversations
Excellent communication skills via chat, phone, video conference, email and comfortable to use Wechat as communication tool
Strong time management skills and clear sense of ownership and independent working ability
An understanding of (either some or all): Slack, Zoom, Intercom, Mixpanel, Hubspot, G-Suite, and Omnisend or other e-commerce and marketing platforms
Experience in e-commerce, SaaS, project management -or- marketing, and advising customers on marketing strategy is a plus!

What we offer in return:

Gross salary starting from 1500 EUR/month based on experience + commission depending on individual results
An unlimited learning budget for self-improvement complying with the best interest of Omnisend
Working methods and best practices inspired by the best tech companies in Silicon Valley
Senior colleagues that enable us to have a high-performing, productive environment where your growth will accelerate
Private health insurance
Remote work possibilities
Hybrid work (in Vilnius, Kaunas, Charleston): three days a week in the office with your team, two from home
Possibility to work from anywhere in the world
Unlimited access to psychotherapy
A workstation budget
Personalized work anniversary gifts (house cleaning, spas, international flights & more that you choose depending on the year)
Attractive workations and team-led team-building events

Omnisend is an email and SMS marketing platform built for ecommerce brands. With one-click integration to major ecommerce platforms, intuitive automation, and powerful email templates, we make sophisticated marketing effortless — no learning curve required.

Award-winning 24/7/365 customer support? Check. A platform trusted by growing brands and seasoned pros alike? Absolutely. The idea that “great marketing needs to be expensive”? Our 150,000+ customers prove that wrong every day.

jobs.description:
En el IGBS estamos buscando a nuestro Record to Report Analyst será responsable de ejecutar y garantizar los procesos contables necesarios para la generación de los Estados Financieros (FFS), de acuerdo con las políticas y procedimientos estándar establecidos globalmente.

El rol deberá asegurar el cumplimiento de los niveles de calidad y los tiempos acordados para la entrega de reportes, así como la correcta ejecución de las actividades relacionadas con el cierre y análisis de inventarios de vehículos y repuestos.

Asimismo, será responsable de evaluar la razonabilidad de los resultados, asegurando la integridad, exactitud y consistencia de la información financiera, en colaboración con los equipos de liderazgo financiero de los mercados.

Dentro de sus responsabilidades se encuentra también el registro de asientos contables y ajustes en el Libro Mayor (GL) para los mercados asignados, de acuerdo con los Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLA) establecidos.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES
Realizar conciliaciones de cuentas, identificando y resolviendo oportunamente las partidas conciliatorias, con el fin de garantizar la integridad, exactitud y razonabilidad de los saldos contables.
Analizar las cuentas del balance general, verificando que los saldos y movimientos registrados sean correctos e investigando y reportando oportunamente cualquier transacción inusual, inconsistencia o diferencia identificada.
Ejecutar las actividades contables correspondientes al cierre de período, siguiendo los procedimientos y lineamientos establecidos, garantizando el cumplimiento de las políticas de la compañía, las regulaciones financieras y el cronograma definido.
Preparar y coordinar el cierre de inventarios de vehículos y repuestos, asegurando la correcta determinación, validación y registro de los saldos de inventario al cierre de cada período.
Realizar conciliaciones relacionadas con los procesos de inventarios de vehículos y repuestos, validando la consistencia entre los registros operativos, los sistemas de inventario y los registros contables, así como identificar, analizar y gestionar oportunamente las diferencias y partidas pendientes.
Ejecutar controles y análisis sobre los movimientos de inventario, garantizando la trazabilidad, exactitud y razonabilidad de la información utilizada durante el proceso de cierre contable.
Preparar y analizar reportes recurrentes de acuerdo con los tiempos establecidos, proporcionando información confiable y oportuna para la revisión y análisis de los mercados.
Preparar estados financieros y reportes, de acuerdo con las políticas, procedimientos y requerimientos de auditoría, asegurando que la información entregada a los mercados y clientes sea completa, precisa y de calidad.
Atender requerimientos de auditoría relacionados con las cuentas de inventarios, proporcionando conciliaciones, análisis, soportes y demás información requerida dentro de los tiempos establecidos.

Spreetail propels brands to increase their ecommerce market share across the globe while improving their operational costs. Learn how we are building one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies in history: www.spreetail.com .

Spreetail is seeking a Senior Payables Analyst – Freight to join our Accounting team, where you will play a critical role in managing and scaling our freight payables operations within a fast-paced, high-growth environment. In this role, you will own key aspects of freight invoice processing, accruals, and reconciliation, partnering closely with Transportation, Logistics, Treasury, and FP&A to ensure accurate, timely recording of freight costs.

How You Will Achieve Success

Lead cross-functional process design and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen internal controls and scale with business complexity.
Own month-end close activities, including financial statement variance analysis, while identifying and executing process efficiencies.
Monitor credits and funds owed to Spreetail, partnering with Treasury on cash optimization and weekly payment processing.
Design and deliver reporting, metrics, and insights that drive issue resolution and improve financial outcomes.
Drive cross-functional issue resolution through clear communication, strong stakeholder partnerships, and a bottom-line mindset.

What Experiences Will Help You In This Role

Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field; industry certifications and/or graduate degree preferred.
3–5+ years of experience in accounting, finance, or a related business function with working knowledge of GAAP.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (used extensively), with experience leveraging analytics tools; SQL a plus.
Strong problem-solving and process-improvement mindset, with the ability to adapt in a fast-paced, changing environment.
Excellent organizational and stakeholder-management skills, able to prioritize competing initiatives and manage multiple projects.

This is a remote position and requires candidates to have an available work-from-home setup

Desktop/Laptop System Requirements

4th generation or higher, at least Intel i3 or equivalent processor;
at least 4GB RAM;
Windows 10 and above or MAC OSX operating system
You are required to provide your own dual monitors

A strong and stable internet connection (A DSL, cable or fiber wired internet service with 10 Mbps plan or higher for primary connection)

PC Headset

A high-definition (HD) external or integrated webcam with at least 720p resolution.

Please be aware of scammers.
Spreetail will only contact you through Lever or the spreetail.com domain. Spreetail will never ask candidates for money during the recruitment process. Please reach out to [email protected] directly if you have any concerns. Emails from @spreetailjobs.com are fraudulent.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
