jobs.title: Project Controller
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

We are one of the world's leading professional services firms, bringing together engineering, advisory, and science to create a positive impact. With more than 73,000 professionals across over 500 offices worldwide, we deliver projects in Mining, Transportation & Infrastructure, Buildings, Environment, Energy, Oil & Gas, and Energy Transition.
At WSP, we transform the built environment and protect the natural world. We foster innovation, value curiosity, and lead in sustainability through our ESG-driven approach and expertise in water and energy transition.
Imagine a better future. Build it with us.

Why Work at WSP?

At WSP, you will find an environment where you can think big, grow your career, and contribute to projects that make a real difference. Our purpose is to create sustainable environments that improve people's lives.
We are a collaborative, inclusive, and diverse organization where every individual brings unique value. We encourage fresh ideas, foster innovation, and provide equal opportunities for all candidates.
Are you ready to get started?
With us, you can.

Project Controller

WSP is seeking a Project Controller to join the Québec Buildings Team (ST-CI & M&E), providing financial and administrative support to Project Managers while contributing to the successful delivery of building projects.
Reporting to the Operations Coordinator, the successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring effective coordination between Operations, Finance, Accounting, Billing, and Accounts Receivable teams. This position is critical to maintaining financial integrity, supporting project performance, and contributing to projects that help shape the future of our communities.
Would you like to be part of a high-performing team and work on challenging projects? At WSP, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a dynamic and innovative environment while supporting impactful projects across Canada and beyond.

Why Choose WSP?

• We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging and are committed to maintaining it.
• Flexible work policy: We recognize the importance of work-life balance and support our employees in achieving it.
• A Canadian success story: We are proud to represent Canada and showcase its expertise around the world.
• Enhancing the world around us: From the environment to infrastructure and buildings, we contribute to the sustainable development of communities.
• Exceptional career opportunities: We continue to grow, embrace innovation, and pursue continuous improvement.
• We offer competitive compensation, flexible work arrangements, a strong organizational culture, and comprehensive employee benefits.

Key Responsibilities

• Ensure the accuracy, creation, maintenance, and ongoing updates of project-related data, including opportunities, projects, budgets, and revenue information.
• Provide support to the Project Management Office (PMO) in the use and administration of Oracle, including project setup, project modifications, and baseline resets.
• Identify variances between project costs and revenues and coordinate the implementation of corrective actions with relevant stakeholders.
• Prepare and maintain periodic project forecasts, including Estimate at Completion (EAC) and Estimate to Complete (ETC), in collaboration with Project Managers.
• Support Project Managers with financial and project control activities, complementing the work performed by Project Accountants and Finance teams.
• Participate in project change management processes and ensure proper financial impacts are reflected.
• Ensure the quality, consistency, and traceability of project financial information within corporate systems.
• Facilitate effective coordination between Operations, Finance, Billing, and other project stakeholders.
• Improve the flow, accessibility, and understanding of project financial information, serving as a key resource for project teams.
• Monitor project financial performance and prepare reports to support informed decision-making.
• Contribute to the successful achievement of project financial and operational objectives.

Qualifications

Education

• Technical Diploma, Associate Degree, Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent qualification in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
• Additional education or certifications in Project Controls, Financial Management, Project Management, or related disciplines will be considered an asset.
• Any equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.

Experience

• 5 to 10 years of experience in Project Controls, Project Financial Management, Cost Control, or Project Administration.
• Experience within the buildings, engineering, infrastructure, or construction industries.
• Strong experience in project budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and financial performance monitoring.
• Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders.

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of the building engineering and construction environment.
• Solid knowledge of Project Controls principles and methodologies.
• Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM).
• Knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and project financial reporting.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Experience with ERP systems, preferably Oracle.
• Experience preparing and managing EAC (Estimate at Completion) and ETC (Estimate to Complete) forecasts.
• Strong analytical and financial reporting capabilities.

Core Competencies

• Analytical thinking.
• Attention to detail.
• Results-oriented mindset.
• Teamwork and collaboration.
• Strong communication skills.
• Planning and organizational skills.
• Proactive and self-motivated approach.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Autonomy and commitment to quality work.
• Dynamic and positive attitude.

Languages

• Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.
• Advanced French proficiency, both written and spoken.
Any equivalent combination of education, experience, and qualifications demonstrating the ability to successfully perform the responsibilities of the role will be considered.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit your CV in English. We look forward to hearing from you.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Senior Financial Analyst to work directly with the Chief Financial Officer (CFO). In this role, you will play a critical part in guiding the financial strategy, operational analysis, and fiscal performance of our skilled nursing and long-term care facilities. The ideal candidate possesses deep experience in the healthcare sector—specifically within nursing home or post-acute care operations—and brings strong expertise in reimbursement models, census-driven financial analytics, and executive-level reporting.
Key Responsibilities

Executive Financial Analytics & Reporting:
Partner with the CFO to prepare comprehensive monthly, quarterly, and annual financial packages, board presentations, and executive summaries highlighting key performance indicators (KPIs).
Operational & Healthcare Analysis:

Orange Hands · Bogotá · Freelance during the financing phase; after a successful financing, a full-time position as Head of Finance & Investor Relations

Orange Hands is developing a campus for urban mining and circular construction in Bogotá. Residual and reclaimed wood becomes technically dried, calibrated construction timber and wood products with traceability; alongside, joinery (windows, doors) and interior fit-out. The framework is in place: concept, financial model and investor materials exist and are now being sharpened into their final version. PROFILE

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Finance

Job Sub Function

Finance Business Partners

Job Category

People Leader

All Job Posting Locations:

Bogotá, Distrito Capital, Colombia

Job Description

The Sr Finance Manager, CFM Corporate, Vision Care Americas and Surgical Vision Global
will lead the CFM and controllership agenda for Corporate, Vision Care Americas and Surgical Vision Global from Bogotá. This highly visible leadership role is accountable for the integrity of actuals, financial reporting excellence, and end-to-end close execution across a complex regional and global portfolio. As the senior authority on actuals, the leader partners with senior Finance stakeholders to drive strong governance, actionable insights, and informed business decisions. The role leads a senior finance organization, mobilizes the broader A2R and GSF network across the Americas, and drives operational excellence, risk mitigation, and the development of a scalable, high-performing finance organization.

Core Accountabilitie
s

Own controllership of actuals for the assigned portfolio and serve as the lead authority on financial results, ensuring accurate, complete, timely and decision-ready reporting under US GAAP and applicable company policies.
Lead the end-to-end close governance, including pre-close readiness, closing calendar execution, trial balance review, income statement and balance sheet reviews, cash flow analysis, risk assessment, financial commentary, BRAVO submissions and final close sign-off or green-light within the defined governance model.
Translate financial results into clear insights for Finance Directors, CFOs, FP&A and business leaders, explaining key drivers, identifying risks and opportunities, and recommending practical actions that protect financial integrity and improve business outcomes.
Act as the primary senior Global Services Finance partner for the assigned businesses, building trusted relationships and serving as the right hand to sector and regional Finance leadership on actuals, accounting, controls, reporting and transformation matters.
Lead through influence across A2R, GSF, FP&A, Business Unit Finance, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, Corporate Services and other process teams to resolve issues, clarify ownership, strengthen handoffs and deliver integrated end-to-end outcomes.
Establish disciplined risk and issue management, including early identification, materiality assessment, executive communication, root-cause analysis, remediation plans, clear accountability and follow-through to sustainable closure.
Maintain a strong control environment, ensure SOX compliance and audit readiness, and coordinate timely responses to internal and external audit requests and remediation actions.
Shape the future-state organization by defining capabilities, governance, ways of working, talent needs and scalable service-delivery practices, while protecting business continuity during transitions.
Drive simplification, standardization, automation and digital enablement across the portfolio, challenging legacy practices and converting improvement opportunities into implemented, sustainable solutions.
Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team, setting clear expectations, building technical and leadership capability, strengthening succession pipelines and fostering inclusion, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning.

Scope-Specific Mandat
e

For Corporate, oversee actuals and reporting for complex corporate and functional activities, including allocations, centrally managed costs, organizational changes, capital and other enterprise-level transactions or programs.
For Vision Care Americas, provide regional controllership and business partnership across markets, connecting commercial performance, working capital, inventory and local market considerations to reliable financial results.
For Surgical Vision Global, coordinate global close and reporting across regions, ensuring consistent consolidation inputs, visibility of global risks and opportunities, and effective interaction among regional finance teams, including shaping and improving the current operating model.
Lead high-quality balance-sheet, P&L, cash-flow and risk reviews tailored to each portfolio, and synthesize diverse issues into concise executive messages and prioritized action plans.
Support transformation and system deployments affecting Corporate and Vision businesses, ensuring that redesigned processes and reporting solutions preserve controls, data integrity and stakeholder usability.

Key Stakeholder Relationship
s

Corporate, Vision Care Americas and Surgical Vision global CFOs, Finance Directors, Controllers, BUF and FP&A leaders.
Regional and global A2R and GSF delivery teams, consolidation teams, CFM peers and process owners.
Corporate Reporting, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, Internal Audit and External Audit.
Commercial, supply-chain, capital, technology and transformation stakeholders relevant to each portfolio.

Leadership and Change Expectation
s

Demonstrate executive presence and communicate complex accounting and financial topics with clarity, confidence and appropriate judgment for senior audiences.
Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities across countries, functions and time zones, making sound decisions while balancing accuracy, speed, risk and stakeholder needs.
Lead organizational and process change with a structured, people-centered approach, helping teams and stakeholders understand the case for change, adopt new ways of working and sustain performance through transition.
Create an environment where team members understand the business, connect their work to enterprise outcomes, raise risks early and contribute ideas that improve the operating model.
Model integrity, accountability, inclusive leadership and constructive challenge, reinforcing a culture where issues are surfaced transparently and resolved collaboratively.
Support the evolution from a primarily CFM-focused model toward integrated CFM and Legal Entity controllership, bringing together management reporting, statutory and legal-entity perspectives where the future operating model requires it.
Help define the governance, role clarity, capability plan and transition roadmap required to integrate Legal Entity Controller responsibilities without weakening core CFM ownership of actuals or business partnership.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field required; postgraduate degree or MBA preferred.
CPA, CMA or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
Minimum 10 years of progressive finance experience, with significant depth in controllership, accounting, external or management reporting, financial analysis and complex matrix organizations.
At least 5 years of people-leadership experience, including demonstrated success developing managers and/or senior individual contributors and building high-performing teams.
Strong knowledge of US GAAP required; practical exposure to IFRS and/or local GAAP, statutory reporting, tax coordination and legal-entity accounting strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience supporting North American markets or senior North American stakeholders strongly preferred.
English proficiency at C1 level or equivalent, with the ability to lead executive meetings, negotiations and presentations and to produce clear, nuanced written communication.
Experience with SAP and enterprise financial reporting environments; and exposure to CFIN, BRAVO, TM1/EPM, BlackLine/Cadency, Power BI, Alteryx, UiPath or similar tools is an advantage.
Availability to collaborate across North American and global time zones and to travel domestically or internationally as business needs require.

Critical Capabilities

Controllership and technical accounting depth
Executive business partnering and stakeholder influence
Strategic thinking and organization shaping
Risk identification, judgment and decisive issue resolution
Financial storytelling and executive communication
People leadership, coaching and succession development
Cross-functional and cross-cultural leadership through influence
Transformation, change leadership and operating-model design
Process standardization, digital fluency and continuous improvement
Business acumen, intellectual curiosity and learning agility

Preferred Experience For This Portfolio

Experience managing a mixed portfolio spanning corporate functions, regional commercial businesses and global business units.
Strong background in global consolidation and cross-regional governance, with the ability to distinguish corporate, commercial and product-business drivers.
Knowledge of inventory, capital, allocations, intercompany, working capital and global reporting considerations is highly valued.

Success Profil
e

The successful candidate will combine the rigor of a controller, the perspective of a strategic finance partner and the leadership of an organization builder. This leader will be equally comfortable challenging an accounting conclusion, guiding a CFO through risks and opportunities, mobilizing multiple execution teams, developing talent and shaping a scalable future-state model from Bogotá.

jobs.description:
En Bia ya gestionamos la energía de más de 3.700 empresas en Latam. Y apenas estamos empezando. Si estás buscando más que un trabajo y quieres ser parte del equipo que está revolucionando el sector energético, llegaste al lugar correcto.

El desafío que vas a resolver

Buscamos a una persona que combine habilidad para negociar, criterio financiero y capacidad de ejecución para construir una parte clave de nuestro crecimiento.

Como Procurement & Financing Lead, tendrás el reto de desarrollar nuestros modelos de adquisición y financiación de equipos: decidir con quién compramos, bajo qué condiciones y cómo ofrecemos cada solución a nuestros clientes.

Trabajarás con los equipos técnico, comercial y financiero para convertir esas decisiones en modelos rentables, sostenibles y escalables. Negociarás con proveedores y aliados financieros, evaluarás alternativas y llevarás las iniciativas hasta su implementación.

Tus decisiones tendrán impacto directo en nuestro flujo de caja, la rentabilidad de cada cliente y la velocidad con la que podemos crecer.

Lo que harás

Definir la mejor solución para cada cliente, junto con los equipos técnico y comercial, equilibrando necesidades operativas, valor para el cliente y costo.
Desarrollar y gestionar proveedores nacionales e internacionales, liderando procesos de cotización, selección y negociación. Coordinar las importaciones con agentes de carga y aduana cuando corresponda.
Negociar condiciones de compra que protejan la caja, como plazos de pago, consignación, periodos de gracia, pagos contra instalación, descuentos por volumen y garantías.
Estructurar alternativas de financiación con bancos, compañías de leasing y renting, fintechs y fabricantes, alineando sus condiciones con los contratos de nuestros clientes.
Evaluar el impacto financiero de cada alternativa, junto con Finanzas: flujo de caja, resultados, balance, costo total y recuperación de la inversión por cliente.
Diseñar las modalidades de adquisición y cobro, definiendo cómo se presentan en la oferta comercial y qué ocurre con los equipos cuando termina el contrato.
Negociar la contratación de servicios para la operación, incluyendo instalación, mantenimiento, software, conectividad, transporte y bodegas, con tarifas y niveles de servicio claros.
Incorporar herramientas de IA para investigar proveedores, comparar propuestas, apoyar el análisis financiero y automatizar tareas de seguimiento, validando la información para sustentar decisiones.
Llevar las iniciativas de principio a fin, coordinando a los equipos técnico, comercial, financiero y legal, con hitos, responsables y seguimiento.

Lo que necesitarás

Formación profesional en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas, Finanzas, Economía o áreas afines.

Experiencia negociando directamente con proveedores y gestionando contratos de montos relevantes para el negocio.
Capacidad para modelar y comparar alternativas considerando flujo de caja, costo total de propiedad y retorno de la inversión.
Conocimiento práctico de leasing, renting y condiciones de financiación o pago con proveedores.
Experiencia elaborando o revisando condiciones comerciales y contractuales.
Manejo avanzado de Excel o herramientas de análisis.
Experiencia usando herramientas de IA para resolver tareas de negocio, analizar información o mejorar procesos, con criterio para verificar sus resultados.
Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de negociación, sustentar decisiones con datos y coordinar varias iniciativas en paralelo.

No buscamos empleados que esperen instrucciones. Buscamos personas que se muevan rápido, propongan antes de preguntar y se apropien del resultado de principio a fin.

El cargo requiere experiencia sólida en cost control, cost coding, WBS, estimaciones de costos, reporting y sistemas ERP, particularmente SAP, además de capacidad para trabajar en ambientes de proyectos de alta complejidad.

Liderar el proceso de control y seguimiento de costos de proyectos mineros, comparando presupuesto aprobado, costos reales, costos comprometidos y forecast.
Preparar y mantener el Cost Forecast del proyecto, identificando tendencias, desviaciones, riesgos y oportunidades de ahorro.
Analizar variaciones entre Budget vs. Actual vs. Committed vs. Forecast, identificando sus causas y proponiendo acciones correctivas.
Desarrollar y mantener estructuras de Cost Coding y asegurar la correcta asignación de costos a los diferentes niveles de WBS (Work Breakdown Structure).
Participar en la preparación y revisión de estimaciones de costos, asegurando que los costos estén correctamente codificados y asignados al WBS correspondiente.
Controlar la correcta imputación de costos provenientes de contratos, órdenes de compra, servicios, materiales, mano de obra, equipos y otros componentes del proyecto.
Elaborar reportes de costos con diferentes niveles de segmentación, incluyendo:
WBS.
Áreas / disciplinas.
Paquetes de trabajo.
Contratos y órdenes de compra.
Centros de costo.
Categorías de gasto.
Preparar reportes ejecutivos de cost performance, variaciones y forecast para Project Management y stakeholders.
Identificar tempranamente desviaciones respecto al presupuesto y generar análisis de tendencias para anticipar impactos futuros.
Coordinar con las áreas de Project Controls, Procurement, Contracts, Engineering, Construction, Finance y Project Management para asegurar la integridad de la información de costos.
Asegurar la consistencia entre la información de costos del proyecto, el presupuesto, compromisos contractuales y la información registrada en SAP.

jobs.title: INTERNAL CONTROL SPECIALIST RBS
jobs.description:
We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection, and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality, and integrity. Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer, and more interconnected world.

Descripción del empleo

The Internal Control Specialist
is a key contributor role within the SGS North America (NAM) region, reporting directly to the NAM VP of Finance Operations, and informally to the NAM Risk Management & Internal Control (RM&IC) Manager. In this position, you will be responsible for handling Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICoFR) and Enterprise Risk Management initiatives in the region. You will facilitate the preparation of centralized key control documentation and analysis, for control owners review and approval. You will prepare self-assessments of centralized controls and assist with the planning and preparation of self-assessments by business unit Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) for de-centralized controls, to ensure:

Control activities, processes, and procedures comply with group and local requirements and regulations.
The adequacy of control design and operation addresses the underlying risks and assertions.
Recommendations for improvements align with best-practices and leverage organizational synergies wherever possible.
Control and process deficiencies are remediated in a timely and effective manner.

This position will also be responsible for assisting in the administration of other compliance requirements including, but not limited to, the annual Management Risk Assessment and the monitoring/updates of the regional Grants of Authority, with guidance from the RM&IC Manager.

Responsibilities

Ensure the implementation and operation of effective ICOFR and Risk Management processes within SGS NAM, along with respective Local Process/Risk Owners, Finance Directors/Business Controllers, SMEs, and Internal Control Owners.
Maintain clear/adequate Risk Control Matrix (RCMs)/ICOFR framework for NAM, and documentation, together with the local SMEs, Finance Directors/Business Controllers, and Internal Control Owners, based on end-to-end business processes, aligned with the respective local process.
Implement risk management framework tailored to the specific needs and objectives of the SGS operations; perform risk assessment process within the required scope, ensure mitigating measures are properly defined and timely implemented.
Collaborate as a business partner and trusted advisor for Local Process/Risk Owners, Finance Directors/Business Controllers, and SMEs, Control Owners and Action Owners, and other local stakeholders within NAM, on internal control and risk-related matters.
Provide practical guidance and recommendations, and cooperate with Local Process Owners, Finance Directors, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, External Audit, and other internal and external stakeholders; foster a culture of risk awareness and accountability.
Promote ICOFR best practices, internal control harmonization, automation, digital solutions, and data analytics for a highly sustainable control environment; build strong cooperation with Internal Audit, Local Process Owners, IT, and local employees engaged in internal controls.
Ensure effective application, maintenance and continuous development of Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) system. Provide guidance and administer efficient usage of the GRC system in NAM region.
Collaborate and coordinate with the RM&IC Manager on other related projects and initiatives.

Specific Responsibilities

Ensure timely and complete planning and execution of centralized and de-centralized ICOFR activities.
Prepare, and report on, ICOFR design and operating effectiveness self-assessments (ToDs and ToEs) for NAM business units, as well as the business risks assessment, using GRC system.
Assist with, and independently validate, SME completion of ICOFR ToDs and ToEs for de-centralized controls.
Ensure and monitor adequate Risk Management mitigating measures are in place to address the identified risks in the region and respective countries.
Establish, implement, and monitor remediation action plans to close deficiencies and gaps, incorporating synergetic, constructive, and practical feedback and improvement recommendations.
Prepare regular and ad hoc management reports and executive summaries, in cooperation with the RM&IC, to the attention of the governing bodies within NAM.
Assist in providing ICOFR and Risk Management training to local organizations and their employees.
Prepare monthly management review controls, and testing, over Unbilled Revenues and Work-in-Progress balances (significant accounting estimates), for review and approval by the NAM Finance Directors.
Review and update Grant of Authority (GOA) documents for all NAM business units and functions, with input from the Finance Directors; adjust system user access, approval levels, and approval management engine rules accordingly.
Perform and document quarterly Segregation of Duties (SOD) control activities over system access violations, resolutions, and mitigating control activities, as per SOD principles, with input from Finance Directors and other local stakeholders.
Support action owners in the resolution of internal and external audit inquiries, requests, findings, and Management Letter comments.
Apply judgment and act according to the SGS standards of ethics and integrity, and compliance with SGS regulations and principles, and relevant laws and regulations.
Perform other duties and engage in other projects, initiatives, due diligence, and tasks, when required by management.

Requisitos

Qualifications

At least 5 years of combined internal control, risk management, external/internal audit, and/or finance experience. Experience in a Big Four will be a strong plus.
Practical knowledge in designing/implementing internal control frameworks, testing internal controls, risk assessment methodologies and regulatory requirements, familiarity with data analytics, CAAT, and knowledge of COSO.
Qualified accountant (ACA, CPA, CIA or similar), university degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field.

It works with the business to directly drive planning efforts, identify business drivers, and develop the bottom-up budget and forecast. We are a strong 100+ member team (finance professionals) in multiple markets.

Manage the financial close process through the analysis of customer-level variances against budget, forecasts, prior year actuals, encompassing volume, revenue, customer and Rebates & Incentives.
Review and provide thoughtful business-driven commentary to Customer Planning Finance management team.
Develop the customer-level annual plan / budget and monthly forecast / O&Rs.
Create and maintain standardized, as well as customized, financial reporting packages that will help drive and support the business, inclusive of customer metrics / KPIs and revenue generation initiatives. Identify and communicate revenue risks and opportunities and review and respond promptly to ad-hoc requests for information and analysis.
Drive Mastercard strategic plans by providing relevant customer-level financial analytics and business insights to key stakeholders, while developing robust tracking mechanisms.
Develop periodic and ad-hoc financial insights for U.S. customer account teams.
Execute on financial process improvements by building and maintaining financial tools to perform analysis and modeling.
Leverage automation and AI to create more efficient methods of delivering insights to business stakeholders.

All About You

Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Language - Fluent English Speaker

High intellect with good commercial acumen and a creative approach to problem solving.
Ambitious, highly driven and motivated.

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

. In this role, you will support the implementation of an IT Financial Management tool. Responsibilities include financial and resource planning, IT cost optimization, promotion of operational excellence, and the achievement and measurement of strategic objectives.

Collaborate with Product Teams to ensure consistency between Product operating methodologies, prioritization decisions, and budget allocation across RUN, GROW, and TRANSFORM initiatives.
Support governance processes related to prioritization and funding decisions, ensuring consistency with approved budget frameworks.
Prepare executive reports and dashboards on budget execution, investment performance, and cost transparency to support decision-making.
Provide data-driven analysis to support senior management in investment prioritization and resource allocation decisions.

Financial Management & ITFM Implementation

Support the implementation and adoption of the IT Financial Management (ITFM) tool to improve cost transparency, funding allocation, and financial decision-making across products.
Assist in the preparation, allocation, and monitoring of Capital and Administrative budgets, providing relevant financial analysis and insights, including the preparation of investment proposals while ensuring integrity, consistency, and strategic alignment.
Monitor the use of financial resources, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and tracking the value generated by investments.

Education: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent advanced degree) in Business Administration, Computer Science, or other fields relevant to the responsibilities of the role.

Fully remote modality.  
Development support: We offer learning opportunities to boost your professional profile, such as seminars, 1:1 professional counseling, and much more.

Job Description

The Investment Management Analyst/Associate will support the origination, analysis, execution, and monitoring of debt and hybrid finance investments across Latin America, with a primary focus on financial institutions, including banks, non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs), and other financial intermediaries. 

This is a hands-on role requiring strong analytical capabilities, financial modelling skills, and the ability to support multiple transaction workstreams simultaneously. The successful candidate will contribute throughout the investment lifecycle, from transaction screening and due diligence to execution and portfolio monitoring, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams across Finance in Motion. 

The position is well suited for a high-performing professional with approximately 3-5 years of relevant experience in investment banking, corporate finance, investment management, credit analysis, or financial institutions analysis. 

English is the company’s working language. Portuguese proficiency is highly desirable given the team's significant exposure to Brazil. 

Key responsibilities:

Transaction Structuring, Execution & Monitoring 
Conduct financial and credit analysis of prospective clients and investment opportunities, with a focus on financial institutions. 
Support the assessment of debt capacity and capital structure for senior, subordinated, and hybrid debt instruments. 
Build and maintain financial models, including cash flow projections, sensitivity analyses, and stress-testing scenarios. 
Prepare investment memoranda, credit proposals, financial analyses, and term sheets for internal approval processes. 
Coordinate due diligence activities across legal, financial, ESG/I&S, AML, and risk workstreams. 
Support transaction negotiation and closing processes in coordination with internal teams, external advisors, and counterparties.

Market & Sector Analysis 
Conduct market, sector, and company research across Latin America, with particular emphasis on banking and financial services sectors.
Monitor macroeconomic, regulatory, and industry developments relevant to investment opportunities and portfolio risk assessment.
Analyze financial statements, business models, and key risk drivers of potential and existing clients.

  Stakeholder Engagement & Internal Coordination 
Coordinate with internal stakeholders including legal, ESG/I&S, risk, AML, portfolio management, and structuring teams. 
Support interactions with clients, co-investors, technical advisors, and external service providers. 
Contribute to the preparation of materials and presentations for Investment Committees and other internal governance forums.

Portfolio Monitoring & Reporting 
Monitor portfolio investments, including financial performance, covenant compliance, and risk developments. 
Support the preparation of periodic portfolio reviews, credit monitoring reports, and investor reporting. 
Assist in identifying and escalating material risks or performance issues within the portfolio.

What we expect:

Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline. 
Approximately 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in investment banking, investment management, corporate finance, private credit, commercial banking, or financial institutions analysis. 
Solid understanding of financial statement analysis, credit analysis, and financial modelling. 
Experience analyzing banks, NBFIs, or other financial institutions is strongly preferred. 
Exposure to debt structuring, capital markets, lending products, or project finance is an advantage. 
Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish. 
High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a proactive mindset. 
Willingness to travel within Latin America as required.

Other Desired Skills & Experience 
Master's degree in finance or other professional qualification (e.g. CFA) is a plus.
Portuguese language proficiency is highly desirable.
Ability to work independently in a multicultural, international, and fast-paced environment.
Strong interpersonal skills and cultural sensitivity.

What you can expect:
An agile, widely diverse international working environment of around 70 nationalities that is keenly interested in making a positive difference through their work and who share a collaborative, can-do spirit.
A job that allows you to fully utilize and expand your skills within an innovative, hands-on company culture.
A purpose-driven, performance-oriented company that rewards above-average results.
An organization dedicated to providing effective training and upskilling to its employees.
A company that offers a flexible and amicable work environment, placing a high value on work-life balance.

We, a team of over 300 dedicated professionals across 15 regional offices worldwide, are committed to advancing sustainable development through pioneering finance solutions. If you relish tackling complex challenges hands-on and crave an adaptable and motivating work environment, we're eager to connect with you.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis

Overview

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

The Financial Planning & Analysis function manages all aspects of management reporting encompassing budgeting and forecasting, strategic and customer planning. This includes the management and execution of the corporate reporting and planning requirements

This Sr Analyst position is responsible across a broad spectrum of strategic processes and initiatives while managing and executing the corporate reporting and planning requirements for LAC region

About Business Finance Center (BFC)

BFC provides Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) expertise to the organization by compiling and analysing metrics, identifying trends and problems, communicating information to relevant groups and recommending actions to improve financial performance. It works with business directly drive planning efforts, identify business drivers, and develop the bottom-up budget and forecast. It also helps business in standard, ad hoc reporting, and key performance indicators (KPIs) each period for the business and finance management and also helping to provide decision support to business teams as needed. We are a strong 100+ member team (finance professionals) based out of Gurgaon, India and now expanding into Bogota, Colombia

Role

Support the financial close process through the analysis of variances against budget, forecasts, prior year actuals, key business drivers and initiatives. Review and provide thoughtful business driven commentary to respective management teams
Support the development of the annual plan/budget and forecast for scheduled cycle. Also be responsible for ensuring accurate data upload into Hyperion budgeting and forecasting tool
Manage, develop and update standardized financial reporting packages that will help drive and support the business, inclusive of business metrics/KPIs. Also identify and communicate revenue risks and opportunities and review and respond promptly to ad-hoc requests for information and analysis

Finance in Motion is seeking an experienced investment professional to join its Latin America Investment Management team. The role focuses on originating, structuring, executing, and monitoring corporate debt investments across the region, with a particular focus on agribusiness, sustainable agriculture, aquaculture, renewable energy, and energy transition sectors. The role combines business development, transaction execution, portfolio management, and active engagement with clients and stakeholders across Latin America.

The successful candidate will bring strong corporate finance, credit analysis, structuring, and negotiation capabilities, together with sound commercial judgment and a demonstrated ability to manage complex transactions from origination through execution and portfolio supervision. Experience in restructurings, workouts, reschedulings, and special situations is highly valued.

Job Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Originate and develop new investment opportunities across Latin America, leveraging existing networks and building relationships with corporates, sponsors, financial institutions, advisors, and other market participants.
Structure, negotiate, and execute corporate debt transactions, including senior debt, subordinated debt, structured credit, sustainability-linked financing, and other bespoke financing solutions tailored to client needs.
Lead financial analysis, due diligence, credit assessment, cash flow modeling, and transaction structuring, working closely with internal and external stakeholders throughout the investment process.
Prepare investment memoranda, transaction proposals, and presentations for internal decision-making committees, articulating key risks, mitigants, and investment rationale.
Take an active role in negotiating commercial terms, financing structures, covenant packages, collateral arrangements, and legal documentation with clients and counterparties.
Monitor portfolio investments and proactively manage client relationships, identifying emerging risks and opportunities while supporting the long-term growth of portfolio companies.
Support portfolio management activities, including amendments, waivers, refinancings, restructurings, reschedulings, and other special situations when required.
Collaborate closely with legal, ESG, risk, compliance, treasury, and portfolio management teams throughout the full transaction lifecycle.
Contribute to sector and market intelligence efforts, particularly across agribusiness, sustainable agriculture, aquaculture, renewable energy, and energy transition sectors.
Mentor junior team members and contribute to the continued development of the regional investment platform and investment processes.

What we expect:

Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline. Master’s degree in finance or professional qualifications (e.g. CFA) is a plus.
7+ years of relevant experience in investment management, corporate banking, investment banking, private credit, structured finance, project finance, development finance, or related fields.
Proven experience originating, structuring, negotiating, and executing corporate debt transactions.
Strong financial modeling, credit analysis, and corporate finance skills.
Experience working with corporate borrowers across Latin America.
Experience with restructurings, special situations, distressed credits, or portfolio remediation is a strong advantage.
Sector experience in agribusiness, aquaculture, forestry, renewable energy, infrastructure, or related sectors is preferred.
Experience working with DFIs, impact investors, commercial banks, investment banks, or private credit funds is desirable.

jobs.title: ANALYTICS CONSULTANT
jobs.description:
Company Description

Experian es una empresa global de datos y tecnología que impulsa oportunidades para personas y negocios en todo el mundo. Ayudamos a redefinir prácticas de préstamos, descubrir y prevenir el fraude, simplificar la atención médica, crear soluciones de marketing y obtener perspectivas más profundas del mercado automotriz, todo utilizando nuestra combinación única de datos, análisis y software. También asistimos a millones de personas a alcanzar sus metas financieras y ayudarles a ahorrar tiempo y dinero.

Operamos en una variedad de mercados, desde servicios financieros hasta atención médica, automotriz, agroindustria, seguros y muchos otros segmentos industriales.

Invertimos en personas y nuevas tecnologías avanzadas para desbloquear el poder de los datos. Como empresa del índice FTSE 100, cotizada en la Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN), contamos con un equipo de 22,500 personas en 32 países. Nuestra sede corporativa está en Dublín, Irlanda. Obtenga más información en experianplc.com.

Job Description

Descripción del trabajo

Reporta directamente al Gerente de Consultoría Analítica y colabora estrechamente con el profesional de desarrollo de modelos analítico, el equipo de Analítica Avanzada, consultoría de negocio, desarrollo de negocios, el área comercial, gestión de proyectos y plataformas tecnológicas. Tiene exposición directa tanto con clientes internos como externos y actúa como puente entre negocio, regulación y analítica. Es responsable de los proyectos de principio a fin: entendimiento de la necesidad, preparación de datos, evaluación de datos, diseño metodológico, desarrollo, validación, documentación, presentación, transferencia (capacitación), implementación, validación y certificación de modelos estadísticos.

Dentro De Los Propósitos Del Cargo Se Encuentran

ü Acompañar a nuestros clientes en el desarrollo de soluciones analíticas a la medida como lo pueden ser desarrollar, calibrar, validar y monitorear modelos de pérdida esperada, modelos de puntaje, segmentaciones, estudios personalizados, políticas de decisión, proyecciones macroeconómicas, sistemas de provisiones y demás necesidades analíticas que presentan las entidades asociadas a Experian en el día a día.

ü Guiar, desarrollar y validar los desarrollos hechos por los colaboradores de la fábrica orientados a dar solución a diversas necesidades alrededor del ciclo de crédito (originación, mantenimiento y cobranza) de nuestros clientes, desde un punto de vista critico en términos analíticos y conocimiento de negocio dependiendo del tipo de proyecto asignado.

ü Implementar mecanismos de control en cada fase del desarrollo para asegurar la calidad de los entregables, ya sea en procesos de revisión interna o en interacciones con clientes. Por ejemplo, controles de calidad sobre datos, supuestos, código, resultados, documentación y presentaciones; asegurando reproducibilidad, trazabilidad y coherencia entre entregables.

ü Plantear metodologías regionales y productos genéricos, acompañando el desarrollo y mantenimiento de forma que se validen todos los supuestos estadísticos y de negocio para el buen comportamiento de las soluciones de acuerdo con su mercado garantizando la aceptación de nuestros clientes.

ü Generar análisis innovadores, explicables, estables e implementables que apoyen decisiones de negocio y consoliden al especialista como referente técnico y consultivo del equipo que generen valor para la organización y sus clientes.

ü Integrar, de acuerdo con las políticas organizacionales, herramientas de inteligencia artificial para mejorar la productividad, impulsar la innovación y fortalecer la calidad del análisis, la programación, la documentación, la automatización y la preparación de entregables; involucrando el juicio profesional, los controles metodológicos, legales, de cumplimiento y de riesgo aplicables.

Responsabilidades Del Cargo

ü Dirigir, desarrollar, validar, calibrar y monitorear soluciones analíticas genéricas o a la medida asegurando la calidad y precisión de los entregables. Por ejemplo, modelos de pérdida esperada, provisiones, prospectiva macroeconómica, originación, gestión de cartera, cobranza, recuperación y fraude.

ü Diseñar metodologías estadísticas, econométricas o de aprendizaje automático adecuadas al problema, justificando supuestos, variables, métricas, muestras, horizontes y tratamientos aplicados.

ü Elaboración de entregables estratégicos alineados con los objetivos del cliente y orientados la toma de decisiones en conjunto con el equipo de Experian y sus clientes.

ü Presentación de resultados en modalidad presencial o virtual a audiencias técnicas, de negocio y directivas traduciendo hallazgos cuantitativos en implicaciones y recomendaciones accionables; asegurando una comunicación clara, profesional y alineada con los estándares de la compañía.

ü Asegurar el cumplimiento de tiempos de entrega hacia nuestros clientes manteniendo los estándares de calidad.

ü Asegurar revisiones técnicas y controles sobre consistencia de datos, lógica de cálculo, código, resultados, documentación y trazabilidad entre insumos y estimaciones (salidas).

ü Colaborar en la construcción de diversos productos genéricos que tienen una alta carga estadística.

ü Liderar y orientar al equipo de desarrollo en la construcción de soluciones analíticas, promoviendo la transferencia de conocimiento y la aplicación de metodologías efectivas.

ü Gestionar simultáneamente proyectos y requerimientos de distintos contextos, priorizando actividades y adaptando soluciones sin perder consistencia metodológica regional.

ü Innovar en el uso de nuevas metodologías estadísticas que permitan mejores indicadores en los diferentes modelos estadísticos que se desarrollan.

ü Automatización de procesos repetitivos y construir componentes reutilizables para optimizar los tiempos de entrega y mejorar la calidad de los entregables ofrecidos a nuestros clientes.

ü Documentar de forma suficiente las decisiones metodológicas, limitaciones, riesgos de uso, resultados, recomendaciones y trabajo futuro de modo que la solución pueda ser reproducida, auditada, mantenida y mejorada.

ü Gestionar y hacer uso responsable de herramientas de inteligencia artificial como apoyo al desarrollo de proyectos analíticos de conformidad con las políticas y los lineamientos vigentes de la organización sobre inteligencia artificial. Esto incluye la protección de información personal, confidencial y restringida, mantener la supervisión y validación humana, asegurar la trazabilidad de su uso, evaluar la exactitud, pertinencia y posibles sesgos de los resultados.

Qualifications

Calificaciones

Profesional en estadística, ciencias de la computación, matemática, actuaría, economía, finanzas, ingeniería industrial o áreas afines con formación sólida en estadística, probabilidad, econometría y análisis de datos; así como conocimientos básicos en finanzas o riesgos financieros. Se valora especialización o maestría en estadística, ciencia de datos, econometría, riesgos financieros, finanzas cuantitativas o campos relacionados.
Experiencia de mínimo tres años en áreas analíticas orientadas al riesgo de crédito, servicios financieros o consultoría analítica. Debe demostrar participación en el desarrollo, validación y monitoreo de modelos estadísticos y de aprendizaje de máquina, en la elaboración de entregables para clientes y gestión simultánea de actividades.
Nivel de programación intermedio-alto en Python; elementos básicos en SQL, Spark, R Project o Julia. Conocimiento de modelos supervisados y no supervisados como: series de tiempo, clustering, segmentación, regresión, árboles de decisión, técnicas de clasificación, aprendizaje automático, validación y monitoreo de modelos. Experiencia en calidad de datos, pruebas, control de versiones, automatización y visualización.
Conocimiento sobre el ciclo de crédito, productos financieros, análisis de morosidad, cosechas, matrices de transición, recuperaciones, pérdida esperada, provisiones contables o regulatorias, prospectiva macroeconómica, gobierno de modelos y protección de datos. Debe tener capacidad para comprender y aplicar particularidades normativas de distintos sectores, contextos y países de América Latina.
Gestión y trabajo en equipo, capacidad para ejecutar varios proyectos al mismo tiempo, excelentes habilidades comunicativas efectivas (oral y escrita), pensamiento crítico, rigor cuantitativo, orientación consultiva, comprensión de negocio, gestión de proyectos, priorización, autonomía, negociación, liderazgo funcional, autogestión, cumplimiento y oportunidad, negociación con clientes y stakeholders, mentoría, orientación al resultado con altos estándares de calidad.
Inglés intermedio: B2 en adelante

Additional Information

Nuestra singularidad es que celebramos eso que nos hace diferentes. La cultura y el personal de Experian son elementos diferenciadores clave. Nos tomamos muy en serio nuestra agenda de personas y nos centramos en lo que realmente importa: DEI, conciliación de la vida laboral y personal, desarrollo, autenticidad, compromiso, colaboración, bienestar, recompensa y reconocimiento, voluntariado... y la lista continúa. El sólido enfoque de Experian, en el que las personas son lo primero, ha sido premiado: Great Place To Work™ en 24 países, FORTUNE Best Companies to work y Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globalmente 4,4 estrellas), por nombrar algunos. Eche un vistazo a Experian Life en las redes sociales o a nuestro sitio de empleo para entender por qué.

Experian se enorgullece de ser una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y acción positiva. La innovación es una parte fundamental del ADN y las prácticas de Experian, y la diversidad de nuestra fuerza laboral impulsa nuestro éxito. Todo el mundo puede tener éxito en Experian y aportar todo de sí independientemente de su género, etnia, religión, color, sexualidad, capacidad física o edad. Si tiene alguna discapacidad o necesidad especial que requiera adaptaciones, por favor háganoslo saber lo antes posible.

We are seeking a Senior Business Operations Specialist to serve as the operational backbone of the firm. This is a hybrid seat—part Business Operations Lead and part Controller.

Reporting to the Chief of Staff and partnering closely with the Head of Operations, you will manage people operations, maintain operational cadences, and coordinate cross-functional work. Crucially, you will carry an equal load on the finance and fund operations side: managing company finances, reviewing NAVs, supporting fund launches, and serving as the first line of contact for investor inquiries. Because roughly half of this role is financial, a strong accounting foundation is essential.

What makes this seat different: You won't just run our existing processes—you will master our software systems, optimize them for efficiency, and build AI agents and automations that run routine tasks for you. We want a high-ownership operator who continuously turns manual tasks into automated workflows and measures the hours handed back to the team.

Culture & Team Environment

We operate a flat, team-first environment where transparency, rigorous thinking, and healthy debate are core to our success. Ideas win on merit rather than seniority. We keep our team small and agile, ensuring everyone stays close to the work while offering a clear trajectory to expanded leadership responsibilities as the platform scales.

performance reports

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.

Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

This role is focused on Jeeves’s growth programs and emerging revenue channels — including our partnerships channel and new market expansion initiatives — where we need rigorous, scalable analytics to match the pace of growth.

You’ll be responsible for the analytical layer that connects our sales activity to revenue outcomes: building the dashboards our leadership relies on, maintaining shared responsibility for the integrity of our performance data, and proactively surfacing the insights that shape how we operate. You’ll work closely with the Head of Revenue Operations and contribute meaningfully to planning and review cycles alongside GTM leadership.

The pace here is real. Priorities shift, timelines compress, and the ground moves under your feet — not occasionally, but constantly. We need someone who is energized by that, not worn down. You won’t wait for someone to tell you what to look at. You’ll already know.

Key Responsibilities

GTM Analytics & Growth Program Insights

Build and maintain Tableau dashboards tracking performance across our partnerships channel and new growth initiatives — serving audiences from country leads to executive leadership.
Analyze conversion rates, pipeline health, ramp trends, and revenue attainment across programs and segments, surfacing patterns before they become decisions that have already been made.
Come with a point of view. When a program is underperforming or a trend shifts, bring an interpretation and a recommendation (not just a chart).
Support quarterly and annual GTM business reviews with structured analysis: cohort breakdowns, market-level benchmarks, and forward-looking indicators.

Revenue Planning & Target Analysis

Contribute to GTM capacity planning and quota-setting cycles — modeling scenarios, building attainment reports, and stress-testing assumptions before plans are finalized.
Maintain performance-against-target reporting for growth programs and emerging channels: track attainment, flag outliers early, and ensure data is always reconciled.
Support variable compensation analysis for relevant programs — running calculations, auditing for accuracy, and partnering with Finance to ensure payouts are correct and timely.
Build and maintain data structures that support reliable rolling forecasts for new and high-growth segments.

AI-Driven Operations & Scale

Use AI tools, including Claude and other frontier models, as active parts of your workflow: automating repetitive reporting tasks, accelerating data synthesis, and building scalable analytical programs that would otherwise require a much larger team.
Identify RevOps processes that can be operationalized or significantly improved through AI, and take ownership of building those solutions, not just flagging the opportunity.
Apply AI-assisted analysis to extract insights at scale from large, multi-source datasets: pipeline signals, rep activity, customer behavior, and market trends.
Help establish Jeeves’s AI-first approach to RevOps as a model for how the broader GTM team operates.

Data Quality & Systems Integration

Share responsibility for data quality across our revenue stack (HubSpot CRM, Tableau, and financial systems), conducting audits for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Connect disparate data sources (CRM, marketing automation, financial tools, and proprietary revenue data) so that reporting on growth programs is unified and trustworthy.
Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic so the team works from a shared understanding of what we’re measuring and why.

Stakeholder Partnership

Develop enough context on our GTM motion to contribute meaningfully in planning and pipeline review cycles alongside sales leadership, bringing data that drives decisions, not just awareness.
Serve as a reliable analytical resource to the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM leadership: scope requests clearly, pull the data, and return clear answers quickly.
Identify process gaps and proactively propose improvements to how we collect, manage, and act on GTM data (especially across new and growing channels).

What We’re Looking For

Technical & Analytical Skills

Tableau mastery: able to write complex calculated fields, build multi-source dashboards, and design views for diverse audiences from reps to the C-suite.
Advanced Excel and Google Sheets: complex formulas, pivot tables, and financial modeling — you reach for the right tool for the job, not just the most impressive one.
Strong SQL skills: you can get to an answer independently without waiting for a data engineer to pull it for you.
Data integration experience: comfortable connecting CRM, marketing automation, and financial data into unified reporting environments.
Business metrics fluency: deep understanding of conversion rates, customer lifetime value (LTV), pipeline coverage, ramp curves, revenue attainment, and customer health.
Data modeling: able to design clean structures that support accurate forecasting, compensation analysis, and multi-region rollups.

AI Fluency (Required, Not Optional)

You actively use AI tools, Claude Copilot/Code, or equivalent, as part of your day-to-day workflow, not as a novelty.
You’ve used AI to automate reporting pipelines, accelerate analysis, or build operational programs that scale beyond what a single analyst could do manually.
You’re curious about where AI can go next in RevOps and you bring ideas, not just execution.

Soft Skills & Ways of Working

Hungry and driven: you want to build something generational, and you bring the energy and output to match. You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else will hold you to.
Thrives in high-velocity environments: you’re not just comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities — you’re energized by them. You find a way through, not a reason to wait.
High agency: you don’t wait for a ticket. You’re already thinking about what the data might be missing or what question leadership will ask next week.
Sharp communicator: your outputs — whether a Slack message, a Tableau dashboard, or a business review slide — are concise, structured, and ready for a senior audience.
Strong time management: you’re comfortable managing multiple live workstreams, setting expectations on timelines, and delivering reliably under pressure.
Low ego and collaborative: Jeeves is building something ambitious across complex markets. You’re here to make the whole team better, not just your function.

Qualifications

2–4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, or a related GTM-adjacent role.
Hands-on Tableau experience is required. You should be able to demonstrate dashboards you’ve built from scratch.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.
Experience working with CRM data (HubSpot preferred) and connecting it to downstream reporting.
Exposure to incentive compensation modeling, quota attainment reporting, or variable pay analysis is strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Science, or a related field.
Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is preferred.

Nice to Have

Experience in B2B fintech, payments, corporate banking, or expense management.
Familiarity with multi-currency, multi-region revenue reporting.
Experience building or improving compensation and quota-tracking systems end-to-end.
Background in channel partnerships, broker networks, or indirect sales models.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
The chance to work on analytically complex problems across 3+ continents and multiple currencies — at a company moving fast enough that your work actually changes things.
A lean team that uses AI first, moves with urgency, and trusts you to own your domain from day one.
Direct exposure to senior RevOps and GTM leadership.
A culture that values output, curiosity, and honest feedback over hierarchy — and that genuinely believes it’s building something that matters.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Parkway Capital, headquartered in Baltimore, MD, with additional offices in Boston, MA is a SBIC-licensed private equity firm providing debt and equity to companies in the United States, with a particular focus on those that are headquartered from the Rocky Mountains to the East Coast. Since its launch in 2000, Parkway has invested over $540 million across 75+ companies.

Parkway distinguishes itself in the market by its creative capital solutions - investing both subordinated debt and equity in lower middle market companies, its experience investing over multiple business cycles and its bench of operating partners. Parkway looks to back outstanding management teams and equity sponsors in niche manufacturing, business services, industrial service, value-added distribution and healthcare services companies. Parkway can invest up to $12.5 million per company and targets businesses with $10 to $75million of revenue and $2 to $10 million of EBITDA at the time of investment.

Position Summary

Parkway is seeking to hire an Analyst/Associate with 1-5 years of post-undergraduate experience to be an integral member of our growing team. As an important member of the investment team, you will play a key role in the investment process, where you will be responsible for evaluating new investments, underwriting and structuring investments, supporting the due diligence process and ongoing monitoring of portfolio companies.

You will work closely with the firm’s Partners, Principals and Vice Presidents. You will have the opportunity to work with portfolio company executives (CEOs, CFOs, etc.) in support of Parkway’s role on the board of directors of portfolio companies.

Qualifications

An ideal candidate will have 1 to 5 years of total work experience with a preference for backgrounds in private credit, leveraged lending, private equity, investment banking, strategy consulting or commercial banking.
Bachelor's degree required, preferably with a major in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics or related financial discipline with an outstanding record of academic achievement.
Excellent organization, communication, and research skills with the ability to succinctly express and present ideas. Ability to compile, analyze, and present company and industry information.
Demonstrated experience or a strong passion for investing, financial analysis, and business strategy.
Financial modeling experience with superior analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Strong interpersonal skills, including excellent oral and written communication skills.
Entrepreneurial mindset and dedicated team player with a strong sense of ownership.
Meticulous attention to detail.
This candidate must thrive in an entrepreneurial private equity culture with the ability to work in less structured environments with minimal oversight.

Position Responsibilities

Helping to source transaction opportunities from equity sponsors, other credit funds, senior lenders and investment bankers.
Supporting all aspects of the investment process including analyzing, evaluating and executing subordinated debt and equity investment opportunities
Conducting due diligence and analytical work on potential investments, including participating in management presentations of prospect companies
Researching investment target’s competitive position, market size and industry dynamics
Conducting financial analysis to assess companies’ historical financials, unit economics, customer-by-customer details, pipeline and backlog details, customer utilization data, customer churn analyses and other key performance indicators (KPIs)
Building financial projection models, investment return models and conducting sensitivity analysis on model outputs
Developing financial analyses, reports and presentations to facilitate making investment and business decisions
Quickly develop a sense of what makes an appropriate Parkway Capital investment opportunity
Prepare for, participate and document calls with third party diligence providers, including legal, accounting and industry specific consultants
Assisting with the preparation of investment memos and supporting the presentation of investment recommendations to the firm’s investment committee
Ongoing monitoring of portfolio company performance including creating and tracking company financial performance and KPIs
Assisting Parkway’s CFO with SBIC portfolio reporting requirements
Assist with the preparation of Limited Partner Advisory Board presentations and Parkway’s annual meeting of Limited Partners

Compensation

Competitive amongst firms with comparable assets under management (AUM).

Next Steps

Interested candidates should send a cover letter and their resume to careers@parkway.calvertst.com
.

This position will play a key role in ensuring accurate employee timekeeping, schedules, attendance records, and payroll-related inputs through the Kronos platform.

You will work closely with managers, supervisors, employees, Human Resources, Payroll, and Finance teams, providing support with timekeeping processes, employee records, attendance-related questions, and monthly closing activities.

Time & Attendance Administration

Support the administration and monitoring of employee time and attendance records through the Kronos platform.
Enter and maintain employee work schedules and ensure information is accurately reflected in the system.
Monitor employee clock-ins, clock-outs, meal breaks, overtime, and other timekeeping records.

Support managers and supervisors with questions related to employee schedules, timekeeping, and attendance.

Payroll & Employee Changes

Enter and maintain employee changes and time-related information that directly impacts the Kronos system.
Process and update employee absences, vacations, medical leave, maternity and paternity leave, paid and unpaid permits, suspensions, family days, voting leave, and other applicable employee-related changes.

Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.
Excellent communication and customer service skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with employees, managers, supervisors, Payroll, Human Resources, and Finance teams.
Proactive, service-oriented, and able to follow up on issues until resolution.

You feel connected to our mission and values: Integrity, Respect, Accountability, Passion, Community and Continuous Improvement.

You enjoy sharing your quirkiness and talents with your coworkers.

jobs.title: Clearance Assistant (800506)
jobs.description:
Quiénes somos

El Comité Internacional de la Cruz Roja (CICR) trabaja en todo el mundo para proporcionar asistencia humanitaria a las personas afectadas por conflictos y violencia armada. Tomamos medidas en respuesta a emergencias y al mismo tiempo promovemos el respeto del derecho internacional humanitario. Somos una organización independiente y neutral, y nuestro mandato se deriva esencialmente de los Convenios de Ginebra de 1949. Trabajamos en estrecha colaboración con las Sociedades Nacionales de la Cruz Roja y de la Media Luna Roja y con su Federación Internacional para garantizar una respuesta humanitaria concertada, racional y rápida a las necesidades de las víctimas de conflictos armados o cualquier otra situación de violencia interna.

El CICR está firmemente comprometido con la diversidad y e inclusión. Se anima a participar en nuestras convocatorias a personas con discapacidad, minorías étnicas, personas LGTBIQ y mujeres.

¿Quieres saber más sobre nuestro trabajo en Colombia? Visite nuestros sitios web en: https://www.icrc.org/es

Código de conducta para colaboradores y colaboradoras del CICR | https://www.icrc.org/es/document/codigo-de-conducta-para-los-colaboradores-y-las-colaboradoras-del-cicr

Propósito del cargo

En el marco de las operaciones de la Delegación, el área de ImpEx es responsable de apoyar y coordinar los procesos de importación, exportación y trámites aduaneros requeridos para garantizar la disponibilidad y el movimiento oportuno de bienes, equipos y vehículos. El/la Impex Assistant brinda soporte operativo y administrativo al Clearance Officer, asegurando el adecuado seguimiento de los expedientes, la coordinación con autoridades, agencias de aduana y transportistas, así como la correcta recepción, almacenamiento y despacho de mercancías, en cumplimiento con los procedimientos internos y la normativa nacional aplicable

A quién reporta

Clearance Officer

Relacionamiento

A nivel interno, interactúa con el equipo del Departamento de Logistics and Supply Chain y los clientes internos.
A nivel externo, interactúa con prestadores de servicios y autoridades aduanales.

Principales tareas y responsabilidades

Realizar la liberación de las guías aéreas de la mercancía que es enviada para importación.
Realizar todos los tramites de preinspecciones, aforos, liberaciones, inspección, retiros y demás tramites que se presente durante el proceso de importación de la mercancía.
Apoyar a la responsable de ImpEx en la elaboración de las declaraciones de importación.
Realizar la entrega de la carga una vez se encuentre nacionalizada a la bodega o al cliente interno.
Informar a la responsable de ImpEx sobre los problemas e irregularidades durante las actividades de importaciones y exportaciones, así como sobre problemas de seguridad.
Ser el responsable de realizar la entrega de los equipajes y valijas para exportación al agente de aduana.
Llevar a cabo el acompañamiento de las inspecciones realizadas por las autoridades aduaneras y/o policía antinarcóticos para las exportaciones de mercancía y efectos personales.
Mantener la herramienta de seguimiento de procesos ImpEx, incluyendo diariamente cada uno de los procesos de importaciones y exportaciones que se originen.
Tramitar el proceso de descargue directo de la mercancía en caso de requerirse.
Elaborar todas las requisiciones (SR) necesarias para la legalización de los trámites aduaneros (Importaciones, exportaciones, transportes, etc ) ante el sistema JDE/IRIS.
Elaborar las SR en el sistema JDE/IRIS para las necesidades equipo logístico.
Realizar seguimiento, cierre y archivo de los SR creadas.
Realizar los procesos de despacho de carga desde Bogotá hacia las estructuras CICR o a nivel nacional e internacional de los procesos ImpEx o solicitudes de los clientes internos.
Actuar como Backup del Logista generalista para envíos generales de mercancía a nivel nacional de elementos de flota y stock IRIS.
Gestionar el seguimiento de los envíos realizados y facturados por Servientrega, análisis y optimización de costos de los fletes.
Realizar la revisión de la pre factura mensual de los servicios realizados por la transportadora.
Gestionar la bodega y picking de los elementos de ImpEx y la mercancía transitoria.
Mantener actualizado y ordenado los archivo ImpEx.
Responsable de gestionar y mantener actualizado de forma oportuna el archivo de las SR asignadas.
Responsable de gestionar los despachos y encomiendas y mantener al día el archivo correspondiente.

Requisitos

Técnico, tecnólogo o profesional en Comercio Exterior, Negocios Internacionales, Logística, Administración, Aduanas o áreas afines.
Conocimiento práctico de trámites ante DIAN, Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores y autoridades aduaneras, especialmente si la posición maneja vehículos, exenciones o importaciones institucionales.
Mínimo 2 años de experiencia relevante en importaciones, exportaciones, procesos aduaneros, transporte internacional o comercio exterior.
Experiencia con agencias de aduana, operadores logísticos, transporte de carga, organismos internacionales o sector humanitario.
Buen manejo de Microsoft Excel, Outlook y herramientas de Office. Idealmente experiencia con ERP o sistemas de procurement/logística.
Español fluido. Inglés básico-intermedio deseable, especialmente lectura de documentos, correos y términos de comercio internacional

Qué ofrecemos

Ubicación: Bogotá
Tipo de contrato: Contrato laboral a término indefinido (según legislación laboral Colombiana)
Prestaciones de ley: Afiliaciones salud, pensión, ARL y caja de compensación.
Beneficios: apoyo auxilio de anteojos cada dos años, poliza de servicios médicos.
Salario según escala salarial del CICR.
Tasa de actividad: 100%
Vacaciones: 20 días hábiles por año laborado
Inicio de contrato: Enero 2027

Fecha de Cierre

Podrá realizar su postulación hasta el 19 de octubre de 2026
.

Información adicional

Si no posee la nacionalidad Colombiana, debe estar legalmente autorizado para trabajar en Colombia (permiso de trabajo, permiso de residencia o estatus legal), ya que la organización no tramita solicitudes de visa.

El CICR tiene una política de tolerancia cero ante toda forma de discriminación, acoso, acoso sexual y abuso de poder. Por lo tanto, todos los candidatos seleccionados serán sometidos a rigurosas verificaciones de referencias y antecedentes.

En el CICR, valoramos el impacto, la colaboración, el respeto y la compasión, y buscamos candidatos que demuestren comportamientos basados en estos valores.
