Cuando te unes a Didi, vas a formar parte de una comunidad abierta, inclusiva y diversa de más de 12,000 empleados en todo el mundo. Desde el primer día encontrará una rica cultura global colaborativa donde sus responsabilidades tendrán un impacto directo en la estrategia y el crecimiento de la empresa.

About The Team/role

Working at DiDi means solving real problems for millions of riders, eaters, drivers and couriers across Latin America on one of the region's largest ride-hailing and delivery platforms, built to be every day better for everyone. This role is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing, data-driven environment, where decisions doesn't stay in a deck — it ships to a real city before the week is out.

As a Data & Analytics Intern,
you will turn DiDi's raw data into the decisions that run a multi-country marketplace — from what a ride should cost to which experiment gets scaled. This role is built for people who trust a numbers and won't stop until they know why, how and what it moved. You will support the execution of strategic initiatives, promote cross-functional collaboration, and build dashboards and tools that improve data accessibility to support leader's decision-making.

In this role, you'll be...

Solving ambiguous business questions through structured analysis — the right data, the right frame, a defensible answer.
Navigate the exciting messiness of a fast-growing marketplace by modelling pricing, elasticity and demand scenarios that inform real decisions.
Collaborate across ops, marketing and finance to turn analysis into decisions, not just dashboards.
Own a data product or pricing question from hypothesis to recommendation, managing the pressure of numbers leadership actually uses.
Adapt your approach as new data and shifting priorities reshape the question you're answering.
Identify the pattern behind a metric (not just what moved, but why) and translate it into a story the business can act on.

What You'll Get

A real process you help keep honest, with the rigor and mentorship to do it right
A manager who mentors you and gives feedback on a weekly rhythm (not once a semester)
Structured onboarding and a development trail built with our Learning & Culture team, plus hands-on upskilling on the tools this role uses
Space to work alongside AI on real problems

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Minimum education: enrolled in a Bachelor's degree (statistics, engineering, economics or another data-heavy field)
Availability to onboard on January, 2027 with at least 6 months remaining from graduation date
Clear communication in Spanish, with working proficiency in English
Technical foundation: comfortable in spreadsheets, with SQL or Phyton knowledge for analysis and automation.
Proven analytical rigor: you have completed academic or personal projects in which through the right question and data, you found the answer.
Demonstrated intellectual curiosity: you chase the story behind the numbers, not just the summary.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

The Chargeback Analyst position provides support to the organization by using the ability to analyze distributor data, investigate the root cause of chargeback differences, determine appropriate resolutions for all discrepancies and disputes, while processing and verifying transactions related to all aspects of contract administration. Objetivo

Planificar, preparar y presentar CAPEX y OPEX, para proyectos nacionales e internacionales, considerando los recursos disponibles dispuestos por el proyecto, cumpliendo los plazos establecidos por el proyecto, organizando la información de acuerdo con los requerimientos del cliente y los estándares de Worley, así como participando de las reuniones y talleres a los que haya lugar para la correcta y oportuna presentación de los entregables asociados a la disciplina de estimaciones.

Posición de nivel Senior con conocimientos avanzados y una profundidad especializada o amplitud de experiencia, obteniendo un dominio de una sola área o múltiples áreas más amplias de especialización.

Responsabilidades

Apoyar y asegurar el cumplimiento, preparación y supervisión de estimados de costos de acuerdo con los procedimientos aprobados para las siguientes fases del proyecto.
Planificar recursos para el cumplimiento de entregables asociados al área de estimaciones y estar en la capacidad de preparar, presentar y sustentar los documentos (plan de estimaciones, bases de estimaciones, informes de estimaciones, CAPEX, OPEX, CAPEX trending, conciliaciones de CAPEX), siguiendo los esándares del cliente, de la compañía y de la industria.
Proveeer apoyo en la identificación, análisis y generación de soluciones innovadores a los problemas relacionados con la estimación de costos.
Generar retroalimentación y apoyo en el desarrollo y mejora de los de estándares, procedimientos y sistemas para la estimación de licitaciones, ofertas o propuestas.
Preparar y realizar Kick-off meeting de estimaciones ante el equipo del proyecto y cliente.
Organizar el tiempo disponible entre reuniones del proyecto, solicitud de información y preparación y estimación de CAPEX/OPEX.
Presentar y sustentar resultados de la estimación con base en los supuestos o bases adoptadas en la preparación de los diferentes documentos
Apoyar la identificación de áreas de riesgo en la compilación de estimados de costos y evaluar los niveles de contingencia apropiados; colaborar con el equipo de riesgo para la preparación del análisis de riesgo, para la estimación de la contingencia y los niveles de precisión.
Colaborar con el área de planificación y control de proyectos en la elaboración de los planes maestros de trabajo.
Mantener la información organizada, disponible para consultas y consolidación de bases de datos del área o de benchmarking de la compañia.
Colaborar con la estimación de costos para estudios específicos. Responsable de la integración de actividades e identificación del alcance total del trabajo. Evaluar los resultados del estudio, la ruta crítica y la conclusión recomendada para su consideración y debate por parte del equipo del proyecto.
Apoyar la revisión de las provisiones relacionadas con la ingeniería de programa/costo, así como con el control de materiales, y generar datos de apoyo para la negociación de contratos. Participar en el establecimiento de estructuras de precios que se aplicarán a las cantidades para las estimaciones.
Definir las necesidades del proyecto en cuanto a control de costos de acuerdo con los requerimientos contractuales, objetivos y procedimientos.
Revisar los criterios de alcance del diseño y cantidades para verificar la completitud del proyecto, y coordinar reuniones con las diferentes disciplinas e involucrados en el proyecto para verificar información, así como para definir y diseñar provisiones de acuerdo al nivel de alcance de la ingeniería desarrollada.
Comparar y analizar alcance cantidades, y datos de costos entre proyectos. En comparación con estimados anteriores, resultados de costos y precios de proveedores, realizar estimaciones de referencia a través de benchmark y estándares de la industria.
Preparar flujos de caja y estar en la capacidad de estimar escalaciones con información proveniente del mercado, así como apoyar la estimación del desarrollo del costo del dueño.

jobs.title: Representante Nacional GTM
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

Contexto

El Comité Internacional de Rescate (IRC) responde a las peores crisis humanitarias del mundo y ayuda a las personas cuyas vidas y medios de vida son destrozadas por los conflictos y los desastres para sobrevivir, recuperar y obtener el control de su futuro. Fundada en 1933, a petición de Albert Einstein, el IRC trabaja con personas obligadas a huir de la guerra, los conflictos y los desastres y las comunidades de acogida, que los apoyan, así como aquellos que permanecen dentro de sus hogares y comunidades. Actualmente, IRC trabaja en más de 40 países y 22 ciudades de EE. UU., restauramos la seguridad, la dignidad y la esperanza a millones de personas desarraigadas que luchan por sobrevivir.

Descripción general del trabajo:
el representante del del Grupo de Transferencias Monetarias (GTM) facilita la articulación entre actores humanitarios, gubernamentales y del sector privado para garantizar una respuesta eficiente y alineada con estándares internacionales en la asistencia mediante transferencias monetarias, garantizando la implementación de la Estrategia 2025 y la movilización de recursos y el fortalecimiento de alianzas para optimizar la asistencia en efectivo y medios de vida. Su rol se centra en la armonización de enfoques, el intercambio de buenas prácticas y la gestión del conocimiento, asegurando que las intervenciones sean informadas por datos y experiencias previas. Además, participa en espacios de coordinación interinstitucional y promueve la integración de estrategias multisectoriales para maximizar el impacto de las transferencias en poblaciones vulnerables. El/la Representante Nacional ejercerá como enlace estratégico entre el GTM y las instituciones clave, asegurando la coherencia de las acciones, la articulación de esfuerzos y la generación de evidencia técnica.

En Esta Función, La Persona Titular Deberá

Articular la Estrategia 2025 con actores nacionales, adaptando sus ejes de acción a contextos territoriales y promoviendo su adopción en planes de trabajo de socios.
Liderar procesos de coordinación interinstitucional, convocando y facilitando espacios de diálogo, estableciendo agendas claras y capitalizando acuerdos para impulsar iniciativas de asistencia en efectivo.
Movilizar y diversificar recursos, identificando oportunidades de financiamiento nacionales y diseñando propuestas robustas que reflejen las prioridades del GTM.
Velar por el cumplimiento de indicadores técnicos y financieros, implementando sistemas de seguimiento (dashboards, 5W, matriz de riesgos) y reportando avances de forma oportuna.
Fomentar la transferencia de conocimientos, documentando buenas prácticas y lecciones aprendidas, liderando talleres de capacitación y generando insumos para la mejora continua de las intervenciones.

Responsabilidades Principales

El/la Representante Nacional del GTM es responsable de liderar y articular estratégicamente todas las acciones relacionadas con las transferencias monetarias y esquemas híbridos a nivel nacional. Las responsabilidades incluyen:

Gobernanza y Liderazgo Estratégico

Diseñar, actualizar y facilitar el marco de gobernanza del GTM, asegurando la coherencia con la Estrategia 2025 y los mandatos institucionales.
Convocar y presidir el Comité Directivo y Subgrupos Técnicos, garantizando la toma de decisiones eficiente y el cumplimiento de acuerdos.
Posicionar la agenda de asistencia en efectivo en espacios multilaterales, donantes y actores clave para elevar la visibilidad y relevancia del GTM.

Planeación y Coordinación Técnica

Liderar la elaboración y validación del Plan de Trabajo Nacional, integrando las perspectivas territoriales y ajustando objetivos de cobertura y protección.

Negociar convenios de cooperación y representar al GTM en espacios de incidencia política y sectorial.
Desarrollar estrategias de comunicación técnica y de incidencia, elaborando materiales clave (briefings, presentaciones, notas técnicas).

As the driving force behind the acquisition and transformation of data sets, your contribution will be key to unlocking analytics insights from our client’s data.

You will ensure the data pipelines are scalable and secure, and cater to the needs of multiple business units. Your expertise in developing and optimizing data pipelines will be instrumental in driving our data-driven initiatives forward. jobs.title: Business Intelligence & Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
Who is UJV?

Planning and managing a 5-star vacation from scratch requires expertise, cleverness, and a genuine passion for detail. That's what UJV is all about. UJV is a service-driven team of experts that work behind the scenes, engineering luxury travel experiences for advisors globally, so they can grow their business and fully satisfy their exclusive clients.

We are the luxury travel advisor’s right hand. How?

UJV is a team of travel experts that advises and supports luxury travel advisors worldwide.
We work behind the scenes as allies of top luxury travel advisors, to offer a 5 Star experience for their clients.
We offer travel advisors the knowledge and tools needed to grow their business and better serve their exclusive clients.
We offer an experience-centered service based on passion, expertise, integrity
and attention to detail.
We are willing to do the hard work in order to see our clients shine.

Role Mission

At Ultimate Jet Vacations, we don't believe data should sit inside dashboards waiting to be discovered.

We're looking for a Business Intelligence & Solutions Specialist
who can transform complex commercial data into clear, actionable insights that help our leaders make faster and smarter decisions.

This isn't a report-building role. It's a strategic business partner role.

You'll work closely with our Head of Commercial Strategy and department leaders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to uncover trends, identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and proactively bring insights to the table before anyone asks for them.

If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving business problems with data, and love telling the story behind the numbers, we'd love to meet you.

Responsibilities

Own and continuously improve our core Tableau dashboards across Sales, Gross Profit, Agent Performance, Regional Performance, Marketing, and Luxury Travel.
Partner with department leaders to review performance, identify trends, uncover opportunities, and translate data into meaningful business conversations.
Proactively identify GP leakage, negative-margin bookings, underperforming agents, operational inefficiencies, and emerging commercial trends, providing recommendations for improvement.
Prepare and maintain the weekly Commercial Reporting package, ensuring leadership has accurate and actionable metrics for strategic meetings.
Maintain the integrity of our commercial data model, Tableau environment, and data dictionary while collaborating closely with the Technology team.
Design thoughtful ad hoc analyses that help answer strategic business questions—not simply produce reports.
Improve data accessibility by empowering department leaders to confidently self-serve key dashboards and metrics.
Research, design, and implement AI-powered analytical solutions using Large Language Models (Claude preferred) to automate repetitive reporting and accelerate decision-making.
Continuously look for opportunities to improve reporting processes, dashboard usability, and overall data quality across the organization.

Qualifications

2-4 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Commercial Analytics, or a similar analytical role.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Advanced experience with Tableau.
Strong SQL skills.
Excellent Excel and/or Google Sheets proficiency.
Experience designing dashboards focused on business decision-making rather than simply displaying metrics.
Strong understanding of data modeling and data visualization best practices.
Experience working with AI tools or Large Language Models (Claude preferred).
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings in a clear, simple, and business-friendly way.
Full professional proficiency in English, both written and verbal.

Bonus Points

Experience with Python for data analysis or automation.
Experience with HubSpot reporting.
Experience within the travel, hospitality, or luxury industries.
Experience building AI automations or analytical workflows.

Who You Are

You don't wait for someone to ask for a report; you already noticed the trend.
You're naturally curious and love digging beneath the surface to understand why something is happening.
You enjoy partnering with business leaders, asking thoughtful questions, and helping them make better decisions through data.
You see dashboards as conversation starters, not finished products.
You're constantly looking for ways to improve processes, automate repetitive work, and make data easier for everyone to understand.
Most importantly, you care about business outcomes just as much as the numbers behind them.

Why You'll Love This Role

¡Invitamos a postularse para el puesto de Management Trainee – Especialista de Nomina.

Procesamiento de Nómina

Procesar altas, bajas, transferencias, promociones, ajustes salariales, bonos, comisiones y otros cambios relacionados con la nómina.
Validar los datos de entrada de nómina para garantizar su integridad y exactitud antes de la ejecución.
Calcular ingresos, deducciones, impuestos y contribuciones legales obligatorias.
Brindar soporte para nóminas fuera de ciclo, pagos retroactivos y ajustes de nómina.

Administración de Nómina
Mantener registros precisos de nómina de los empleados en los sistemas de Recursos Humanos y nómina.
Realizar conciliaciones de nómina y resolver discrepancias antes del cierre definitivo de la nómina.
Generar reportes de nómina para Recursos Humanos, Finanzas y otras partes interesadas del negocio.
Garantizar que la documentación de nómina se mantenga de acuerdo con las políticas de la empresa y los requisitos de auditoría.

Cumplimiento Normativo
Garantizar que el procesamiento de la nómina cumpla con la legislación laboral argentina y las regulaciones legales vigentes.
Apoyar la generación de reportes y la presentación de pagos obligatorios ante las autoridades gubernamentales correspondientes.
Mantener la confidencialidad de la información de nómina de los empleados.
Brindar soporte en auditorías internas y externas relacionadas con la nómina.

Soporte al Empleado
Responder consultas de los empleados relacionadas con la nómina dentro de los niveles de servicio acordados.
Investigar y resolver incidencias de nómina en colaboración con Recursos Humanos, Finanzas, Beneficios y proveedores externos.
Proporcionar orientación sobre recibos de sueldo, cálculos de nómina, deducciones legales y políticas de nómina.

Realizar controles de calidad y actividades de control relacionadas con la nómina.
Identificar oportunidades de mejora y automatización de procesos.
Participar en iniciativas de transición, transferencia de conocimiento y documentación de procesos.
Mantener actualizados los Procedimientos Operativos Estándar (SOPs) y la documentación de procesos.

Gestión de Partes Interesadas
Colaborar con los equipos de Recursos Humanos, Finanzas, Impuestos, Beneficios, Control de Asistencia y Tiempo, así como con proveedores de nómina.
Dar soporte a las actividades de nómina de cierre mensual y cierre anual.
Escalar oportunamente a la gerencia los riesgos e incidencias relacionados con la nómina.

Experiencia en administración de nómina con soporte a nómina de Argentina.
Licenciatura o diploma en Recursos Humanos, Finanzas, Contabilidad, Administración de Empresas o un campo relacionado.
Sólido conocimiento de la legislación de nómina en Argentina y de los requisitos legales aplicables.
Experiencia con sistemas de nómina como SAP, Workday, ADP, Oracle o plataformas similares de HRIS/Nómina.
Dominio de Microsoft Excel, incluyendo tablas dinámicas, funciones de búsqueda y análisis de datos.

Requisitos preferidas

Una certificación en nómina será considerada una ventaja.
Se prefiere experiencia procesando nómina en entornos de servicios compartidos o BPO (Business Process Outsourcing).
La experiencia brindando soporte a operaciones multinacionales de nómina es una ventaja.
Es deseable experiencia con sistemas de Control de Asistencia y Tiempo (Time & Attendance).

Genere un impacto : impulse el cambio para las empresas globales y resuelva los desafíos comerciales que importan

Prospere en una cultura impulsada por valores: nuestro coraje, curiosidad e incisividad, construidos sobre una base de integridad e inclusión, permiten que sus ideas impulsen el progreso.

Propósito del cargo

Garantizar la gestión integral, técnica y administrativa del servicio farmacéutico, asegurando el cumplimiento de la normatividad vigente, los lineamientos institucionales y los estándares de calidad establecidos. Gestionar el control, custodia y trazabilidad de los medicamentos, con especial énfasis en los Medicamentos de Control Especial (MCE), promoviendo el uso seguro y racional de los mismos y contribuyendo a la mitigación de riesgos y a la seguridad del paciente.

Educación

Tecnólogo en FARMACIA

Formación complementaria

Cursos complementarios deseables en buenas prácticas de elaboración (BPE), bioseguridad hospitalaria y/o farmacovigilancia.

Conocimientos Técnicos

Uso medicamentos de control especial.
Normatividad legal vigente del servicio farmacéutico.
Ingles Basico, Manejo técnico en adecuación y/o preparación de medicamentos.
Manejo de Office Powerpoint, Excel y Word.

Centro Médicos

Manejar la normatividad legal vigente en Colombia Decreto 780 de 2016
Resolución 1403 de 2007
Resolución 3100 de 2019
Legislación de Medicamentos de Control Especial
Resolución 1478 de 2006
Conocimientos sólidos en Buenas Prácticas de Almacenamiento, Recepción y Dispensación, control de cadena de frío y gestión de vencimientos mediante semaforización.
Farmacovigilancia, manejo de indicadores del servicio, atención de auditorías de entes reguladores (Secretaría de Salud, Invima, FNE).

Experiencia Laboral Específica

2 años de experiencia servicios farmacéuticos de baja o mediana complejidad.

Competencias

CREACIÓN DE VALOR - OPERATIVO

GENERACIÓN DE VALOR EN SALUD - OPERATIVO

SERVICIO HUMANIZADO - OPERATIVO

TRABAJO COLABORATIVO - OPERATIVO

ADAPTABILIDAD - OPERATIVO

CONCIENCIA DEL CUIDADO - OPERATIVO

Roles y Responsabilidades del cargo (A)

Gestionar la recepción, almacenamiento y dispensación de Medicamentos de Control Especial (MCE), mediante la verificación de fórmulas médicas, el diligenciamiento del libro oficial, la custodia de las llaves y la elaboración de los informes requeridos, garantizando la trazabilidad, el uso racional y el cumplimiento de la normatividad vigente.
Liderar el programa de Farmacovigilancia de la sede, mediante la identificación, recolección y notificación oportuna de sospechas de Reacciones Adversas a Medicamentos (RAM) y Eventos Adversos en VigiFlow/INVIMA, así como la gestión de los comités y la capacitación al personal, con el fin de prevenir riesgos y fortalecer la seguridad del paciente.
Gestionar integralmente el inventario y la semaforización de medicamentos, dispositivos médicos y reactivos, mediante el control de fechas de vencimiento, aplicación de la metodología FEFO, seguimiento a las condiciones de temperatura y humedad y registro de los movimientos, asegurando su calidad, disponibilidad y conservación.
Dirigir los procesos operativos y administrativos del servicio farmacéutico, mediante la aplicación de los manuales y procedimientos institucionales, la capacitación al personal y la atención de visitas de los entes de control, garantizando la calidad del servicio y el cumplimiento de los requisitos legales.
Gestionar el aprovisionamiento oportuno de gases medicinales, mediante la planificación de necesidades, solicitud, recepción y almacenamiento de los cilindros bajo las condiciones establecidas, asegurando la continuidad y calidad de los servicios asistenciales.
Gestionar la base de alertas sanitarias, mediante la revisión periódica de las alertas emitidas por el INVIMA, la actualización de la herramienta institucional y su socialización en los comités, con el fin de mitigar riesgos y prevenir el uso de productos defectuosos o inseguros.
Garantizar el cumplimiento de la normatividad aplicable al servicio farmacéutico, ejerciendo las responsabilidades inherentes a la Dirección Técnica y asegurando la implementación del sistema de gestión, el control de los medicamentos y dispositivos médicos y el manejo adecuado de los MCE, para preservar la seguridad y calidad del servicio y prevenir incumplimientos ante las autoridades sanitarias.

Roles y Responsabilidades del cargo (B)

ALCANCE CENTRAL DEL MEZCLAS Clínica

Apoyar al Químico Farmacéutico de producción en actividades de adecuaciones de medicamentos.
Organizar y alistar los insumos requeridos para las preparaciones.

Job Description

DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a Payroll DS Manager, located in Taguig, Philippines or Bogota, Colombia.

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

Taguig, Philippines - Requisition Number: R-090226

Remember, whether you apply to one or all of these requisition numbers, your applications will be considered as a single submission.

The Payroll Manager is accountable for the end‑to‑end delivery of accurate, timely, and compliant payroll services for a defined group of countries. The role is responsible for developing and implementing standardized methodologies in partnership with Global Process Owners, business partners (Capability Center Team, when located in local country), and other cross-functional teams, serving as a regional focal for operations, project, and/or audits. The role will provide leadership and guidance to assigned team members while managing the performance of vendor partners to maintain processes that support payroll administration.

The Payroll Manager Is Responsible For

Payroll Operations & Service Delivery
Manage end‑to‑end payroll delivery for assigned countries, ensuring timely and accurate payroll processing in compliance with company policy and local statutory requirements.
Oversee payroll controls, approvals (including off‑cycle payments), reconciliations, payroll accounting entries, and statutory remittances.
Ensure audit readiness by maintaining robust documentation, records, and payroll calendars.
Support internal, external, and regulatory audits as required.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Build strong, trusted relationships with senior country stakeholders and global partners across HR, Finance, Tax, Legal, Compliance, IT, Procurement, and Employee Relations.
Serve as the primary escalation point for complex payroll issues, ensuring effective resolution and adherence to service commitments.
Manage performance of third‑party payroll vendors, ensuring adherence to SLAs, operational metrics, and contractual obligations.
Align stakeholder expectations, mediate conflicts, and balance operational priorities with business needs.

People Leadership & Talent Management

Lead and manage a matrixed team of payroll supervisors and individual contributors.
Own hiring, performance management, coaching, career development, succession planning, and resource allocation across assigned team.
Promote a positive and inclusive work environment, fostering teamwork, and encouraging professional development. 
Foster a high‑performing, inclusive culture grounded in accountability, continuous learning, and strong customer focus.  
Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement
Lead payroll-related business, statutory, or compliance driven projects, ensuring delivery within scope, timeline, and budget.
Stabilize existing payroll processes while driving continuous improvement, simplification, automation, and standardization.
Partner with Global Payroll, (Capability Center when located in local country), and Projects teams on system implementations, transitions and enhancements.
Represent Payroll in cross‑functional initiatives and transformation programs as required.
Perform other duties assigned by Global or Regional Leadership.

Qualifications And Requirements

A minimum of 7 years of prior experience in Payroll, HR and/or Finance operations.
A minimum of 3 years in a Management/People Leader role is required
Strong experience managing multi‑country payroll operations
Proven experience overseeing payroll controls, compliance, audits, and statutory requirements.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams through change in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment.
Strong analytical, decision‑making, and problem‑solving capabilities.
Excellent English language written and verbal communication abilities, with strong presentation and facilitation skills and can speak to a diverse set of audiences
Adaptable and capable of navigating through ambiguity & work effectively in a fast-paced environment
Experience in knowledge management systems and proficiency with compliance requirements (e.g. SOX, business controls, etc.) are preferred
Certification in the following areas are preferred: Payroll, Project Management, Analytics, Lean Six Sigma/Design Thinking.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you dream of making an impact? Cultural Care Au Pair is looking for a Program Coordinator
based in our Medellín office to grow the Colombian market to help us achieve our goal of being the largest and most trusted au pair program in the world.

Hitting your goals at Cultural Care means you play an important role in making the world a more welcoming, understanding, and open place.

Our cultural exchange program builds global families by bringing together au pairs with American host families—providing meaningful childcare for families, an unforgettable year in the U.S.A. for au pairs, and a culturally enriching experience for both parties.

This is a role for someone who thrives on hitting targets, because every approval and match means another au pair gets a life-changing experience in the U.S.

In this role, you will report to the Country Product Manager. We are searching for someone who is passionate about cultural exchange, displays a great deal of responsibility and autonomy, is very sales-driven, and has excellent communication skills, both in-person and on the phone.

What You Will Do

Grow the Colombian market in your assigned region, taking ownership of sales in your region, to reach sales targets
Build awareness for the program and drive new leads by working with schools, universities, job centers, fairs, and other local institutions
Drive sales on the phone by responding to the needs of the customer
Recruit, screen, and coach potential au pairs while providing excellent customer service
Organize and attend promotional events
Collaborate with our local au pair community to help achieve goals

Who You Are

Personal qualifications:

You are passionate about cultural exchange and highly motivated to hit and exceed targets
You love connecting with people over the phone and in-person to understand their needs and so that you can successfully pitch our program
You are a team player who brings a positive attitude and "nothing is impossible" spirit to the team
You have an entrepreneurial spirit, taking ownership of your ideas and making them happen
You have good time management skills that allow you to handle multiple priorities while paying attention to the details and delivering on your goals
You love being a part of a supportive team that has fun while hitting goals

Professional Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree
1+ years of sales experience with a record of hitting sales targets
At least 6 months of experience living abroad, preferred
Proven capability with both phone sales and in-person sales
Full proficiency in Spanish and English
Exceptional presentation and public speaking skills

What We Offer

An international and dynamic environment with a start-up vibe
Base salary + bonus potential
Regular training sessions, team events, kick-offs and get-togethers
The ability to expand your international network through our monthly professional development opportunities with colleagues from around the world.
Opportunities to travel internationally, e.g. Staff exchanges to our US or European Markets for your professional development
Discounts on EF programs
And many more...

If you are motivated by the prospect of an international career with a dynamic and forward-thinking company, we want to hear from you.

Please submit your application, including your CV and cover letter in English.

About The Team

At Cultural Care Au Pair, we believe that cultural exchange has the power to make the world a more welcoming, understanding, and open place. As the largest and most experienced au pair organization in the world, we build global families by bringing together international visitors with American hosts—providing meaningful childcare for families, an unforgettable year in America for au pairs, and a culturally enriching experience for all. If you’re ready to expand your own horizons we invite you to be a part of our global team of problem-solvers, relationship-builders, and innovators. jobs.title: Kam Acceso & Comercial
jobs.description:
Introducción al negocio

GSK mantiene su compromiso de alcanzar ambiciosos objetivos comerciales para el futuro. Para 2031, aspiramos a alcanzar £40 mil millones en ventas anuales, aprovechando el sólido impulso de nuestro desempeño actual para aumentar significativamente nuestro impacto positivo en la salud de miles de millones de pacientes a nivel mundial. Nuestra estrategia Ahead Together se centra en la intervención temprana para prevenir y modificar el curso de las enfermedades, protegiendo así a las personas y apoyando a los sistemas de salud.

Nuestro portafolio diverso está compuesto por vacunas, medicamentos especializados y medicamentos generales.

A través de la innovación continua y un enfoque dedicado en la excelencia científica y técnica, buscamos desarrollar y lanzar tratamientos nuevos e innovadores que respondan a desafíos críticos de salud.

Resumen de la posición

Liderarás los esfuerzos comerciales y de acceso para cuentas institucionales y del canal comercial clave en Colombia. Trabajarás de cerca con equipos multifuncionales para diseñar e implementar estrategias que mejoren el acceso de los pacientes y el desempeño comercial. Valoramos el pensamiento estratégico, la toma de decisiones basada en datos, la comunicación clara y la colaboración. Este cargo ofrece claras oportunidades de crecimiento, la posibilidad de generar un impacto medible para los pacientes y la oportunidad de contribuir a la misión de GSK de unir la ciencia, la tecnología y el talento para adelantarnos juntos a las enfermedades.

Este cargo te brindará la oportunidad de liderar actividades clave para impulsar el desarrollo de tu carrera. Estas responsabilidades incluyen algunas de las siguientes:

Desarrollar y ejecutar planes de cuenta para clientes institucionales y del canal comercial, como aseguradoras, distribuidores, prestadores de servicios de salud y grandes compradores.
Gestionar el presupuesto de ventas del territorio, las proyecciones y el seguimiento del desempeño para alcanzar los objetivos.
Liderar procesos de licitación, preparar propuestas y realizar negociaciones comerciales para asegurar y ampliar el acceso.
Utilizar datos para gestionar inventarios, rotación y devoluciones, y para orientar las decisiones comerciales.
Coordinar con los equipos de cadena de suministro, finanzas, médico y marketing para resolver barreras de acceso.
Monitorear las tendencias del mercado y las necesidades de los grupos de interés para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y orientar la estrategia.

¿Por qué tú?

Requisitos básicos

Buscamos profesionales con las siguientes habilidades y cualificaciones requeridas para ayudarnos a alcanzar nuestros objetivos:

Título universitario en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Química Farmacéutica, Economía o un campo relacionado.
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en la gestión de cuentas institucionales o del canal comercial en el sector salud o farmacéutico.
Experiencia en la gestión de presupuestos de ventas, proyecciones y negociaciones comerciales.
Experiencia participando en procesos de licitación y preparando propuestas comerciales.
Sólidas habilidades de análisis de datos y confianza en el uso de Excel y herramientas de reportería.
Habilidades efectivas de comunicación y gestión de grupos de interés.

Requisitos preferidos

Si cuentas con las siguientes características, será considerado un valor adicional:

Experiencia comercial específica en oncología o canales de atención especializada. (Experiencia comercial específica en alto costo o canales de atención especializada).
Conocimiento de conceptos de gross-to-net y gestión de márgenes.
Experiencia trabajando en equipos grandes y multifuncionales.
Nivel de inglés intermedio.
Experiencia trabajando con distribuidores, socios logísticos o grandes clientes institucionales.
Formación o experiencia en análisis de mercado y planificación territorial.

Cómo postularte

Si este cargo se alinea con tu experiencia y tus objetivos profesionales, queremos conocerte. Postúlate y cuéntanos cómo tus habilidades pueden mejorar el acceso de los pacientes y los resultados comerciales. Damos la bienvenida a personas candidatas de todos los orígenes y estamos comprometidos con un proceso de selección inclusivo.

Skills

Account Management, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Negotiation, Omnichannel, Scientific Literacy

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

jobs.title: Incentive Compensation & Sales Performance Manager
jobs.description:
Business Introduction

GSK is committed to achieving ambitious commercial goals for the future. By 2031, we aim to generate £40 billion in annual sales, building on our strong current performance to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients around the world.

Our Ahead Together strategy focuses on early intervention to prevent and modify the course of disease, protecting people and supporting health systems.

Our diverse portfolio includes vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we seek to develop and launch new, innovative treatments that address critical health challenges.

Position Summary

As Incentive Compensation & Sales Performance Manager, you will lead, end to end, the design, administration, calculation, governance, and continuous improvement of sales force incentive plans, special incentives, and recognition programs for Colombia and four Central America and Caribbean markets, with effective scope expected as of January 1, 2027.

You will transform pharmaceutical commercial strategy and performance data, including sell-in and sell-out information, into fair, transparent, measurable compensation decisions aligned with compliance standards. You will also lead the Incentive Committee, the change management strategy, and alignment with senior stakeholders.

You will work closely with commercial leaders, Human Resources, Finance, Technology, local, regional, and global teams, as well as external vendors. This position will report to the BI & Insights Lead and will operate with a high level of autonomy, judgment, and accountability within established guidelines.

Responsibilities

Manage the variable compensation process end to end for Colombia and four Central America and Caribbean markets, ensuring accuracy, transparency, traceability, and compliance.
Translate information on sell-in, sell-out, customer coverage, channel dynamics, market potential, territories, and product life cycle into practical recommendations.
Calculate and validate incentive payments, special incentives, and recognition programs, coordinating payroll submissions and resolving inquiries, adjustments, and special cases.
Maintain data quality controls, reconciliations, and audit trails across information sources, calculations, approvals, and payments.
Use advanced Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, and automation tools to improve the scalability, transparency, efficiency, and control of processes.
Identify operational, financial, behavioral, and compliance risks, recommending mitigation actions and escalating situations according to established levels.

Why You?

We are looking for someone with strategic and analytical thinking, precision, a sense of accountability, confidentiality, strong oral and written communication skills, and attention to detail.

Basic Requirements

We are looking for professionals with the following skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

University degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative or business discipline.
Four years of relevant experience in incentive compensation, Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Sales Force Effectiveness, Business Intelligence, Finance, or Commercial Analytics.
Experience in incentive plan design, goal or quota setting, calculations, payment validation, payroll submissions, and recognition programs.
Solid knowledge of the pharmaceutical commercial model, including sell-in, sell-out, channels, customers, territory structures, portfolio, and field performance measurement.
Advanced Excel proficiency and hands-on experience with Power BI, along with experience documenting business rules, controls, reconciliations, and approval traceability.
English level sufficient to interact with regional and global stakeholders and to interpret policies and technical documentation.

Preferred Requirements

If you have the following, it will be considered a plus:

Postgraduate studies related to compensation, commercial strategy, finance, analytics, Business Intelligence, or related disciplines.
Prior experience in the pharmaceutical industry, life sciences, or another regulated sector.
Practical knowledge of SQL, Python, automation, data warehouses, or cloud data platforms.
Experience leading cross-functional committees, change management initiatives, and recommendations for executive audiences.
Experience in financial simulations, sensitivity analysis, forecasting, payout distribution, and risk assessment.
Proven track record of making decisions under ambiguity, assessing calculated risks, and driving process changes and business adoption.

Skills

Business Acumen, Data to Insights, Digital Literacy, Influencing Without Authority, Problem Solving, Project Management, Sales Performance, Scientific Literacy

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

If you require any adjustments or accommodation during the selection process to better showcase your abilities, please let our team know as soon as we contact you. We're here to support you.

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Our inclusive workplace makes our employees feel engaged by the contribution they make, by affording them equal treatment regardless of actual or perceived characteristics. As so, when you apply for a job at GSK, it is not necessary to include on your resume information such as: race, color, ethnicity, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, origin, photographs or any other personal characteristics.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Generation Colombia (1 year Fixed Term/Remote)
jobs.description:
About Generation

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have an 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

About The Role

Job duration: This is a 12 months fixed-term contract
Location requirements: Remote (with reliable WiFi), based in Colombia. Availability to travel within Colombia and attend in-person events
Start date: November 2026
End date: October 2027

What Will You Do

The Program Coordinator will coordinate the execution of training phase logistics and operational activities across Generation Colombia programs. This role may also deliver assigned operational support to mobilization processes, as required.

Main Responsibilities

Act as the main point of contact for learners, responding to learner inquiries, tracking requests, and escalating issues according to defined protocols.
Execute learner onboarding activities (“Day 0”) by preparing onboarding sessions, validating learner readiness requirements, and documenting attendance and commitment prior to “Day 1.”
Support day-to-day program delivery in collaboration with the C&I Coordinator by monitoring learner experience and tracking TSP operational execution when applicable.
Identify, document, and support resolution of operational risks and issues by applying troubleshooting actions and supporting the implementation of mitigation plans.
Track learner progress, engagement, and outcomes by maintaining monitoring tools, producing interim performance reports, and developing improvement recommendations.
Execute learner stipend and resource distribution processes (laptops, internet access, cameras, and economic support) ensuring transparency and timely delivery.
Monitor correct use of resources and compliance with program policies.
Monitor and troubleshoot outcomes, create interim reports and make recommendations for operational improvements
Support mentorship process execution by tracking participation, identifying dropout risks, and documenting actions to improve retention and graduation outcomes.
Participate in weekly calls to troubleshoot learners’ outcomes and plan for extra support if needed
Execute periodic TSP performance review activities by preparing inputs, documenting mentorship and operational delivery status, and tracking performance against academic and operational KPIs
Conduct regular check-ins with TSP teams to review progress, risks, quality of instruction, and learner performance.
Identify and escalate TSP-related risks and performance gaps by documenting findings and supporting corrective action planning and follow-up.
Support the execution of complementary formative workshops by coordinating logistics and tracking delivery with partner companies.
Execute cohort outcome support activities in collaboration with Learner Support Services by completing cohort risk analysis and individual learner readiness assessments.

Additionally, as part of placement support within the in-program sessions this role might:

Support the BD & Partnerships team in employability activities during the in-program phase and ensure a structured and smooth handover to the placement team
Execute learner preparation activities for transition into placement, ensuring data, profiles, and readiness of all learners are complete
Support event planning and employability engagement activities with learners

About You

Bachelor's degree in any field with a solid academic record.
3-5 years of experience in program coordination, preferably in a nonprofit, start-up, or social enterprise environment
Strong communication skills. Demonstrated fluency with Spanish and English speaking and writing skills
Experience developing program procedures and resources, with keen attention to detail
Experience managing teams, project managing tasks, and coordinating stakeholders
Entrepreneurial and proactive mindset to deliver against targets and seek opportunities for improvement and growth
Results-driven and able to quantify success by developing metrics/analytics
Ability to operate independently while also being a team player
Belief in Generation’s mission, preferably with experience working with disadvantaged communities
Demonstrated commitment to equity and social impact work
The candidate should be open to traveling to Generation sites as per the needs of the program
Please apply with your English CV/resume, thank you***

jobs.title: People Experience Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

As we’ve grown from a startup into a global company, our teams and challenges have grown with us. We’re now looking for a People Experience Manager to join our team in Colombia
.

This is a newly created role, so you’ll have a real opportunity to shape how we support our people and leaders as the Colombia business continues to grow. We’re looking for someone who can combine strong HR expertise with a hands-on approach, someone who enjoys building processes, coaching leaders, developing teams, and tackling people challenges along the way.

How will you make an impact?

Drive our hiring plans: Make sure we execute the country Headcount Plan proactively and on time, balancing speed, quality, and a great candidate experience.
Build strong people foundations: Implement and standardize HR policies and processes that support our growth strategy and are aligned with our global PX framework, including talent acquisition, performance management, and talent development.
Partner with leaders: Work closely with the Colombia leadership team, coaching them and providing practical, expert advice on people-related topics.
Improve the employee experience: Develop initiatives across the employee lifecycle that help us retain and engage our people and address key turnover challenges.
Support organizational growth: Act as a strategic partner on organizational development, team effectiveness, and employee engagement.
Navigate employee relations: Manage labor-related matters together with our Legal team and external partners, ensuring we stay compliant while finding practical solutions.
Build the local PX team: Develop and grow a high-performing People Experience team that can scale alongside the business.

Qualifications

What will help you thrive?

Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Industrial Engineering, Psychology, Law, or a related field.
You bring 6+ years of HR experience, including at least 3 years in a senior HR role, ideally in a fast-growing or scaling environment.
You have a track record of building and improving HR processes, tackling recruitment and retention challenges, and supporting teams through periods of growth and change.
You’re fluent in English, both written and spoken.
You’re hands-on, proactive, and results-oriented, and you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and getting things done.

The position will be based in Bogotá, Colombia.

What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat
– A first call with our Global Head of People Experience to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla –
(SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Peer Interview
with a Senior Leader from the People Experience team.

4️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview
– A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Rafael Montoya-Robledo ,
Colombia's Country Manager and your potential manager in this role .
Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

5️⃣ Business Case –
A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with Rafael and Rodrigo Adanya ,
Global dCPO to discuss your thoughts and findings.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits –
No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks –
Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth –
We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team –
Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You –
Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results –
we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner –
take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean –
smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest –
openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious –
growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. jobs.description:

Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.

Overview

You'll turn workforce data into clear insight that helps shape organizational design, workforce planning, M&A integration, and broader people analytics work. In this role, you'll partner with Organizational Design, HR, Finance, and business leaders to keep data reliable, build reporting that people can use, and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You'll be part of work that helps colleagues make informed decisions and improve organizational effectiveness.

How You'll Make An Impact

You'll analyze workforce data to spot trends, risks, and opportunities across headcount, attrition, spans of control, workforce mix, organizational effectiveness, and talent movement. You'll build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations in HRIS, OrgVue, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools, and you'll create recurring and ad hoc reports for HR leadership and business stakeholders.

You'll also support organizational analytics work for mergers, acquisitions, restructures, and enterprise transformation. That means helping with org structure models, reporting structures, workforce scenarios, health checks, and analysis of workforce impacts, synergy capture, and talent integration. You'll work closely with Organizational Design and HR teams to assess options, track changes over time, and highlight implementation risks.

Data quality is a big part of the role too. You'll extract, validate, cleanse, transform, and reconcile HRIS data, then help keep workforce data consistent across reporting systems. You'll also partner with HR, Finance, and IT colleagues to support data governance and improve reporting methods.

About You

You have 3 to 5 years of experience in workforce analytics, people analytics, HRIS, organizational effectiveness, organizational design analytics, or a similar analytical role.
You have worked with HRIS data and employee master data.
You use Excel to analyze workforce data and build reports.
You have created dashboards and visualizations in Power BI, Tableau, or a similar platform.
You can explain complex data in simple terms in presentations and written updates.
You can work independently in a global, matrixed environment.
You can work with HR, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to gather information and keep work moving.

jobs.title: Generalista de gestión humana - Contact Center
jobs.description:
¿Quieres cambiar el mundo?

Eso es lo que hacemos en Cabify. Nuestro objetivo es hacer de las ciudades mejores lugares para vivir, mejorando la movilidad de las personas que viven en ellas, conectando a pasajeros y conductores con tan sólo pulsar un botón. Es posible que algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un coche privado, pero aún nos queda un largo camino por recorrer… ¿nos acompañas?

Fundada en 2011, nos hemos convertido en el primer ‘unicornio’ español. Nuestra sede central está en Madrid pero actualmente nos encontramos en 38 ciudades de España y Latinoamérica. Y cada mes que pasa más gente se une a nuestro equipo internacional lleno de personas apasionadas, brillantes y con talento con ganas de desafiar el “status quo”.

Pero no importa lo rápido que crezcamos o lo grande que nos volvamos, queremos mantener nuestro espíritu ‘start-up’. Somos un equipo seguro de sí mismo, energético, profesional y carismático, y estamos orgullosos de hacer las cosas bien. Nos gusta pensar en nosotros mismos como una empresa de tecnología ética e innovadora que ha creado un negocio donde todos son tratados de manera justa y respetuosa, desde nuestros ingenieros hasta los conductores que utilizan nuestra plataforma. Además, siempre cumplimos plenamente con las regulaciones gubernamentales y respetamos las leyes locales.

Hemos recorrido un largo camino hasta ahora, pero en realidad nuestro viaje no ha hecho más que comenzar. Si vamos a convertir nuestra misión en una realidad, ¡necesitamos que personas con talento y ambición como tú se unan a nuestro equipo!!

Sobre el puesto

Serás un socio estratégico de Channels desde la gestión humana, asegurando el cumplimiento de los indicadores y la alineación con el direccionamiento estratégico de la compañía. Tu rol será clave para conectar las necesidades del negocio con las prácticas de People, actuando como puente de comunicación efectivo entre Channels y las demás áreas, e impactando directamente en el desempeño, la cultura organizacional y los resultados del negocio.

¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir con nuestra misión?

Apoyando a los managers en su rol de liderazgo, asegurando la aplicación efectiva y consistente de los procesos de Gestión Humana en Channels, alineados con la estrategia global de People.
Administrando las relaciones laborales del equipo Channels, liderando la resolución de conflictos y procesos de mediación, garantizando un clima laboral positivo.
Alineando las estrategias y proyectos de People Global con el equipo Channels, asegurando la correcta implementación de los procesos de performance management y talent management en la unidad de negocio asignada.
Diseñando, recomendando e implementando soluciones integrales de recursos humanos para Channels en temas de reclutamiento y selección, compensación, relaciones laborales, gestión del desempeño, desarrollo de carrera, inducción y formación, entre otros.
Brindando coaching a colaboradores y líderes en comportamientos, manejo de personal y desarrollo de talento.
Participando activamente en los comités primarios del equipo Channels, proponiendo acciones, realizando seguimiento y apoyando la ejecución de los planes de acción definidos.
Promoviendo un ambiente de alto desempeño, impulsando estrategias de formación y desarrollo, fomentando un entorno laboral inclusivo y comunicando de manera efectiva la visión, los valores y la estrategia de People.
Administrando y ejecutando los procesos disciplinarios del equipo Channels, garantizando el cumplimiento de la normativa interna y legal.
Garantizando la adecuada ejecución del proceso de onboarding para los nuevos colaboradores del equipo Channels.
Participando en los procesos de desvinculación del personal de Channels, asegurando una gestión respetuosa y alineada con los lineamientos de la compañía.
Monitoreando y analizando los niveles de rotación del equipo Channels, proponiendo e implementando planes de acción y estrategias de retención.
Coordinando, ejecutando y supervisando el plan anual de bienestar de People Channels.

Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation at scale, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as-a-service” model.

Job Description

The Facilities Manager is responsible for ensuring that the organization's facilities operate efficiently, safely, and in compliance with applicable requirements. This includes overseeing maintenance, security, cleaning, waste management, transportation expenses, expansion projects, asset inventories, and other facility-related services.

Key Responsibilities

Oversee and coordinate all facility-related activities and services.
Plan and manage the facilities maintenance budget.
Ensure facilities comply with occupational health and safety regulations.
Oversee waste management and ensure appropriate disposal practices.
Coordinate the procurement and delivery of cleaning, security, and maintenance services.
Manage preventive and corrective maintenance activities.
Partner with other departments to ensure facilities meet their operational needs.
Regularly audit processes performed by direct reports to ensure efficiency and compliance with established policies and procedures.
Maintain strict control of transportation-related expenses, ensuring they remain within the approved budget and identifying opportunities to optimize costs.
Lead all site expansion projects, ensuring delivery within established timelines and coordinating the teams required for execution.
Control the annual fiscal-year budget in line with approved amounts and information received from vendors and Procurement. Any expense exceeding the approved amounts must be authorized by email by the Senior Manager, Facilities LATAM, VP Facilities, or Business Controller.
Monitor site consumption and optimization initiatives to support a healthy organizational carbon-footprint impact. Audit the process to ensure the Carbon Footprint (CFP) tool is current, properly documented, and demonstrates improvement compared with the previous fiscal year.
Audit inventory processes and ensure all asset trackers remain current, including furniture, chairs, televisions, UPS units, projectors, air-conditioning units, and other assets. Mobile phones must also be registered in the company's MainApp tool.
Conduct periodic audits of the petty cash managed by the team, reviewing invoices and ensuring compliance with Finance policies. Purchases must be made at businesses that provide electronic invoices and may not exceed COP 500,000 per invoice. Expense reconciliation must be approved by the Senior Manager, Facilities.
Conduct regular site walkthroughs with the team to ensure work is completed in accordance with the company's established service-level agreements (SLAs).

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Management, Architecture, Facility Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
4-5 years of relevant facilities management experience; property management and/or BPO experience is highly desirable.
Advanced English proficiency.
Knowledge of occupational health and safety regulations, budget management, team coordination, communication, and problem-solving.
Candidates with different academic backgrounds may be considered if they have strong, transferable experience relevant to the role.

jobs.title: People Ops Coordinator
jobs.description:
Antenna is the leading provider of data and analytics for subscription media services in the U.S. Antenna's standardized metrics, competitive benchmarks, syndicated insights, and market intelligence are trusted by some of the most recognized and respected brands across media and entertainment sectors. Using a proprietary AI-powered approach, Antenna connects subscription activities with real consumer viewership to provide services, studios, and creators with an unmatched, market-wide view of subscriber behaviors to better understand acquisition, retention, and engagement.

At Antenna, we're building the standard for how the entertainment industry understands its subscribers - and none of that happens without a team that runs well. We're looking for a People Ops Coordinator
who will own that foundation: someone who sees a scattered process and wants to build the system that fixes it, who treats a new hire's first week as seriously as their onboarding metrics, and who takes pride in being the person people can count on. The role extends beyond People Ops, too; you'll provide coordination support to our co-founders and help keep priorities moving across the company more broadly. This is a chance to shape how People Ops and company operations work at an early-stage company.

You will report to the VP, Ops. Antenna is a remote-first company, and we are looking for candidates who can work during US business hours. Preferably, you should be based in a US time zone (Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific). You will report to the VP, Finance.

What You'll Do

Own the People Operations side of the employee lifecycle - onboarding and offboarding, benefits and payroll coordination, HRIS updates, PTO tracking, and employee records - serving as an approachable first point of contact for routine questions and escalating anything sensitive to VP, Ops
Support performance management, employee engagement, and internal culture programs, including feedback cycles, goal-setting, recognition, and team-building initiatives
Coordinate recruiting and hiring support end-to-end: job descriptions, interview scheduling, candidate communications, recruiting documentation, and a smooth handoff from candidate to new hire
Support our co-founders and other cross-functional administrative projects from request through completion
Build processes that simplify, automate, or improve People and operations workflows as Antenna scales

Who You Are

1–3 years of experience in People Operations, Human Resources, or a related administrative role
Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and levels
High degree of discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information
Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership without waiting for detailed instructions
Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities and responsibilities may evolve
Strong follow-through and a bias toward action — you enjoy getting things done and making processes work better
Familiarity with HR, project management, collaboration, or other business operations tools
Advanced English proficiency (B2-C1) Please submit a resume in English language in the application.

Antenna Benefits:

Work from anywhere during US business hours
Competitive compensation, including participation in Antenna equity program
Mentorship from experienced executives
Opportunity to grow and impact a rapidly growing start up
Travel to In-person team off-sites (visa-permitting)

About Antenna

Antenna is the leading provider of data and analytics for the U.S. Subscription Economy. Our standardized metrics, competitive benchmarks, syndicated insights, and market intelligence are used by some of the most trusted brands across media and entertainment sectors to better understand subscriber behavior and successfully navigate the rapidly changing consumer subscription landscape.

Founded in 2019 by Jonathan Carson, a successful serial entrepreneur with deep roots in data and analytics, and Rameez Tase, a seasoned executive in media and analytics, Antenna's mission is supported by top investors with global expertise in media and technology: Raine Ventures, BDMI, UTA Ventures, and many more. Antenna is powered by a dedicated group of individuals who are intellectually curious, passionate about service, and committed to supporting the needs of Antenna clients and each other every day. As a small remote-first team, Antenna team members have the opportunity to work alongside senior leaders and professionally grow with an early-stage team.
