jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager  (Bogotá)
jobs.description:
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas—Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease—we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on patients’ lives as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Regulatory Affairs Manager (Bogotá)

The Regulatory Affairs Manager for Colombia, serving as the Local Regulatory Representative (LRR), is accountable for leading and executing local regulatory strategies that enable timely patient access and effective lifecycle management of Amgen products in Colombia.

The role leads the planning, preparation, submission, tracking, and approval of new sanitary registrations and marketing authorizations, post-approval modifications, renewals or other maintenance activities where applicable, indication extensions, labeling updates, and related regulatory activities, in compliance with Colombian regulations, INVIMA requirements, and Amgen policies and standards.

The LRR serves as a key regulatory advisor and the primary local interface with INVIMA and other relevant Colombian authorities and stakeholders. The role proactively identifies regulatory risks, defines mitigation plans, and partners with Global, Regional, and cross-functional teams to support business priorities, maintain compliant product supply, and protect patient access.

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will:

Own regulatory strategy and product lifecycle management for the assigned portfolio in Colombia.
Lead the development and execution of evidence-based local regulatory strategies and filing plans for assigned products throughout their lifecycle in Colombia.
Ensure timely preparation, submission, follow-up, and approval of new sanitary registrations, post-approval modifications, renewals or maintenance activities where applicable, indication extensions, administrative changes, and labeling updates.
Provide strategic Colombian regulatory input to Global and Regional Regulatory teams to optimize development, registration, launch, access, and lifecycle-management plans.
Assess regulatory risks and opportunities, define mitigation strategies, and clearly communicate potential business, supply, compliance, and patient-access impacts.
Ensure local implementation of approved labeling changes, including prescribing information, instructions for use, labels, package inserts, patient leaflets, cartons, and other artwork components, in coordination with relevant functions.
Lead or support regulatory assessments related to product supply, manufacturing-site and quality changes, importation requirements, certificates, and other documentation needed to maintain compliant supply in Colombia.

Health Authority and External Engagement

Act as the primary regulatory contact with INVIMA for assigned products and regulatory activities, and engage the Ministry of Health and Social Protection or other authorities when relevant.
Lead and coordinate regulatory meetings, responses to information requests, deficiency letters, technical clarifications, and other interactions with Colombian health authorities.
Build and maintain effective professional relationships with relevant INVIMA and external stakeholders while ensuring full compliance with applicable laws and Amgen policies.
Monitor and interpret changes in Colombian legislation, regulations, technical standards, guidance, and health-authority practices; translate them into clear business implications, risks, impacts, and recommendations.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Compliance

Partner closely with Global, Regional, and Local Regulatory, Quality, Safety, Medical, Clinical Development, Supply Chain, Access, Legal, Healthcare Compliance, and Commercial teams to assure business continuity.
Provide timely regulatory guidance to support product launches, reimbursement and access initiatives, clinical trial activities, medical and commercial communications, and business continuity in Colombia.
Ensure regulatory review of promotional and non-promotional materials, as applicable, in accordance with Colombian requirements, relevant industry codes, and Amgen procedures.
Contribute to the local compliance framework by identifying regulatory obligations and supporting the implementation of necessary controls.
Ensure accurate and inspection-ready maintenance of regulatory documentation, submission records, tracking tools, commitments, licenses, and local regulatory intelligence.

Operational Excellence and People Leadership

Drive continuous improvement of regulatory processes, systems, and ways of working, including leadership of the Regulatory Information Management (RIM) function, to strengthen predictability, submission quality, compliance, and efficiency.
Manage external regulatory consultants, service providers, and contractors, where applicable.
Lead, coach, and share knowledge with peers and cross-functional partners, fostering accountability, collaboration, and high-quality execution.
Establish clear priorities and ensure appropriate resource allocation across the portfolio.

What We Expect Of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The vital attribute professional we seek is a type of person with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Professional degree in Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline, plus at least 7 years of Regulatory Affairs experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry (at least 2 years directly managing regulatory submissions and product lifecycle activities -with minimum or no supervision).
Strong knowledge of Colombian pharmaceutical legislation, INVIMA processes, and regulatory requirements for innovative medicines, biological products, biosimilars, and small molecules, including (but not limited to) new drug applications, post-approval variations, labeling and packaging, promotional compliance
Fluency in Spanish and professional proficiency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Proven record engaging with INVIMA through the life cycle activities of biologics, biosimilars, and/or small molecules, from GMP certification through obtention, maintenance and surveillance of marketing authorizations.
Proven ability to lead external engagement (with health authorities, trade associations and other key stakeholders), manage complex regulatory issues, set and negotiate suitable solutions.
Strategic thinking with strong risk-assessment, problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
Ability to translate complex scientific, technical, and regulatory information into clear and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Strong business acumen, written and verbal communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Forward-looking mindset, with the ability to lead regulatory and competitive intelligence, anticipate emerging trends, and translate insights into proactive strategies and actions.
Strong digital skills, including data analytics, regulatory information management systems, collaboration tools, and emerging technologies to improve regulatory efficiency and decision-making.

What You Can Expect Of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

Estudiantes de último semestre de Ingeniería Química o Farmacia.

jobs.description:
Description

Rapyd has unified payments, payouts and fintech on one worldwide platform, and we’re assembling the world’s best team to liberate global commerce. With offices in Tel Aviv, Amsterdam, Singapore, Iceland, London, Dubai, Hong Kong, Latam and the U.S., the opportunities at Rapyd are limitless.

We believe in straight talk, quick decisions, strong execution and elegant solutions. Rapyd is where hard work pays off and careers take off. Join us and let’s build the future of fintech together.

Get the tools to grow globally at www.rapyd.net. Follow: Blog, Insta, LinkedIn, Twitter

As the Regional Tax Manager, you will lead and scale Rapyd’s tax function across seven Latin American countries, serving as the region’s primary tax advisor and strategic business partner. Based in our Bogotá office on a hybrid model, you will report directly to the VP of Global Tax and lead a dedicated regional team (Tax Team Leader in Colombia; Tax Managers in Argentina, Chile, and Peru). You will own regional tax strategy, compliance, reporting, commercial tax advisory, transfer pricing, and tax audits, ensuring tax excellence as we scale our high-growth fintech platform across LATAM.

What You’ll Do

Lead Regional Tax Operations: Oversee the end-to-end tax function across seven LATAM jurisdictions, managing corporate income tax, indirect taxes, withholding taxes, and tax compliance.
Drive Strategy & Business Partnering: Serve as the primary tax advisor to Finance, Legal, Product, and Operations, reviewing the tax implications of new products, cross-border transactions, merchant onboarding, and supplier agreements.
Own Transfer Pricing & Compliance: Manage the regional transfer pricing framework, including documentation, compliance, intercompany transactions, and tax planning initiatives.
Manage Audits & Governance: Direct all regional tax audits, disputes, and interactions with local tax authorities, preparing robust technical positions and defense files.
Build & Elevate the Team: Manage and develop your direct reports (Tax Team Leader in CO; Tax Managers in ARG, CH, PE) and coordinate regional external advisors.
Process Optimization: Drive tax process improvements, automation, and operational excellence across the region while supporting budgeting, forecasting, and global tax reporting initiatives.

Requirements

Academic Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Tax, Finance, Law, Economics, Business, or a related field.
﻿Experienced Tax Leader: You bring 8–10 years of professional tax experience, demonstrating a strong track record of leading and developing tax teams in regional or multinational environments.
LATAM & Colombian Tax Expert: Deep, practical knowledge of Colombian tax laws (corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and ICA) with proven experience navigating tax frameworks across additional LATAM jurisdictions (especially Argentina, Chile, and Peru).
Strategic Business Partner: Highly analytical with outstanding communication skills and the ability to translate complex tax regulations into clear, commercial recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders.
Bilingual Communicator: Fully fluent in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) with the ability to collaborate effectively with local teams and global leadership.

Nice to Have

A licensed tax lawyer qualification.
A Master’s degree in Taxation.
Prior experience in the FinTech, payments, or financial services industries.
A combination of Big Four consulting experience and an in-house tax role in a high-growth company.

For more than 30 years, we've worked alongside insurers with passion and commitment, turning actuarial complexity into opportunities. Friendly teamwork environment

International environment

Take Your Skills to the Next Level

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Architect (GenAI, AWS)
jobs.description:
About the role:

Provectus is a Premier AWS partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner
at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide and are obsessed with reimagining how they operate and compete.

Our work centers on two verticals — Financial Services & Insurance and Healthcare & Life Sciences
— where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture.

We embed engineers and leaders inside client operations as Forward Deployed Architects (FDA) and Forward Deployed Executives (FDX) — people who learn the work, ship the system, and own the outcome. Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Bluprints.

You will do the customer’s job before you automate it.

Most AI engagements fail the same way: someone gathers requirements, someone writes a PRD, and a team ships a workflow nobody uses. We think the requirements-gathering step is the bug. So we remove it.

A Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Provectus spends the first weeks of an engagement in the operator’s seat
— as the underwriter, the analyst, the RCM specialist, the claims clinician, whoever actually does the work we’ve been asked to change. You do the job. You learn the constraints from the inside, the ones nobody writes down. Then you sit at a table with that operator and a Forward Deployed Executive and rebuild the function from first principles
— and you are the one who builds it.

Three things define how you work:

Embedded, not engaged. You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it
Real tasks, not scope. You are not fenced into a siloed deliverable. You go where the operating problem is
Autonomous. Embedded is not staff-augmented. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket

You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry blueprints
— working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. That loop is the difference between an outcome and an invoice.

You’ll be measured on whether the Business Unit’s number moved — not on hours, not on scope delivered.

This is a role for engineers who have led before — as a founder, a CTO, a staff engineer — and who want to stay in the code while owning the outcome. On most days you’ll be the most senior technical person in the room, and you’ll still be the one shipping.

Requirements:

8+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands-on today and intend to stay that way
You will take the operator’s seat. You are genuinely willing to spend weeks doing someone else’s job — claims processing, underwriting, revenue-cycle work — before you write a line of code. Engineers who need to stay in the IDE should not apply
You learn domains fast. Demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly enough to argue with the people who do it for a living
Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works
You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why
Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack
Cloud-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus): containers, Kubernetes/ECS, IaC, CI/CD, and the operational reality of a system someone else inherits
Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room
Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job
Solid AI/ML foundations — you understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes, not just call the API
Strong hands-on prodcution experience with Claude Code/Cowork
Fluent English, written and spoken

Nice to have:

Prior experience as a founder, CTO, or engineering leader who has chosen to return to individual contribution
Real depth in one of our blueprint industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare, asset management
Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery
Data platform depth: data lakes, warehouses, streaming and real-time analytics, data mesh and data contracts, governance and data quality
MLOps and classical ML: PyTorch, SageMaker, MLflow
Fine-tuning, distillation, or inference/serving optimization
Graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune)
IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform
Open-source contributions or public writing on applied AI

What you’ll do:

Take the seat

Do the operator’s job for two to four weeks at the start of an engagement. Learn the function from inside, not from a requirements doc
Reach working fluency in a new domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset flow — in weeks, not quarters
Sit with the operator and the Forward Deployed Executive and redesign the function from first principles. Discovery, user research, and PRD-writing collapse into one team that re-imagines its own job. You are all three roles

Build

Ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment — LLM applications, agentic workflows, retrieval and structured-extraction pipelines, and the services around them. Running software, not recommendations
Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature. When the engagement is bound to a business KPI, “it looked good in testing” is not an answer. Define what working means, instrument it, and let the evals drive the design
Write production code across the stack — backend services, data pipelines, and the AI layer. Python and TypeScript are our centre of gravity; we choose tools to fit the customer, not the résumé
Take systems to production on AWS (GCP/Azure where the customer requires it): containerized, observable, and maintainable after we leave
Start from the blueprint, and feed the blueprint. What you learn in the field becomes the baseline the next engagement starts from

Own the outcome

Work in a pair with a Forward Deployed Executive who carries the Business Unit’s KPIs. Your work is measured against the same number
Drive adoption. A system the BU routes around has not shipped. Change management is part of the engineering job here, not a phase after it
Be credible with the customer’s engineers, their operators, and their executives — and be willing to disagree with all three
Shape what we commit to before we commit to it. You’ll have the standing to do it, because you’re the one who will build it

What We Offer:

Frontier delivery work across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare
The chance to shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment
A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside Principal Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers
A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them
Remote-friendly culture
High-impact role with direct visibility to leadership
Strong earning potential with performance-based bonuses
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and cloud solutions
B2B contract model
PTO policy, paid local public holidays
Medical insurance coverage
Generous budget for educational opportunities

How we hire:

Intro conversation — the role, your background, what you want to be doing
Two live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor. You may use an LLM assistant (ChatGPT, Claude) — how you work now includes these tools. Autocomplete/agentic coding tools are off for these sessions
The redesign session. We hand you an unfamiliar business function and the constraints of the person who performs it. You have to understand the job well enough to rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. No LLMs for this one
Team and practice conversation

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Employment Type: Independent Contractor | Full-Time & Part-Time
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote | Work schedule will depend on client requirements and agreed availability.
Hours: 15–40 hours per week
Time Zones: U.S. Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time
About the Role We are seeking an experienced Bilingual Senior Medical Billing & Coding Specialist who is fluent in English and Spanish and has strong hands-on experience supporting U.S. healthcare practices.
The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of direct experience working within a U.S. healthcare practice or medical organization, with hands-on responsibility for medical billing, coding, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Accounts Receivable (AR), claims, and denial management.
We are particularly interested in professionals who have worked directly within a healthcare specialty such as Primary Care, Behavioral Health, Mental Health, Dental, Ophthalmology, or another U.S. medical practice setting.
This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the full billing and revenue cycle process—not simply someone with general administrative or healthcare experience.
Key Responsibilities Handle day-to-day U.S. medical billing and coding activities.
Prepare, review, and submit accurate claims to Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance payers.
Review patient accounts, medical records, and billing information for accuracy.
Apply and interpret CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and relevant modifier codes as applicable to the practice.
Identify and correct coding or billing errors that may result in claim rejections or denials.
Manage denials, rejected claims, appeals, and claim corrections.
Perform Accounts Receivable (AR) follow-up and monitor outstanding balances.
Investigate unpaid and underpaid claims and follow up with insurance companies.
Support the overall Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process from charge entry through payment and account resolution.
Verify and maintain accurate patient and insurance information.
Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and Electronic Remittance Advice (ERAs).
Identify trends in denials, payment issues, and billing discrepancies and recommend corrective actions.
Communicate professionally with insurance companies, healthcare providers, patients, and internal teams as needed.
Maintain accurate documentation and follow client-specific billing and compliance procedures.
Work independently in a remote environment while meeting productivity, accuracy, and turnaround-time expectations.

Required Qualifications Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in U.S. healthcare medical billing and coding.
Direct experience working within a U.S. healthcare practice, clinic, dental practice, behavioral health organization, ophthalmology practice, or similar healthcare setting.
Strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare revenue cycle.
Hands-on experience with: Medical Billing, Medical Coding, Claims Submission, Denial Management, Accounts Receivable (AR), Payment Posting, Claim Follow-up, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
Experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance payers.
Strong working knowledge of CPT codes and familiarity with ICD-10 and HCPCS coding.
Ability to identify coding and billing discrepancies and resolve claim-related issues.
Fluent in both English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate professionally in both languages.
Strong computer skills and ability to learn and navigate healthcare billing systems, EHRs, EMRs, and payer portals.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications Experience with healthcare billing software, EHR/EMR systems, clearinghouses, and payer portals.
Experience handling complex denials, appeals, and aging AR.
Medical billing or coding certification such as CPC, CCS, CPB, CCA, or equivalent.

Certification is not required, but relevant medical billing or coding certification is considered a strong plus.
What We’re Looking For We are looking for a senior-level, hands-on billing and coding professional who understands how billing works within an actual U.S. healthcare practice.
Strong candidates should be able to demonstrate practical experience—not just familiarity—with coding, claims, payer processes, denials, AR, and the broader RCM cycle.
Experience in a specific clinical practice environment is highly valued, particularly where the candidate understands the billing workflow and payer requirements associated with that specialty.
Important Note for Applicants When applying, please ensure your CV clearly highlights:
Your 3+ years of U.S. medical billing and coding experience.
The specific healthcare practices or specialties you have worked with.
Your experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance.
Your hands-on experience with CPT/ICD-10/HCPCS coding.
Your experience with RCM, denials, AR, claims, and payment posting.
The healthcare billing systems, EHRs/EMRs, clearinghouses, or payer portals you have used.
Your English and Spanish proficiency.
Any medical billing or coding certifications you hold.

Candidates whose experience is primarily general healthcare administration without hands-on U.S. medical billing/coding experience may not be considered.

jobs.title: AUXILIAR DE ENFERMERIA
jobs.description:
Propósito del cargo

Brindar apoyo integral en la atención de los pacientes, gestionando su acceso y continuidad en los servicios de salud de acuerdo con sus necesidades clínicas, mediante la ejecución de actividades asistenciales y la gestión de procesos bajo los protocolos institucionales y la supervisión del profesional de enfermería, con el fin de garantizar una atención segura, oportuna y humanizada.

Exclusivo Versania:
Brindar atención integral y humanizada a pacientes en condición de terminalidad, mediante la ejecución de cuidados básicos de enfermería, manejo seguro de síntomas y medicamentos de control especial, acompañamiento empático al paciente y su familia, y registro adecuado de la información clínica, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los planes de manejo y a la calidad de vida del paciente.

Educación

Técnico en ENFERMERIA

Formación complementaria

Técnico auxiliar de enfermería

Exclusivo Versania:
Curso Cuidados Paliativos 40 horas

Conocimientos Técnicos

Toma de signos vitales.
Control de líquidos.
Manejo de equipos de infusión parenteral y enteral.
Administración de Medicamentos parenterales.
Registros en historia clínica, inventarios, controles de temperatura y humedad, lista de chequeo de limpieza y desinfección.

Exclusivo Versania:

Conocimientos básicos sobre Cuidados Paliativos Vías de adminisración de medicamentos, vía subcutánea, cuidados de la piel, comunicación y relación de ayuda

Experiencia Laboral Específica

2 años de experiencia

Exclusivo Versania:

De los 2 años, 1 año Debe tener experiencia laboral en el área clínica o asistencial

Competencias

CREACIÓN DE VALOR - OPERATIVO

GENERACIÓN DE VALOR EN SALUD - OPERATIVO

SERVICIO HUMANIZADO - OPERATIVO

TRABAJO COLABORATIVO - OPERATIVO

ADAPTABILIDAD - OPERATIVO

CONCIENCIA DEL CUIDADO - OPERATIVO

Roles y Responsabilidades del cargo (A)

Gestionar las historias clínicas, realizando su apertura, organización, cierre y entrega a estadística, así como el diligenciamiento de formatos clínicos, para garantizar registros completos y actualizados.
Preparar equipos y apoyar procedimientos clínicos, incluyendo punciones, curaciones, venopunciones, reanimaciones y transfusiones, para brindar atención segura y oportuna. Monitorear signos vitales y balance hídrico, registrando la evolución del paciente y reportando cambios relevantes, para contribuir a una atención segura y oportuna.
Gestionar insumos y equipos médicos, realizando pedidos, control de inventarios, traslado de muestras y limpieza y desinfección de equipos, para garantizar su disponibilidad y adecuado funcionamiento.
Participar en actividades educativas e institucionales, atendiendo las directrices del área de enfermería y del jefe inmediato, para contribuir al cumplimiento de los estándares de atención.

Exclusivo Versania:

Brindar apoyo en actividades básicas de cuidado, higiene, alimentación y movilización del paciente, promoviendo su bienestar y el acompañamiento al cuidador y la familia.
Realizar toma y registro de signos vitales e información clínica en la historia clínica y sistemas institucionales, garantizando trazabilidad y cumplimiento normativo.
Ejecutar cambios de posición y cuidados de la piel, orientados a prevenir lesiones y favorecer la comodidad y seguridad del paciente.
Realizar limpieza, desinfección y seguimiento del estado de catéteres y accesos, contribuyendo a la prevención de infecciones y complicaciones.
Participar en la entrega de turno, comunicando oportunamente novedades y condiciones relevantes del paciente para asegurar la continuidad del cuidado.
Apoyar procedimientos básicos de enfermería delegados y administración de medicamentos bajo supervisión, aplicando protocolos y lineamientos de seguridad institucional.
Ejecutar y hacer seguimiento al plan de cuidado del paciente y su familia, garantizando una atención integral, segura y acorde con las indicaciones clínicas.
Desarrollar una comunicación empática y compasiva con el paciente y su familia, promoviendo la escucha activa, el acompañamiento y la contención emocional.
Identificar necesidades del paciente y su entorno familiar, realizando seguimiento continuo y fortaleciendo la percepción de acompañamiento permanente.
Trabajar articuladamente con el equipo interdisciplinario y realizar seguimiento telefónico a pacientes, favoreciendo la continuidad del cuidado y la calidad en la atención.

Roles y Responsabilidades del cargo (B)

Atención Extramural:

Realizar asistencia telefónica a los pacientes, aplicando los protocolos establecidos para identificar necesidades emergentes, orientar al usuario, gestionar adecuadamente los casos y notificar al equipo asistencial ante cualquier alarma que requiera intervención prioritaria. Además, debe realizar valoraciones iniciales, verificar la programación de visitas médicas y de enfermería, y coordinar acciones con el personal correspondiente. También es responsable del seguimiento telefónico a pacientes hospitalizados, confirmación de egresos por fallecimiento o cambio de programa, y atención de requerimientos tanto de los usuarios como de sus familiares en el domicilio, dejando siempre el registro correspondiente en la historia clínica.
Brindar soporte tanto asistencial como administrativo, colaborando en la gestión y coordinación de servicios de apoyo como laboratorios, traslados, oxígeno e insumos médicos necesarios para la atención en el hogar. Entre sus funciones se incluye la atención de solicitudes recibidas por correo electrónico por parte de pacientes, aseguradoras y terceros, así como la elaboración de planillas para toma de muestras, ambulancias y oxígeno, según el programa correspondiente. Además, confirma diariamente las agendas de los profesionales, ajustando la programación según la pertinencia clínica y la frecuencia establecida en cada programa, a través de la revisión de historias clínicas. También es responsable de dar respuesta oportuna a los requerimientos de usuarios, aseguradores y terceros, garantizando una atención eficiente y coordinada.
asegurar la disponibilidad, entrega y recolección eficiente de los insumos y equipos necesarios para la atención de los pacientes en el hogar. Esto incluye la entrega diaria de materiales a los profesionales de salud para el inicio de las rutas de atención, el alistamiento de carpetas, insumos y equipos biomédicos, así como la confirmación con los usuarios egresados para coordinar recolecciones. Además, debe ejecutar la limpieza y desinfección diaria y terminal de maletines y equipos, cumpliendo con los protocolos establecidos, y realizar inventarios semanales notificando cualquier novedad como daños, pérdidas o traslados. Su labor es clave para garantizar la continuidad del servicio y evitar fallas en el proceso de atención domiciliaria.
brindar cuidados directos a los usuarios, siguiendo el plan de cuidado definido por el profesional de enfermería del programa, el cual responde a las necesidades individuales del paciente y a los objetivos terapéuticos establecidos. Entre sus funciones se encuentran la toma de signos vitales, valoraciones de riesgo, verificación del estado de accesos vasculares y dispositivos médicos, así como la administración segura de medicamentos. También realiza actividades de confort y seguridad como higiene, movilización, alimentación, curaciones simples, toma de muestras y cuidados específicos como gastrostomías y traqueostomías, todo conforme a los protocolos institucionales.
acatar rigurosamente las normas y procedimientos de bioseguridad, salud y seguridad en el trabajo, utilizando de manera adecuada los elementos de protección personal (EPP) y realizando el lavado o higiene de manos conforme a los protocolos institucionales. Estas acciones son fundamentales para prevenir la aparición de infecciones asociadas a la atención en salud (IAAS) y garantizar condiciones seguras tanto para el paciente como para el personal asistencial durante la prestación del servicio en el entorno domiciliario.

Job Description

AECOM Enterprise Capabilities is currently recruiting for a Principal Engineer - Ground Engineering
to join our busy and expanding experienced team. The team provides assessment, concept, feasibility, preliminary and detailed designs on a wide range of Projects, either as standalone commissions or as part of multidisciplinary major projects. You may have the opportunity to work on some of the most iconic Transportation, Water and Energy projects, being part of a diverse and multicultural team. It can be a great opportunity for a mid-level profile that wants to boost his/her professional technical career on the ground engineering.

The responsibilities of this role include:

Performs specific and moderate portions of a broader assignment of an experienced engineer in diverse geotechnical projects
Gathers and correlates basic engineering data using established and well-defined procedures in geotechnical engineering with emphasis on soil and rock data
Performance at this level requires developmental experience in a professional position in relation to geotechnical projects
Provides specialized technical input to studies and designs for staff in geotechnical engineering
Prepare and manage technical specification sections related to designs, ensuring they meet project requirements and industry standards and regulations
Works on detailed or routine engineering assignments involving calculations and tests for geotechnical projects
Independently perform all the tasks necessary to complete design elements for geotechnical engineering works
Proposes approach to solving new problems encountered using modifications of standard procedures or methods developed in previous assignments in relation to geotechnical engineering projects
Provides guidance to entry level engineers in geotechnical engineering with emphasis on soil and rock mechanics
Develops study and design procedures to facilitate high-quality cost-effective work by others
Works as part of a ground and tunnelling engineering team with other engineers at the same functional level that can be from different EC offices (Poland, Spain, India, etc.)
Works within interdisciplinary teams in infrastructure projects design
Participates in interdisciplinary review of project deliverables
Follow the AECOM’s Technical Quality Review procedure
Identifies discrepancies in results in calculations and reports for geotechnical projects
Performs quality control review of reports, design calculations and drawings for geotechnical projects
Performs work in accordance with agreed upon budget and schedule with little supervision with emphasis on geotechnical projects
Provides input to the development of engineering budget and schedule to meet requirements

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering o Engineering Geology from a recognized University
Master´s degree, with emphasis in geotechnical engineering, from a recognized University
Proven track record of working on ground engineering designs (+6 years) for Transportation, Water and/or Energy Projects
Experience in the application of international regulations and standards with emphasis on geotechnical engineering
Proficiency in geotechnical design software such as Roscsience, Geo Studio.
Proficiency in numerical analysis using FEM software such as PLAXIS 2D and 3D; RS2 and RS3
Proficiency in use of CAD software such as Civil 3D, Auto CAD
Experience in geotechnical design for slope stability, retaining structures, foundations and soil improvement
Proven commitment with Quality Control Policy and Quality Management System
Fluent in English (oral and written)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the use of structural engineering software SAP 2000, SAFE
Experience working on international projects will be considered favorably
US and/or Australia Professional Engineer license will be considered favorably
Background in underground works associated with water and electrical projects would be considered as positive
Experience working with Common Data Environment platforms (e.g., BIM 360, ACC)
Knowledge of software for generating geotechnical models such as Leapfrog, and for processing geotechnical data as OpenGround and Gint

Additional Information

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

jobs.title: Manager, Payroll Transformation & Process Optimization (GBSC People & Capability)
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Manager, Payroll Transformation & Process Optimization (GBSC People & Capability)

Who is Mastercard?

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

Who is GBSC?

The Global Business Solutions Center (GBSC) is a powerhouse of innovation and strategic partnership inside of Mastercard that combines operational excellence with a vision for what’s next. More than a service provider; it is a collaborative force that delivers impactful outcomes. Anchored in strong, reliable operations, the GBSC brings to life bold ideas that empower teams across Finance, Legal, People & Capability, Sales, Marketing, and Product. 

About The Role

The Manager, Payroll Process Design & Optimization Lead is responsible for designing, optimizing, and continuously improving global payroll processes to ensure they are standardized, compliant, timely, and digitally enabled across countries.

This role applies leading-practice process architecture, documentation, governance frameworks, and optimization initiatives, across the payroll lifecycle, into scalable solutions—from upstream data inputs through calculation, validation, payment, reporting, and post pay activities—while partnering closely with regional payroll team, Technology, Risk, and vendors.

The role enables consistent payroll outcomes and improved employee experiences by defining scalable process standards, controls, and metrics that support Mastercard’s broader modernization and automation agenda, while execution accountability remains with regional and in country payroll teams.

Success in this role requires working in close alignment with Payroll leadership to translate strategic direction into executable, scalable, and continuously improving process outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with Payroll leadership to support global payroll process design and optimization efforts, contributing insights, analysis, and frameworks that inform the evolution of future state process standards and execution across the payroll lifecycle.
Enable and support the development, alignment, and use of payroll process flows and documentation by partnering with Payroll and related teams to ensure artifacts are clear, practical, and reflective of agreed‑upon operating models; support consistent understanding and execution across regions while accounting for local legal, regulatory, and business requirements.
Manage Payroll Transformation portfolio, including intake, prioritization, transformation roadmap, and work sequencing.
Support Payroll leadership by defining structured global vs localization approaches, clearly articulating global standards versus permissible country-level variation; identify and assess process variation, bringing data and fact-based recommendations to leadership on where standardization, simplification, or deviation is appropriate .
Function as a process design lead and trusted advisor for payroll related changes, system enhancements, country implementations, and operating model evolution—translating business needs into tangible, prioritized process requirements and design standards aligned to Payroll strategy and operating norms.
Partner with Product & Engineering to simplify, automate, and optimize payroll processes and data flows, ensuring process designs support system capabilities across Workday Payroll, time and attendance, benefits, integrations, and in country vendors.
Support enhancement testing by providing relevant use cases and executing user-testing to validate that optimized process designs are viable, system‑enabled, and fit-for-purpose.
Leverage payroll process performance metrics to identify trends, prioritize future optimization opportunities, and track improvement over time.
Support strong vendor and cross functional process governance by partnering with P&C, Tax, Risk & Compliance, and payroll providers to drive service quality, regulatory adherence, data privacy and security, and continuous improvement.
Assess payroll process impacts of policy changes, acquisitions, technology advancements, workforce updates, and regulatory developments, leading process change design, impact analysis, documentation updates, and stakeholder communications.

Qualifications & Leadership Profile

7+ years of experience in global payroll operations, payroll process design, or shared services environments, with strong knowledge of multi country payroll processing, statutory compliance, and payroll controls
Demonstrated experience designing, standardizing, and governing end to end processes within complex, matrixed, global organizations—ideally within a Global Business Services, Consulting, or transformation led model.
Strong working knowledge of payroll platforms and ecosystems (for example, Workday Payroll and external payroll vendors), including process enablement for automation, workflow tools, and emerging AI enabled capabilities.
Proven understanding of audit requirements, SOX controls, regulatory reviews, and risk management frameworks, with the ability to translate control expectations into practical process design.
Advanced analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to balance precision, scalability, and employee experience in high risk, highly regulated environments.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority across regions, functions, and senior leadership.
Enterprise first mindset with clear accountability for process integrity, quality, and continuous improvement, paired with a calm, structured, and pragmatic decision making approach.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Analyze product performance, activation metrics, and cohort behavior independently using SQL and Metabase.

Who you are

Must haves

Working proficiency in English and Spanish.
5+ years in product management, with at least 2–3 years owning a card product, rewards program, or premium card benefits portfolio within fintech or banking.
Demonstrated P&L ownership or strong commercial management experience, including revenue responsibility, pricing strategy, and unit economics.
Deep knowledge of corporate or premium card benefit structures, card network programs (e.g., Mastercard World Elite or Visa Infinite), and partner ecosystem economics.
Technical fluency and comfort working with Github (reading diffs, following PRs) and using AI coding tools to prototype and validate ideas.
Strong data literacy with hands-on experience running queries in SQL and evaluating product performance via dashboards like Metabase.
Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows, accelerate discovery, and scale product execution.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with proven success aligning engineering, finance, legal, and commercial partners through clear documentation.
Adaptability to fast-changing environments, bringing a high-agency builder mindset.

Nice to haves

Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it.
Hands-on experience negotiating complex provider contracts across multiple Latin American markets.
Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or Python to build financial and user models.
A good sense of humor.

Why Clara

A high talent-density team
driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.
Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.
An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.
English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

Clarity
— Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.
Simplicity
— If it can be simpler, it should be.
Ownership
— We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.
Pride
— We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.
ABC (Always Be Changing)
— We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.
Inclusivity
— Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

Hybrid at Clara

Claridians split their time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles, but we expect you to spend time there naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.

The Principal Stat Programmer plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of statistical programming across various clinical projects. This position demands proficiency in R and SAS programming
and familiarity with CDISC standards, particularly ADaM and SDTM models
. Key responsibilities include developing and validating complex data sets and outputs, collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize processes, and providing technical guidance on statistical methodologies and programming best practices. Develops and validates complex datasets and outputs using SAS programming, ensuring compliance with CDISC standards such as ADaM and SDTM models.

Mentors and guides junior programmers, fostering their growth and development.

Leads initiatives to enhance programming tools and techniques, driving innovation in statistical programming.

2 + years working with efficacy analysis (Adam datasets & TLF’s) and/or 4 + years on ADAM statistical programming on clinical trials.

Advanced English (both written and spoken - tested during the interview process).

Effectively manages time and resources to deliver high-quality programming outputs within tight deadlines.

Descripción de la empresa
Mekatronica MX es una empresa dedicada a la fabricación y mecanizado de componentes de alta precisión para distintos sectores industriales. Trabajamos con tecnología CNC de última generación para ofrecer soluciones fiables y de calidad a nuestros clientes. Descripción del puesto
En el puesto de Tornero CNC en Mekatronica MX te encargarás de operar tornos CNC para la fabricación de piezas según planos y especificaciones técnicas. En tu día a día configurarás parámetros de máquina, seleccionarás herramientas, ajustarás programas y realizarás controles dimensionales con instrumentos de medición. También participarás en el mantenimiento básico de los equipos, la preparación de materiales y el registro de la producción para asegurar la calidad y eficiencia del proceso. Este es un puesto a tiempo completo, presencial y ubicado en Bogotá, D.C., donde trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con el equipo de producción y calidad.
Requisitos

Experiencia previa como tornero CNC o en puestos similares de mecanizado, interpretando planos y tolerancias.
Conocimientos en programación básica de CNC (por ejemplo, Fanuc, Siemens u otros) y ajuste de parámetros de corte.
Manejo de instrumentos de medición (calibrador, micrómetro, relojes comparadores) y control de calidad dimensional.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma segura, ordenada y siguiendo procedimientos de producción y normas de prevención de riesgos laborales.
Aptitudes como trabajo en equipo, comunicación clara, atención al detalle y orientación a la mejora continua.
Valorable formación técnica en mecanizado, mecatrónica o ramas afines, así como experiencia en otros procesos de taller (fresado, rectificado, etc.).

Overview

The Senior Specialist, Payroll Governance is responsible for the end-to-end coordination, tracking, and administration of tuition payments associated with the ACS MBA sponsorship program. This role serves as the primary operational liaison between Payroll, Total Rewards Center of Excellence (COE), People Business Partners, and other key stakeholders to ensure tuition payments are accurately tracked, timely processed, and appropriately reported through payroll in compliance with company policies and local regulatory requirements. This individual plays a critical role in supporting the operational execution of a global educational assistance program with a complex population of employees on educational leave, internship assignments, and return-to-work arrangements.

Role

Monitor tuition payments, reimbursements, and outstanding balances received from program administrators and vendors.

Reconcile payment files and supporting documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy.
Track payroll processing status for all tuition-related transactions.

Payroll Coordination

Coordinate submission of tuition payment files for payroll processing.
Monitor payroll execution and confirm successful completion of transactions.
Partner with payroll teams to resolve discrepancies, exceptions, and processing issues.

Stakeholder Management & COE Support

Deliver regular reporting on tuition payments, open items, outstanding actions, and payroll completion status.
Respond to stakeholder inquiries regarding payment status and timing.
Escalate risks, delays, or data concerns to appropriate stakeholders.

All About You

Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data reconciliation and reporting.
Ability to manage multiple deadlines and large volumes of data with a high degree of accuracy.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working with Workday or other HRIS/payroll systems.

Experience working with cross-functional global teams.

jobs.description:
ROLE: Benefits Specialist

Company: Worldpanel by Numerator

Location: Bogotá office - Hybrid

About the Role:

We are looking for a Benefits Analyst to join our HR team and lead the design, administration, and communication of employee benefits programs across the LATAM region. This role, based in Colombia, will serve as a key partner to HR teams throughout the region, ensuring that benefits offerings are compliant with local regulations, competitive in local markets, and tailored to the diverse needs of our employees across Latin America.
The Benefits Analyst will manage a wide range of benefits — from statutory social security programs and healthcare to wellness initiatives and leave entitlements — while navigating the distinct cultural, legal, and labor frameworks of each LATAM country.

What You’ll do:

Benefits Strategy & Administration

Lead day-to-day operations for benefits programs across the LATAM region, including healthcare, pension/retirement plans, life insurance, and wellness programs
Partner with regional HR teams to tailor benefits to local employee needs, benchmarking against LATAM-specific market data
Manage country-specific statutory benefits including social security contributions, severance funds (e.g., Cesantías in Colombia, FGTS in Brazil), profit-sharing obligations (PTU in Mexico), and 13th/14th month salary requirements.

Vendor & Provider Management

Manage relationships with regional insurance brokers and wellness vendors across LATAM markets
Ensure service delivery meets agreed SLAs and handle escalations with local vendor contacts.
Negotiate plan designs and pricing with vendors, factoring in LATAM inflation rates and currency volatility.

Compliance & Regulatory Management

Stay current on regulatory changes across key LATAM markets including Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, and Peru in partnership with our global and local brokers.
Ensure all benefits programs comply with local labor codes, tax laws, and social security mandates — including Colombian Decreto 1072, Mexico's Ley Federal del Trabajo, Brazil's CLT, and Argentina's Ley de Contrato de Trabajo.
Manage country-specific statutory requirements such as prima de servicios (Colombia), aguinaldo (Mexico/Argentina), 13º salário (Brazil), asignación familiar (Chile/Peru), and obra social coverage (Argentina).
Liaise with local legal counsel and payroll teams to ensure benefits are correctly treated for tax and social contribution purposes in each jurisdiction.

Pension & Retirement Programs

Oversee compliance and employee education on mandatory pension systems across LATAM, including Colombia's dual regime (RPM vs. RAIS/AFP), Mexico's AFORE system, Brazil's INSS, Chile's AFP system, and Argentina's SIPA.
Where applicable, manage supplementary voluntary pension or savings vehicle offerings (e.g., voluntary contributions to Colombian AFP accounts or Brazilian PGBL/VGBL plans).

Benefits Communication

Build effective, multilingual communication strategies (primarily in Spanish and Portuguese) through emails, webinars, FAQs, and guides to help employees understand and maximize their benefits.
Adapt communication style for cultural nuances across LATAM countries, ensuring clarity for employees with varying levels of benefits literacy.
Partner with HR leaders and HR Generalists to deliver in-country communications.

Global Collaboration, Cost Optimization, & Reporting

Align LATAM benefits programs with global HR strategy while advocating for regional requirements and nuances in partnership with local and global broker partners.
Evaluate ROI on benefits offerings, factoring in local inflation, currency fluctuations, and statutory cost increases across LATAM markets.
Recommend enhancements that balance employee value with cost efficiency, particularly when managing benefits across high-inflation economies such as Argentina.

Requisites:

Previous experience in benefits administration with a strong focus on LATAM markets.
Understanding of country-specific benefits, statutory programs, and regulatory landscapes across LATAM (e.g., Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Peru).
Experience navigating multi-country benefits administration in a remote or distributed HR environment is strongly preferred.
Familiarity with LATAM payroll cycles and how benefits integrate with payroll processing across different countries.
Awareness of the economic environment in LATAM, including how currency devaluation and inflation (particularly in Argentina and Venezuela) affect benefits design and vendor contracting.
Fluency in Spanish required; Portuguese proficiency strongly preferred given the importance of the Brazilian market.
Fluent english.
Strong written and verbal communication skills to develop effective benefits communication strategies across culturally diverse employee bases.
Strong organization and administrative skills to balance priorities.
Ability to manage cross-functional and cross-border relationships, negotiate with regional vendors, and resolve complex compliance issues.
Proficiency in benefits administration software and HRIS systems (e.g., ADP, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar platforms commonly used in LATAM-operating organizations).
Comfortable working across multiple time zones within the Americas.
Bachelor's degree in any field. Professional certifications in HR and/or benefits is a plus.

jobs.description:
Diseñador de Producto

Sobre MAJORITY

MAJORITY es una innovadora aplicación móvil de servicios financieros todo en uno que incluye una cuenta asegurada por la FDIC, una Visa® Prepaid card, transferencias y llamadas internacionales. Para migrantes, por migrantes.

La migración global es una realidad del siglo XXI. Ya sea que las personas persigan sus sueños, el amor o nuevas experiencias, cada vez somos más los que buscamos nuevos entornos. Nuestro propósito en MAJORITY es empoderar a las personas increíbles, valientes y talentosos, y ayudarlos a alcanzar todas sus ambiciones.

Creemos que todos merecen la misma oportunidad de prosperar. Nuestra misión es brindar a los migrantes las herramientas para salir adelante en su nuevo país.

Somos un grupo diverso de personas de más de 40 países diferentes que colaboran diariamente y buscamos a otros impulsados por el mismo deseo de crear productos significativos que unan distancias culturales y geográficas.

Sobre el Rol

Buscamos a un Diseñador de Producto para unirse a nuestro equipo y construir productos globales clave utilizados diariamente por nuestros usuarios: transferencias de dinero, pagos con tarjeta y momentos que generan confianza en un producto financiero. Trabajarás en colaboración con product managers, ingenieros y creativos, llevando funciones desde el planteamiento inicial del problema hasta una interfaz de usuario pulida y lanzada al mercado.

Este rol se enfocará principalmente en nuestros productos globales, como las experiencias de criptobilletera y tarjeta en Colombia y México.

Es ideal para profesionales del diseño con una curiosidad innata, que se sienten cómodos asumiendo la responsabilidad de una función de principio a fin, atraídos por la resolución de problemas y disfruten colaborar con equipos de datos, cumplimiento e ingeniería. Deben sentirse cómodos operando dentro de las limitaciones propias de la creación de productos financieros y tomando decisiones ágiles con la información disponible para salir al mercado rápidamente e iterar, en lugar de esperar una claridad perfecta desde el lanzamiento.

Responsabilidades

Liderar el diseño de funciones desde la definición del problema hasta el lanzamiento, colaborando estrechamente con un product manager y un equipo de ingeniería.
Traducir investigaciones, requisitos de producto y datos (por ejemplo, análisis de la tasa de abandono en el embudo) en flujos claros e interfaces de usuario de alta fidelidad.
Diseñar dentro del sistema de diseño de MAJORITY y contribuir a él, creando componentes escalables, bien organizados y fáciles de expandir por otros diseñadores e ingenieros.
Considerar casos límite y estados menos comunes (errores, estados vacíos, cargas, rutas de fallo) como una parte central del diseño, no como algo secundario.
Colaborar con partes interesadas de cumplimiento, riesgo y operaciones para diseñar experiencias que cumplan con los requisitos regulatorios y de KYC sin comprometer la usabilidad.
Crear prototipos y probar enfoques de diseño, iterando según la retroalimentación y los datos del producto, utilizando herramientas de IA como Claude como parte de tu flujo de trabajo de prototipado.
Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con los ingenieros durante la implementación, proporcionando documentación de entrega detallada y bien organizada para que las especificaciones, estados y casos límite sean claros.
Presentar el trabajo con claridad a partes interesadas multifuncionales, incorporar comentarios y articular con claridad las razones detrás de tus decisiones de diseño.

Experiencia y Cualificaciones

Más de 5 años de experiencia en diseño de producto, idealmente en productos de consumo o móviles, con un portafolio excepcional que demuestre pensamiento de producto y cuidado del detalle visual.
Dominio profundo y práctico de Figma (variables, componentes, auto-layout y nomenclatura de capas disciplinada y organizada) con trayectoria en la creación de sistemas de componentes escalables y reutilizables.
Gran destreza visual: atención meticulosa a los detalles y un alto estándar de acabado perfecto en la interfaz de usuario implementada.
Facilidad para usar Claude (u herramientas de IA similares) para prototipar diseños, además de experiencia diseñando prompts (prompt engineering) para apoyar o automatizar partes de tu flujo de trabajo de diseño.
Apertura genuina a incorporar la IA en el proceso de diseño, utilizándola para agilizar la exploración, el prototipado y las tareas repetitivas.
Un portafolio que muestre la autoría completa de principio a fin: cómo planteas los problemas, exploras enfoques y llegas a soluciones lanzadas, no solo pantallas finales pulidas.
Soltura en el uso de datos para orientar las decisiones de diseño: lectura del abandono en el embudo, segmentación de uso o hallazgos de investigación para convertirlos en dirección de diseño.
Excelente capacidad de comunicación para explicar y defender los fundamentos del diseño ante ingenieros, product managers y otros colaboradores, así como de recibir comentarios para convertirlos en mejores decisiones de diseño.
Empatía con las comunidades a las que sirve MAJORITY e interés genuino en diseñar para personas que construyen su vida financiera.
Comodidad trabajando en entornos de habla inglesa.

Deseable

Experiencia diseñando productos financieros o productos en entornos globales complejos y regulados.
Experiencia con productos financieros para inmigrantes, sectores no bancarizados o mercados emergentes.
Familiaridad con flujos de pagos con tarjeta, depósitos o movimiento de dinero.
Experiencia contribuyendo o evolucionando un sistema de diseño.
Experiencia con Lokalize u otras herramientas equivalentes.

jobs.description:
Remote, Latam, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +4 years of experience

Who We Are

At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations.

We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries.

About The Role

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!

As a Customer Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of a merchant's journey with Yuno from the first discovery call to the first transaction in production. You sit on both sides of the deal: you design the solution that wins it, and you build the integration that makes it real. Demos, technical discovery, architecture proposals, RFPs and security reviews on one side; integration planning, API guidance, testing, and go-live on the other.

You will work with merchants processing millions of transactions across LATAM, each with a different stack, a different set of PSPs, and a different definition of "done". You will map their payment flows, find where Yuno fits, and translate that into something an engineering team can actually ship. Quality is the standard here, not the goal: every payment, every user, every time. An integration that goes live with unresolved edge cases is not a finished integration.

No two merchants integrate the same way, and priorities shift as deals move. You will need to adapt fast, pick up new payment methods and markets as they come, and stay effective when the plan changes mid-cycle. You will also be the connection point between Sales, Product, Engineering, and the merchant's own developers, making sure nothing gets lost between what was promised and what was built.

If you like being the person in the room who can answer the hard technical question and then go implement the answer, we want to talk to you.

Your Contribution Will Be

Lead technical discovery with prospects to understand their payment stack, requirements, and constraints.

Run product demos and deliver technical presentations to engineering and product audiences.

Design payment orchestration solutions and integration architectures tailored to each merchant.

Respond to RFPs, security questionnaires, and technical due diligence with Sales.

Own the end-to-end implementation, from kickoff and integration plan to testing and go-live.

Guide merchant developers through Yuno's APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and payment method configurations.

Troubleshoot integration issues across payment flows, API logs, and third-party providers.

Build reusable demo environments, integration guides, and technical documentation that shorten future cycles.

Hand off live merchants to Technical Account Management with complete context and documentation.

Feed recurring merchant requirements and integration friction back to Product and Engineering.

Skills You Need

Minimum Qualifications

Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required. Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.

+4 years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical implementation, or integration roles.

Hands-on technical skills: REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, HTTP debugging, and at least one programming language for building demos and sample integrations.

Payments knowledge: gateways, PSPs, acquirers, card networks, 3DS, tokenization, refunds, chargebacks, and alternative payment methods.

Experience running technical conversations with both engineering teams and commercial stakeholders.

Proven track record delivering integration projects with external development teams on defined timelines.

Comfortable working with SQL and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or similar.

Ability to manage multiple merchants and deals in parallel without losing technical depth on any of them.

Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities and processes evolve quickly.

What We Offer at Yuno

Competitive Compensation

Remote Work – You can work from everywhere!

Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.

Work Equipment

Stock Options

Health Plan wherever you are.

Flexible Days Off

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Product Architect
jobs.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Purpose

Job Description

The Product Architect owns the successful delivery, adoption and ongoing success of Visa Intelligent Authorisation (VIA) for strategically important clients, ensuring that client needs, product capabilities, implementation activities and delivery outcomes remain aligned throughout the onboarding lifecycle.

Serving as the connective tissue between Product, Sales Engineering, Client Services, Delivery teams and the client, the Product Architect provides continuity from pre-sales discovery through production stabilisation, ensuring requirements are understood, solution designs are viable, delivery remains aligned to client needs, and product evolution is informed by implementation reality.

This role exists because complex onboarding programmes require more than delivery management and more than product ownership. They require an individual who can operate across both worlds, challenge assumptions, navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and remain accountable for the integrity of the client outcome.

The Product Architect owns neither the product roadmap nor the day-to-day management of the project plan. However, they remain accountable for the successful delivery and adoption of VIA for their assigned clients, ensuring that commercial commitments, solution design, product capabilities and implementation activities remain aligned from initial engagement through production stabilisation.

Key Responsibilities

Client Ownership:

Act as the accountable Product lead for assigned strategic clients.
Own the successful delivery and adoption of VIA for assigned clients.
Maintain continuity from pre-sales engagement through production stabilisation.
Maintain accountability for implementation progress, delivery risks, solution integrity and client outcomes throughout the onboarding lifecycle.
Ensure client requirements, constraints, risks and dependencies are understood and managed throughout delivery.
Act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, helping align business objectives with product capabilities and implementation realities.
Escalate and drive resolution of issues that threaten delivery timelines, implementation success or client outcomes.

Solution Design & Requirements

Lead requirements discovery and solution definition for complex onboarding engagements.
Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure scope reflects genuine business needs.
Develop and maintain end-to-end solution designs covering technical, operational and product considerations.
Ensure solution designs balance client requirements, operational readiness, scalability and long-term product strategy.
Ensure that what is sold can be successfully implemented, operated and supported at scale.

Product & Delivery Alignment

Act as the primary bridge between client implementation teams and VIA product teams.
Ensure delivery remains aligned to agreed solution intent and product capabilities.
Surface product gaps and advocate for enhancements supported by implementation evidence.
Provide implementation-driven insights that influence product strategy, onboarding frameworks and future platform investments.
Drive alignment between product decisions, implementation activities and client commitments.

Delivery Governance

Provide architecture and product leadership throughout implementation.
Identify and mitigate technical, operational and onboarding risks.
Support Pilot exit and production readiness assessments for complex implementations.
Act as a senior authority within implementation governance forums, managing escalations, resolving ambiguity, and driving clear ownership across stakeholders.
Cut through organisational noise, competing priorities and conflicting viewpoints to maintain focus on delivery objectives and client outcomes.
Operate comfortably in situations where requirements, ownership, priorities or delivery paths are not yet fully defined, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges.
Influence without formal authority, aligning client, product, operational and delivery teams around a common outcome.
Be accountable for the overall success of the implementation, regardless of where individual workstreams or delivery responsibilities reside within the organisation.
Proactively intervene when delivery risks, ownership gaps or organisational barriers threaten successful execution.
Drive stakeholders toward decisions and actions required to maintain implementation timelines and client commitments.

Problem Resolution & Continuous Improvement

Troubleshoot complex integration, onboarding and production issues where required.
Capture lessons learned and convert implementation experience into reusable standards, guidance and onboarding patterns.
Contribute to improvements in product readiness, onboarding frameworks and client implementation practices.
Demonstrate a willingness to step beyond traditional role boundaries when required, contributing wherever necessary to keep implementations on track and achieve successful client outcomes.
Balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution, moving seamlessly between executive stakeholder discussions and detailed implementation problem solving.
Be prepared to do whatever is required to achieve the client outcome, whether leading executive escalations, facilitating workshops, removing delivery blockers, resolving implementation issues, or supporting activities outside traditional role boundaries.

Measures Of Success

Strategic clients successfully onboard and adopt VIA.
Client commitments are delivered successfully and sustainably.
Pilot and production milestones are achieved with strong operational readiness.
Delivery risks are identified early and resolved effectively.
Solution designs remain aligned to client objectives and product capabilities.
Product improvements are informed by implementation experience.
Stakeholders view the Product Architect as the accountable owner of the client outcome and successful delivery of VIA.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

8+ years of relevant professional experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 6+ years with an Advanced Degree, or equivalent experience.
Experience leading complex client onboarding, implementation, transformation, or integration programmes within Payments, Financial Services, FinTech, or related industries.
Experience translating business requirements into scalable, operationally viable solution designs.
Strong understanding of payment processing, issuer or acquirer operations, authorization systems, fraud and risk management, or related financial services technologies.
Experience working directly with clients to define requirements, manage expectations, and drive successful implementation outcomes.
Experience operating across Product, Technology, Operations, Client Services, Delivery, and Sales Engineering functions.
Demonstrated ability to identify, manage, and mitigate technical, operational, commercial, and programme risks.
Experience influencing stakeholders and driving decisions without direct authority in matrixed organizations.
Experience managing implementation governance, issue resolution, and client escalations.
Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments where requirements, ownership, or delivery approaches may not be fully defined.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience collaborating within global, cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of experience in Payments, Financial Services, Banking, FinTech, or related industries.
Experience leading strategic client implementations involving complex integrations and multiple stakeholder groups.
Understanding of issuer processing, authorization decisioning, digital payments, fraud systems, and associated operational processes.
Experience supporting pilot execution, production readiness, and post-production stabilization activities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic delivery mindset.
Demonstrated accountability for delivering successful client outcomes regardless of organizational boundaries, workstream ownership, or functional responsibilities.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
