jobs.description:
Description

Rapyd has unified payments, payouts and fintech on one worldwide platform, and we’re assembling the world’s best team to liberate global commerce. With offices in Tel Aviv, Amsterdam, Singapore, Iceland, London, Dubai, Hong Kong, Latam and the U.S., the opportunities at Rapyd are limitless.

We believe in straight talk, quick decisions, strong execution and elegant solutions. Rapyd is where hard work pays off and careers take off. Join us and let’s build the future of fintech together.

Get the tools to grow globally at www.rapyd.net. Follow: Blog, Insta, LinkedIn, Twitter

As a Payroll Analyst
you will be responsible to own and scale our local and regional HR operations. You will ensure precise, timely monthly payroll execution alongside external partners and internal teams while maintaining strict regulatory compliance. If you thrive in a high-growth fintech environment, love optimizing processes, and deliver operational excellence with high attention to detail, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Payroll Operations: Partner with external payroll vendors to execute end-to-end monthly payroll. Consolidate monthly novelties, review draft outputs, automate audit checks, and finalize monthly closing reports.
Financial & Tax Compliance: Align operations with local tax, labor, and social security regulations. Deliver monthly payroll reconciliations for Finance and maintain strict SOX controls and audit trails.
Employee Life Cycle Management: Lead onboarding/offboarding documentation, manage contracts, track work permits, and monitor local statutory requirements (e.g., SENA regulations, Monetization).
HR Systems & Data Integrity: Maintain updated employee records across HRIS and digital archives. Track medical leave reimbursements and generate operational payroll reporting.
Employee Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact for payroll and admin queries, working with in-country partners to resolve issues quickly.
Regional Support: Build domain knowledge across LATAM payroll frameworks to serve as an effective operational backup across the region.

Requirements

Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, HR, Business Administration, or a related field, with 1–3 years of hands-on payroll processing and personnel administration experience.
Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of local labor legislation, social security registration, and end-to-end employee lifecycle documentation.
Tech & Analytical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the Office suite, alongside direct experience managing HRIS platforms and databases.
SOX & Compliance Focus: Proven experience handling payroll audits and financial control environments.
Communication Skills: Professional English proficiency (B2 minimum) for cross-border collaboration.
Mindset: Extreme attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to prioritize dynamically in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About DEUNA 🧡

DEUNA is a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing global commerce with ATHIA, our AI-powered orchestration and payments platform that helps large enterprises boost approval rates, reduce costs, and unlock new revenue. Built by the team behind DEUNA—the fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin America—ATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution.

With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexico’s digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation.

We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! 🚀

Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us!

About The Role

We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to support the integration of new payment methods and PSPs as DEUNA scales its payment orchestration platform. You'll manage the roadmap for bringing new payment methods and providers to market, from technical scoping through go-live, working closely with Engineering and other teams to expand payment coverage across new and existing markets. This role exists to help make integrations faster, enabling DEUNA to support more payment methods and markets as we grow.

Who You Are

You have 4+ years of experience in product management or a related product or technical role
You have experience working in payments, ideally in a fintech or startup environment
You have a technical background in Computer Science, Engineering, or hands-on experience with APIs and technical integrations
You're comfortable reading API documentation, understanding integration flows, and discussing technical trade-offs with engineers
You can write clear technical specifications and requirements that help Engineering move efficiently
You're comfortable managing multiple integrations in parallel and prioritizing based on business impact and technical complexity
You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and are comfortable working with external partners and clients
You look for opportunities to use automation and AI tools to reduce manual work and make processes more efficient

What You'll Do

Manage the roadmap for payments integrations, from technical scoping through go-live. Write clear technical specifications for Engineering. Manage multiple integrations in parallel. Collaborate closely with Engineering during development and testing. Define and track success metrics for integrations. Communicate progress, blockers, and trade-offs with Commercial, and leadership. Identify opportunities to automate and standardize the integration process using AI and tooling.

What will you find when you join DEUNA?

A multicultural team distributed throughout LATAM
Dynamism, agility and constant innovation
Being part of a high-impact solution for an entire region
The best tools and technology to operate
Being part of the startup culture
We are in full expansion!

Vacations and additional PTO 🏝️

Economic support for health insurance, internet and cell phone line📱🌐

We all own DEUNA, we offer stock options 💸

Learning and development platform 📚

Multidisciplinary, diverse and dynamic team 🧡

Growth and career path 🚀

Be part of a dynamic team that's creating the next generation payments platform.

jobs.description:
It's more than a job

As part of the HR team at Kuehne+Nagel, you will help build careers, nurture talent, and empower people to succeed. Your work doesn’t stop at HR - it drives the entire supply chain forward. By attracting and developing the right people, you ensure that our operations run smoothly, so medical equipment reaches hospitals on time, toys arrive in stores for the holidays, and fresh flowers make it to local florists. Every great logistics solution starts with great people - and that’s where you come in.

‎

Are you passionate about Compensation & Benefits and interested in shaping fair, competitive, and data-driven reward practices? Join Kuehne+Nagel as a Total Rewards Specialist, where you will contribute to the management and continuous improvement of our compensation framework, with a strong focus on pay ranges, salary structures, and market competitiveness. You will partner with HR and business stakeholders to ensure our reward practices support both our people strategy and business objectives.

How you create impact

Manage pay ranges and salary structures: Maintain and analyze pay ranges, ensuring they are aligned with internal structures, job levels, and the company's compensation philosophy.
Support compensation benchmarking: Conduct market analysis and salary benchmarking to assess competitiveness and identify opportunities for adjustments.
Provide compensation insights: Partner with HR Business Partners and business leaders by providing data-driven recommendations on salary positioning, offers, promotions, and internal movements.
Ensure internal equity: Analyze compensation data to identify potential inconsistencies and support a fair and consistent approach to pay across roles and organizational levels.
Contribute to Total Rewards initiatives: Support compensation cycles, salary reviews, annual processes, and continuous improvement projects related to the company's Total Rewards strategy.

What we would like you to bring

Professional degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
Experience in Compensation & Benefits, Total Rewards, HR Analytics, or a similar position, with solid exposure to salary structures and pay ranges.
Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret compensation data and translate it into clear business recommendations.
Advanced Excel/data analysis skills and experience working with HR or compensation systems and market salary information.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with HR teams, managers, and business leaders in an international environment.

What's in it for you

Join a global logistics leader and contribute to the evolution of its Total Rewards strategy.
Gain strong exposure to compensation, pay ranges, salary structures, and market benchmarking across an international organization.
Work closely with HR and business stakeholders, developing your ability to influence compensation decisions through data and insights.
Be part of a dynamic environment where data, internal equity, and market competitiveness play a key role in people decisions.
Build your career in Total Rewards and Compensation within a global organization with opportunities for professional and international growth.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer / Solutions Architect & Technical PM
jobs.description:
About SAMY

We weren't built to follow, we were built to lead.

SAMY is the global powerhouse redefining brand communication for a social-first world—helping brands stay relevant, shape culture, and build real connections at the speed the world moves. Since 2013, we've grown from a bold idea into a global force: 1,200+ experts, 17+ offices, 55 markets, 22+ countries. We launch 40+ campaigns a week, create one piece of content every minute, and generate +$500K in revenue every day.

We are Path Finders: curious, ambitious, and never afraid to challenge what's next.

We don't play it safe. We build what's next.

Instagram | TikTok | Culture page

Role Mission

We're hiring a senior developer/architect to lead the development and QA teams and manage the project itself across the next phase of a large-scale, high-traffic digital platform modernization: migrating a headless Next.js + CMS stack onto Vercel, in parallel with a personalization/experimentation build shipping on the current infrastructure. You'll direct both teams responsible for this engagement, own technical oversight across every workstream, run the project plan and tracking, and sit client-facing co-designing the architecture in real time with the client's engineering leadership and their UX/UI implementation partner.

,

Key Responsibilities

Lead both the development team and the QA team across the full engagement — assigning work, reviewing implementation, setting the technical and quality bar, and acting as the escalation point across all workstreams.
Own project management for the initiative: maintain the project plan and timeline, run the Linear-tracked exit-criteria checklist through weekly review, and report status and risk to stakeholders.
Direct QA and acceptance testing for the Payload-on-Vercel migration build (cold-start/connection-pool behavior, Jobs Queue rebuild, bulk-operation limits) — the build is executed by another party; this role owns sign-off, not the implementation itself.
Direct QA across the entire initiative — every workstream in the migration and personalization build passes through development and QA review before it's considered done.
Define and validate performance budgets for the new architecture (TTFB, LCP, INP, CLS, personalization latency, tentpole-load behavior), and test the Vercel build against them under simulated peak traffic.
Decide and stand up observability tooling — infrastructure monitoring, uptime checks, and application performance/error tracking — instrumented on Vercel from day one.
Own disaster-recovery design and testing for the new Vercel/Neon topology.
Support cost modeling — projecting Vercel usage cost at steady-state and traffic-spike volume against a proposed dollar ceiling.
Co-lead security and privacy validation of the new architecture — access management, secrets, application security, edge/runtime security, monitoring, and consent/privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA) via OneTrust — alongside client stakeholders.
Partner with the client's UX/UI implementation team on caching correctness (cache-hit/miss behavior, cross-visitor isolation, invalidation) as part of the migration test suite.
Act as direct technical point of contact with client-side engineering and product leadership, translating architecture tradeoffs into terms non-technical stakeholders can act on.

Skills & Experience

7+ years of experience in full-stack development, software architecture, or similar roles, with hands-on experience in Vercel, Next.js/React, headless CMS, GraphQL, and Postgres (Neon is a plus).
Experience leading development and QA teams, setting technical standards, reviewing implementations, and owning acceptance criteria and deliverable quality.
Experience in technical project management, including planning, tracking, risk management, and stakeholder communication. Linear experience is a plus.
Knowledge of QA, testing, performance, observability, disaster recovery, security, and privacy, ideally with OneTrust and GDPR/CCPA knowledge.
Experience migrating or re-architecting high-traffic production systems, particularly in cloud/edge environments. Cloudflare Workers and AWS are a plus.
Knowledge of personalization, experimentation, CDP/identity systems, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud is a plus.
Experience working with clients, agencies, and external teams, with fluent English and strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced, and cross-functional environments, making technical decisions and translating architectural trade-offs into business needs.

Benefits

Work your way — Flexible schedule, hybrid work, and the opportunity to work up to 3 weeks a year from any SAMY office around the world.
Time that matters — Celebrate your birthday with a day off, plus company holidays on December 24th and 31st to recharge.
Grow with us — Global mobility opportunities, mentorship, parenthood support, and a transparent performance-driven compensation framework.
Be part of the journey — Help shape our team through our referral program and enjoy a collaborative, social culture, backed by a transparent, performance-driven compensation framework that rewards impact and supports your growth.

The SAMY Mindset

Forget the job description for a second. The real question is: are you a Path Finder? Bold enough to challenge what's possible. Collaborative enough to build it together. Driven enough to make it happen.

We don't just hire for roles, we hire for mindset. We look for people who communicate with honesty, collaborate without ego, embrace change with energy, and take real ownership of what they build.

We're not looking for people who think the same, we're looking for people who want to grow with us.

Here's What It Actually Looks Like To Belong Here

Be Kind
— because respect, trust, and honest feedback make great teams stronger.

Go Beyond
— because good is never enough when excellence is the standard.

Craft Together
— because the best ideas don't happen in silos.

Enjoy the Journey
— because growth lives outside the comfort zone.

Own It
— because real impact starts with accountability.

If this feels like your kind of adventure, let's build something together.

Diversity & Inclusion

At SAMY, difference is not something we accommodate, it's what makes us stronger.

With a team made up of 70% women and more than 35 different nationalities, our different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences challenge our thinking, sharpen our creativity, and push us to build better work, and a better company.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and barrier-free environment where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to thrive. And if you need support or adjustments along the way, we'll make sure you have what you need to do your best work.

Liderar integraciones con rieles como SPEI, Bre-B, PIX y otros sistemas locales e internacionales.

jobs.title: CPQ Architect
jobs.description:
RevOps Solutions Architect (Quote-to-Cash)

About The Job

At Go Nimbly, we want to be a global thought leader in the RevOps space by developing a badass brand built through innovative work created by individuals with growth mindsets. As a member of the Delivery team, you will help our clients drive more revenue by creating a buying experience that’s both frictionless and human. You will move these high‑growth companies toward a more operationally efficient organization.

As a CPQ Solutions Architect
at Go Nimbly, you’ll collaborate with a team of RevOps Consultants, Program Managers, Developers, and Analysts to design and deliver quote‑to‑cash (Q2C) solutions across Salesforce and adjacent CPQ/Billing platforms (e.g., Nue.io, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, DealHub, or comparable tools). You will act as a subject matter expert across quoting, pricing, discounting, approvals, product modeling, subscriptions, amendments/renewals, order management, and downstream integrations to CLM, Billing, and Finance. You lead through solution and architecture decisions by considering scalability, trade-offs, best practice, and the latest technology trends, including where generative AI can accelerate or improve general operations and go-to-market motions.

On a given day, a CPQ Solutions Architect will spend time:

Leading discovery on selling motions, pricing strategies, and approval policies, then translating them into a scalable CPQ data model, owning that conversation directly with client stakeholders, including executives.
Designing end-to-end Q2C architectures spanning Lead to Opportunity to Quote/Proposal to Contract to Order to Invoice to Revenue, including integrations to CLM, e-signature, billing, and ERP, and advising clients on when to buy an existing tool versus build a custom solution.
Identifying where AI and agents create real leverage inside Q2C, quote generation, approval routing, contract review, then building those workflows, always weighing where AI should own the process versus where a person needs to stay involved, and mindful of data governance and compliance.
Modeling products and pricing (bundles, options, attributes, rules, price books, multi-currency, partner pricing) and defining solution patterns for complex use cases like ramp deals, usage/consumption, prorations, amendments, and renewals.
Diagnosing where Q2C systems are broken or fragmented, duplicate product or pricing sources of truth, manual approval workarounds, data that doesn't reconcile between CPQ and Billing or ERP, and owning the fix from root cause through to a shipped solution, not just flagging the gap.
Authoring technical design docs and scoping and estimating CPQ workstreams and migrations, presenting them to client stakeholders in a way that builds trust and drives alignment, and calling out risks and dependencies early.
Guiding implementation by partnering with developers and administrators on configuration standards, code review, data migration, and test plans, and setting governance for CPQ and Billing so clients are enabled with clear playbooks and runbooks.
Mentoring teammates with ad hoc coaching on CPQ concepts and platform releases, and championing a diligent, no corners cut delivery through strong enablement and rollout.

What’s in it for you?

Flexible working environment: our entire team works remotely, and we have no plans to change this!
Tiered incentive program (in addition to base salary) to reward high performers.
Exposure to several high‑growth companies investing in quote‑to‑cash transformation.
Collaborate with top industry professionals. Many alumni have gone on to become leaders and executives at high‑growth companies!
Annual camp: a yearly offsite to bring the team together, celebrate our successes, and plan the year.
Dedicated employee development and career paths aimed at fostering your growth and your career.
100% paid premiums for US employees’ insurance coverage.

About You

8+ years designing and implementing RevOps and/or Q2C solutions, partnering with senior stakeholders across Sales, RevOps, Finance, and IT to uncover requirements, diagnose gaps and pains, and translate them into scalable technical designs, including advising clients on when to buy versus build.
Deep CPQ expertise with Salesforce and at least one modern CPQ/Billing platform, having a strong preference for Nue.io, with other considerations being Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Salesforce CPQ/Billing, DealHub, able to articulate when to configure versus customize, with Salesforce platform breadth across core objects, Flow, Platform Events, and Apex/Lightning best practices.
A track record of diagnosing fragmented or broken Q2C systems, duplicate sources of truth, manual handoffs, data that doesn't reconcile, and owning the fix through to a shipped solution, paired with a genuine point of view on where AI and agents should own part of that process versus where a person needs to stay in the loop, mindful of data governance, PII, and compliance boundaries.
Proven product and pricing modeling skills, bundles/options, configuration rules, advanced pricing, multi-currency, tax, and channel/partner scenarios, along with lifecycle mastery of subscriptions: amendments, co-terming, renewals, and ARR/RevRec implications in partnership with Finance.
Hands-on integration experience across CLM, e-signature, billing, payment gateways, data warehouses, and ERPs, including API patterns and middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato), data and migration chops, and broad, practical knowledge of the wider RevOps and revenue tech ecosystem with a demonstrated ability to rapidly learn new platforms.
Agile delivery, backlog shaping, story writing, acceptance criteria, and iterative release planning, paired with the ability to author clear technical design docs and scope and estimate complex workstreams.
Ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams, communicating with technical and non-technical audiences, mentoring others through ad hoc coaching, and comfortable in front of executive stakeholders as easily as in a technical working session.
Bonus: Salesforce Application or System Architect certification, CPQ/Billing vendor certifications (e.g., Nue.io, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Salesforce CPQ/Billing, Conga), or experience with consumption/usage-based pricing or marketplace monetization.

About Us

As a remote first team, we rely on video calls to stay connected, make decisions, and work directly with clients, so being comfortable on camera and engaged in that setting is part of how we operate day to day.

Be a Leader. Leadership at Go Nimbly isn't about title, it's showing up with a point of view, saying the hard thing clearly, and making sure what you started actually lands.
Show Your Work. We love a finished product, but how you got there matters too. Clear communication and proactive updates are part of the job.
Value Long-Term Over Short-Term. The fast answer and the right answer aren't always the same. We're committed to building things that scale, even when that means slowing down.
Take It to the Finish Line. We don't hand things off and hope for the best. When you own something here, you own it all the way through.
Customer-Obsessed. When our clients win, we win. We genuinely understand their business and show up as trusted advisors, as invested in their outcomes as they are.
Gotchu Energy. The best teammates make the people around them feel like they've got backup, leaning into hard moments instead of away from them.

What’s next?

Apply! Rest assured, while AI might feel like it’s taking over the world, we have a human on the other end of the computer personally reviewing each application. Our Talent Acquisition team will reach out if we’d like to speak further about the role. And if not, we promise to let you know because let’s be honest, who enjoys being ghosted when applying for a job? Not only are we committed to getting back to you but we also provide clear feedback.

During the first call with our Talent team, we will lay out the steps in the interview process since it’s unique to each role but typically includes a couple of rounds. We value your time and ours, so we plan to make the best use of our interviews to learn if we are a good fit for you and vice versa.

The base salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000 USD. Additionally, this role is eligible for a tiered bonus structure of up to 22 percent of base salary.

Initial placement within the range depends on geographic location, experience, and skillset, with most hires landing at or near the midpoint, leaving room for growth and future impact. The top of the range is generally reserved for those who are performing at a high level and impact here at Go Nimbly. Final offer amounts will vary based on leveling, and will be adjusted based on geographical location and the candidate's applicable experience and skillset.

jobs.title: Facade Project Manager - Medellin, Colombia

About Us:

DeSimone is a leading global structural engineering firm known for delivering innovative, high-performance design solutions across the built environment. Our team of engineers, designers, and technical experts collaborates on a diverse portfolio—from iconic high-rise buildings to complex, large-scale structures—shaping skylines and communities around the world. With offices across the U.S. and internationally, we partner closely with clients to bring bold ideas to life with precision, creativity, and technical excellence.

Why DeSimone?

At DeSimone Consulting Engineering, you’ll work alongside some of the world’s most brilliant engineering minds on projects that redefine skylines and push the boundaries of design and innovation. From iconic skyscrapers to cutting-edge structures, our global portfolio reflects a commitment to excellence and creativity.

We are a team that values growth, collaboration, and real impact—you won’t just be part of the work, you’ll help shape it. With strong mentorship, hands-on experience, and opportunities to advance, you’ll build a career as impressive as the projects you’re working on.

We offer a flexible, collaborative work environment along with a comprehensive benefits package—designed to support your well-being and long-term success.

At DeSimone, your contributions matter. You’ll be trusted with meaningful work, empowered to grow, and supported every step of the way.

Ready to build what’s next? Join us.

About the Role:

As a Façade Project Manager, you will:
Lead the technical delivery of façade design and consultancy services.
Collaborate and coordinate with other project participants including Architects, owners, consultants, contractors and the project team.
Lead and plan broken-off tasks or efforts appropriately and independently, assign work to internal staff and budget time, review progress, provide quality checks and markups, meet deadlines, and communicate progress as needed or directed by the PM or Associate to external parties.
Work effectively on multiple projects simultaneously.
Understand project scope, proactively track project deliverables/milestones and risks to exceeding scope and effectively communicate updates or alerts to PM and/or Associate.
Proactively undertake business development activities.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other team members.

  What You'll Do:  

Project Leadership & Delivery:

Lead façade design and consulting projects from planning through construction.
Coordinate with architects, owners, contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders.
Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, deliverables, and milestones.
Assign work to project team members, review progress, provide quality control, and ensure deadlines are met.
Identify project risks and communicate scope, budget, or schedule concerns proactively.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high-quality deliverables.

Technical Expertise

Prepare and review technical reports, specifications, drawings, sketches, and analyses.
Conduct building enclosure assessments, façade inspections, forensic investigations, and due diligence studies.
Perform and review engineering calculations related to façade systems and building enclosure performance.
Evaluate contractor submittals, shop drawings, product data, test reports, and detailed design packages.
Participate in factory visits, field inspections, and performance testing.
Provide technical recommendations related to architectural intent, durability, sustainability, constructability, scheduling, and budget objectives.
Conduct independent code research and ensure compliance with applicable building and energy codes.

Client & Business Development

Build and maintain strong client relationships.
Support proposal development, fee negotiations, and project budgeting efforts.
Identify opportunities for business development and cross-selling services.
Represent DeSimone through networking events, industry presentations, webinars, publications, and professional organizations.
Stay informed on industry trends, emerging technologies, and market opportunities.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

Mentor and develop junior staff through technical guidance and project support.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team environment.
Provide constructive feedback and assist with professional development planning.
Support recruitment, interviewing, and team growth initiatives when needed.

Minimum (Required) Skills:

Maintain and develop computer literacy skills; including specialist software, Microsoft Office and Teams.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, Bluebeam Revu, LBNL Therm, Window, Optics, Revit, Rhino and other relevant technical software.
Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering or related field.
Up to date knowledge, which is maintained, in technical area of expertise.
Licensure in Architecture or Engineering
Minimum 5 years of experience working with/applying a variety of building envelope systems and materials
including: Roofing
Below-Grade Waterproofing
Above-Grade Waterproofing
Curtain Wall
Window Wall
Punched Windows
Brick
Metal Panel Cladding
Precast Concrete/GFRC/Stone Cladding

Minimum 5 years of experience performing building envelope inspections and forensic investigations.
A minimum of 5 years of façade design and engineering experience.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

Master’s degree in Architecture or Engineering.

jobs.title: Civil/Structural Designer
jobs.description:
Audubon is currently looking for a Civil/Structural Designer/Drafter to join our design team at our Bogotá Office and support active and upcoming projects within the civil and structural discipline.
This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with strong knowledge of structural steel detailing, modeling, and drafting. The candidate should be able to interpret technical information, understand structural concepts, follow company and client standards, and actively participate in technical discussions with engineers, designers, and project teams.

We are especially looking for candidates who can understand the technical requirements of a project, identify potential issues, ask relevant questions, and develop accurate and constructible deliverables.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Preparing, developing, and updating structural steel drawings and deliverables.
Detailing and modeling structural steel components, including platforms, stairs, ladders, handrails, supports, frames, and miscellaneous steel.
Interpreting engineering documents, design criteria, specifications, sketches, and markups.
Reviewing structural models and drawings to identify inconsistencies, interferences, and constructability concerns.
Applying company, client, and project drafting standards to all deliverables.
Preparing plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules, and material take-offs as required.
Coordinating with engineers, designers, drafters, and other disciplines to resolve technical issues.
Participating in technical meetings and clearly communicating questions, progress, and potential concerns.
Performing self-checks to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and quality of deliverables.
Incorporating review comments and supporting the checking and approval process.
Meeting project schedules, priorities, and delivery commitments.
Supporting the development of efficient and constructible design solutions.

EXPERIENCE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

Technical degree, professional training, or equivalent experience in drafting, structural design, civil engineering, or a related field.
Relevant experience in structural steel drafting, detailing, or design.
English proficiency sufficient to understand technical information and communicate with global teams.
Strong knowledge of structural steel components, connections, supports, platforms, stairs, ladders, handrails, and miscellaneous steel.
Ability to read and interpret structural drawings, engineering documents, specifications, and technical information.
Experience using structural design and drafting software such as Advance Steel, AutoCAD, Revit, Tekla, or similar tools.
Knowledge of drafting standards, drawing practices, and quality control requirements.
Ability to understand technical discussions and translate engineering requirements into accurate drawings and models.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to ask clear and relevant technical questions.
Ability to work effectively with engineers, designers, drafters, and multidisciplinary teams.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering accurate, complete, and constructible work.
Ability to work independently, organize priorities, and meet established deadlines.
Experience in the Oil & Gas, industrial, infrastructure, or construction sectors is valued.
Knowledge of international standards and codes related to structural steel is a plus.
Positive attitude, teamwork mindset, accountability, and willingness to learn.

jobs.title: RevOps Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
About The Job

At Go Nimbly, we want to be a global thought leader in the RevOps space by developing a badass brand built through innovative work created by individuals with growth mindsets. As a member of the Delivery team, you will help our clients drive more revenue by creating a buying experience that’s both frictionless and human. You will move these high-growth companies towards a more operationally efficient organization.

As a RevOps Solutions Architect at Go Nimbly, you'll collaborate with a team of RevOps Consultants, Program Managers, Developers, and Analysts to build best-in-class solutions and impactful technology roadmaps. You will act as a subject matter expert on the process of scoping, discovery, solutioning, and leading the team through solution and architecture decisions by considering scalability, trade-offs, best practice, and the latest technology trends, including where generative AI can accelerate or improve general operations and go-to-market motions.

Remote: Location Requirements

We’re a fully remote company. At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who reside in the following locations due to payroll, tax, and compliance requirements:

U.S. states:
California, Colorado, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah.

Countries:
Argentina, Colombia, Uruguay, Mexico, Brazil

On a given day, a RevOps Solutions Architect will spend time:

Defining architecture principles and standards. A RevOps Solutions Architect owns communication and justification of design decisions with our internal team and directly with the client, including executive stakeholders.
Building connections between GTM systems that drive real value and outcomes, whether that's through custom code, integrations, or an iPaaS/automation platform like Workato, Make, or n8n. The tool matters less than knowing which one fits the problem.
Finding where AI and agents can add value, then building workflows that turn GTM data into actionable insights and automate work. You identify and propose when AI should own the process versus when a human needs to stay involved, all while respecting data privacy, security, and compliance.
Diagnosing where GTM systems are broken or fragmented, duplicate sources of truth, manual handoffs, data that doesn't reconcile, and owning the fix from root cause through to a shipped solution, not just flagging the gap.
Designing solutions for complex workstreams, advising clients on when to buy an existing tool versus build a custom solution, and presenting these solutions to client teams in a way that builds trust and makes the case for scalability and best practice.
Actively participating in up-leveling the team through ad hoc coaching and mentoring on solutions, and championing a diligent, no corners cut delivery through strong enablement and rollout.
Senior members of Go Nimbly act as an ambassador within the Revenue Operations space and keep a pulse on the latest releases and technology trends, including generative AI and its growing role in RevOps architecture, to help form a point of view on how releases and changes will impact teams and customers.

What’s in it for you?

Flexible working environment: our entire team works remotely, and we have no plans to change this!
Tiered incentive program (in addition to base salary) to reward high performers.
Gain exposure to several high-growth companies looking to scale and invest in their revenue operations function.
Be a part of a dynamic team and collaborate with top industry professionals. Many of our alumni have gone on to become leaders and executives at high-growth companies!
Annual camp: we have a yearly offsite to bring the team together, celebrate our successes, and plan the year.
Dedicated to employee development and career paths aimed at fostering your growth and your career.
100% paid premiums for US employees’ insurance coverage.

About You

You have 8+ years of experience in at least one core discipline (Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, or Business Systems) and working fluency across the others, including systems architecture and administration (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, or similar), data modeling and integration design across the tech stack.
You work with senior stakeholders to uncover business requirements, diagnose gaps and pains, and design scalable technical solutions to resolve them, including advising clients on when to buy versus build.
Extensive knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities and core features, with a perspective on when to use out of the box features, declarative automation, or code, and comfort building connections across custom code, integrations, or an iPaaS platform like Clay, Workato, Make, or n8n.
A track record of diagnosing fragmented or broken GTM systems, duplicate sources of truth, manual handoffs, data that doesn't reconcile, and owning the fix through to a shipped solution, not just flagging the problem.
Ability to influence and lead internal and external teams, communicating with technical and non technical audiences, and you can hold your own in front of executive stakeholders.
A genuine point of view on AI and agents in RevOps: judgment on where AI should own delivery versus where a person needs to stay in the loop, and mindful of data governance, PII, and compliance boundaries.
Bonus: if you have a Certified Salesforce Application Architect or Systems Architect certification, or are on the path to achieving one of these certifications.

About Us

As a remote first team, we rely on video calls to stay connected, make decisions, and work directly with clients, so being comfortable on camera and engaged in that setting is part of how we operate day to day.

Be a Leader. Leadership at Go Nimbly isn't about title, it's showing up with a point of view, saying the hard thing clearly, and making sure what you started actually lands.
Show Your Work. We love a finished product, but how you got there matters too. Clear communication and proactive updates are part of the job.
Value Long-Term Over Short-Term. The fast answer and the right answer aren't always the same. We're committed to building things that scale, even when that means slowing down.
Take It to the Finish Line. We don't hand things off and hope for the best. When you own something here, you own it all the way through.
Customer-Obsessed. When our clients win, we win. We genuinely understand their business and show up as trusted advisors, as invested in their outcomes as they are.
Gotchu Energy. The best teammates make the people around them feel like they've got backup, leaning into hard moments instead of away from them.

What’s next?

Apply! Rest assured, while AI might feel like it’s taking over the world, we have a human on the other end of the computer personally reviewing each application. Our Talent Acquisition team will reach out if we’d like to speak further about the role. And if not, we promise to let you know because let’s be honest, who enjoys being ghosted when applying for a job? Not only are we committed to getting back to you but we also provide clear feedback.

During the first call with our Talent team, we will lay out the steps in the interview process since it’s unique to each role but typically includes a couple of rounds. We value your time and ours, so we plan to make the best use of our interviews to learn if we are a good fit for you and vice versa.

The base salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000 USD. In addition to a base salary, this role is eligible for a performance bonus plan.

Initial placement within the range depends on geographic location, experience, and skillset, with most hires landing at or near the midpoint, leaving room for growth and future impact. The top of the range is generally reserved for those who are performing at a high level and impact here at Go Nimbly. Final offer amounts will vary based on leveling, and will be adjusted based on geographical location and the candidate's applicable experience and skillset.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
Remote, Latam or Europe, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +6 years of experience

Who We Are

Yuno is the AI-native operating system of global commerce, powering the financial infrastructure of enterprise merchants, banks, and wallets. With a single API, Yuno connects them to pay-ins, payouts, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB, and stablecoins globally, so they can operate everywhere with a single integration.

Agnostic by design, Yuno offers connectivity to 1,000+ payment methods and 460+ integrations in 190+ countries, optimizing acceptance rates, reducing costs, and strengthening security through specialized AI agents that learn from every transaction on the network. Global brands run their payments on Yuno, including Arcos Dorados (McDonald's), NetEase Games, GoFundMe, inDrive, and Rappi. Banks, acquirers, PSPs, and wallets use Yuno to modernize their infrastructure without replacing core systems and to prepare for the next generation of commerce, including agentic payments.

About The Role

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team! If you are a Lead Product Designer ambitious and passionate about building world-class payment experiences, joining Yuno will allow you to transform complex problems into simple, elegant solutions that reach millions of users across the globe. At Yuno, every design decision impacts the payment revolution.

As a  Lead Product Designer you will be part of the Product Team, working end-to-end from discovery through delivery always with the customer at the center.

Your contribution will be

Lead the design process
from discovery to delivery, owning the full end-to-end experience across web and mobile platforms.

Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, and Data Scientists
to deeply understand customer needs and define the right problems to solve.

Identify key metrics for your projects
and take ownership of their success, iterating based on real performance data.

Research and bring forward user insights
to support product launches in new markets and the rollout of new payment features.

Design clear, elegant solutions
from early wireframes and concepts through to polished, production-ready prototypes and flows.

Run customer testing workshops
to validate assumptions and ensure designs solve real problems before going to build.

Collaborate closely with engineers
during implementation to ensure design quality and fidelity at release.

Contribute to and help evolve
Yuno's design system to keep our product consistent, scalable, and cohesive.

Bring ideas to solve problems
: any idea is better than none.

Skills You Need

Minimum Qualifications

Fluent English.

6+ years of experience designing complex, commercial digital products in-house (fintech or payments experience is a strong plus).

A compelling portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design work across web and mobile — required to apply.

Experience designing across iOS, Android, and web platforms.

Strong UX foundation: deep understanding of user behavior, interaction design, and information architecture.

Clean visual design sensibility: typography, grid systems, color, and component design.

Ability to think strategically and clearly articulate design decisions to cross-functional stakeholders.

Understanding of technical constraints and how they influence design decisions.

Ownership mindset: ability to drive the design process autonomously and manage multiple projects.

Problem-solving skills: thinking outside the box is what we're looking for.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing or maintaining design systems at scale.

Ability to code simple prototypes (HTML/CSS, Framer, or similar).

Enthusiasm for working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

Comfort with ambiguity and a drive to bring clarity to complex, evolving problems.

What We Offer at Yuno

Competitive Compensation

Remote Work – You can work from everywhere!

Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.

Work Equipment

Stock Options

Health Plan wherever you are.

Flexible Days Off

jobs.title: Solutions Architect Lead - Stripe Payments
jobs.description:
Salary Range
: 17,000,000-19,000,000 COP

Company Description:

Monstarlab builds digital solutions that start with people and scale with purpose—crafting platforms that deliver real, measurable impact.
We are a tight‑knit crew of strategists, product managers, designers, and engineers united by a single passion: crafting user‑centric experiences and digital products for our clients. Monstarlab's operational model lets us blend boutique, hands-on service with true global scale—so you benefit from round‑the‑clock momentum, deep domain expertise, and solutions tailored to your market.
Who You Are:

Level: Payments Solutions Architect (IC contributor with mentorship responsibilities)
Role DNA: This position blends elements of:
Solution Architect (50%) - Technical design and PSP solution guidance
Technical Product Manager (50%) - Requirements creation and product definition

Job Description:

Overview We're seeking an experienced payments expert to bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation in client engagements. This role combines deep payment service provider (PSP) knowledge — with particular depth in Stripe Connect — and technical acumen to drive successful payment integration projects. You will help clients navigate complex payment ecosystems, define integration requirements, and deliver seamless solutions that drive business growth.
The right candidate will:

Operate at the intersection of technical product management and solutions architecture
Shape product requirements
Be comfortable presenting technical solutions to non-technical clients; particularly complex payment ecosystems built on Stripe Connect
Guide technical design and integrations
Be pragmatic and commercially savvy, but able to dive into technical detail when needed
Be adept at context-switching between high-level strategy and low-level payment integration patterns
Natural teacher who can simplify complexity for clients while pushing engineering teams toward scalable designs

Core Responsibilities

Overall Payments Strategy & Advisory

Stay current on payment industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes, including tracking and evaluating emerging trends in the payments ecosystem (embedded finance, open banking, digital wallets, BNPL, etc.)
Translate complex payment concepts — particularly Stripe Connect account structures and fund flows — into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders

Technical Design & Requirements

Contribute to technical architecture discussions and design reviews
Architect and scope payment integrations including marketplace-style platforms and payment facilitators, payment migrations, and multi-party fund flows, with particular depth in Stripe Connect (Custom, Express, and Standard account types; destination charges; application fees; separate charges and transfers)
Participate in technical input sessions and exploratory calls with enterprise clients to assess payment processing needs and technical readiness
Design comprehensive payment solutions leveraging Stripe Connect and Square capabilities, with working knowledge of Adyen and other providers as needed
Develop technical specifications and integration approaches for complex use cases involving payments and fund routing, especially Stripe Connect-based marketplace and platform models
Draft and refine product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for payment integrations
Develop wireframes and visual mockups to communicate payment flows and user experiences

PSP Specific Advisory and Implementation Support

Provide hands-on guidance and act as a SME for Stripe Connect (Custom, Express, and Standard accounts; destination charges and application fees; Connect Onboarding and embedded components; Treasury and Issuing where applicable), with working proficiency in Square APIs and Adyen integrations
Evaluate and recommend platform strategies around risk management, monetization, reporting, and onboarding — with particular focus on Stripe Connect's account and capability model
Navigate PSP dashboards and administrative tools (Stripe Dashboard, Square Dashboard, Adyen Customer Area) to troubleshoot and optimize configurations
Document integration patterns, best practices, and technical specifications
Translate provider features into clear business value propositions for client stakeholders

Stakeholder & Team Collaboration

Partner with commercial leads to shape client proposals and scoping
Collaborate with distributed engineering teams to ensure successful implementation of payment solutions
Work closely with client engineering teams to translate requirements into implementation plans
Explain technical implementation details to non-technical stakeholders in plain language
Facilitate workshops and knowledge transfer sessions with client stakeholders
Partner closely with commercial leads, engineers, and program managers to align solution design with business goals
Facilitate client workshops to uncover requirements and educate clients on payment provider capabilities
Serve as a trusted advisor who can balance business outcomes, technical feasibility, and user experience

Nice-to-Haves

Create detailed product requirements documents for payment integrations
Perform vibe coding/prototyping to validate technical approaches
Collaborate with engineers on wireframes, solution design, and minimal technical architecture reviews
Support and occasionally guide hands-on API/SDK integrations at a conceptual level

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

Evaluate client payment needs and recommend optimal PSP solutions using best-in-class, API-driven providers (Stripe, Square, Adyen, others)
7–10+ years in payments, fintech, or software consulting, with a focus on payment service providers
Hands-on experience with major payment platforms, particularly deep, hands-on expertise with Stripe Connect (Custom/Express/Standard accounts, destination charges, application fees, multi-party fund flows), plus working experience with Square and Adyen
Deep understanding of payment ecosystem including acquirer relationships, payment facilitation, and card network operations
Proficiency with PSP APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns, with particular fluency in the Stripe Connect API surface (Accounts, Transfers, Payouts, Application Fees)
Understanding of technical architecture concepts (APIs, microservices, data flows)
Familiarity with payment compliance requirements (PCI-DSS, PSD2, etc.)
Strong grasp of regulatory considerations including PCI compliance, KYC/KYB requirements, and handling tokenized payments
Experience leading complex technical implementations with enterprise clients in regulated industries
Ability to translate complex payment concepts for both technical and business stakeholders

Professional Skills

Proven ability to create clear product requirements and technical documentation
Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences
Excellent problem-solving and analytical capabilities
Comfortable with lightweight technical validation (e.g., reviewing API documentation, testing flows)

Preferred Experience

Exposure to marketplace, multi-party payment models, or embedded finance, particularly Stripe Connect-based marketplace and platform architectures
Understanding of fraud prevention and risk management in payments
Experience with payment platform migrations and merchant account transitions
Understanding of global payment methods, currency handling, and cross-border transaction complexities
Background in SaaS, marketplace, or multi-sided platform business models
Familiarity with modern development practices and API-first integration approaches

Benefits

As a full-time employee you will be eligible to participate in health care plans, fringe benefits, and/or retirement programs provided by Monstarlab.

Este no es un cargo enfocado únicamente en mantener o ejecutar un sistema previamente definido. Aunque actualmente existe una base de conocimiento comercial, la persona deberá diseñar, documentar e implementar desde cero varios de los programas, estándares, indicadores y políticas que necesita la organización.

Propósito del cargo

Liderar la formación interna y el aseguramiento de calidad de los equipos Comercial, Fidelización, Asesores y Técnicos, convirtiendo el conocimiento institucional en comportamientos, estándares y resultados consistentes y medibles.

El cargo pertenece a Talento Humano, pero tiene un impacto transversal en la experiencia del estudiante. Será responsable de definir qué significa brindar una atención adecuada en cada punto de contacto y de asegurar que ese estándar se traduzca en la actuación real de los equipos.

Principales responsabilidades

Formación y desarrollo

Diseñar e implementar el programa de onboarding para los nuevos integrantes de los equipos Comercial, Fidelización, Asesores y Técnicos.

Diseñar y ejecutar planes de capacitación continua sobre oferta académica, pénsum, precios, aliados financieros, producto, manejo de objeciones y atención al estudiante.

Calidad y experiencia del estudiante

Definir y documentar los estándares de atención para los equipos Comercial, Fidelización y Técnicos.
Diseñar rúbricas y checklists para auditar llamadas, chats, canales digitales y atención presencial.
Ejecutar auditorías periódicas y convertir los hallazgos en acciones de formación y mejora.
Establecer indicadores de calidad relacionados con tiempos de respuesta, resolución, satisfacción y NPS, apoyándose en las fuentes de información disponibles.
Diseñar el protocolo para el manejo de quejas, reclamos y situaciones de crisis en canales de atención y redes sociales.
Identificar brechas de servicio y acompañar la implementación de acciones correctivas.
Proponer, junto con Dirección y el área Administrativa, las políticas del estudiante relacionadas con devoluciones, congelamientos, aplazamientos y becas.

Documentar procesos que actualmente dependen del conocimiento individual o que todavía no cuentan con una definición formal.
Actuar como punto de coordinación entre Talento Humano y los equipos operativos que tienen contacto con el estudiante.
Trabajar con Marketing y Digital para identificar y cerrar brechas de atención en redes sociales y canales de mensajería.
Presentar avances, resultados y oportunidades de mejora a Talento Humano y Dirección.

Profesional en Educación, Psicología, Administración, Comunicación o carreras afines.
Experiencia liderando procesos de formación, capacitación y/o calidad en equipos comerciales o de atención al cliente.

jobs.title: Global Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Title

Global Payroll Specialist

Job Description

The Global Payroll Specialist supports the accurate and timely preparation and processing of payroll across the organization. The role gathers payroll inputs from HiBob and business teams, checks their completeness and accuracy, and converts data into the required format for submission to ADP Celergo and other payroll providers.

This is a hands-on operational role for someone with payroll processing experience, strong Excel and data skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to learn new systems quickly. The role works closely with the Global Payroll Manager, HR, Finance, and external payroll providers. The Global Payroll Manager retains accountability for payroll governance, compliance, final approval, and technical decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll preparation and processing

Support payroll processing across assigned countries, entities, and payroll cycles in line with agreed calendars and deadlines.
Collect payroll inputs from HiBob and business teams, including new hires, leavers, salary changes, variable payments, benefits, deductions, leave, and other employee changes.
Extract, clean, validate, and format employee and payroll data from multiple sources into templates required by ADP Celergo and other payroll providers.
Upload or submit accurate payroll input files and complete pre-processing checks before payroll cut-off dates.
Review payroll outputs against source data, prior periods, and agreed control totals; investigate discrepancies and escalate material issues promptly.
Support off-cycle payments, corrections, and retroactive adjustments under the direction of the Global Payroll Manager.
Maintain accurate payroll records, checklists, trackers, and supporting documentation.

Data, reconciliation and reporting

Reconcile payroll inputs and outputs, identify variances, and maintain clear evidence of completed checks.
Prepare payroll reports, journals, funding information, and audit support for review by the Global Payroll Manager and Finance.
Monitor data quality between HR, payroll, and finance systems and follow up on missing, inconsistent, or incomplete information.
Use Excel to organize and analyze large data sets, including lookups, formulas, pivot tables, and data validation tools.
Handle payroll and employee data securely and in accordance with data privacy and confidentiality requirements.

Stakeholder and provider support

Work with HR, Finance, managers and external providers to obtain complete and accurate payroll information on time.
Respond to routine payroll queries clearly and professionally, referring complex, sensitive, or technical matters to the Global Payroll Manager.
Track outstanding actions with payroll providers and internal teams and support the timely resolution of operational issues.
Build effective working relationships across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Processes, systems and improvement

Learn and use HiBob, ADP Celergo and other payroll platforms to support day-to-day payroll operations.
Follow documented payroll processes, controls, and approval requirements, escalating exceptions and potential risks.
Maintain process notes, payroll calendars, templates, and job aids so activities can be completed consistently.
Suggest practical improvements to data collection, templates, controls, and workflows to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.
Support system testing, payroll migrations, and process changes as required.

Essential

Experience and qualifications

Practical payroll processing or payroll administration experience, with a sound understanding of payroll inputs, outputs, deadlines, and reconciliations.
Strong Excel and data manipulation skills, including the ability to extract, clean, compare, validate, and format data from multiple sources.
High level of accuracy, numeracy, and attention to detail when working with sensitive, high-volume data.
Ability to learn new payroll and HR systems quickly and follow structured processes and controls.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities within fixed deadlines.
Confidence in investigating discrepancies, solving operational problems, and escalating issues appropriately.
Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to work effectively with international colleagues and providers.

Desirable

Experience in a multinational, shared services, or multi-entity environment.
Experience using ADP Celergo, another ADP payroll product, HiBob or a comparable HR/payroll platform.
Experience working with outsourced payroll providers or preparing payroll input files for third-party processing.
Exposure to payroll-to-finance reconciliations, journals, funding reports, or payroll implementation projects.
A relevant technical, professional, or university qualification in payroll, accounting, finance, business administration, or human resources.

Core Capabilities

Data accuracy

Checks detail and produces reliable outputs.

Learning agility

Quickly understands systems, templates, and workflows.

Delivery focus

Works methodically to fixed payroll deadlines.

Problem solving

Investigates variances and identifies practical actions.

Collaboration

Works constructively with HR, Finance and providers.

Confidentiality

Handles sensitive employee data with care and discretion.

Physical Requirements

Sitting
Standing
Walking
Climbing
Lifting up to 50+ pounds
Pulling
Pushing
Carrying
Grasping
Reaching
Bending
Visual Acuity—Color Determination
Speaking
Listening

Additional Information

This job description outlines the primary responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. As the organization continues to evolve and establish its standalone operating model, responsibilities may be reviewed and amended to meet changing business requirements. The role holder may be required to undertake other duties commensurate with the level and scope of the position.

🚀 Join the Paystone team and build technology that makes an impact!

At Paystone, we’re all about bringing together talented people who love solving problems, challenging the status quo, and creating solutions that make a difference for our clients. 💻✨

We’re looking for a remote Hotfix (Technical Service) Developer
who is curious, analytical, and ready to jump into complex technical challenges. If you enjoy digging into problems, figuring out what is happening behind the scenes, and turning challenges into reliable solutions, we’d love to have you on our team.

Ready for your next challenge? Let’s build something great together. 🚀

Overview

The Hotfix team is responsible for delivering urgent, high-impact fixes for enterprise clients. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work under time-sensitive conditions. The Hotfix Developer ensures client issues are investigated, resolved, and deployed quickly while maintaining data integrity and minimizing risk.

Key Responsibilities

Investigate and resolve urgent production issues raised by Success, Support, Project or Account Management
Write and execute SQL queries for data corrections, imports, exports, and reporting fixes
Perform root-cause analysis on transactional data, logs, and system behaviors
Read and understand the PHP/Symfony codebase to troubleshoot issues and confirm system logic
Build and run custom scripts (PHP, SQL) for bulk updates, data migrations, or exports
Deploy fixes safely using internal tools (Phing, etc.) with rollback plans if necessary
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Support, Success, Account Management, Core, etc.) to clarify requirements and validate solutions
Document fixes thoroughly in Jira, including logic, risks, and testing steps
Participate in Hotfix sprint planning, standups, and reviews
Assist in maintaining and improving Hotfix workflows, documentation, and best practices
Provide proactive communication on ticket progress, risks, and blockers

Required Skills & Experience

2–4 years of experience in software development, technical support engineering, or a developer-facing technical role
Strong SQL skills (queries, updates, imports/exports, data validation)
Solid understanding of debugging and troubleshooting transactional or log-based systems
Proficiency in PHP and familiarity with the Symfony framework
Experience with Git workflows and deployment pipelines
Familiarity with tools such as MySQL Workbench, Docker, and Graylog (or similar logging tools)
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving mindset
Ability to work effectively under pressure with tight deadlines
Clear written and verbal communication skills, especially when working with non-technical stakeholders
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice to Have

Experience building or maintaining exports, reporting tools, or custom client scripts
Familiarity with ACH (Automated Clearing House) processing
Prior experience in client-facing support, success, or technical troubleshooting
Experience documenting technical fixes for non-technical audiences

Perks & Benefits

Compensation tied to market data
We reward for contribution
Flexible Time-off
We’re committed to career development
Work from home

Our Mission

By joining Paystone, you are joining a team that is future-focused and driven by our mission of creating Customer Driven Growth.

By helping our clients create better experiences for their customers, and in turn, motivating their happy customers to share their experiences with others, our platform creates the momentum for our clients to gain more happy customers. In other words, we win when our customers do.

Curious?

jobs.description:
Clara is the leading spend management platform in Latin America.
More than 40,000 businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We're ~400 people, backed by Kaszek, monashees, Coatue, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer
to own backend and frontend development in Clara's Collections squad. You'll build features end-to-end — from data models and APIs to the interfaces our customers and internal teams use. This is a high-ownership role: you won't wait for a ticket to tell you what to do; you'll identify gaps, propose solutions, and ship.

Design and implement backend services in Java + Spring Boot, with a focus on financial flows (payments, collections, reconciliation)
Build and maintain frontend interfaces in React + TypeScript — you're comfortable owning a feature across both layers
Model data and manage PostgreSQL and Redis for transactional and caching needs
Work with event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar) in a distributed microservices environment
Build and secure RESTful APIs for internal and external consumption
Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) as a default part of your workflow — we expect this, not just welcome it
Collaborate with your Pod Lead and PM to translate product needs into technical decisions, and push back when something doesn't make sense

Who you are

Must haves

3–5 years of backend development experience in Java, including Spring Boot
Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript — you've shipped real UI, not just tutorials
Solid understanding of PostgreSQL and distributed systems fundamentals
Experience with CI/CD, Docker, Git, and cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
AI-augmented development is how you work
— you use AI tools daily to write, review, and debug code; you can speak concretely about how it's changed your output
You identify what's missing before someone asks — proactive, not reactive
Working proficiency in English and Spanish

Nice to haves

Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other message brokers
Background in financial services, payments, or fintech — domain ramp is real; prior exposure matters
Experience in Kubernetes and production observability
You've built something — side project, open source, internal tool — that you're proud of and can walk us through

Clara está comprometida con el trabajo híbrido, combinando la flexibilidad del trabajo remoto con los beneficios de colaboración, conexión y desarrollo profesional que ofrece trabajar juntos en la oficina. El equipo no cuenta con días fijos de asistencia presencial, pero alentamos a nuestros claridians a asistir a la oficina según las necesidades del negocio o equipo

Why Clara

A high talent-density team
driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.
Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.
An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.
English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

Clarity
— Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.
Simplicity
— If it can be simpler, it should be.
Ownership
— We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.
Pride
— We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.
ABC (Always Be Changing)
— We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.
Inclusivity
— Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

Hybrid at Clara

Claridians split their time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles, but we expect you to spend time there naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

Breakmark is partnering with an energy technology company to hire its next Chief Financial Officer.
Our client is transforming how businesses purchase, manage, and optimize electricity. By combining energy supply with smart metering, consumption analytics, and a digital platform, the company helps customers better understand their energy costs and make more informed operational decisions.
The company is looking for a CFO to shape its financial strategy, strengthen its financial operations, and support its next phase of growth.
About the role
The CFO will serve as a strategic partner to the CEO and leadership team, owning financial performance, capital strategy, and the finance function.
This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution. You will translate growth ambitions into a clear financial roadmap, secure the liquidity and funding needed to execute, and build the systems, controls, and team required to scale.
The ideal candidate brings strong commercial judgment and understands how to balance growth, profitability, and risk in a business combining technology with the operational and financial complexity of the energy sector.

Key responsibilities

Financial strategy and planning

Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Partner with leadership on growth priorities, pricing, investment decisions, and expansion opportunities.
Develop visibility into margins, unit economics, customer profitability, and returns on investment.
Translate financial insights into actionable recommendations for commercial and operational teams.

Liquidity and capital management

Own cash flow, treasury, working capital, and liquidity planning.
Align customer collections, supplier payments, and financing needs to support sustainable growth.
Manage relationships with banks, lenders, and financial partners.
Develop the capital structure and lead debt and equity financing processes as required.
Oversee financial due diligence, financing negotiations, and lender and investor reporting.

Financial operations and governance

Oversee accounting, financial reporting, tax, audits, and internal controls.
Ensure accurate financial statements and timely, reliable management reporting.
Build scalable processes across billing, collections, payments, and financial systems.
Strengthen controls around credit exposure, counterparty risk, and energy-related financial commitments.
Partner with legal and regulatory teams on financial obligations within the energy sector.

Board and investor engagement

Prepare board materials and communicate performance, risks, and strategic trade-offs.
Maintain strong investor relationships and support fundraising readiness.
Bring financial discipline and constructive challenge to major business decisions.

Team leadership

Build and develop a finance team capable of supporting increasing scale and complexity.
Establish clear ownership, accountability, and performance expectations.
Improve automation, data quality, and collaboration across finance, technology, commercial, and operations teams.

Candidate profile
Experience as a CFO, VP of Finance, or senior finance leader with meaningful ownership of financial strategy and operations.
A track record in a growing business, including building or strengthening the finance function.
Strong technical grounding in accounting, FP&A, treasury, working capital, and financial controls.
Direct experience raising capital, securing financing, or managing banking and investor relationships.
Strong commercial judgment and an ability to connect financial decisions to business performance.
Experience managing complex cash cycles, credit exposure, or financially demanding operating models.
Comfort working in an entrepreneurial environment, moving between strategic decisions and operational detail.
Strong communication skills and experience presenting to boards, investors, and senior stakeholders.
Professional fluency in Spanish and English.

Experience in energy, utilities, infrastructure, energy trading, or another regulated sector would be valuable. Candidates from technology or adjacent industries with strong financial depth and relevant operating experience are also encouraged to apply.
Why this opportunity
This is an opportunity to shape a business at the intersection of energy and technology, with direct influence over its growth strategy, capital allocation, financial resilience, and long-term value creation.
Breakmark is managing this search on behalf of our client.
