jobs.description:
Job Description

As an Executive Director, Senior Corporate Banker within the Global Corporate Banking (GCB) team in Colombia, you will own, deepen, and grow relationships with large corporate clients while driving profitable revenue growth across the full suite of the firm's banking capabilities. You will act as the senior trusted advisor to CFOs, Treasurers, and C-suite executives, orchestrating the delivery of credit, treasury and cash management, investment banking, markets, and trade finance solutions. You will lead deal teams, structure complex credit and capital solutions, and represent the whole firm to clients — combining commercial ambition with disciplined risk management and an unwavering commitment to control standards.

Job Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership & Origination

You will own, manage, and grow a portfolio of large corporate client relationships, with direct accountability for revenue, returns, and client satisfaction.
You will originate new business and lead the cross-sell of the full product suite, including lending, treasury services, Investment Banking advisory, markets, and trade & working capital solutions.
You will serve as the senior trusted advisor to CFOs, Treasurers, and C-suite executives on strategic financing, capital structure, and liquidity decisions.

Deal Leadership & Whole-Firm Delivery

You will lead deal teams, structure complex credit and capital solutions, and drive end-to-end execution to close.
You will partner across investment banking, treasury services, markets, and product partners to deliver the whole firm to clients.

Risk, Controls & Talent

You will manage credit risk and portfolio quality, ensuring all activity remains within the firm's stated risk appetite, and ensure full compliance with regulatory, KYC/AML, and internal risk and control standards at all times.
You will mentor junior bankers and contribute meaningfully to talent development and team performance.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills.

15+ years of corporate banking or relevant client coverage experience.
Strong credit acumen and a sophisticated understanding of complex capital structures.
A proven origination and revenue generation track record at scale.
Deep knowledge of banking products spanning credit, treasury, capital markets, and advisory.
Excellent relationship management, communication, and negotiation skills.
Strong oral and written communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal and influencing skills.
Ability to lead and work in a cross-cultural team environment.
Demonstrated leadership and team management experience.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills.

MBA or other advanced degree.
An established senior-level client network within target industries or regions.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Global Banking business is one of the largest wholesale banking client franchises in the world. We serve clients, including corporations, governments, states, municipalities, healthcare organizations, education institutions, banks and investors.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Banking Platform
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $8,000 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Product Manager
who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is building the platform that will carry us from a BNPL provider into a full-stack financial institution. This role owns the system at the center of that: Sezzle’s banking core — the ledger, accounts and balances, and the money movement that every future Sezzle financial product will run on.

You would own it end to end. Discovery, architecture and vendor decisions, requirements, build, launch, and everything after — not a slice of someone else’s roadmap, but the full product lifecycle for the platform itself. You’d work directly with Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Treasury, and Risk, with real authority over how this gets built.

Ideally you’ve built something like this before.
If you haven’t, but you’ve owned a ledger, a payments platform, an issuing program, or other financial infrastructure — and you’re the kind of person who learns a domain properly rather than around the edges — we want to talk to you. What matters most is that you’ve owned real infrastructure and that you’re willing to go deep on the parts you don’t know yet.

What You'll Do:

Own the banking platform roadmap. Define and sequence the platform work required to support accounts, deposits, cards, and lending on a single ledger and account model.
Help drive the build-vs-buy decision. Evaluate core banking platforms and processors, run vendor diligence, model cost and time-to-market, and help leadership decide whether we extend what we have or integrate a third party.
Shape the account and ledger model. Work with Engineering and Finance on account hierarchies, sub-ledgers, chart-of-accounts mapping, posting rules, holds, interest and fee accrual, and general ledger integration.
Specify money movement. Own product requirements for transfers, ACH, card issuing and network settlement, real-time rails, and returns and reversals — including exception handling, cutoff windows, and settlement reconciliation.
Make the platform auditable. Ensure the system produces the reporting, traceability, and controls that Finance, audit, and regulators need — reconciliation breaks, balance attestation, and complete transaction history.
Partner on regulatory readiness. Work with Compliance and Legal to turn their requirements into platform capabilities: screening hooks, onboarding data, error resolution, disclosures and statements, and reporting. You don’t need to arrive fluent in US banking regulation — you do need to be someone who learns it properly.
Plan migration and cutover. If a migration is in scope, own data mapping, parallel-run strategy, validation criteria, rollback plans, and phased cutover.
Write the technical requirements. Own detailed specs, API contracts, event schemas, data models, user stories, and release plans end-to-end.
Use data to prove it works. Write your own SQL. Define platform KPIs — posting latency, reconciliation break rate, settlement accuracy, failure rates — and monitor them relentlessly.
Manage risk early. Anticipate technical risks, edge cases, race conditions, and dependencies before they become incidents. Money movement defects are the expensive kind.
Operate with urgency. Deliver against an evolving regulatory and business timeline with incomplete information.

What We Look For:

Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or other technical discipline (required).
5–10 years of product experience, with meaningful time spent on financial infrastructure rather than only customer-facing surfaces.
Real ownership in at least one of the following. You do not need all of them, and we care much more about depth in one than exposure to several:
Ledgers, general ledger, or balance and transaction systems
Payments processing, orchestration, or money movement — ACH, card networks, transfers, settlement, or the LATAM equivalents (PIX, SPEI, PSE, CCE)
Card issuing or card program management
Deposit, wallet, or account platforms
Lending origination or loan servicing platforms
Product work at a processor, BaaS provider, or core banking vendor
Comfort with double-entry accounting concepts as they show up in software — debits and credits, sub-ledgers, accruals, reconciliation — or a genuine appetite to get comfortable with them quickly.
Deep technical understanding of APIs, event-driven architecture, idempotency, distributed system failure modes, batch vs. real-time processing, and data flows.
Strong SQL skills and comfort querying and interpreting data independently.
Experience working directly with Compliance, Legal, Finance, or Treasury as stakeholders — not only Engineering and Design.
Comfortable working in ambiguity and making sound, documented decisions with incomplete information.
Strong written and verbal communication — can hold your own in an engineering standup, a Finance review, and an executive discussion.
Hands-on familiarity with AI tools, data models, or generative AI applications—personally, professionally, or better yet, both!

Preferred Qualifications:

Direct experience with a core banking platform, in-house or vendor (Thought Machine, Mambu, 10x, Finxact, Temenos, Technisys, Galileo, Pismo, or similar).
Experience with a core migration, conversion, or major ledger replacement.
Experience at a chartered or licensed financial institution, or supporting a charter, banking licence, or deposit insurance application.
Familiarity with consumer finance regulation — US (Reg E, Reg DD, Reg CC, Reg Z, TILA, FCRA, BSA/AML) or equivalent local regimes.
Background in consumer credit or BNPL, card products, or bank-fintech sponsorship programs.
Experience with third-party risk management and vendor oversight in a regulated environment.

About You:

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Descripción del rol

Propósito del rol:

Liderar la estrategia, diseño y ejecución de migraciones y sincronización de bases de datos hacia entornos cloud (AWS/Azure), garantizando integridad, consistencia y disponibilidad de la información.

Impacto en el negocio:

Asegura la continuidad operacional de datos críticos, minimizando riesgos de pérdida o inconsistencias y habilitando plataformas escalables y seguras.

Alcance:

Actúa como referente técnico experto en transformación y operación, coordinando con equipos técnicos y vendors, con una fuerte gobernanza en entornos regulados.

Responsabilidades clave

Definir y liderar la estrategia técnica de migración de bases de datos hacia nube, considerando criticidad, dependencias, tamaño, ventanas de indisponibilidad y modelo operativo destino.

Evaluar la arquitectura actual de las bases de datos, incluyendo motores, versiones, configuraciones, dependencias, esquemas, storage, backups, replicación y mecanismos de alta disponibilidad.

Diseñar estrategias de migración adecuadas para cada caso de uso: rehost, replatform, refactor parcial, migración homogénea o heterogénea.

Definir los mecanismos de replicación, sincronización y CDC necesarios para soportar migraciones con baja indisponibilidad o coexistencia temporal entre ambientes.

Asegurar la integridad, consistencia, trazabilidad y reconciliación de los datos antes, durante y después de la migración.

Diseñar y validar la arquitectura de almacenamiento asociada a las bases de datos en nube, considerando desempeño, capacidad, crecimiento, resiliencia, cifrado y costos.

Definir criterios técnicos para backup, restore, snapshots, retención, recuperación ante desastres y continuidad operacional.

Participar en la definición de planes de cutover, fallback, rollback y pruebas de recuperación.

Acompañar la optimización de desempeño de bases de datos migradas, incluyendo ajustes de configuración, índices, queries críticas, parámetros de motor y sizing.

Coordinar técnicamente con equipos de aplicación, infraestructura, redes, seguridad, cloud, storage, operación y proveedores.

Garantizar que las soluciones de migración cumplan con lineamientos de seguridad, gobierno de datos, auditoría y requisitos regulatorios aplicables al sector financiero.

Documentar decisiones técnicas, procedimientos, runbooks, evidencias de validación y criterios de aceptación para el handover a operación.

Actividades principales

Evaluar bases de datos y definir estrategias de migración.

Ejecutar migraciones con herramientas especializadas.

Configurar replicación (DMS, GoldenGate).

Validar consistencia post-migración.

Optimizar performance en entornos cloud.

Diseñar estrategias de backup y DRP.

Automatizar procesos de migración.

Documentar procedimientos y runbooks.

Atender incidentes críticos de datos.

jobs.title: Project Manager – ERP Implementation
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced ERP Implementation Project Manager to lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of ERP implementation initiatives, with a strong focus on Financials and Accounting processes.
The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading ERP implementations from requirements gathering and solution design through configuration, data migration, testing, training, go-live, and post-implementation stabilization.

Key Responsibilities

ERP Implementation Project Management
Lead end-to-end ERP implementation projects, from initial planning and requirements gathering through go-live and stabilization.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Coordinate implementation activities across Finance, Accounting, Operations, IT, and other business functions.
Establish project governance, track progress, identify risks, and ensure timely resolution of issues.
Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, and changes throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Provide regular project status updates to leadership and key stakeholders.

Financials & Accounting Implementation
Lead or coordinate the implementation of Financial and Accounting modules and processes within the ERP.
Work closely with Finance and Accounting teams to understand current-state processes, identify requirements, and define future-state workflows.
Translate accounting and business requirements into ERP functional requirements and implementation activities.
Support the design and validation of processes related to General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Banking, Fixed Assets, Taxes, Purchasing, Sales, and other financially relevant processes.
Ensure ERP workflows generate accurate accounting entries and appropriately integrate operational transactions with the General Ledger.
Coordinate the validation of the Chart of Accounts, journals, taxes, cost centers, analytic accounts, financial dimensions, and other accounting structures.
Partner with Finance stakeholders to ensure the ERP solution meets accounting, reporting, and internal control requirements.

Odoo Implementation
Lead or support Odoo ERP implementations, ensuring successful adoption across relevant business functions.
Coordinate Odoo configuration, functional requirements, workflows, integrations, and testing.
Work with Odoo consultants, developers, and internal teams to translate business requirements into effective system solutions.
Validate configurations and transaction flows across Odoo modules.
Identify functional gaps, configuration issues, and process inconsistencies and coordinate their resolution.
Support Odoo data migration, validation, reconciliation, testing, and go-live activities.
Ensure business and accounting requirements are properly reflected in the final Odoo solution.

Data Migration & Testing
Coordinate data migration activities, including data preparation, cleansing, mapping, validation, and reconciliation.
Ensure migrated financial and operational data is complete, accurate, and consistent with source systems.
Develop and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans and scenarios.
Coordinate test execution with business users and implementation teams.
Track defects, discrepancies, and configuration issues through resolution.
Validate that system corrections and configuration changes produce the expected results.

Change Management & Training
Partner with business stakeholders to support change management and ERP adoption.
Coordinate user training, process documentation, and implementation communications.
Ensure end users understand new workflows, responsibilities, and system processes.
Develop or oversee the creation of SOPs, work instructions, process maps, and other implementation documentation.
Identify adoption challenges and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.

Go-Live & Post-Implementation Support
Coordinate go-live readiness activities across business and technical teams.
Ensure critical processes, data, integrations, controls, and user access are validated before go-live.
Lead the transition from implementation to operational support.
Manage post-go-live issues, priorities, and stabilization activities.
Track outstanding issues and ensure they are resolved within agreed timelines.
Establish appropriate processes and controls to prevent recurring issues after implementation.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
Serve as the primary project coordination point between internal stakeholders, ERP consultants, technical teams, and third-party vendors.
Facilitate project meetings, working sessions, and decision-making forums.
Clearly communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and required decisions.
Manage vendor deliverables and ensure implementation partners meet agreed timelines and requirements.
Escalate critical risks and issues appropriately while maintaining ownership of project outcomes.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience managing ERP implementation projects.
Proven experience leading or coordinating end-to-end ERP implementations, not simply supporting ERP operations.
Strong experience implementing or managing Financials/Accounting functionality within an ERP environment.
Odoo implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience with ERP data migration, testing, reconciliation, configuration validation, and go-live activities.
Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, risk management, issue tracking, and stakeholder communication.
Experience working with cross-functional teams and external implementation partners.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

jobs.description:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.

Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

Jeeves is looking for a Product Manager who understands accounting to drive our Accounting & Finance Automation work. You'll build products that accountants, controllers, and finance teams use to manage corporate spend across 20+ countries — automating manual workflows, ensuring data accuracy, and connecting Jeeves to the ERP and accounting systems our customers rely on.

Location:
This role is remote or hybrid based out of Bogotá, Colombia,
and is a full-time remote position where it is also possible to come into our office in the Parque de la 93 area on a flexible schedule.

What you'll do:

Ship improvements to the accounting user experience: spend data management, reconciliation, compliance, and audit trails
Identify and validate AI automation opportunities — prototype solutions, know when AI fits vs. when deterministic rules are required
Drive integration work with ERP and accounting platforms (NetSuite, SAP, QuickBooks, etc.)
Run customer discovery with controllers and CFOs; turn findings into clear specs engineering can build

What we're looking for:

PM with financial systems experience — 3+ years of B2B SaaS/fintech PM experience building products that integrate with ERP or accounting platforms
Working knowledge of GAAP/IFRS
Strong analytical skills (SQL, data analysis)
Hands-on comfort prototyping with AI tools, and excellent written communication
LatAm accounting and compliance knowledge is a big plus

Why This Role Matters

Accounting and finance workflows in spend management are fundamentally broken. Finance teams spend dozens of hours per month on repetitive manual work that should be automated. This isn't just inefficiency—it delays financial reporting, introduces errors, and frustrates talented professionals who should be focused on strategic work, not data entry.

As our Accounting & Finance Automation PM, you'll have the opportunity to:

Transform how finance teams work for 5,000+ global businesses
Build AI-powered solutions that finance professionals actually trust and adopt
Solve complex multi-market problems across LatAm, US, and Europe
Shape the future of financial automation in spend management

If you're passionate about accounting and finance, love building products that solve real workflow problems, and want to use technology to transform how finance teams work—we'd love to talk to you.

jobs.title: Senior Accounts Payable Specialist
jobs.description:
Accounting, Accounting & Finance, Accounts Payable, Financial Operations

About The Position

Royal York Property Management is seeking a highly experienced Senior Accounts Payable Specialist to support the accuracy, organization, and control of our accounts payable operations.

This position will play an important role in ensuring invoices are properly reviewed, expenses are accurately recorded, vendor accounts remain current, and payment requests are complete and ready for approval. The successful candidate will work closely with members of our finance, property management, maintenance, and operations teams.

We are looking for someone who understands the complete accounts payable cycle and can manage their responsibilities with limited supervision. This is not a junior invoice-entry position. The person hired must be capable of identifying irregularities, investigating discrepancies, maintaining reliable records, and protecting the integrity of the company’s payment processes.

Previous experience supporting Canadian companies is required. Candidates should already be comfortable working with Canadian invoices, GST and HST coding, Canadian vendors, and Ontario-based team members.

Our Hiring Process

Every application is reviewed by our recruitment team.

Candidates whose education and experience appear to align with the position will receive an email within one to two business days of applying with a link to complete a pre-recorded online interview.

The interview allows us to evaluate your accounts payable experience, Canadian-company exposure, technical knowledge, judgment, communication skills, and ability to manage senior-level responsibilities in a remote environment.

Only candidates selected to move forward will be contacted regarding the next stage of the hiring process.

Key Responsibilities

Review invoices for accuracy, completeness, supporting documentation, and proper authorization
Code and enter invoices using the correct company, department, account, tax treatment, and cost allocation
Match invoices to purchase orders, work orders, contracts, service records, and other supporting documents
Manage vendor records, payment terms, contact information, and banking details
Prepare payment batches and supporting schedules for management review and approval
Reconcile vendor statements and investigate differences between vendor records and the accounting system
Resolve missing invoices, duplicate billings, unapplied credits, incorrect balances, and payment discrepancies
Monitor due dates, overdue balances, payment commitments, and upcoming cash requirements
Respond to vendor inquiries regarding invoice status, account balances, and payment timing
Process credit-card transactions, employee expenses, recurring charges, and other operating expenses
Apply the appropriate GST and HST treatment to invoices and expenses
Assist with accounts payable, bank, and credit-card reconciliations
Support month-end activities, including accruals, cut-off procedures, prepaid expenses, and outstanding invoice reviews
Maintain complete and well-organized electronic records for review and audit purposes
Support accounts payable activities involving multiple entities, departments, properties, and vendor relationships
Identify process gaps, control weaknesses, and recurring errors
Recommend practical improvements to increase accuracy, efficiency, and accountability
Follow approval limits, segregation-of-duties requirements, and fraud-prevention procedures
Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing information and resolve payment-related issues

Education And Experience Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration with an accounting concentration, or a closely related field
Colombian Contador Público qualification or another relevant accounting designation is considered an asset but is not mandatory
Minimum 4 years of directly related accounts payable or accounting operations experience
Candidates with 4–7+ years of relevant experience are strongly preferred
Previous experience supporting one or more Canadian companies is required
Demonstrated experience managing the full accounts payable cycle
Experience reviewing, coding, processing, and reconciling a high volume of invoices
Practical knowledge of Canadian GST and HST coding
Experience preparing payment runs or payment batches for approval
Strong vendor statement reconciliation and discrepancy-resolution skills
Experience supporting month-end closing activities
Experience working with multiple companies, entities, departments, or cost centres
Property management, real estate, construction, maintenance, or service-industry accounting experience is considered an asset
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
Experience with QuickBooks Online or another established accounting or ERP platform
Advanced written and spoken English
Confidence communicating with vendors, managers, and cross-functional team members
Ability to work full-time during Ontario business hours
Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, headset, webcam, and quiet professional workspace

The Person We Are Looking For

You are a careful and experienced accounting professional who understands the responsibility involved in handling company expenses and vendor payments.

You do not process information blindly. You verify documentation, question inconsistencies, investigate unusual activity, and follow issues through to resolution.

You are comfortable managing deadlines, communicating with multiple departments, and balancing speed with accuracy. You understand when an issue can be resolved independently and when it must be documented and escalated.

You also recognize that strong accounts payable performance depends on sound controls, reliable records, professional communication, and consistent follow-through.

Measures of Success

Success In This Role Means

Invoices are processed accurately and within the required timelines
Expenses are assigned to the correct accounts, entities, and cost centres
Taxes are coded correctly
Vendor balances are regularly reconciled and supported
Payment batches are accurate, complete, and ready for approval
Duplicate, unsupported, or unauthorized payments are identified before funds are released
Outstanding issues are documented and followed through to completion
Vendor communications are handled professionally
Month-end information is accurate and delivered on time
Accounts payable records are complete, organized, and review-ready
Management has dependable information regarding payment obligations and outstanding balances

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this position is:

C$27,600–C$32,400

Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s depth of accounts payable experience, previous work with Canadian companies, knowledge of Canadian tax coding, accounting-system proficiency, industry exposure, English communication skills, and ability to independently manage complex accounts payable responsibilities.

jobs.title: Senior Accounts Receivable & Collections Specialist
jobs.description:
Accounting, Accounting & Finance, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Cash Application, Collections, Collections Operations, Credit & Collections, Financial Operations

Hours:
Full-Time, aligned with EST business hours

The Opportunity

Royal York Property Management is seeking an experienced receivables professional to oversee customer account accuracy, overdue balance recovery, payment follow-up, and collection reporting.

This position combines financial administration with direct customer communication. The person hired will be expected to maintain reliable account records while actively moving unpaid balances toward resolution.

You must be able to determine why an account remains unpaid, distinguish between billing problems and genuine collection risk, coordinate with internal departments, and take appropriate action without constant supervision.

This is a senior individual-contributor position. It is not intended for someone whose experience is primarily limited to issuing invoices, posting receipts, or sending standard payment reminders.

Previous Experience Supporting Canadian Companies Is Required.

Professional Profile

You are persistent without being unnecessarily aggressive.

You can protect a professional customer relationship while remaining direct about payment obligations, deadlines, and missed commitments.

You understand the difference between a customer who has a legitimate dispute, a customer experiencing financial difficulty, and a customer who is avoiding payment.

You keep accurate notes, follow through consistently, and know when an account requires escalation.

Most importantly, you are comfortable being accountable for actual collection outcomes rather than simply the number of calls or emails completed.

Core Responsibilities

Collections and Account Recovery

Contact customers by telephone and email regarding outstanding balances
Manage follow-up across current, 30-, 60-, and 90-day receivables
Prioritize accounts based on age, value, payment history, dispute status, and recovery risk
Obtain and document payment dates, commitments, and required next steps
Follow up promptly when payment commitments are missed
Discuss payment arrangements that fall within approved company policies
Investigate whether non-payment results from a billing issue, service concern, administrative delay, or financial difficulty
Escalate high-value, disputed, severely overdue, or high-risk accounts
Coordinate with internal teams to resolve legitimate account issues
Identify balances that may require legal review, service restrictions, external collections, settlement consideration, or write-off review
Prepare collection forecasts and report expected and uncertain cash receipts
Recommend improvements to reminder timing, escalation procedures, documentation standards, and account-risk management

Accounts Receivable Administration

Maintain accurate customer balances, account histories, and billing records
Review billing information before invoices and statements are issued
Apply incoming payments to the correct customer, invoice, and legal entity
Resolve unapplied receipts, deductions, short payments, credits, refunds, and overpayments
Reconcile customer accounts and correct identified differences
Maintain current billing contacts, payment terms, customer notes, and supporting records
Review aging reports and identify accounts requiring action
Support accounts receivable reconciliations, reporting, and month-end close
Work across multiple companies, legal entities, departments, and customer portfolios
Coordinate with finance and operational teams when accounting records do not match the underlying agreement or service history
Maintain complete, organized, and review-ready documentation

Required Background

Minimum 4 years of directly relevant accounts receivable, collections, credit, billing, or accounting operations experience
Candidates with 4–7+ years of relevant experience are strongly preferred
Previous experience supporting Canadian companies is required
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration with an accounting concentration, or a closely related discipline
A recognized professional accounting designation is considered an asset but is not mandatory
Demonstrated experience managing both accounts receivable administration and active collections
Experience carrying responsibility for an assigned customer portfolio
Direct experience conducting telephone and email collections
Experience reviewing aging reports and managing delinquent balances
Strong customer-account reconciliation and discrepancy-resolution skills
Experience applying payments and resolving unapplied cash
Experience handling billing disputes, deductions, credits, short payments, refunds, and overpayments
Experience documenting and monitoring payment commitments
Experience negotiating payment schedules within approved guidelines
Experience preparing collection forecasts, aging summaries, or expected cash-receipt reports
Experience contributing to month-end accounting activities
Strong Excel or Google Sheets capability
Experience with QuickBooks Online or another established accounting or ERP platform
Advanced spoken and written English
Ability to communicate clearly and remain composed during difficult collection conversations
Ability to work full-time during Ontario business hours
Reliable computer equipment, high-speed internet, headset, webcam, and a quiet professional workspace

Experience in property management, real estate, leasing, construction, maintenance, financial services, or another service-based environment is considered beneficial.

Application and Interview Process

Applications are assessed against the education, experience, communication, and technical requirements of the role.

Candidates selected for initial screening will receive an email within one to two business days of applying with a link to complete a pre-recorded interview.

The interview will evaluate Canadian-company experience, accounts receivable knowledge, collections judgment, customer communication, systems experience, and the ability to manage difficult accounts independently.

Candidates who meet the required standard may be invited to a live interview.

Performance Expectations

The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To

Reduce aged receivables, particularly balances exceeding 60 and 90 days
Maintain complete and useful customer account notes
Apply incoming payments promptly and accurately
Produce reliable collection and cash-receipt forecasts
Resolve billing disputes and account discrepancies efficiently
Maintain consistent contact with overdue customers
Monitor and follow up on broken payment commitments
Keep customer balances accurate and reconciled
Escalate high-risk balances before recovery becomes unlikely
Reduce unresolved unapplied cash
Follow company approval limits and financial controls
Maintain professional, direct, and well-documented customer communication
Avoid unauthorized settlements, reductions, refunds, waivers, or write-offs

Scope of Authority

The specialist may discuss payment timing and establish arrangements that remain within approved company guidelines.

Management Authorization Is Required Before

Approving an arrangement outside established limits
Reducing or settling a valid account balance
Referring an account to an external collection agency
Waiving material charges or interest
Suspending services
Writing off an amount owed
Referring an account to legal counsel

The specialist must investigate the account, document the circumstances, and present a clear recommendation before seeking approval.

Compensation and Bonus

Base Compensation For This Position Is

C$30,000–C$40,000 annually

The Role Also Offers

Up to C$4,800 annually in quarterly performance-based bonus potential

The Maximum Quarterly Bonus Is

C$1,200

Performance May Be Assessed Using Factors Such As

Accuracy of cash-receipt forecasts
Reduction in 60- and 90-day receivables
Timely escalation of high-risk accounts
Percentage of customer payment commitments received as promised
Quality and completeness of account documentation
Collection results across assigned accounts
Compliance with approval limits and internal controls
Accuracy of payment application and customer reconciliations
Speed and quality of dispute resolution
Professional quality of customer communication

Final compensation will be based on the candidate’s relevant experience, Canadian-company background, collections performance, portfolio complexity, systems knowledge, communication ability, and capacity to work independently.

jobs.title: Billing Specialist
jobs.description:
It's a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!

About the role:

We're looking for a detail-oriented Billing Specialist to own the end-to-end billing process on our Revenue team. Reporting to the Revenue Manager, you'll keep invoicing accurate, payments collected, and accounts reconciled, with Stripe at the center of your day. You'll manage recurring billing, refunds, disputes, and payment gateway operations, and help automate the process as you go.

About us:

At 8am, our vision is to power a world where professionals thrive. We start every day on a mission to empower professionals with the most trusted, innovative technology to deliver world-class outcomes for their clients and exceptional financial results for their business. They count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

Founded in 2005, 8am™ (formerly AffiniPay) is the professional business platform built to help legal, accounting, and other client-focused professionals run stronger, more profitable businesses. Today, more than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. trust 8am to help them work smarter, serve clients better, and unlock their full potential. We have been recognized as one of Inc 5000's fastest growing companies in the U.S. for 13 years in a row, and as a result, our teams continue to grow as well!

What you'll do:

Own the end-to-end billing process, auditing invoicing and credit memo runs for accuracy.
Manage subscription billing in Stripe, including recurring payments, plans, discounts, and tax configurations.
Reconcile transactions and payment records, and resolve billing discrepancies.

jobs.title: Project Accountant
jobs.description:
Project Accountant

Role Summary

The Project Accountant role provides financial support and advisory to the Project Manager. This is a role that reports to a financial function, typically to a Financial Controller, and is typically budgeted in the overhead costs of a project. This role is assigned to multiple projects.

Responsibilities

Set up project in financial systems including project funding, revenue recognition, bill plans, contract overrides and billing/revenue controls.
Provide project pricing support (bill rates, contract overhead allowance, etc.).
Support/review project setup and change orders in financial system (WBS, budgets, margin expectations, and contingency/reserves).
Provide contractual and client compliance support including maintaining certificates of insurance, subcontractor/DBE reporting, rate/per diem caps, and identifying unallowable costs.
Ensure project financials are accurately reported in line with the Project’s commercial authorization.
Support financial performance of the project through monitoring project costs and recognized revenue (including calculating labour breakage/enhancements, overruns, missing bill/revenue rates, etc.).
Support project team in monthly reviews from a financial perspective, including estimated gains/losses.
Support DSO and collection efforts through monitoring unbilled costs, WIP, and AR in accordance to the terms and conditions of its contract, as approved by the project manager.
Be responsible for reconciliation of project financials at closeout.
Perform weekly reconciliation of labour hours, project charges, and financial transactions between BST (Colombia) and Horizon (Canada/US) to ensure completeness, accuracy, and timely correction of variances.
Support and monitor BST-Horizon project integration, including project setup validation, mapping of project structures, charge codes, and ongoing data integrity between systems.
Produce and distribute a weekly exception report identifying missed transactions, interface failures, unmatched labour postings, billing discrepancies, and other data quality issues requiring corrective action.
Coordinate with project managers, operations teams, and finance stakeholders to resolve cross-system discrepancies and ensure project financial data is current and accurate.
Maintain oversight of project and employee charging compliance by proactively identifying and resolving missing timesheets, incorrect project allocations, and unposted transactions.
Support month-end close activities through verification of BST-Horizon reconciliation, resolution of outstanding exceptions, and confirmation of project financial accuracy prior to invoicing and reporting.
Support Horizon implementation and post-go-live stabilization activities in GCC Colombia, including data migration validation, project and employee master data setup, timesheet compliance monitoring, user support, reconciliation of migrated transactions, and resolution of issues impacting project financial reporting and labour charging accuracy.

Family: Finance & Accounting.
Function: Project Accounting.
Oracle Persona(s): Project Accountant (including Contract Administrator) within PPM and Contract Modules.

FUNCIONES Y RESPONSABILIDADES

Gestionar el portafolio asignado de cuentas de clientes, asegurando el seguimiento oportuno y el recaudo de las facturas pendientes.
Investigar, analizar y resolver disputas relacionadas con la facturación, en colaboración con las áreas de Ventas, Servicio al Cliente y otros grupos de interés internos.
Mantener una comunicación proactiva y profesional con los clientes respecto al estado de los pagos, las diferencias identificadas y los planes de resolución.
Monitorear los reportes de antigüedad de cartera (aging) y priorizar las actividades de cobro de acuerdo con el nivel de riesgo y materialidad.
Realizar análisis de causa raíz de las disputas recurrentes y proponer acciones correctivas.
Garantizar la correcta aplicación de notas crédito y ajustes relacionados con disputas en los sistemas ERP.
Preparar y presentar informes periódicos sobre el desempeño del recaudo, las disputas y los saldos de cartera por antigüedad.
Apoyar las actividades de cierre de mes relacionadas con las cuentas por cobrar y el seguimiento de disputas.
Garantizar el cumplimiento de los controles internos, las políticas de crédito y los requerimientos de auditoría.
Identificar oportunidades de mejora de procesos y apoyar iniciativas de automatización dentro del ciclo O2C.
Mantener la documentación y los soportes adecuados para auditorías internas y externas.
Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para mejorar la experiencia del cliente y optimizar el capital de trabajo.

FORMACIÓN, HABILIDADES Y EXPERIENCIA REQUERIDA

Profesional en Contaduría Pública, Finanzas, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.
Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en contabilidad, cuentas por cobrar, gestión de cartera o gestión de disputas.

Experiencia trabajando con sistemas ERP (SAP preferiblemente).

Fuertes habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas.

Description

The Financial Analyst - CS GO Finance will drive cost efficiency and operational excellence for Amazon's Customer Service organization by leading financial analysis for VCPC (Variable Cost Per Contact) projects and strategic initiatives. This role partners with CS GO and cross-functional teams globally to identify optimization opportunities, analyze cost trends, and deliver year-over-year improvements. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights that enable leadership to make informed decisions and achieve key business goals with a high bar for cost efficiency.

Key job responsibilities

As a Financial Analyst supporting VCPC (Variable Cost Per Contact) initiatives, you will:

Lead financial analysis for VCPC improvement projects, identifying cost reduction opportunities and efficiency gains across Customer Service operations

Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to influence decision-making on cost optimization initiatives and resource allocation

Track and report on project performance, monitoring key metrics and providing regular updates on progress toward YoY improvement targets

Analyze cost trends by month, location, and vertical to identify optimization opportunities and support data-driven recommendations

Develop financial models and business cases to evaluate VCPC initiatives and quantify potential savings

Support monthly and quarterly financial reporting, providing insights into variances and trends that impact VCPC performance

Collaborate with Customer Service, Operations, and Finance teams to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables

Communicate findings clearly to stakeholders at various levels, translating complex financial data into actionable insights

Build and maintain tracking mechanisms to measure the impact of improvement initiatives and ensure accountability for results

A day in the life

You'll start your day reviewing VCPC performance metrics and identifying trends that require deeper analysis. You'll collaborate with Customer Service and Operations leaders to discuss ongoing cost optimization projects, providing financial insights that guide decision-making. Much of your time will be spent building financial models, analyzing cost drivers across different locations and verticals, and tracking progress on improvement initiatives. You'll prepare updates for stakeholders, clearly communicating project status and financial impact. You'll also participate in cross-functional meetings to influence resource allocation decisions and ensure alignment on YoY improvement targets.

We are Customer Service Finance (CSF), integral partners to one of the largest Customer Service teams on Earth. We are passionate about helping customers through insightful analysis and data-driven decision-making. We collaborate globally, celebrate diverse perspectives, and support our peers to excel. Join us to apply your financial acumen to diverse challenges, build lasting relationships, and take great strides in your career growth.

4+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience

Construction Accounting Manager
:
Job Description

Futura USA Inc. is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Construction Accounting Manager
to oversee the day-to-day financial and accounting processes of our construction operations. This role will be responsible for ensuring accurate project billing, collections, payments, payroll coordination, job costing, and financial reporting across multiple active projects.
The ideal candidate has experience in construction accounting and understands progress billing, retainage, change orders, subcontractor/vendor payments, project costs, and cash flow.
Responsibilities

Prepare and send client invoices based on project billing schedules, milestones, and approved change orders
Manage accounts receivable and actively follow up on outstanding payments
Process and track vendor and subcontractor invoices
Manage accounts payable and prepare payments for approval
Coordinate and maintain payroll, contractor payments, reimbursements, and related records
Maintain accurate job costing for labor, materials, subcontractors, equipment, freight, and other project expenses
Track deposits, retainage, stored materials, progress billings, and change orders
Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and financial transactions
Maintain accurate project financial information in QuickBooks and company management software
Ensure all transactions are properly categorized by project and cost code
Maintain WIP schedules and monitor project profitability
Prepare weekly cash flow, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and upcoming payment reports
Assist management with monthly P&L, balance sheet, project profitability, and financial reporting
Coordinate with project managers to ensure billing milestones are invoiced promptly
Maintain organized financial documentation for projects, vendors, subcontractors, and clients
Coordinate with the company’s CPA and outside accounting professionals as needed
Help establish and maintain strong financial controls and accounting procedures

Qualifications

3+ years of accounting or finance experience, preferably within the construction industry
Strong understanding of construction accounting, job costing, progress billing, retainage, A/R, and A/P
Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software
Experience processing or coordinating payroll
Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and financial priorities simultaneously
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Comfortable communicating directly with clients regarding invoices and collections
Experience with WIP reporting and construction financial reporting is highly preferred

Preferred Experience

Commercial construction or subcontractor accounting
AIA/progress billing
Change order tracking
Certified payroll
Construction ERP or project management software

This position will serve as a key financial point of control for Futura, helping ensure that projects are billed properly, collections stay current, expenses are accurately captured, and management has clear visibility into the financial performance of the company.

jobs.title: Controlling Professional
jobs.description:
Cómo será tu día

Como Factory Controller, trabajarás en el análisis, control y seguimiento de los costos de la fábrica, asegurando una lectura clara de los principales drivers del negocio y la correcta aplicación de los métodos de costeo definidos por la compañía. Tendrás una interacción constante con áreas operativas, financieras y de soporte para controlar costos fijos y variables, inventarios, CAPEX, rentabilidad por línea y procesos de cierre. Será una posición clave para generar visibilidad financiera, anticipar desviaciones y apoyar decisiones que impactan la eficiencia, competitividad y sostenibilidad de la operación.

Cuál es tu responsabilidad

Proyectar y controlar los principales elementos de la estructura de costos de la entidad, incluyendo costos administrativos, de producción y bases para el costeo estándar.
Controlar las notificaciones de producción, especialmente en procesos de metalmecánica, definiendo costos estándar y monitoreando over / under absorption.
Asegurar que las órdenes de fabricación sean notificadas y cerradas oportunamente para garantizar registros contables correctos durante el cierre comercial.
Preparar forecast de fábrica con base en pronósticos de notificaciones, evolución de costos, centros de costo y líneas de producto.
Mantener actualizados los precios estándar y estructuras de costos para asegurar tarifas de venta consistentes y confiables para los clientes.
Analizar variaciones en Change in Inventories, movimientos contables en SAP y transacciones de órdenes de producción para anticipar impactos financieros.
Identificar y analizar la rentabilidad por línea de producto, examinando movimientos atípicos y variaciones relevantes en profit.
Planificar, monitorear y controlar costos fijos e indirectos de fábrica, incluyendo license fees, infra costs y otros acuerdos con terceros o compañías asociadas.
Gestionar y controlar inversiones CAPEX de acuerdo con lineamientos corporativos y necesidades operativas, incluyendo control de activos, registro contable y coordinación con tesorería.
Analizar costos de no conformidad, provisiones, inventarios, costos y activos, preparando conciliaciones e informes confiables para stakeholders internos.
Cumplir y promover lineamientos de calidad, EHS y seguridad física aplicables al rol, escalando desviaciones críticas y soportando una operación segura y controlada.

Cuáles son los requisitos para el cargo

Profesional en Contabilidad, Finanzas, Ingenierías, Administración de Empresas o áreas afines; deseable especialización o certificaciones en costos, finanzas, controlling o campos relacionados.
Más de 2 años de experiencia en áreas de control de negocio, control de costos, controlling financiero o roles similares; deseable experiencia en procesos productivos o industriales.
Conocimientos en métodos de costeo, contabilidad, costos estándar, inventarios, CAPEX, provisiones, cierre financiero y análisis de rentabilidad.
Manejo de SAP y herramientas Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel; deseable experiencia con Power BI, Tableau o Alteryx para análisis y visualización de información.
Inglés intermedio.
Competencias: orientación al resultado, pensamiento analítico, criterio financiero, colaboración, comunicación efectiva, autonomía, proactividad y capacidad para trabajar con equipos multifuncionales.

Acerca del equipo

Formarás parte del equipo de Performance & Factory Controlling de la fábrica de transformadores ubicada en Tenjo, Cundinamarca. Este equipo es responsable de la planificación, análisis y control financiero de la operación, asegurando que la organización cuente con información precisa y oportuna para cumplir sus objetivos estratégicos y operativos.

El equipo de Controlling se enfoca en el análisis de costos, presupuestos, pronósticos, productividad, indicadores clave de rendimiento y mejora continua de procesos. Trabajamos de manera cercana con producción, supply chain, contabilidad, compras, proyectos y otras áreas del negocio para fortalecer la toma de decisiones y contribuir a una operación más eficiente y competitiva.

¿Qué es Siemens Energy?

En Siemens Energy somos más que una empresa de tecnología energética. Satisfacemos la creciente demanda de energía en más de 90 países, al mismo tiempo que garantizamos la protección de nuestro clima. Con más de 92 000 empleados, no solo generamos electricidad para más del 16 % de la comunidad mundial, sino que también usamos nuestra tecnología para ayudar a proteger a las personas y al medio ambiente.

Nuestro equipo global está comprometido a hacer realidad la energía sostenible, fiable y asequible al ampliar los límites de lo que es posible. Mantenemos un legado de innovación de 150 años que fomenta nuestra búsqueda de personas que respalden nuestro enfoque en la descarbonización, las nuevas tecnologías y la transformación energética.

Nuestro compromiso con la diversidad

Por suerte para nosotros, no todos somos iguales. Generamos energía a través de la diversidad. Nos basamos en la inclusión y la combinación de nuestra energía creativa se nutre de más de 130 nacionalidades. Siemens Energy celebra el carácter, sin importar el origen étnico, el género, la edad, la religión, la identidad o la discapacidad. Dinamizamos a toda la sociedad y no discriminamos por nuestras diferencias.

Medicina Prepagada al 100% para el colaborador y 25% para el cónyuge.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Job Description

As a Senior Accountant, you will maintain financial records and ensure that financial transactions are properly recorded. You will maintain the accuracy of entries to ledger accounts and reconcile subsidiary ledger accounts to the general ledger. You will prepare complex balance sheets, profit and loss statements and other financial reports. You will analyze current costs, revenues, financial commitments, and obligations incurred to predict future revenues and expenses. You may guide lower-level accountants.

Responsibilities

Prepares journal entries, analyzes accounts, prepares statements, and assists accounting manager with monthly closing and accounting reports.
Compiles and analyzes financial information to prepare entries for accounts, including general ledger and document business transactions.
Maintains and coordinates implementation of accounting and control procedures.
Resolves and corrects billing, inventory, costing, and other accounting discrepancies.
Prepares documentation of processes and procedures and recommends improvements.
Prepares general ledger account reconciliations.

jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Business Operations Specialist – Cloud
who will drive cloud financial management, cost analysis, and optimization across the Media cluster, supporting FinOps delivery in close partnership with Finance and Technology teams.

Key Responsibilities

FinOps Delivery Support & Media Cluster Partnership: Work in close partnership with the central FinOps team to support FinOps activities related to the Media cluster. Provide Finance execution support where capacity is constrained and act as a consistent Finance point-of-contact for Media cloud cost topics.
Cloud Spend Analysis & Financial Insight: Analyse Media cloud spend to identify key cost drivers, trends, and variances. Support the improvement of cost attribution (e.g., allocation, tagging quality, cost centre alignment) to increase transparency and translate cloud cost data into clear financial insights for Finance and Technology stakeholders.
Cloud Cost Optimisation Support: Collaborate with FinOps, Tech Ops, and Global Product teams to identify and validate cloud cost optimisation opportunities. Assist in defining baselines, estimating savings, tracking delivery, and maintaining visibility of optimisation activities, risks, and realised benefits.
Forecasting, Budgeting & Actuals Support: Support budgeting, forecasting, and actuals variance tracking for Media cloud spend, ensuring accurate alignment between operational consumption and financial planning.
Reporting, Governance & Continuous Improvement: Support the production of consistent, Finance-quality reporting and showback information for Media stakeholders. Ensure appropriate documentation and audit trails in line with WPP Finance policies, while contributing to the refinement of FinOps trackers, templates, and ways of working between Finance, FinOps, and Technology teams.

Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:

3+ years of experience in IT Finance or Tech Finance as a Financial Analyst with strong skills in cost analysis, modeling,variance explanation and IT Budgeting experience is a MUST.
Bachelor's degree is a must
Advanced English level (Written & speaking) (this will be assess during the interview process)
Advanced Excel proficiency (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, complex data analysis); exposure to Microsoft Copilot or AI tools is a plus.
Experience with ERPs and CRMS.
Understanding of Cloud costs & FinOps concepts (or a strong learning mindset) to analyze consumption-based spend, challenge data, and identify savings.
Experience in large, complex matrix organizations or global tech/services companies, collaborating across international regions.
Self-driven & proactive mindset with the ability to work independently, reach out to stakeholders to ask the right questions, and bring structure to financial data.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

jobs.description:
This role is with KLG, a global leader in international education. KLG is now owned by Inspirit Capital and continues to deliver world-class educational experiences through its international network of schools and university partners.

Kaplan Languages Group (KLG) is a world-class language education platform operating over 20 schools across 8 countries. We deliver premium academic, professional, and language travel programmes to students from over 140 countries. At KLG, we combine education with financial excellence to support our international growth.

Job Description

Key responsibilities

Support payroll processing across assigned countries, entities, and payroll cycles in line with agreed calendars and deadlines.
Collect payroll inputs from the HRIS and business teams, including new hires, leavers, salary changes, variable payments, benefits, deductions, leave, and other employee changes.
Extract, clean, validate, and format employee and payroll data from multiple sources into templates required by ADP Celergo and other payroll providers.
Upload or submit accurate payroll input files and complete pre-processing checks before payroll cut-off dates.
Review payroll outputs against source data, prior periods, and agreed control totals; investigate discrepancies and escalate material issues promptly.
Support off-cycle payments, corrections, and retroactive adjustments under the direction of the Global Payroll Manager.
Use Excel to organize and analyze large data sets, including lookups, formulas, pivot tables, and data validation tools.
Respond to routine payroll queries clearly and professionally, referring complex, sensitive, or technical matters to the Global Payroll Manager.
Build effective working relationships across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Qualifications

Essential

1+ (Junior Level) years of experience with Payroll processes.
C1+ Level of English. Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to work effectively with international colleagues and providers.
Practical payroll processing or payroll administration experience, with a sound understanding of payroll inputs, outputs, deadlines, and reconciliations.
Strong Excel and data manipulation skills, including the ability to extract, clean, compare, validate, and format data from multiple sources.
High level of accuracy, numeracy, and attention to detail when working with sensitive, high-volume data.
Ability to learn new payroll and HR systems quickly and follow structured processes and controls.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities within fixed deadlines.

Desirable

Experience in a multinational, shared services, or multi-entity environment.
Experience using ADP Celergo, another ADP payroll product, HiBob or a comparable HR/payroll platform.
Experience working with outsourced payroll providers or preparing payroll input files for third-party processing.
Exposure to payroll-to-finance reconciliations, journals, funding reports, or payroll implementation projects.
A relevant technical, professional, or university qualification in payroll, accounting, finance, business administration, or human resources

Estudiantes de último semestre, en proceso de grado o egresados de la carrera en Contaduría Pública.
Experiencia mínima de 1 a 2 años en cumplimiento tributario, con conocimiento en:
Revisión y preparación de declaraciones de renta.
Retención en la fuente.
IVA e ICA.
Impuesto diferido.
Elaboración de conceptos tributarios.
Revisión y preparación de solicitudes de devoluciones y saldos a favor de IVA y renta.

jobs.description:
En Bia ya gestionamos la energía de más de 3.700 empresas en Latam. Y apenas estamos empezando. Si estás buscando más que un trabajo y quieres ser parte del equipo que está revolucionando el sector energético, llegaste al lugar correcto

El desafío que vas a resolver:

Buscamos un/a Analista de Liquidaciones de Energía con conocimiento del sector eléctrico colombiano, capacidad analítica y una obsesión genuina por el detalle. Alguien que no se limite a identificar diferencias, sino que investigue sus causas, movilice a los actores involucrados y asegure su corrección.
Serás responsable de ejecutar y sostener el ciclo mensual de conciliación de los diferentes componentes de la cadena de energía. Validarás que los valores cobrados por los operadores de red, reportados a XM y facturados a nuestros usuarios sean consistentes.
Tu trabajo será clave para detectar desviaciones, cuantificar su impacto financiero y gestionar su solución. También aportarás tu conocimiento del sector para fortalecer los controles, documentar los procesos y acelerar la automatización de las liquidaciones en Bia.

Lo que harás:

Validar mensualmente los formatos TC1 emitidos por los operadores de red, conciliando el nivel de tensión y la propiedad de los activos frente a lo facturado en cada frontera.
Calcular las tarifas de SDL y los cargos de STR por operador de red, utilizando los insumos publicados por XM.
Conciliar energía activa y reactiva, factor M, niveles de tensión, propiedad de activos y tarifas entre las preliquidaciones de los operadores, los reportes a XM y la facturación al usuario.
Validar las preliquidaciones de COT y asegurar que la energía y las tarifas cobradas correspondan con lo trasladado al usuario final.
Gestionar el ciclo de compensaciones por calidad del servicio, desde la revisión de la liquidación hasta su reconocimiento al usuario.
Analizar los balances de energía y gestionar la aceptación, corrección o rechazo de las diferencias identificadas.
Elaborar los cierres mensuales de pérdidas, provisiones y compensaciones.
Hacer seguimiento a los indicadores de desviación en los reportes de energía a XM y cuantificar su impacto financiero.
Sustentar y gestionar reclamaciones ante los operadores de red, haciendo seguimiento hasta comprobar la aplicación efectiva de los ajustes.
Trabajar con diferentes áreas de Bia para identificar las causas raíz de las diferencias e implementar controles que eviten su recurrencia.
Participar en el levantamiento, documentación y validación de nuevos rubros de la cadena de energía.
Validar los resultados de las automatizaciones del área antes de su salida a producción e identificar oportunidades para hacer los procesos más rápidos, precisos y escalables.

Para el desarrollo del rol necesitaras:

Ser profesional en Economía, Contabilidad, Finanzas, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería o carreras afines.
Contar con entre 1 a 2 años de experiencia en el sector eléctrico colombiano
, específicamente en procesos de liquidación, facturación, conciliación de cargos o mercado de energía.
Haber tenido relacionamiento con operadores de red y/o XM.
Conocer los procesos y conceptos asociados con SDL, STR, balances de energía, pérdidas, compensaciones, energía activa y reactiva.
Tener capacidad para trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información e identificar desviaciones con impacto operativo o financiero.
Manejar Excel avanzado.
Tener conocimientos de SQL y/o Python para consultar información, validar cálculos y automatizar procesos.
Contar con una alta atención al detalle, capacidad de análisis, comunicación asertiva y criterio para priorizar.

Bienvenido a Gallagher, una comunidad global de personas que aportan ideas audaces, una profunda experiencia y un compromiso compartido con hacer lo correcto. En Gallagher, encontrarás más que un empleo; encontrarás una cultura basada en la confianza, impulsada por la colaboración y sostenida por la creencia de que somos mejores juntos. Ya sea que te unas a nosotros en un rol de atención al cliente, en nuestra división de corretaje, en nuestra división de beneficios y consultoría de recursos humanos, o como parte de nuestro equipo corporativo, tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollar tu carrera, generar un impacto y formar parte de algo más grande. Vive una experiencia laboral donde se te anima a ser tú mismo, se te apoya para tener éxito y se te inspira a seguir aprendiendo. Eso es vivir el Gallagher Way.

Descripción

En este rol, vas a apoyar la gestión integral del ciclo de nómina de GCoE Latam, con foco en Colombia. Trabajarás en la revisión, validación, control y trazabilidad de la información que impacta pagos, novedades, liquidaciones y obligaciones laborales.

También vas a coordinarte con áreas internas y proveedores externos para que cada etapa del proceso avance a tiempo y con precisión. Si te interesa un entorno donde el servicio, la confidencialidad y el cumplimiento legal son clave, esta puede ser una buena oportunidad para ti.

Cómo lograrás un impacto

Vas a atender solicitudes y consultas relacionadas con nómina, dando seguimiento oportuno a colaboradores, líderes y equipos internos. Además, coordinarás el calendario del proceso, desde las fechas de corte y entrega de insumos hasta la revisión, aprobación y pago, asegurando que cada parte del ciclo avance según lo previsto.

Tu trabajo también incluirá registrar, validar y cargar información en los sistemas y plantillas definidas, revisar la nómina procesada, identificar diferencias y corregir inconsistencias antes de la aprobación. A esto se suma la gestión de pagos asociados a seguridad social, obligaciones laborales y otros conceptos relacionados, junto con la administración de soportes para retiros, liquidaciones y cierres administrativos.

Revisarás y reconciliarás la nómina para detectar variaciones o errores antes del pago.
Coordinarás aprobaciones con los niveles de autorización definidos por la compañía.
Elaborarás informes, soportes y evidencias para auditorías, controles internos y decisiones del área.
Harás seguimiento al cumplimiento de lineamientos legales y de confidencialidad.
Mantendrás la trazabilidad de la información a lo largo de todo el proceso.

Acerca de ti

Profesional en Contaduría Pública, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía, Finanzas o carreras afines.
Entre 4 y 5 años de experiencia en nómina colombiana, incluyendo procesamiento y validación de novedades, revisión y auditoría, liquidaciones laborales, seguridad social y nómina electrónica.
Experiencia atendiendo consultas técnicas y analizando bases de datos relacionadas con nómina.
Manejo de Excel en nivel intermedio a avanzado.
